-- [[ read-only option state ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules options
local Options = {}
local utils, config
function Options.setup(deps)
  utils, config = deps.Utils, deps.Config
  return true
end
function Options.get(key)
  assert(config.hasKey(key), "Unknown option: " .. tostring(key))
  return utils.getConfigValue(key)
end
function Options.isEnabled(key) return Options.get(key) == true end
function Options.describe(key)
  local descriptor = config.describe(key)
  if not descriptor then
    return nil
  end
  if table.isfrozen(descriptor) then
    return descriptor
  end
  if descriptor.constraints then
    if descriptor.constraints.choices and not table.isfrozen(descriptor.constraints.choices) then
      table.freeze(descriptor.constraints.choices)
    end
    if not table.isfrozen(descriptor.constraints) then
      table.freeze(descriptor.constraints)
    end
  end
  return table.freeze(descriptor)
end
function Options.observe(keys, callback)
  assert(type(callback) == "function", "Option observer required")
  keys = type(keys) == "string" and { keys } or keys
  assert(type(keys) == "table" and #keys > 0, "Option keys required")
  local selected = {}
  for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
    assert(config.hasKey(key), "Unknown option: " .. tostring(key))
    selected[key] = true
  end
  return utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(changes) do
      if selected[key] then
        result[key] = value
      end
    end
    if next(result) then
      callback(table.freeze(result))
    end
  end)
end
Options.__contract = {
  access = { default = "internal.read" },
  provides = { "setup", "get", "isEnabled", "describe", "observe" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Config = "config" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getConfigValue", "observeConfig" }, Config = { "describe", "hasKey" } },
}
return Options

-- [[ configuration persistence and recovery ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules persistence

-- code
local Persistence = {}
function Persistence.setup() return true end
local function createStore(deps)
  local store = {}
  local state, CONFIG, http = deps.state, deps.config, game:GetService("HttpService")
  local savePending, saveToken, saveDirty, saveRevision, persistenceReady = false, 0, false, 0, false
  function store.ensureDataFolder()
    if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
      error("API externa ausente: makefolder", 2)
    end
    if type(isfolder) ~= "function" then
      error("API externa ausente: isfolder", 2)
    end
    local current = ""
    for part in CONFIG.FOLDER:gmatch("[^/]+") do
      current = current == "" and part or current .. "/" .. part
      if not isfolder(current) then
        makefolder(current)
      end
    end
    return true, CONFIG.FOLDER
  end
  local function isPersistentConfigKey(key)
    if key == "AutoExecuteOnJoin" or key == "AutoExecuteAllGames" then
      return false
    end
    local config = deps.getConfigModule()
    local descriptor = config and config.describe(key)
    return type(key) == "string" and descriptor ~= nil and descriptor.scope == deps.scope and config.isPersistentKey(key)
  end
  local function serializeConfig(config)
    local data = {}
    for key, value in pairs(config) do
      if isPersistentConfigKey(key) then
        if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
          data[key] = value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode and { keyCode = value.Name } or { mouseButton = value.Name }
        else
          data[key] = value
        end
      end
    end
    return http:JSONEncode({ format = 2, scope = deps.scope, values = data })
  end
  local function persistenceAvailable()
    return type(isfile) == "function"
      and type(readfile) == "function"
      and type(writefile) == "function"
      and type(isfolder) == "function"
      and type(makefolder) == "function"
  end
  local function decodeKeyCode(value)
    if type(value) == "table" and type(value.mouseButton) == "string" then
      local buttons = {
        MouseButton1 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
        MouseButton2 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
        MouseButton3 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,
      }

      return buttons[value.mouseButton]
    end
    if type(value) ~= "table" or type(value.keyCode) ~= "string" then
      return value
    end
    local name = value.keyCode
    local ok, keyCode = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
    if ok and keyCode then
      return keyCode
    end
    warn("Config ignorada: KeyCode inválido " .. tostring(name))
    return nil
  end
  local function migrateConfig(data)
    local migrated = deps.migrate and deps.migrate(data) or false
    local patch = {}
    for key, value in pairs(data) do
      if not isPersistentConfigKey(key) then
        migrated = true
      else
        value = decodeKeyCode(value)
        if value ~= nil then
          local valid, reason = deps.getConfigModule().validatePatch({ [key] = value })
          if valid then
            patch[key] = value
          else
            warn("Config ignorada: " .. tostring(reason))
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return patch, migrated
  end
  local function readSavedConfig(path)
    local checked, exists = pcall(isfile, path)
    if not checked then
      return nil, nil, "inaccessible"
    end
    if not exists then
      return nil, nil, "missing"
    end
    local readOk, raw = pcall(readfile, path)
    if not readOk or type(raw) ~= "string" then
      return nil, nil, "inaccessible"
    end
    local decoded, data = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not decoded or type(data) ~= "table" or next(data) == nil then
      return nil, nil, "invalid"
    end
    if data.format == 2 and type(data.values) == "table" then
      if data.scope ~= deps.scope then
        return nil, nil, "foreign"
      end
      return raw, data.values, "valid", true
    end
    return raw, data, "valid", false
  end
  local function writeVerified(path, body)
    local ok = pcall(writefile, path, body)
    if not ok then
      return false
    end
    local raw = readSavedConfig(path)
    return raw == body
  end
  local function backupPath(folder, index) return folder .. "/config_backup_" .. index .. ".json" end
  local function backupAtStartup(folder, body)
    for index = 5, 2, -1 do
      local old = readSavedConfig(backupPath(folder, index - 1))
      if old and not writeVerified(backupPath(folder, index), old) then
        return false
      end
    end
    return writeVerified(backupPath(folder, 1), body)
  end
  local function writeConfig()
    if not persistenceReady or not saveDirty then
      return
    end
    local revision = saveRevision
    local _, folder = store.ensureDataFolder()
    local path = folder .. "/config.json"
    local body = serializeConfig(state.config)
    local decoded, data = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(body) end)
    if not decoded or type(data) ~= "table" or next(data) == nil then
      warn("Configuração vazia ou inválida; arquivo anterior preservado")
      return
    end
    local previous, _, status = readSavedConfig(path)
    if status == "inaccessible" then
      warn("Configuração inacessível; salvamento suspenso")
      return
    end
    if status == "invalid" then
      warn("Configuração inválida; salvamento suspenso para evitar perda")
      return
    end
    if previous == body then
      if saveRevision == revision then
        saveDirty = false
      end
      return
    end
    if previous and not writeVerified(folder .. "/config_recovery.json", previous) then
      warn("Falha ao proteger configuração anterior; salvamento suspenso")
      return
    end
    if not previous then
      local recovery, _, recoveryStatus = readSavedConfig(folder .. "/config_recovery.json")
      if not recovery and recoveryStatus ~= "missing" then
        warn("Backup de recuperação inacessível ou inválido; salvamento suspenso")
        return
      end
      if not recovery and not writeVerified(folder .. "/config_recovery.json", body) then
        warn("Falha ao criar proteção inicial; salvamento suspenso")
        return
      end
    end
    if not writeVerified(path, body) then
      warn("Falha ao salvar configuração; cópia anterior preservada")
      return
    end
    if saveRevision == revision then
      saveDirty = false
    end
  end
  local saveRunning = false
  local queueSave
  local function saveConfig()
    if saveRunning then
      return
    end
    saveRunning = true
    local revision = saveRevision
    local ok, reason = pcall(writeConfig)
    saveRunning = false
    if not ok then
      warn("Falha ao salvar configuração: " .. tostring(reason))
    end
    if saveDirty and saveRevision ~= revision and persistenceReady then
      queueSave()
    end
  end
  queueSave = function()
    if not persistenceReady then
      return
    end
    saveDirty = true
    saveRevision += 1
    if savePending then
      return
    end
    savePending = true
    saveToken += 1
    local token = saveToken
    task.delay(0.25, function()
      if token ~= saveToken then
        return
      end
      savePending = false
      saveConfig()
    end)
  end
  local function flushSave()
    saveToken += 1
    savePending = false
    saveConfig()
  end
  function store.load()
    if not persistenceAvailable() then
      warn("Persistência indisponível; usando configuração da sessão")
      return true
    end
    local ok, folder = pcall(function()
      local _, path = store.ensureDataFolder()
      return path
    end)
    if not ok then
      warn("Persistência indisponível: " .. tostring(folder))
      return true
    end
    local path = folder .. "/config.json"
    local raw, data, status, formatted = readSavedConfig(path)
    local imported = false
    if status == "missing" then
      for _, legacy in ipairs(deps.legacyPaths or {}) do
        local old, values, _, oldFormat = readSavedConfig(legacy)
        if old and not oldFormat then
          raw, data, imported = old, values, true
          break
        end
      end
    end
    local recovered, anyStored = false, status ~= "missing"
    if not raw then
      for index = 0, 5 do
        local backup = index == 0 and (folder .. "/config_recovery.json") or backupPath(folder, index)
        local saved, value, backupStatus, backupFormat = readSavedConfig(backup)
        if backupStatus ~= "missing" then
          anyStored = true
        end
        if saved then
          raw, data, recovered, formatted = saved, value, true, backupFormat
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if not raw then
      if anyStored then
        warn("Nenhuma configuração válida pôde ser recuperada; salvamento suspenso para preservar os arquivos")
        return true
      end
      persistenceReady = true
      return true
    end
    if raw and not formatted and deps.scope == "hub" then
      local archive = CONFIG.FOLDER .. "/legacy_config.json"
      local existsOk, exists = pcall(isfile, archive)
      if not existsOk or not exists and not writeVerified(archive, raw) then
        local patch = migrateConfig(data)
        deps.setConfig(patch)
        warn("Migração suspensa: não foi possível proteger a configuração antiga")
        return true
      end
    end
    if recovered or imported then
      if status == "inaccessible" then
        warn("Configuração recuperada em memória; arquivo principal inacessível, salvamento suspenso")
        local patch = migrateConfig(data)
        deps.setConfig(patch)
        return true
      end
      if not writeVerified(path, raw) then
        warn("Configuração recuperada em memória; falha ao restaurar arquivo, salvamento suspenso")
        local patch = migrateConfig(data)
        deps.setConfig(patch)
        return true
      end
      warn("Configuração restaurada de um backup")
    end
    if not backupAtStartup(folder, raw) then
      warn("Falha ao criar backup de entrada; salvamento suspenso")
      local patch = migrateConfig(data)
      deps.setConfig(patch)
      return true
    end
    if not writeVerified(folder .. "/config_recovery.json", raw) then
      warn("Falha ao preparar recuperação; salvamento suspenso")
      local patch = migrateConfig(data)
      deps.setConfig(patch)
      return true
    end
    local patch, migrated = migrateConfig(data)
    deps.setConfig(patch)
    persistenceReady = true
    if migrated or imported or not formatted then
      queueSave()
    end
    return true
  end
  store.isPersistentKey = isPersistentConfigKey
  store.queue = queueSave
  store.flush = flushSave
  function store.stop()
    flushSave()
    persistenceReady, saveDirty = false, false
    saveToken += 1
    savePending = false
  end
  return store
end
function Persistence.create(deps)
  local config = deps.config
  local shared = table.clone(deps)
  shared.config = table.clone(config)
  shared.config.FOLDER = "Exodus Hub"
  shared.scope = "hub"
  shared.legacyPaths = { config.LEGACY_FOLDER .. "/config.json" }
  local stores = { createStore(shared) }
  if config.PROFILE ~= "universal" then
    local owned = table.clone(deps)
    owned.config = table.clone(config)
    owned.config.FOLDER = "Exodus Hub/hubs/" .. config.PROFILE
    owned.scope = config.PROFILE
    owned.legacyPaths = { "Exodus Hub/legacy_config.json", "Exodus Hub/config.json" }
    stores[#stores + 1] = createStore(owned)
  end
  local store = {}
  function store.ensureDataFolder() return stores[1].ensureDataFolder() end
  function store.isPersistentKey(key)
    for _, scoped in ipairs(stores) do
      if scoped.isPersistentKey(key) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function store.load()
    for _, scoped in ipairs(stores) do
      scoped.load()
    end
    return true
  end
  function store.queue(changes)
    for _, scoped in ipairs(stores) do
      local relevant = changes == nil
      for key in pairs(changes or {}) do
        relevant = relevant or scoped.isPersistentKey(key)
      end
      if relevant then
        scoped.queue()
      end
    end
  end
  for _, method in ipairs({ "flush", "stop" }) do
    store[method] = function()
      for _, scoped in ipairs(stores) do
        scoped[method]()
      end
    end
  end
  return store
end
Persistence.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create" } }

return Persistence

-- [[ config ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules config

-- module
local Config = {}
local Registry = {}
local Keys = {}
local SessionOnly = {}
local Owners, Scopes, Constraints = {}, {}, {}
local ResolvedDefaults

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  RATE_MIN = 0,
  DELAY_MIN = 0,
  DELAY_MAX = 5,
  DELAY_MS_MAX = 400,
  POSITION_MIN = -10000,
  POSITION_MAX = 10000,
  ERRORS = {
    boolean = "flag inválida: %s",
    rate = "taxa inválida: %s",
    delay = "atraso inválido: %s",
    delayMs = "tempo inválido: %s",
    position = "posição inválida: %s",
    keyCode = "keybind inválido: %s",
    miniScale = "tamanho da Mini UI inválido",
  },
}

-- validation
local function isFiniteNumber(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value < math.huge and value > -math.huge end
local function validKeyCode(value)
  return typeof(value) == "EnumItem"
    and (
      value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode
      or value == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or value == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
      or value == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
    )
end
local validationErrors = CONFIG.ERRORS
local validators = {
  text = function(value) return type(value) == "string" and #value <= 256 end,
  boolean = function(value) return type(value) == "boolean" end,
  rate = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.RATE_MIN end,
  delay = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.DELAY_MIN and value <= CONFIG.DELAY_MAX end,
  delayMs = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.DELAY_MIN and value <= CONFIG.DELAY_MS_MAX end,
  position = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.POSITION_MIN and value <= CONFIG.POSITION_MAX end,
  keyCode = validKeyCode,
  miniScale = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= 0.5 and value <= 2 end,

}

local function validateValue(key, kind, value, constraints)
  local validator = validators[kind]
  if validator and validator(value) then
    local bounds = constraints or Constraints[key]
    if not bounds then
      return true
    end
    if (bounds.min and value < bounds.min) or (bounds.max and value > bounds.max) then
      return false, "valor fora do intervalo: " .. key
    end
    if bounds.choices and not table.find(bounds.choices, value) then
      return false, "opção inválida: " .. key
    end
    return true
  end
  local message = validationErrors[kind] or "valor inválido: %s"
  return false, message:find("%s", 1, true) and message:format(key) or message
end
local function copy(source)
  local result = {}
  for key, value in pairs(source or {}) do
    result[key] = value
  end
  return result
end

-- registration
function Config.reset()
  table.clear(Registry)
  table.clear(Keys)
  table.clear(SessionOnly)
  table.clear(Owners)
  table.clear(Scopes)
  table.clear(Constraints)
  ResolvedDefaults = nil
end
function Config.register(name, definition, scope)
  if Registry[name] then
    return false, "configuration already registered: " .. tostring(name)
  end
  if type(name) ~= "string" or type(definition) ~= "table" then
    return false, "invalid configuration definition"
  end
  if definition.resolveDefaults ~= nil and type(definition.resolveDefaults) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  if definition.persistent ~= nil and type(definition.persistent) ~= "boolean" and type(definition.persistent) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  if definition.constraints ~= nil and type(definition.constraints) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  if definition.schema ~= nil and type(definition.schema) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  if definition.defaults ~= nil and type(definition.defaults) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  for field in pairs(definition) do
    if not ({ schema = true, defaults = true, persistent = true, constraints = true, resolveDefaults = true, legacy = true })[field] then
      return false
    end
  end
  local schema = type(definition.schema) == "table" and definition.schema or {}
  local defaults = type(definition.defaults) == "table" and definition.defaults or {}
  if type(definition.persistent) == "table" then
    for key, value in pairs(definition.persistent) do
      if not schema[key] or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  for key, kind in pairs(schema) do
    if type(key) ~= "string" or not validators[kind] or Keys[key] then
      return false
    end
  end
  for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
    local kind = schema[key]
    if not kind or not validateValue(key, kind, value) then
      return false
    end
  end
  local constraints = definition.constraints or {}
  for key, bounds in pairs(constraints) do
    if not schema[key] or type(bounds) ~= "table" then
      return false
    end
    if bounds.min ~= nil and not isFiniteNumber(bounds.min) then
      return false
    end
    if bounds.max ~= nil and not isFiniteNumber(bounds.max) then
      return false
    end
    if (bounds.min or bounds.max) and schema[key] ~= "rate" and schema[key] ~= "position" and schema[key] ~= "miniScale" then
      return false
    end
    if bounds.min and bounds.max and bounds.min > bounds.max then
      return false
    end
    if bounds.choices ~= nil then
      if type(bounds.choices) ~= "table" or #bounds.choices == 0 then
        return false
      end
      for _, value in ipairs(bounds.choices) do
        if not validateValue(key, schema[key], value) then
          return false
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
    if not validateValue(key, schema[key], value, constraints[key]) then
      return false
    end
  end
  for key, kind in pairs(schema) do
    local bounds = constraints[key]
    if bounds then
      Constraints[key] = { min = bounds.min, max = bounds.max, choices = bounds.choices and table.clone(bounds.choices) }
    end
    Keys[key], Owners[key], Scopes[key] = kind, name, scope or "hub"
    SessionOnly[key] = definition.persistent == false or type(definition.persistent) == "table" and definition.persistent[key] == false
  end
  ResolvedDefaults = nil
  Registry[name] = {
    schema = copy(schema),
    defaults = copy(defaults),
    resolveDefaults = definition.resolveDefaults,
    persistent = type(definition.persistent) == "table" and copy(definition.persistent) or definition.persistent ~= false,
  }
  return true
end

-- defaults
function Config.defaults(context)
  if ResolvedDefaults then
    return copy(ResolvedDefaults)
  end
  local result = {}
  for _, definition in pairs(Registry) do
    for key, value in pairs(definition.defaults) do
      result[key] = value
    end
    if definition.resolveDefaults then
      local values = definition.resolveDefaults(context)
      for key, value in pairs(values) do
        assert(definition.schema[key] and validateValue(key, definition.schema[key], value), "Invalid dynamic default: " .. key)
        result[key] = value
      end
    end
  end
  for key, value in pairs(context and context.profile and context.profile.defaults or {}) do
    assert(Keys[key] and validateValue(key, Keys[key], value), "Invalid game default: " .. tostring(key))
    result[key] = value
  end
  ResolvedDefaults = copy(result)
  return result
end

-- validation-api
function Config.validatePatch(patch)
  if type(patch) ~= "table" then
    return false, "configuração não é uma tabela"
  end
  for key, value in pairs(patch) do
    local kind = Keys[key]
    if not kind then
      return false, "chave de configuração desconhecida: " .. tostring(key)
    end
    local ok, reason = validateValue(key, kind, value)
    if not ok then
      return false, reason
    end
  end
  return true
end
function Config.normalizePatch(patch)
  local ok, reason = Config.validatePatch(patch)
  if not ok then
    return nil, reason
  end
  return copy(patch)
end
function Config.validate(config)
  if type(config) ~= "table" then
    return false, "configuração não é uma tabela"
  end
  local ok, reason = Config.validatePatch(config)
  if not ok then
    return false, reason
  end
  return true
end

-- public-api
function Config.hasKey(key) return Keys[key] ~= nil end
function Config.isPersistentKey(key) return Keys[key] ~= nil and not SessionOnly[key] end
function Config.describe(key)
  if not Keys[key] then
    return nil
  end
  return {
    kind = Keys[key],
    owner = Owners[key],
    scope = Scopes[key],
    persistent = not SessionOnly[key],
    default = ResolvedDefaults and ResolvedDefaults[key],
    constraints = Constraints[key]
      and { min = Constraints[key].min, max = Constraints[key].max, choices = Constraints[key].choices and table.clone(Constraints[key].choices) },
  }
end
function Config.getRegistry()
  local result = {}
  for name, definition in pairs(Registry) do
    result[name] = {
      schema = copy(definition.schema),
      defaults = copy(definition.defaults),
      persistent = type(definition.persistent) == "table" and copy(definition.persistent) or definition.persistent,
    }
  end
  return result
end

-- contract
Config.__contract = {
  access = {
    default = "internal.read",
    methods = { register = "infrastructure.write", reset = "infrastructure.write" },
  },
  provides = { "reset", "register", "defaults", "validate", "validatePatch", "normalizePatch", "getRegistry", "isPersistentKey", "describe", "hasKey" },
  requires = {},
}

return Config

--!optimize 2
-- @modules diagnostics

local Diagnostics = {}
function Diagnostics.setup() return true end
function Diagnostics.create(deps)
  local collector = {}
  local state, CONFIG = deps.state, deps.config
  local snapshot, lifecycleSnapshot = deps.snapshot, deps.lifecycleSnapshot
  local refreshPending = false
  local function append(list, value)
    list[#list + 1] = value
    if #list > CONFIG.HISTORY_LIMIT then
      table.remove(list, 1)
    end
  end
  local function refreshNamespace() deps.refresh() end
  local function diagnosticsSnapshot(includeModules)
    local statuses = {}
    local source = deps.getModules().status
    if includeModules ~= false and type(source) == "table" and type(source.collect) == "function" then
      local ok, result = pcall(source.collect)
      if ok and type(result) == "table" then
        statuses = snapshot(result)
      end
    end
    local diagnostics = state.diagnostics
    return {
      schema = CONFIG.API_VERSION,
      generatedAt = os.clock(),
      lastError = snapshot(diagnostics.lastError),
      lastTransition = snapshot(diagnostics.lastTransition),
      lastTransitionAt = diagnostics.lastTransitionAt,
      errors = snapshot(diagnostics.errors),
      transitions = snapshot(diagnostics.transitions),
      lifecycle = lifecycleSnapshot(),
      runtime = {
        active = state.active,
      },
      modules = statuses,
    }
  end
  local function recordTransition(source, fromState, toState, reason)
    local item = {
      source = tostring(source or "Unknown"),
      from = tostring(fromState or ""),
      to = tostring(toState or ""),
      reason = tostring(reason or ""),
      at = os.clock(),
    }

    state.diagnostics.lastTransition, state.diagnostics.lastTransitionAt = item, item.at
    append(state.diagnostics.transitions, item)
    if state.active and not refreshPending then
      refreshPending = true
      local generation = state.lifecycle.generation
      task.delay(0.1, function()
        refreshPending = false
        if state.active and state.lifecycle.generation == generation then
          refreshNamespace()
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  function collector.recordError(source, message)
    source, message = tostring(source or "Unknown"), tostring(message or "")
    local previous = state.diagnostics.lastError
    if previous and previous.source == source and previous.message == message and os.clock() - previous.at < 1 then
      previous.count = (previous.count or 1) + 1
      return true
    end
    local item = { source = tostring(source or "Unknown"), message = tostring(message or ""), at = os.clock() }
    state.diagnostics.lastError = item
    append(state.diagnostics.errors, item)
    warn(("[%s] %s"):format(item.source, item.message))
    refreshNamespace()
    return true
  end
  collector.snapshot = diagnosticsSnapshot
  collector.recordTransition = recordTransition
  return collector
end
Diagnostics.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create" } }
return Diagnostics

--!optimize 2
-- @modules profiler

local Profiler = {}
local enabled = false
local samples = {}
local CONFIG = {
  LIMIT = 64,
}

local LIMIT = CONFIG.LIMIT
function Profiler.setup() return true end
function Profiler.setEnabled(value)
  enabled = value == true
  table.clear(samples)
end
function Profiler.isEnabled() return enabled end
function Profiler.begin(name)
  if not enabled then
    return nil
  end
  if debug.profilebegin then
    debug.profilebegin(name)
  end
  return os.clock()
end
function Profiler.count(name, amount)
  if not enabled then
    return
  end
  local item = samples[name]
  if not item then
    local size = 0
    for _ in pairs(samples) do
      size += 1
    end
    if size >= LIMIT then
      return
    end
    item = { calls = 0, total = 0, maximum = 0 }
    samples[name] = item
  end
  item.calls += amount or 1
end
function Profiler.finish(name, started)
  if not started then
    return
  end
  if debug.profileend then
    debug.profileend()
  end
  if not enabled then
    return
  end
  local item = samples[name]
  if not item then
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(samples) do
      count += 1
    end
    if count >= LIMIT then
      return
    end
    item = { calls = 0, total = 0, maximum = 0 }
    samples[name] = item
  end
  local elapsed = os.clock() - started
  item.calls += 1
  item.total += elapsed
  item.maximum = math.max(item.maximum, elapsed)
end
function Profiler.getStatus()
  local result = {}
  for name, item in pairs(samples) do
    result[name] = table.clone(item)
  end
  return { enabled = enabled, samples = result }
end
function Profiler.teardown()
  enabled = false
  table.clear(samples)
end
Profiler.__contract = {
  access = {
    default = "diagnostics.write",
    methods = {
      getStatus = "internal.read",
      isEnabled = "internal.read",
      setEnabled = "infrastructure.write",
    },
  },
  requires = {},
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "isEnabled", "begin", "finish", "count", "getStatus" },
}
return Profiler

--!optimize 2
-- @modules status

local Status = {}
local active
function Status.setup() return true end
function Status.create(providers, reportError)
  local names, failures, reading = {}, {}, {}
  for name, provider in pairs(providers) do
    if type(provider) == "table" and type(provider.getStatus) == "function" then
      names[#names + 1] = name
    end
  end
  table.sort(names)
  local reader = {}
  function reader.get(name)
    local provider = providers[name]
    if reading[name] or type(provider) ~= "table" or type(provider.getStatus) ~= "function" then
      return nil
    end
    reading[name] = true
    local ok, value = pcall(provider.getStatus)
    reading[name] = nil
    if ok and type(value) == "table" then
      failures[name] = nil
      return value
    end
    if not failures[name] then
      failures[name] = true
      if type(reportError) == "function" then
        pcall(reportError, "Status", name .. ": " .. tostring(ok and "invalid status" or value))
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function reader.collect(selected)
    local result = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(selected or names) do
      local value = reader.get(name)
      if value then
        result[name] = value
      end
    end
    return result
  end
  return reader
end
function Status.configure(providers, reportError)
  if type(providers) ~= "table" then
    return false, "provedores de status inválidos"
  end
  active = Status.create(providers, reportError)
  return true
end
function Status.get(name) return active and active.get(name) or nil end
function Status.collect(selected) return active and active.collect(selected) or {} end
Status.__contract = {
  access = {
    default = "internal.read",
    methods = { configure = "infrastructure.write" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "create", "configure", "get", "collect" },
  requires = {},
}
return Status

--!optimize 2
-- @modules hubapi

local HubAPI = {}
local api = {}
local migrateUI
local boundary
function HubAPI.setup() return true end
function HubAPI.configure(loaded, scope)
  boundary = scope or loaded.gamescope.create(loaded, loaded.gamecontext.getProfile())
  api = loaded.gameruntime and loaded.gameruntime.createAPI(boundary.modules) or {}
  assert(type(api) == "table", "Game adapter must be a table")
  local functions = {
    getUIConfig = true,
    getAbilityAvailability = true,
    getChoices = true,
    getGameContext = true,
    observeAbilityMode = true,
    hasClashPrediction = true,
    resetState = true,
    observeState = true,
    getJumpButton = true,
    createActions = true,
    areAbilitiesEnabled = true,
    migrateConfig = true,
  }
  local tables = { controls = true, readouts = true, updateBlockers = true, miniVisibility = true }
  for name, value in pairs(api) do
    assert(functions[name] and type(value) == "function" or tables[name] and type(value) == "table", "Invalid game adapter field: " .. tostring(name))
  end
  local reserved = { onClose = true, onReload = true, onResetCharacter = true, onRejoin = true, onServerHop = true }
  for name, callback in pairs(api.controls or {}) do
    assert(type(name) == "string" and not reserved[name] and type(callback) == "function", "Invalid or reserved game control: " .. tostring(name))
  end
  boundary.validateKeys(api.miniVisibility or {})
  migrateUI = loaded.uiconfig and loaded.uiconfig.migrateConfig
  return true
end
function HubAPI.teardown()
  api, migrateUI, boundary = {}, nil, nil
  return true
end
function HubAPI.areAbilitiesEnabled() return api.areAbilitiesEnabled and api.areAbilitiesEnabled() or false end
function HubAPI.getAbilityAvailability(name)
  if api.getAbilityAvailability then
    return api.getAbilityAvailability(name)
  end
  return false, "Recurso indisponível neste jogo"
end
function HubAPI.getChoices(name) return api.getChoices and api.getChoices(name) or {} end
function HubAPI.getUIConfig() return boundary.definition(api.getUIConfig and api.getUIConfig() or {}, api.controls) end
function HubAPI.getGameContext() return api.getGameContext and api.getGameContext() or {} end
function HubAPI.observeAbilityMode(callback)
  if api.observeAbilityMode then
    return api.observeAbilityMode(callback)
  end
  return { Disconnect = function() end }
end
function HubAPI.hasClashPrediction() return api.hasClashPrediction and api.hasClashPrediction() or false end
function HubAPI.resetState()
  if api.resetState then
    api.resetState()
  end
end
function HubAPI.observeState(callback)
  if api.observeState then
    return api.observeState(callback)
  end
  return { Disconnect = function() end }
end
function HubAPI.getReadouts() return api.readouts or {} end
function HubAPI.getJumpButton() return api.getJumpButton and api.getJumpButton() end
function HubAPI.createActions(context)
  return boundary.actions(api.createActions and api.createActions(boundary.context(context, api.controls)) or {}, api.controls)
end
function HubAPI.getControls() return table.clone(api.controls or {}) end
function HubAPI.canUpdate()
  for _, blocked in ipairs(api.updateBlockers or {}) do
    local ok, value = pcall(blocked)
    if not ok then
      return false, tostring(value)
    end
    if value then
      return false, "Aguardando um estado seguro do jogo"
    end
  end
  return true
end
function HubAPI.getMiniVisibility()
  local result = {}
  for key, rule in pairs(api.miniVisibility or {}) do
    local ok, visible = pcall(rule)
    if ok then
      result[key] = visible == true
    end
  end
  return result
end
function HubAPI.migrateConfig(data)
  local changed = migrateUI and migrateUI(data) or false
  if api.migrateConfig then
    return boundary.migrate(data, api.migrateConfig) or changed
  end
  return changed
end
HubAPI.__contract = {
  access = {
    default = "internal.read",
    methods = {
      configure = "infrastructure.write",
      resetState = "combat.runtime",
      createActions = "game.inventory",
    },
  },
  provides = {
    "observeState",
    "getReadouts",
    "getJumpButton",
    "createActions",
    "getControls",
    "canUpdate",
    "getMiniVisibility",
    "migrateConfig",
    "setup",
    "configure",
    "teardown",
    "areAbilitiesEnabled",
    "getAbilityAvailability",
    "getUIConfig",
    "getChoices",
    "getGameContext",
    "observeAbilityMode",
    "hasClashPrediction",
    "resetState",
  },
  requires = {},
}
return HubAPI

-- [[ Game modules consume owned settings and explicit shared services ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules gamescope
local GameScope = {}
local sharedServices = {
  utils = {
    getLocalPlayer = true,
    getPlayers = true,
    getRunService = true,
    getWorkspace = true,
    getReplicatedStorage = true,
    getConfigValue = true,
    getConfig = true,
    isActive = true,

    isFiniteNumber = true,
    isNonNegativeFiniteNumber = true,

    getLifecycle = true,
    getDiagnostics = true,
    setConfig = true,
    observeConfig = true,

    trackGlobal = true,
    untrackGlobal = true,
    trackCharacter = true,
    untrackCharacter = true,
    recordError = true,
    recordTransition = true,
    now = true,
    apiVersion = true,
    name = true,
    version = true,
    author = true,

  },
  hubapi = { getAbilityAvailability = true },
  universalcontroller = { connectPhysics = true },
  options = { get = true, isEnabled = true, describe = true, observe = true },
  lifetime = { scope = true, connections = true },
  profiler = { begin = true, finish = true, count = true },
  status = { get = true, collect = true },
  ui = {
    notify = true,
    notifyCorner = true,
    createMini = true,
    addPage = true,
    createWorldLabel = true,
    createWorldBillboard = true,
    createWorldHighlight = true,
    destroyWorldMarker = true,
  },
  uinativeability = { create = true, reveal = true },
  propertybinding = { create = true, apply = true, release = true, getOriginal = true },
  noclip = { acquire = true, release = true, isEnabled = true },
  invisicam = { setSource = true },
}
local function copy(value, freeze, seen, blockCommands)
  if type(value) == "function" and blockCommands then
    return blockCommands
  end
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return value
  end
  seen = seen or {}
  if seen[value] then
    return seen[value]
  end
  local result = {}
  seen[value] = result
  for key, item in pairs(value) do
    result[key] = copy(item, freeze, seen, blockCommands)
  end
  return freeze and table.freeze(result) or result
end
function GameScope.setup() return true end
function GameScope.create(loaded, profile, bindings)
  local owned, keys, protected, legacy, views = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  local root = "hubs/" .. profile.id .. "/"
  for name, module in pairs(loaded) do
    local path = loaded.permissions.getPath(name)
    owned[name] = path ~= nil and path:sub(1, #root) == root
    for key in pairs(module.__config and module.__config.schema or {}) do
      if owned[name] then
        keys[key] = true
      else
        protected[key] = true
      end
    end
    if owned[name] then
      for _, key in ipairs(module.__config and module.__config.legacy or {}) do
        assert(type(key) == "string", name .. ": legacy config key inválida")
        legacy[key] = true
      end
    end
  end
  for key in pairs(legacy) do
    assert(not protected[key], "Game " .. profile.id .. ": legacy config pertence a outro módulo: " .. key)
  end
  local boundary = { modules = {}, profile = copy(profile, true) }
  local function deny(action) error("Game " .. profile.id .. ": acesso fora dos próprios módulos: " .. action, 3) end
  local function validatePatch(patch)
    assert(type(patch) == "table", "Config patch inválido")
    for key in pairs(patch) do
      if not keys[key] then
        deny("config." .. tostring(key))
      end
    end
  end
  local function view(source, provider)
    local result = { __contract = copy(loaded[source].__contract, true) }
    local contract = loaded[source].__contract
    for _, method in ipairs(contract.provides or {}) do
      local service = sharedServices[source] and sharedServices[source][method]
      if owned[source] or service then
        local available, callback = pcall(function() return provider[method] end)
        if not available or type(callback) ~= "function" then
          continue
        end
        if source == "utils" and method == "setConfig" then
          result[method] = function(patch)
            validatePatch(patch)
            return callback(patch)
          end
        elseif source == "utils" and method == "observeConfig" then
          result[method] = function(observer)
            return callback(function(changes)
              local own = {}
              for key, value in pairs(changes) do
                if keys[key] then
                  own[key] = value
                end
              end
              if next(own) then
                observer(table.freeze(own))
              end
            end)
          end
        elseif source == "invisicam" and method == "setSource" then
          result[method] = function(name, value) return callback(profile.id .. "." .. tostring(name), value) end
        elseif source == "ui" and method == "addPage" then
          result[method] = function(definition)
            local valid = boundary.definition({ pages = { definition } })
            local page = callback(valid.pages[1])
            return {
              addSection = function(section)
                local check = boundary.definition({
                  pages = {
                    {
                      id = definition.id,
                      title = definition.title,
                      columns = definition.columns or 1,
                      sections = {
                        section,
                      },
                    },
                  },
                })
                local target = page.addSection(check.pages[1].sections[1])
                local proxy = {}
                function proxy.add(kind, component)
                  component = table.clone(component or {})
                  component.kind = kind
                  local verified = boundary.definition({
                    pages = {
                      { id = definition.id, title = definition.title, columns = definition.columns or 1, sections = { { components = { component } } } },
                    },
                  })
                  return target.add(kind, verified.pages[1].sections[1].components[1])
                end
                return setmetatable(proxy, {
                  __index = function(_, kind)
                    return function(component) return proxy.add(kind, component) end
                  end,
                })
              end,
            }
          end
        elseif source == "uinativeability" and method == "create" then
          result[method] = function(ability, options)
            options = table.clone(options or {})
            options.miniScale = bindings and bindings.miniScale or options.miniScale
            return callback(ability, options)
          end
        elseif source == "ui" and method == "createMini" then
          result[method] = function(definition)
            for _, field in ipairs({
              "key",
              "visibleKey",
              "invisibleKey",
              "xKey",
              "yKey",
              "bindingKey",
              "modeKey",
              "scaleKey",
              "squareKey",
              "widthKey",
              "heightKey",
            }) do
              local key = definition[field]
              if key and not keys[key] then
                deny("mini.config." .. tostring(key))
              end
            end
            return callback(definition)
          end
        else
          result[method] = callback
        end
      end
    end
    for _, field in ipairs(contract.data or {}) do
      if owned[source] then
        result[field] = copy(provider[field], true)
      end
    end
    local metatable = {
      __index = function(_, field)
        if provider[field] ~= nil then
          deny(source .. "." .. tostring(field))
        end
        return nil
      end,
    }
    setmetatable(result, metatable)
    table.freeze(result)
    metatable.__metatable = "locked"
    table.freeze(metatable)
    return result
  end
  for source, provider in pairs(loaded) do
    views[source] = view(source, provider)
  end
  boundary.modules = table.freeze(views)
  function boundary.dependencies(name, dependencies)
    if not owned[name] then
      return dependencies
    end
    local result = {}
    for alias, source in pairs(loaded[name].__contract.requires or {}) do
      result[alias] = view(source, dependencies[alias])
      for _, method in ipairs((loaded[name].__contract.requiresMethods or {})[alias] or {}) do
        assert(type(result[alias][method]) == "function", name .. ": API não autorizada: " .. source .. "." .. method)
      end
    end
    return result
  end
  function boundary.configScope(name) return owned[name] and profile.id or "hub" end
  function boundary.validateKeys(patch) validatePatch(patch) end
  function boundary.validateDefaults(defaults) validatePatch(defaults or {}) end
  function boundary.migrate(data, migrate)
    local input = {}
    for key, value in pairs(data) do
      if keys[key] or legacy[key] then
        input[key] = copy(value)
      end
    end
    local changed = migrate(input) == true
    for key in pairs(input) do
      if not keys[key] and not legacy[key] then
        deny("migration." .. tostring(key))
      end
    end
    for key, value in pairs(data) do
      if (keys[key] or legacy[key]) and input[key] == nil then
        data[key], changed = nil, true
      end
    end
    for key, value in pairs(input) do
      if data[key] ~= value then
        data[key], changed = value, true
      end
    end
    return changed
  end
  function boundary.context(context, controls)
    local result = {}
    for _, field in ipairs({ "desktop", "notify", "persistent", "abilitiesEnabled" }) do
      result[field] = context[field]
    end
    result.scope = context.scope.child()
    for _, field in ipairs({ "setPrimaryActive", "showPrimary" }) do
      if context[field] then
        result[field] = context[field]
      end
    end
    result.utils = views.utils
    result.controls = copy(controls or {}, true)
    result.hub = table.freeze({ getAbilityAvailability = views.hubapi.getAbilityAvailability })
    return table.freeze(result)
  end
  function boundary.actions(actions, controls)
    actions = table.clone(actions or {})
    local function owns(definition)
      local action = definition.action
      return keys[definition.key] or action and ((actions.callbacks or {})[action] or (actions.states or {})[action] or (controls or {})[action])
    end
    for _, method in ipairs({ "resolve", "attach" }) do
      local callback = actions[method]
      if callback then
        actions[method] = function(definition, ...)
          if owns(definition) then
            return callback(definition, ...)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return actions
  end
  function boundary.definition(definition, controls)
    local result = copy(definition)
    for field in pairs(result) do
      assert(
        ({ pages = true, pageOrder = true, miniBalls = true, additions = true, createActions = true, input = true, abilityKeys = true, combatUI = true })[field],
        "Unknown game UI field: " .. tostring(field)
      )
    end
    local ownPages = {}
    for _, page in ipairs(result.pages or {}) do
      assert(type(page.id) == "string" and not ownPages[page.id], "Duplicate game page")
      assert(page.utility ~= true, "Game pages use game navigation")
      ownPages[page.id] = true
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(result.pageOrder or {}) do
      assert(ownPages[id], "Games can only order their own pages: " .. tostring(id))
    end
    for _, mini in ipairs(result.miniBalls or {}) do
      if mini.option then
        assert(
          protected[mini.option] and not mini.key and not mini.action and not mini.onActivate,
          "Universal Mini UI references may only bind an existing option"
        )
      end
    end
    for _, addition in ipairs(result.additions or {}) do
      assert(addition.page == "indeed" and addition.sectionTitle, "Game extensions require a named universal section")
    end
    local visited = {}
    local function validate(value)
      if type(value) ~= "table" or visited[value] then
        return
      end
      visited[value] = true
      for field, item in pairs(value) do
        if
          (
            field == "key"
            or field == "shortcutKey"
            or field == "visibleKey"
            or field == "bindingKey"
            or field == "modeKey"
            or field == "xKey"
            or field == "yKey"
            or field == "scaleKey"
            or field == "squareKey"
            or field == "widthKey"
            or field == "heightKey"
            or field == "invisibleKey"
            or field == "enabledKey"
            or field == "visibleWhen"
            or field == "valueKey"
          )
          and type(item) == "string"
          and not keys[item]
        then
          deny("ui.config." .. item)
        end
        validate(item)
      end
    end
    validate(result)
    if result.createActions then
      local factory = result.createActions
      result.createActions = function(context) return boundary.actions(factory(boundary.context(context, controls)), controls) end
    end
    return result
  end
  return boundary
end
GameScope.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return GameScope

-- [[ actions ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiactions

-- module
local Actions = {}
local Utils
local GameInfo
local Dumper

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  CONFIRM_SECONDS = 3,
}

-- setup
function Actions.setup(deps)
  Utils, GameInfo, Dumper = deps.Utils, deps.Hub, deps.Dumper
  return true
end

-- actions
function Actions.create(context)
  local scope, controls = context.scope, context.controls
  local GameInfo = context.hub or GameInfo
  local shortcuts = {}
  local handles, callbacks, states = {}, {}, {}
  local resetPending, resetGeneration = false, 0
  local function notify(message, important)
    if scope.alive then
      context.notify(message, important)
    end
  end
  local function persistent(message, kind, duration)
    if scope.alive then
      context.persistent(message, "dumper", kind, duration or 0)
    end
  end
  local function invoke(name, ...)
    if type(controls[name]) == "function" then
      return controls[name](...)
    end
  end
  callbacks.rejoin = function() invoke("onRejoin") end
  callbacks.serverHop = function() invoke("onServerHop") end
  callbacks.resetCharacter = function()
    local ok, reason = invoke("onResetCharacter")
    if ok == false then
      notify(reason or "Personagem indisponível", true)
    end
  end
  callbacks.resetSettings = function()
    local handle = handles.resetSettings
    if not resetPending then
      resetPending = true
      resetGeneration += 1
      local revision = resetGeneration
      handle.setText("Tap again to confirm")
      task.delay(CONFIG.CONFIRM_SECONDS, function()
        if scope.alive and revision == resetGeneration then
          resetPending = false
          handle.setText("Reset settings")
        end
      end)
      return
    end
    resetPending = false
    resetGeneration += 1
    local ok, result = pcall(Utils.resetConfig)
    if not ok or not result then
      notify("Reset failed", true)
      warn("[Exodus] Reset settings: " .. tostring(result))
      handle.setText("Reset settings")
      return
    end
    context.rebuild(true)
  end
  callbacks.dumper = function()
    persistent("Dumping...", "info")
    if Dumper.isRunning() then
      return
    end
    local accepted, reason = Dumper.start({
      onStatus = function(message) persistent(tostring(message), "info") end,
      onProgress = function(processed, total) persistent(("Dumping... %d/%d"):format(processed, total), "info") end,
      onComplete = function(result)
        persistent(
          ("Dump completed: %d saved, %d failed (%d recovered)."):format(result.saved, result.failed, result.recovered or 0),
          result.failed > 0 and "warning" or "success",
          5
        )
      end,
      onCanceled = function() persistent("Dumping canceled.", "warning", 1.5) end,
      onError = function(message)
        warn("[Exodus Dumper] " .. tostring(message))
        persistent("Dumper failed. Check the console.", "critical", 2.5)
      end,
    })
    if not accepted then
      warn("[Exodus Dumper] " .. tostring(reason))
      persistent("Dumper is already running.", "warning", 2)
    end
  end
  local gameActions = GameInfo.createActions(context)
  for name, callback in pairs(gameActions.callbacks or {}) do
    assert(not callbacks[name], "Duplicate game action: " .. name)
    callbacks[name] = callback
  end
  for name, read in pairs(gameActions.states or {}) do
    states[name] = read
  end
  local viewActions = context.actionFactory and context.actionFactory(context) or {}
  for name, callback in pairs(viewActions.callbacks or {}) do
    assert(not callbacks[name], "Duplicate UI action: " .. name)
    callbacks[name] = callback
  end
  for name, read in pairs(viewActions.states or {}) do
    states[name] = read
  end

  local result = {}
  function result.resolve(definition)
    definition.toast = false
    definition.expandedDescription = context.desktop and definition.desktopExpanded == true
    if not context.desktop then
      definition.shortcutKey = nil
    end
    if definition.action == "notifications" then
      definition.key = context.desktop and "DesktopNotifications" or "MobileNotifications"
    end
    if viewActions.resolve then
      viewActions.resolve(definition)
    end
    if definition.action then
      assert(
        definition.action == "notifications" or (callbacks[definition.action] or controls[definition.action]),
        "Unknown UI action: " .. tostring(definition.action)
      )
      definition.onClick = callbacks[definition.action] or controls[definition.action]
      definition.onChange = callbacks[definition.action] or controls[definition.action]
      definition.getState = states[definition.action] or definition.getState
    end
    return definition
  end
  function result.attach(definition, handle)
    if gameActions.attach then
      gameActions.attach(definition, handle)
    end
    if definition.action then
      handles[definition.action] = handle
    end
    if definition.shortcutKey then
      local entry = { definition = definition, handle = handle }
      if definition.shortcutPriority == 0 then
        table.insert(shortcuts, 1, entry)
      else
        shortcuts[#shortcuts + 1] = entry
      end
    end
  end
  function result.validateShortcut(key, binding)
    if binding == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
      return true
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(shortcuts) do
      local definition = entry.definition
      if definition.shortcutKey ~= key and Utils.getConfigValue(definition.shortcutKey) == binding then
        return false, "Shortcut already used: " .. definition.title
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  function result.triggerShortcut(binding, priorityOnly)
    if binding == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
      return false
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(shortcuts) do
      local definition, handle = entry.definition, entry.handle
      if (not priorityOnly or definition.shortcutPriority == 0) and Utils.getConfigValue(definition.shortcutKey) == binding then
        if definition.abilityOnly and context.abilitiesEnabled and not context.abilitiesEnabled() then
          return false
        end
        if not handle.activate or not handle.activate() then
          return false
        end
        if not definition.silentShortcut then
          local message = definition.title
          if definition.kind == "toggle" or definition.kind == "checkbox" then
            message = message .. (handle.getValue() and " On" or " Off")
          end
          context.notify(message, false, { category = "shortcut", topic = definition.action or definition.key })
        end
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function result.refreshStates()
    for name, read in pairs(states) do
      local handle = handles[name]
      if handle and handle.setValue then
        handle.setValue(read())
      end
    end
  end
  scope.add(function()
    resetGeneration += 1
  end)
  return result
end

-- contract
Actions.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "create" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Hub = "hubapi", Dumper = "dumper" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "isActive", "observeConfig", "resetConfig", "recordError" },
    Hub = { "createActions" },
    Dumper = { "start", "isRunning" },
  },
}

return Actions

-- [[ deterministic page composition ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiconfig
local UIConfig = {}
local pages = {}
local function copy(value)
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return value
  end
  local result = {}
  for key, item in pairs(value) do
    result[key] = copy(item)
  end
  return result
end
function UIConfig.configure(definitions, universal)
  pages = copy(definitions)
  for _, page in ipairs(pages) do
    if page.id == "indeed" then
      page.sections = copy(universal or {})
    end
  end
  UIConfig.pages = pages
end
function UIConfig.getPages(definition)
  definition = definition or {}
  local result, own, host = {}, {}, {}
  for _, page in ipairs(pages) do
    host[page.id] = true
  end
  for _, page in ipairs(definition.pages or {}) do
    assert(not own[page.id] and not host[page.id], "Duplicate game page: " .. tostring(page.id))
    own[page.id] = copy(page)
  end
  for _, id in ipairs(definition.pageOrder or {}) do
    assert(own[id], "Unknown or repeated game page: " .. tostring(id))
    result[#result + 1], own[id] = own[id], nil
  end
  for _, page in ipairs(definition.pages or {}) do
    if own[page.id] then
      result[#result + 1], own[page.id] = own[page.id], nil
    end
  end
  local byId = {}
  for _, page in ipairs(pages) do
    local value = copy(page)
    result[#result + 1], byId[value.id] = value, value
  end
  for _, addition in ipairs(definition.additions or {}) do
    assert(addition.page == "indeed" and addition.sectionTitle, "Only named universal extensions are supported")
    local page = assert(byId[addition.page], "Unknown extension page")
    page.sections[#page.sections + 1] = { title = addition.sectionTitle, components = copy(addition.components or {}) }
  end
  return result
end
function UIConfig.migrateConfig(data)
  local changed = false
  for _, key in ipairs({ "MiniUISquare", "MiniUIRoundDefaultRestored", "AntiLagFloorCull", "AntiLagRemoveSwordSounds" }) do
    if data[key] ~= nil then
      data[key], changed = nil, true
    end
  end
  return changed
end
UIConfig.pages = pages
UIConfig.__config = {
  schema = {
    MobileNotifications = "boolean",
    DesktopNotifications = "boolean",
    DesktopShortcutNotifications = "boolean",
    ForcePCUI = "boolean",
    MiniUIScale = "miniScale",
    CameraSensitivity = "rate",
    BtnX = "position",
    BtnY = "position",
    PanelX = "position",
    PanelY = "position",
  },
  defaults = {
    MobileNotifications = true,
    DesktopNotifications = true,
    DesktopShortcutNotifications = true,
    ForcePCUI = false,
    MiniUIScale = 1,
    CameraSensitivity = 1,
  },
  constraints = { CameraSensitivity = { min = 0, max = 10 } },
}
UIConfig.__contract =
  { access = { methods = { configure = "infrastructure.write" } }, provides = { "configure", "getPages", "migrateConfig" }, data = { "pages" }, requires = {} }
return UIConfig

-- [[ bootstrap ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules bootstrap

local Bootstrap = {}
function Bootstrap.setup() return true end
function Bootstrap.start(loaded, order, urls, profile, transport)
  loaded.gamecontext.configure(profile)
  local utils = loaded.utils
  local miniScale = {
    read = function() return utils.getConfigValue("MiniUIScale") end,
    observe = function(callback)
      return utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
        if changes.MiniUIScale ~= nil then
          callback()
        end
      end)
    end,
  }
  local boundary = loaded.gamescope.create(loaded, profile, { miniScale = miniScale })
  boundary.validateDefaults(profile.defaults)
  loaded.hubapi.configure(loaded, boundary)
  utils.configure(loaded.permissions.resolve("utils", loaded))
  utils.start()
  if type(_G.Exodus) == "table" then
    _G.Exodus.Utils = utils
  end
  loaded.status.configure(loaded, utils.recordError)
  utils.setLifecyclePhase("configuring")
  local installers, pages, sections = {}, {}, {}
  for _, name in ipairs(order) do
    if loaded[name].__contract.section then
      sections[#sections + 1] = { order = loaded[name].__contract.section, name = name, definition = loaded[name].definition }
    end
    if loaded[name].__contract.page then
      pages[#pages + 1] = { order = loaded[name].__contract.page, name = name, definition = loaded[name].definition }
    end
    if loaded[name].__contract.component == true then
      local path = assert(loaded.permissions.getPath(name))
      assert(path:sub(1, 14) == "ui/components/", "Component implementations belong to the UI library")
      assert(type(loaded[name].install) == "function", "Component installer missing: " .. name)
      installers[#installers + 1] = { install = loaded[name].install }
    end
  end
  loaded.uikit.configure(installers)
  table.sort(pages, function(a, b) return a.order < b.order or a.order == b.order and a.name < b.name end)
  local definitions = {}
  for _, page in ipairs(pages) do
    definitions[#definitions + 1] = page.definition
  end
  table.sort(sections, function(a, b) return a.order < b.order or a.order == b.order and a.name < b.name end)
  local universal = {}
  for _, section in ipairs(sections) do
    universal[#universal + 1] = section.definition
  end
  loaded.uiconfig.configure(definitions, universal)
  loaded.config.reset()
  for name, module in pairs(loaded) do
    if module.__config then
      local accepted, reason = loaded.config.register(name, module.__config, boundary.configScope(name))
      assert(accepted, "Invalid configuration schema: " .. name .. " (" .. tostring(reason or "invalid fields, keys or defaults") .. ")")
    end
  end
  utils.setConfigModule(loaded.config)
  utils.setConfig(loaded.config.defaults({ player = utils.getLocalPlayer(), profile = boundary.profile }))
  utils.loadConfig()
  utils.setModuleURLs(urls)
  local binds = {}
  for _, name in ipairs(order) do
    local module = loaded[name]
    if module.__contract.bindCharacter then
      assert(type(module.bindCharacter) == "function" and type(module.detachCharacter) == "function", "Incomplete character contract: " .. name)
      binds[#binds + 1] = { name = name, bind = module.bindCharacter, detach = module.detachCharacter }
    end
  end
  utils.setLifecyclePhase("initializing")
  for _, name in ipairs(order) do
    local module = loaded[name]
    if name ~= "utils" and name ~= "config" and name ~= "uiconfig" then
      local deps = loaded.permissions.resolve(name, loaded)
      deps = boundary.dependencies(name, deps)
      if name == "character" then
        deps.characterBinds = binds
      end
      if type(module.teardown) == "function" then
        local cleanup = { Connected = true }
        function cleanup:Disconnect()
          if not self.Connected then
            return
          end
          self.Connected = false
          module.teardown()
        end
        utils.trackGlobal(cleanup)
      end
      local ok, reason = module.setup(deps)
      assert(ok == true, name .. ".setup: " .. tostring(reason))
    end
  end
  utils.setDiagnosticsModules(loaded)
  local runtime, reason = loaded.runtime.bind(loaded, order, game:GetService("HttpService"), transport.report)
  assert(type(runtime) == "table", tostring(reason))
  local controls = loaded.hubapi.getControls()
  controls.onClose = function()
    _G.ExodusLoaderRecoveryToken = nil
    _G.ExodusShutdownReason = "close"
    return utils.stop()
  end
  controls.onReload = transport.reload
  controls.onResetCharacter = function()
    local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local character = player and player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
      return false, "Personagem indisponível"
    end
    humanoid.Health = 0
    return true
  end

  for action, method in pairs({ onRejoin = "rejoin", onServerHop = "hop" }) do
    controls[action] = function()
      local function report(message) loaded.ui.notify(message, "server_navigation", "info", 5) end
      local ok, err = loaded.servers[method](report)
      if ok == false then
        utils.recordError("Servers", err)
        report(err)
      end
    end
  end
  local view
  local cleanup = { Connected = true }
  function cleanup:Disconnect()
    if not self.Connected then
      return
    end
    self.Connected = false
    if view then
      view.fade()
    end
    loaded.ui.teardown()
  end
  utils.trackGlobal(cleanup)
  local definition = loaded.hubapi.getUIConfig()
  local pages = loaded.uiconfig.getPages(definition)
  definition.pages = pages
  view = loaded.ui.create({
    name = utils.name(),
    author = utils.author(),
    state = utils,
    miniScale = miniScale,
    effectsEnabled = function() return utils.getConfigValue("AntiLagEnabled") ~= true end,
    headerButtons = { { id = "information", page = "information", icon = "information" }, { id = "config", page = "config", icon = "settings" } },
    controls = controls,
    definition = definition,
    beforePresent = transport.present,
    information = loaded.information,
    capabilities = { clashPrediction = loaded.hubapi.hasClashPrediction() },
    model = {
      getAvailability = loaded.hubapi.getAbilityAvailability,
      getChoices = loaded.hubapi.getChoices,
      getReadouts = loaded.hubapi.getReadouts,
      getVisibility = loaded.hubapi.getMiniVisibility,
      conditionsEnabled = loaded.hubapi.areAbilitiesEnabled,
      observeState = loaded.hubapi.observeState,
    },
    actionsFactory = function(context) return loaded.uiactions.create(context) end,
  })
  if type(_G.Exodus) == "table" then
    local options = {}
    for _, method in ipairs({ "get", "isEnabled", "describe", "observe" }) do
      options[method] = loaded.options[method]
    end
    _G.Exodus.Options = table.freeze(options)
  end
  loaded.updates.start(transport)
  loaded.autoexecute.start(transport)
  return true, runtime
end
Bootstrap.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "start" }, requires = {} }
return Bootstrap

-- [[ character ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules character

-- module
local Character = {}
local utils
local spam
local binds
local added
local removing
local currentLife
local generation = 0
local setupEpoch = 0
local phase = "stopped"
local workerRunning = false
local startWorker

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  BIND_TIMEOUT = 10,
  ROOT_POLL_INTERVAL = 0,
}

-- state-tracking
local function setPhase(value, reason)
  if phase == value then
    return
  end
  local previous = phase
  phase = value
  if utils then
    utils.recordTransition("Character", previous, value, reason)
  end
end

-- lifecycle
local function detach(entry)
  local ok, err = pcall(entry.detach)
  if not ok and utils then
    utils.recordError("Character", ("%s: falha ao desvincular: %s"):format(entry.name or "bind", tostring(err)))
  end
end
local function clearLife()
  local life = currentLife
  currentLife = nil
  if life then
    for i = #life.bound, 1, -1 do
      detach(life.bound[i])
      life.bound[i] = nil
    end
  end
  if not utils then
    return
  end
  utils.disconnectCharacterConnections()
  if spam then
    spam.resetState()
  end
end
local function deactivate(life, reason)
  if currentLife ~= life then
    return
  end
  generation += 1
  setPhase("cleaning", reason)
  clearLife()
  setPhase("stopped", "character_cleaned")
end
local function valid(life) return currentLife == life and utils ~= nil and utils.isActive() and life.character.Parent ~= nil end
local function bindLife(life)
  life.attempted = true
  if not valid(life) then
    return
  end
  setPhase("binding", "character_bind_start")
  local root = life.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local deadline = os.clock() + CONFIG.BIND_TIMEOUT
  while valid(life) and (not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not root.Parent) and os.clock() < deadline do
    task.wait(CONFIG.ROOT_POLL_INTERVAL)
    root = life.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  end
  if not valid(life) then
    return
  end
  if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not root.Parent then
    life.attempted = false
    setPhase("waiting", "root_unavailable")
    return
  end
  for index, entry in ipairs(binds) do
    if not valid(life) then
      return
    end
    local ok, result, detail = pcall(entry.bind, life.character)
    if not ok then
      detail, result = result, false
    end
    if not valid(life) then
      detach(entry)
      return
    end
    if result ~= true then
      utils.recordError("Character", ("%s não vinculou o personagem: %s"):format(entry.name or ("bind_" .. index), tostring(detail or result)))
      detach(entry)
      for i = #life.bound, 1, -1 do
        detach(life.bound[i])
        life.bound[i] = nil
      end
      life.attempted = false
      setPhase("waiting", "bind_failed")
      return
    end
    life.bound[#life.bound + 1] = entry
  end
  if valid(life) then
    setPhase("bound", "character_bound")
  end
end
startWorker = function()
  if workerRunning then
    return
  end
  workerRunning = true
  task.spawn(function()
    local life = currentLife
    local ok, reason = xpcall(function()
      if life then
        bindLife(life)
      end
    end, function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end)
    workerRunning = false
    if not ok and currentLife == life and utils then
      utils.recordError("Character", reason)
      deactivate(life, "bind_error")
      setPhase("invalid", "bind_error")
    end
    if currentLife and not currentLife.attempted then
      local retryLife = currentLife
      task.delay(0.25, function()
        if currentLife == retryLife and utils then
          startWorker()
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end
local function setupCharacter(character)
  if not character or not utils or (currentLife and currentLife.character == character) then
    return
  end
  generation += 1
  clearLife()
  local life = { character = character, bound = {}, attempted = false, humanoids = {} }
  currentLife = life
  utils.trackCharacter(character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
    if not parent then
      deactivate(life, "character_removed")
    end
  end))
  local function watchHumanoid(humanoid)
    if currentLife ~= life or life.humanoids[humanoid] then
      return
    end
    life.humanoids[humanoid] = true
    utils.trackCharacter(humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
      if humanoid.Parent == life.character then
        deactivate(life, "character_died")
      end
    end))
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
      deactivate(life, "character_died")
    end
  end
  local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if humanoid then
    watchHumanoid(humanoid)
  end
  if currentLife ~= life then
    return
  end
  utils.trackCharacter(character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Humanoid") then
      watchHumanoid(child)
    end
  end))
  if character.ChildRemoved then
    utils.trackCharacter(character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
      if currentLife == life and child.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
        deactivate(life, "root_removed")
        if utils and utils.isActive() and character.Parent then
          setupCharacter(character)
        end
      end
    end))
  end
  startWorker()
end
function Character.setup(deps)
  if
    type(deps) ~= "table"
    or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table"
    or type(deps.Hub) ~= "table"
    or type(deps.Hub.resetState) ~= "function"
    or type(deps.characterBinds) ~= "table"
  then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils, Spam ou characterBinds"
  end
  for index, entry in ipairs(deps.characterBinds) do
    if type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.bind) ~= "function" or type(entry.detach) ~= "function" then
      return false, ("characterBinds[%d] inválido"):format(index)
    end
  end
  Character.teardown()
  utils, spam, binds = deps.Utils, deps.Hub, deps.characterBinds
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  if not player then
    setPhase("invalid", "player_unavailable")
    return false, "Players.LocalPlayer indisponível"
  end
  setPhase("ready", "character_controller_ready")
  local owner = setupEpoch
  added = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    if owner == setupEpoch then
      setupCharacter(character)
    end
  end)
  removing = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
    if owner == setupEpoch and currentLife and currentLife.character == character then
      deactivate(currentLife, "character_removing")
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(added)
  utils.trackGlobal(removing)
  if player.Character then
    setupCharacter(player.Character)
  end
  return true
end
function Character.teardown()
  generation += 1
  setupEpoch += 1
  if utils then
    if added then
      utils.untrackGlobal(added)
    end
    if removing then
      utils.untrackGlobal(removing)
    end
  end
  if added then
    added:Disconnect()
  end
  if removing then
    removing:Disconnect()
  end
  added, removing = nil, nil
  setPhase("cleaning", "character_controller_teardown")
  clearLife()
  setPhase("stopped", "character_controller_stopped")
  utils, spam, binds = nil, nil, nil
end

-- public-api
function Character.getStatus() return { schema = utils and utils.apiVersion() or nil, phase = phase, generation = generation } end

-- contract
Character.__contract = {
  requires = { Hub = "hubapi", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = {
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "isActive",
      "apiVersion",
      "trackGlobal",
      "untrackGlobal",
      "trackCharacter",
      "disconnectCharacterConnections",
      "recordTransition",
      "recordError",
    },
    Hub = { "resetState" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "getStatus" },
}

return Character

local Properties = {}

-- [[ resource lifetime ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules lifetime

-- code
local Lifetime = {}
function Lifetime.setup() return true end
function Lifetime.scope()
  local scope = { alive = true }
  local resources, last = {}, nil
  local function unlink(resource)
    local entry = resources[resource]
    if not entry then
      return nil
    end
    resources[resource] = nil
    if entry.previous then
      entry.previous.next = entry.next
    end
    if entry.next then
      entry.next.previous = entry.previous
    else
      last = entry.previous
    end
    return entry.cleanup
  end
  function scope.add(resource, dispose)
    local cleanup = dispose
      or function()
        if type(resource) == "function" then
          resource()
        else
          resource:Disconnect()
        end
      end
    if not scope.alive then
      cleanup()
      return resource
    end
    if resources[resource] then
      return resource
    end
    local entry = { resource = resource, cleanup = cleanup, previous = last }
    if last then
      last.next = entry
    end
    resources[resource], last = entry, entry
    return resource
  end
  function scope.forget(resource) unlink(resource) end
  function scope.remove(resource)
    local cleanup = unlink(resource)
    if cleanup then
      cleanup()
    end
  end
  function scope.connect(signal, callback)
    return scope.add(signal:Connect(function(...)
      if scope.alive then
        callback(...)
      end
    end))
  end
  local function schedule(seconds, callback, ...)
    assert(type(callback) == "function", "Task callback required")
    if not scope.alive then
      return nil
    end
    local arguments, thread = table.pack(...), nil
    local function run()
      local ok, reason = true, nil
      if scope.alive then
        ok, reason = pcall(callback, table.unpack(arguments, 1, arguments.n))
      end
      if thread then
        scope.forget(thread)
      end
      if not ok then
        error(reason, 0)
      end
    end
    if seconds then
      thread = task.delay(seconds, run)
    else
      thread = task.defer(run)
    end
    if thread then
      scope.add(thread, function()
        if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" and thread ~= coroutine.running() then
          pcall(task.cancel, thread)
        end
      end)
    end
    return thread
  end
  function scope.defer(callback, ...) return schedule(nil, callback, ...) end
  function scope.delay(seconds, callback, ...) return schedule(seconds, callback, ...) end
  function scope.child()
    local child = Lifetime.scope()
    scope.add(child, child.destroy)
    child.add(function() scope.forget(child) end)
    return child
  end
  function scope.destroy()
    if not scope.alive then
      return
    end
    scope.alive = false
    while last do
      local cleanup = unlink(last.resource)
      local ok, reason = pcall(cleanup)
      if not ok then
        warn("[Exodus] Cleanup failed: " .. tostring(reason))
      end
    end
  end
  return scope
end
function Lifetime.connections(utils)
  local scope = Lifetime.scope()
  local pool = { connections = {} }
  function pool.disconnect(name)
    local connection = pool.connections[name]
    pool.connections[name] = nil
    if connection then
      scope.remove(connection)
    end
  end
  function pool.connect(name, signal, callback)
    pool.disconnect(name)
    local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
    pool.connections[name] = connection
    utils.trackGlobal(connection)
    scope.add(connection, function()
      utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
      connection:Disconnect()
    end)
    return connection
  end
  function pool.destroy()
    scope.destroy()
    table.clear(pool.connections)
  end
  return pool
end
Lifetime.__contract = {
  access = { default = "lifetime.manage" },
  requires = {},
  provides = { "setup", "scope", "connections" },
}

return Lifetime

-- [[ module linker ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules modulelinker

local Linker = {}
function Linker.setup() return true end
function Linker.order(manifest, loaded)
  local MODULE_ORDER = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(manifest) do
    if entry.name ~= "permissions" then
      MODULE_ORDER[#MODULE_ORDER + 1] = entry.name
    end
  end
  local positions, state, ordered = {}, {}, {}
  for index, name in ipairs(MODULE_ORDER) do
    positions[name] = index
  end
  local function visit(name)
    if state[name] == 2 then
      return
    end
    if state[name] == 1 then
      error("dependência circular entre módulos: " .. name, 2)
    end
    if not positions[name] or type(loaded[name]) ~= "table" then
      error("dependência não inicializável: " .. tostring(name), 2)
    end
    state[name] = 1
    local dependencies = {}
    for _, source in pairs(loaded[name].__contract.requires or {}) do
      if source ~= "permissions" then
        dependencies[#dependencies + 1] = source
      end
    end
    table.sort(dependencies, function(a, b)
      local left, right = positions[a] or math.huge, positions[b] or math.huge
      return left < right or left == right and a < b
    end)
    for _, source in ipairs(dependencies) do
      visit(source)
    end
    state[name] = 2
    ordered[#ordered + 1] = name
  end
  for _, name in ipairs(MODULE_ORDER) do
    visit(name)
  end
  table.clear(MODULE_ORDER)
  for _, name in ipairs(ordered) do
    if name ~= "character" then
      MODULE_ORDER[#MODULE_ORDER + 1] = name
    end
  end
  if loaded.character then
    MODULE_ORDER[#MODULE_ORDER + 1] = "character"
  end
  return MODULE_ORDER
end
Linker.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "order" }, requires = {} }
return Linker
