-- [[ reversible property ownership ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules propertybinding
local Binding = {}
local targets = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local sequence = 0
function Binding.setup() return true end
function Binding.getOriginal(target, key)
  local properties = targets[target]
  local entry = properties and properties[key]
  if entry then
    return entry.original
  end
  return target[key]
end
local function winner(entry)
  local selected
  for _, layer in pairs(entry.layers) do
    if not selected or layer.priority > selected.priority or layer.priority == selected.priority and layer.order > selected.order then
      selected = layer
    end
  end
  return selected
end
function Binding.apply(owner, target, key, value, priority)
  local properties = targets[target]
  if not properties then
    properties = {}
    targets[target] = properties
  end
  local entry = properties[key]
  if not entry then
    entry = { original = target[key], layers = {} }
    properties[key] = entry
  end
  local layer = entry.layers[owner]
  if not layer then
    sequence += 1
    layer = { order = sequence }
    entry.layers[owner] = layer
  end
  layer.value, layer.priority = value, priority or 20
  local selected = winner(entry)
  return pcall(function()
    if target[key] ~= selected.value then
      target[key] = selected.value
    end
  end)
end
function Binding.release(owner, target, key, restoreValue)
  local properties = targets[target]
  local entry = properties and properties[key]
  if not entry or not entry.layers[owner] then
    return true
  end
  if restoreValue ~= nil then
    entry.original = restoreValue
  end
  entry.layers[owner] = nil
  local selected = winner(entry)
  local value = entry.original
  if selected then
    value = selected.value
  end
  local ok, reason = pcall(function() target[key] = value end)
  if not selected then
    properties[key] = nil
    if not next(properties) then
      targets[target] = nil
    end
  end
  return ok, reason
end
function Binding.create(resolve, desired)
  local target, originals, captured = nil, {}, {}
  local binding = {}
  local function release(key)
    local ok, reason = Binding.release(binding, target, key)
    if not ok and target and target.Parent ~= nil then
      warn("[Exodus] Restore " .. tostring(key) .. ": " .. tostring(reason))
    end
    originals[key], captured[key] = nil, nil
  end
  function binding.restore()
    if target then
      for key in pairs(captured) do
        release(key)
      end
    end
    target = nil
    table.clear(originals)
    table.clear(captured)
  end
  function binding.update()
    local nextTarget = resolve()
    if nextTarget ~= target then
      binding.restore()
      target = nextTarget
    end
    if not target then
      return
    end
    local values = desired(target, originals)
    for key, value in pairs(values) do
      if not captured[key] then
        local entry = targets[target] and targets[target][key]
        if entry then
          originals[key] = entry.original
        else
          originals[key] = target[key]
        end
        captured[key] = true
      end
      local ok, reason = Binding.apply(binding, target, key, value)
      assert(ok, tostring(reason))
    end
    for key in pairs(captured) do
      if values[key] == nil then
        release(key)
      end
    end
  end
  return binding
end
Binding.__contract = {
  access = { default = "property.write" },
  provides = { "setup", "create", "apply", "release", "getOriginal" },
  requires = {},
}
return Binding
sources.core/runtime/scheduler.luau:
-- [[ controller ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules universalcontroller

local Controller = {}
local callbacks, signals = {}, {}
local dispatching = false
local function disconnectSignals()
  for _, connection in ipairs(signals) do
    connection:Disconnect()
  end
  table.clear(signals)
end
local function step(...)
  dispatching = true
  local count = #callbacks
  for index = 1, count do
    local entry = callbacks[index]
    if entry and entry.alive and entry.scope.alive then
      local ok, reason = pcall(entry.callback, ...)
      if not ok then
        if entry.scope.fail then
          entry.scope.fail(reason)
        else
          warn("[Exodus Universal] " .. tostring(reason))
        end
      end
    end
  end
  dispatching = false
  for index = #callbacks, 1, -1 do
    if not callbacks[index].alive then
      table.remove(callbacks, index)
    end
  end
  if #callbacks == 0 then
    disconnectSignals()
  end
end
function Controller.setup() return true end
function Controller.teardown()
  disconnectSignals()
  table.clear(callbacks)
  return true
end
function Controller.connectPhysics(scope, callback)
  assert(type(scope) == "table" and type(scope.add) == "function" and type(callback) == "function", "Invalid physics subscription")
  if not scope.alive then
    return
  end
  local entry = { alive = true, callback = callback, scope = scope }
  callbacks[#callbacks + 1] = entry
  scope.add(function()
    entry.alive = false
    if not dispatching then
      local index = table.find(callbacks, entry)
      if index then
        table.remove(callbacks, index)
      end
      if #callbacks == 0 then
        disconnectSignals()
      end
    end
  end)
  if #signals == 0 then
    local run = game:GetService("RunService")
    local before, after = run.PreSimulation or run.Stepped, run.PostSimulation or run.Heartbeat
    assert(before and after and before ~= after, "Two physics phases are required")
    signals[1] = before:Connect(function(first, second) step(second or first) end)
    signals[2] = after:Connect(step)
  end
end
function Controller.create(utils, lifetime, definition)
  local root = lifetime.scope()
  local active, activation, applying = false, nil, false
  local controller = {}
  local function stop()
    active = false
    if activation then
      activation.destroy()
      activation = nil
    end
    if definition.stop then
      definition.stop()
    end
  end
  local function fail(reason)
    applying = true
    pcall(stop)
    utils.setConfig({ [definition.key] = false })
    utils.recordError(definition.key, tostring(reason))
    applying = false
    return false, tostring(reason)
  end
  function controller.sync()
    if applying or not root.alive then
      return true
    end
    applying = true
    local ok, reason = pcall(function()
      local enabled
      if definition.isEnabled then
        enabled = definition.isEnabled() == true
      else
        enabled = utils.getConfigValue(definition.key) == true
      end
      if enabled ~= active then
        if enabled then
          activation = root.child()
          activation.fail = fail
          active = true
          local connect = activation.connect
          activation.connect = function(signal, callback)
            return connect(signal, function(...)
              local ok, reason = pcall(callback, ...)
              if not ok then
                fail(reason)
              end
            end)
          end
          assert(definition.start(activation) ~= false, "falha ao iniciar recurso")
        else
          stop()
        end
      end
      if active and definition.update then
        definition.update()
      end
    end)
    if not ok then
      return fail(reason)
    end
    applying = false
    return true
  end
  function controller.setEnabled(enabled)
    if not root.alive then
      return false, "recurso encerrado"
    end
    if not utils.setConfig({ [definition.key] = enabled == true }) then
      return false, "configuração rejeitada"
    end
    local ok, reason = controller.sync()
    if ok and enabled == true and not active then
      return false, "falha ao ativar recurso"
    end
    return ok, reason
  end
  function controller.setValue(value)
    value = tonumber(value)
    if not value or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge or not definition.valueKey then
      return false, "valor inválido"
    end
    value = math.clamp(value, definition.min or 0, definition.max or 200)
    if not utils.setConfig({ [definition.valueKey] = value }) then
      return false, "configuração rejeitada"
    end
    return controller.sync()
  end
  root.add(utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes[definition.key] ~= nil or definition.valueKey and changes[definition.valueKey] ~= nil then
      controller.sync()
    end
  end))
  local cleanup = { Disconnect = function() root.destroy() end }
  utils.trackGlobal(cleanup)
  root.add(function() utils.untrackGlobal(cleanup) end)
  root.add(stop)
  function controller.destroy() root.destroy() end
  return controller
end
Controller.__contract = {
  access = { default = "lifetime.manage" },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "create", "connectPhysics" },
  requires = {},
}
return Controller

-- [[ internal permissions: generic action categories ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules permissions

local Permissions = {}
local CONFIG = { RESERVED = { __contract = true, __config = true } }
local readonly
local HOST_POLICY = {
  ["base"] = { "internal.read", "lifetime.manage", "diagnostics.write", "ui.use" },
  ["types"] = {
    ["infrastructure"] = { "*" },
    ["presentation"] = { "config.write", "manual.input.write", "input.stop", "tooling.execute", "game.inventory", "hub.control", "ui.write" },
    ["combat"] = { "combat.execute", "combat.runtime", "config.own" },
    ["game"] = {
      "game.write",
      "combat.execute",
      "combat.runtime",
      "config.own",
      "manual.input.write",
      "input.stop",
      "render.write",
      "game.inventory",
      "world.write",
      "property.write",
    },
    ["lifecycle"] = { "lifecycle.write", "combat.runtime", "input.stop" },
    ["universal"] = { "world.write", "property.write", "config.own" },
    ["render"] = { "render.write", "property.write", "config.own" },
    ["view"] = { "ui.write" },
    ["tools"] = { "tooling.execute" },
  },
  ["rules"] = {
    { ["prefix"] = "core/", ["type"] = "infrastructure" },
    { ["prefix"] = "ui/components/", ["type"] = "view" },
    { ["prefix"] = "ui/", ["type"] = "presentation" },
    { ["prefix"] = "universal/anti_lag/", ["type"] = "render" },
    { ["prefix"] = "universal/", ["type"] = "universal" },
    { ["prefix"] = "hubs/", ["type"] = "game" },
  },
  ["modules"] = {
    ["character"] = "lifecycle",
    ["dumper"] = "tools",
    ["servers"] = "tools",

  },
  ["defaults"] = {
    ["infrastructure"] = "infrastructure.write",
    ["presentation"] = "ui.write",
    ["combat"] = "combat.execute",
    ["game"] = "game.write",
    ["lifecycle"] = "lifecycle.write",
    ["universal"] = "world.write",
    ["render"] = "render.write",
    ["view"] = "ui.write",
    ["tools"] = "tooling.execute",
  },
}
local POLICY
local function contains(items, value)
  for _, item in ipairs(items or {}) do
    if item == value then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
local function configure()
  POLICY = readonly(HOST_POLICY)
  return true
end
local function familyFor(name, path)
  local kind = POLICY.modules[name]
  if not kind then
    for _, rule in ipairs(POLICY.rules) do
      if path and type(rule.prefix) == "string" and path:sub(1, #rule.prefix) == rule.prefix then
        kind = rule.type
        break
      end
    end
  end
  assert(kind and POLICY.types[kind], "Module has no authorized type: " .. name)
  return kind
end
local function hasFunctions(value, seen)
  if type(value) == "function" then
    return true
  end
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  seen = seen or {}
  if seen[value] then
    return false
  end
  seen[value] = true
  for _, item in pairs(value) do
    if hasFunctions(item, seen) then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
local function capability(provider, method, data)
  if data then
    return provider.commandData[method] and (provider.access.default or POLICY.defaults[provider.family] or "internal.write") or "internal.read"
  end
  if provider.access.methods and provider.access.methods[method] then
    return provider.access.methods[method]
  end
  if method == "setup" or method == "teardown" or method == "bindCharacter" or method == "detachCharacter" then
    return "lifecycle.write"
  end
  for _, prefix in ipairs({ "get", "is", "has", "are", "uses", "normalize", "validate", "decode", "format", "should" }) do
    if method:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
      return "internal.read"
    end
  end
  for _, prefix in ipairs({ "observe", "track", "untrack" }) do
    if method:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
      return "lifetime.manage"
    end
  end
  return provider.access.default or POLICY.defaults[provider.family] or "internal.write"
end
local function allowed(entry, permission)
  local grants = POLICY.types[entry.family]
  return contains(grants, "*") or contains(grants, permission) or contains(POLICY.base, permission)
end
local function canConsume(entry, provider, method, data)
  local permission = capability(provider, method, data)
  if allowed(entry, permission) then
    return true, permission
  end
  if not data and contains(provider.access.scoped, method) and allowed(entry, "config.own") then
    return true, "config.own"
  end
  return false, permission
end

-- registry
local registry = {}

-- validation
local function deny(name, action) error(("Permissão negada: %s -> %s"):format(name, action), 3) end
local function namedSet(owner, field, items)
  if type(items) ~= "table" then
    error(owner .. ": " .. field .. " inválido", 3)
  end
  local result, count = {}, 0
  for index, name in pairs(items) do
    if type(index) ~= "number" or index < 1 or index % 1 ~= 0 or type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or result[name] then
      error(owner .. ": " .. field .. " contém entrada inválida ou duplicada", 3)
    end
    result[name] = true
    count += 1
  end
  if count ~= #items then
    error(owner .. ": " .. field .. " deve ser uma lista contínua", 3)
  end
  return result
end
local function validate(name, module, path)
  if type(name) ~= "string" or type(module) ~= "table" then
    error("Permissions: módulo inválido", 2)
  end
  local contract = module.__contract
  if type(contract) ~= "table" then
    error(name .. ": contrato ausente", 2)
  end
  if contract.component ~= nil then
    assert(contract.component == true and path and path:match("^ui/components/"), name .. ": invalid component owner")
  end
  for _, field in ipairs({ "page", "section" }) do
    local order = contract[field]
    if order ~= nil then
      assert(type(order) == "number" and order == order and order >= 0 and order < math.huge, name .. ": invalid presentation order")
    end
  end
  local provides = namedSet(name, "provides", contract.provides)
  local data = namedSet(name, "data", contract.data or {})
  for field in pairs(data) do
    if provides[field] or type(module[field]) ~= "table" then
      error(name .. ": dado público inválido: " .. field, 2)
    end
  end
  for field in pairs(provides) do
    if type(module[field]) ~= "function" then
      error(name .. ": API declarada ausente: " .. field, 2)
    end
  end
  for field, value in pairs(module) do
    if type(value) == "function" and not provides[field] then
      error(name .. ": função não declarada no contrato: " .. tostring(field), 2)
    end
    if type(value) == "table" and not CONFIG.RESERVED[field] and not data[field] then
      error(name .. ": tabela pública não declarada: " .. tostring(field), 2)
    end
  end
  if contract.bindCharacter == true and (not provides.bindCharacter or not provides.detachCharacter) then
    error(name .. ": contrato bindCharacter incompleto", 2)
  end
  if contract.onBallSync == true and not provides.onBallSync then
    error(name .. ": contrato onBallSync incompleto", 2)
  end
  local requires = contract.requires or {}
  local methods = contract.requiresMethods or {}
  local fields = contract.requiresData or {}
  local versions = contract.requiresVersions or {}
  if type(requires) ~= "table" or type(methods) ~= "table" or type(fields) ~= "table" or type(versions) ~= "table" then
    error(name .. ": dependências inválidas", 2)
  end
  local uses, sources = {}, {}
  for alias, source in pairs(requires) do
    if type(alias) ~= "string" or type(source) ~= "string" or alias == "" or source == "" or sources[source] or source == name then
      error(name .. ": dependência inválida ou duplicada: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
    sources[source] = true
    uses[alias] = {
      source = source,
      methods = namedSet(name, alias .. ".requiresMethods", methods[alias] or {}),
      data = namedSet(name, alias .. ".requiresData", fields[alias] or {}),
    }
    for field in pairs(uses[alias].methods) do
      if uses[alias].data[field] then
        error(name .. ": método e dado duplicados: " .. field, 2)
      end
    end
  end
  for alias in pairs(methods) do
    if not uses[alias] then
      error(name .. ": requiresMethods sem dependência: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
  end
  for alias in pairs(fields) do
    if not uses[alias] then
      error(name .. ": requiresData sem dependência: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
  end
  for alias, minimum in pairs(versions) do
    if not uses[alias] or type(minimum) ~= "number" or minimum < 0 or minimum ~= minimum or minimum == math.huge then
      error(name .. ": versão de dependência inválida: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
    uses[alias].minimum = minimum
  end
  if
    contract.version ~= nil
    and (type(contract.version) ~= "number" or contract.version < 0 or contract.version ~= contract.version or contract.version == math.huge)
  then
    error(name .. ": versão do contrato inválida", 2)
  end
  local commandData = {}
  for field in pairs(data) do
    commandData[field] = hasFunctions(module[field])
  end
  registry[name] = {
    name = name,
    path = path,
    family = familyFor(name, path),
    module = module,
    provides = provides,
    data = data,
    commandData = commandData,
    uses = uses,
    version = contract.version,
    access = readonly(contract.access or {}),
    owned = readonly(module.__config and module.__config.schema or {}),
  }
  return true
end
readonly = function(value, visited)
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return value
  end
  visited = visited or {}
  if visited[value] then
    return visited[value]
  end
  local copy = {}
  visited[value] = copy
  for key, item in pairs(value) do
    copy[readonly(key, visited)] = readonly(item, visited)
  end
  return table.freeze(copy)
end
local function wrap(consumer, source, provider)
  local entry, exposed = registry[consumer], registry[source]
  if not entry or not exposed or exposed.module ~= provider then
    error("Permissions: módulo não validado: " .. tostring(source), 2)
  end
  local use
  for _, dependency in pairs(entry.uses) do
    if dependency.source == source then
      use = dependency
      break
    end
  end
  if not use then
    error("Dependência interna não declarada: " .. consumer .. " -> " .. source, 2)
  end
  for method in pairs(use.methods) do
    if not exposed.provides[method] then
      error(consumer .. ": API ausente: " .. source .. "." .. method, 2)
    end
    local ok, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, method, false)
    if not ok then
      deny(consumer, entry.family .. " -> " .. permission)
    end
  end
  for field in pairs(use.data) do
    if not exposed.data[field] then
      error(consumer .. ": dado ausente: " .. source .. "." .. field, 2)
    end
    local ok, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, field, true)
    if not ok then
      deny(consumer, entry.family .. " -> " .. permission)
    end
  end
  local members = {}
  for method in pairs(use.methods) do
    local ok, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, method, false)
    if ok then
      local callback = provider[method]
      if permission == "config.own" then
        members[method] = function(patch)
          if type(patch) ~= "table" then
            error("Config patch inválido", 2)
          end
          for key in pairs(patch) do
            if not entry.owned[key] then
              deny(consumer, "config.write outside owned settings: " .. tostring(key))
            end
          end
          return callback(patch)
        end
      else
        members[method] = function(...)
          local result = table.pack(callback(...))
          if permission == "internal.read" and not contains(exposed.access.references, method) then
            for i = 1, result.n do
              if type(result[i]) == "table" then
                result[i] = readonly(result[i])
              end
            end
          end
          return table.unpack(result, 1, result.n)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for field in pairs(use.data) do
    if canConsume(entry, exposed, field, true) then
      members[field] = readonly(provider[field])
    end
  end
  table.freeze(members)
  local view = {}
  setmetatable(view, {
    __index = function(_, field)
      local value = members[field]
      if value ~= nil then
        return value
      end
      if exposed.provides[field] or exposed.data[field] then
        if not use.methods[field] and not use.data[field] then
          deny(consumer, "undeclared API: " .. source .. "." .. tostring(field))
        end
        local _, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, field, exposed.data[field] == true)
        deny(consumer, entry.family .. " -> " .. permission)
      end
      error("API interna ausente: " .. source .. "." .. tostring(field), 2)
    end,
    __newindex = function(_, field) deny(consumer, "api.write." .. source .. "." .. tostring(field)) end,
  })
  local metatable = getmetatable(view)
  table.freeze(view)
  metatable.__metatable = "locked"
  table.freeze(metatable)
  return view
end

-- resolution
local function resolve(consumer, loaded)
  local entry = registry[consumer]
  if type(loaded) ~= "table" or not entry or entry.module ~= loaded[consumer] then
    error("Permissions: módulo não validado: " .. tostring(consumer), 2)
  end
  local dependencies = {}
  for alias, use in pairs(entry.uses) do
    local provider, source = loaded[use.source], registry[use.source]
    if not source or source.module ~= provider then
      error(("API interna ausente: dependência %s (%s)"):format(alias, use.source), 2)
    end
    if use.minimum and (type(source.version) ~= "number" or source.version < use.minimum) then
      error(("API incompatível: %s requer versão %s; encontrada %s"):format(alias, tostring(use.minimum), tostring(source.version)), 2)
    end
    dependencies[alias] = wrap(consumer, use.source, provider)
  end
  return dependencies
end

-- introspection
local function policy(name)
  local entry = registry[name]
  if not entry then
    error("Permissions: módulo não registrado: " .. tostring(name), 2)
  end
  local result = { family = entry.family, capabilities = table.clone(POLICY.base), provides = {}, dependencies = {} }
  for _, permission in ipairs(POLICY.types[entry.family]) do
    result.capabilities[#result.capabilities + 1] = permission
  end
  table.sort(result.capabilities)
  for method in pairs(entry.provides) do
    result.provides[#result.provides + 1] = method
  end
  table.sort(result.provides)
  for _, use in pairs(entry.uses) do
    result.dependencies[#result.dependencies + 1] = use.source
  end
  table.sort(result.dependencies)
  return result
end

-- public-api
Permissions.configure = configure
Permissions.validate = validate
Permissions.wrap = wrap
Permissions.resolve = resolve
Permissions.policy = policy
function Permissions.getPath(name) return registry[name] and registry[name].path end

-- contract
Permissions.__contract = {
  provides = { "configure", "validate", "wrap", "resolve", "policy", "getPath" },
  requires = {},
}

return Permissions

-- [[ executor startup and teleport execution ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules autoexecute

local AutoExecute = {}
local utils, observer, channel
local settings = { allGames = false, games = {} }
local environment, queue, startupDirectory
local syncing, armed = false, false
local mode = "Desativado"
local PATH = "Exodus Hub/auto_execute.json"
local SCRIPT = "Exodus Hub/auto_execute.luau"
local function gameKey() return game.GameId ~= 0 and game.GameId ~= nil and ("u:" .. tostring(game.GameId)) or ("p:" .. tostring(game.PlaceId)) end
local function anyEnabled() return settings.allGames or next(settings.games) ~= nil end
local function bootstrap()
  return [[local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
if env.ExodusAutoExecuteStarted then return end
if game.PlaceId == 0 and not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
local ok, state = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile("Exodus Hub/auto_execute.json")) end)
if not ok or type(state) ~= "table" then return end
if state.allGames ~= true and (type(state.games) ~= "table" or next(state.games) == nil) then return end
local key = game.GameId ~= 0 and game.GameId ~= nil and ("u:" .. tostring(game.GameId)) or ("p:" .. tostring(game.PlaceId))
local allowed = state.allGames == true or (type(state.games) == "table" and state.games[key] == true)
if not allowed then
  local queue = env.queue_on_teleport or env.queueonteleport or (env.syn and env.syn.queue_on_teleport) or (env.fluxus and env.fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
  if type(queue) == "function" then pcall(queue, readfile("Exodus Hub/auto_execute.luau")) end
  return
end
if type(state.entryURL) ~= "string" or not state.entryURL:match("^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/") then return end
env.ExodusAutoExecuteStarted = true
local attempt = 0
local function start()
  local valid, current = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile("Exodus Hub/auto_execute.json")) end)
  if not valid or type(current) ~= "table" or not (current.allGames == true or (type(current.games) == "table" and current.games[key] == true)) then
    env.ExodusAutoExecuteStarted = nil
    return
  end
  local success, reason = pcall(function()
    local owner, repo, _, path = state.entryURL:match("^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/(.+)$")
    local revision = current.revision
    local urls = {{url=state.entryURL}}
    if owner and type(revision)=="string" and #revision==40 and revision:match("^[%x]+$") then
      local prefix, suffix = owner .. "/" .. repo, owner .. "/" .. repo .. "@" .. revision .. "/" .. path
      for _, host in ipairs({"cdn.jsdelivr.net", "fastly.jsdelivr.net", "gcore.jsdelivr.net", "testingcf.jsdelivr.net", "quantil.jsdelivr.net"}) do
        urls[#urls+1]={url="https://" .. host .. "/gh/" .. suffix}
      end
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://cdn.statically.io/gh/" .. suffix}
      table.insert(urls,3,{url="https://rawcdn.githack.com/" .. prefix .. "/" .. revision .. "/" .. path})
      table.insert(urls,4,{url="https://raw.githack.com/" .. prefix .. "/" .. revision .. "/" .. path})
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://github.com/" .. prefix .. "/raw/" .. revision .. "/" .. path}
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://api.github.com/repos/" .. prefix .. "/contents/" .. path .. "?ref=" .. revision,headers={Accept="application/vnd.github.raw+json"}}
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://api.github.com/repos/" .. prefix .. "/contents/" .. path .. "?ref=" .. revision,headers={Accept="application/vnd.github.object+json"},json=true}
    end
    local fetchers, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(fn)
      if type(fn)=="function" and not seen[fn] then seen[fn]=true; fetchers[#fetchers+1]=fn end
    end
    add(env.request); add(env.http_request)
    for _, name in ipairs({"syn","fluxus","http"}) do if type(env[name])=="table" then add(env[name].request) end end
    add(function(options) return {StatusCode=200,Body=game:HttpGet(options.Url)} end)
    add(function(options) return {StatusCode=200,Body=game:HttpGetAsync(options.Url)} end)
    local chunk, failure
    for _, target in ipairs(urls) do
      for _, fetch in ipairs(fetchers) do
        local ok, response = pcall(fetch,{Url=target.url,Method="GET",Headers=target.headers,Timeout=1})
        if ok and type(response)=="table" then
          local status=tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.status_code) or 200
          local source=response.Body or response.body or response.ResponseBody
          if status>=200 and status<300 and type(source)=="string" then
            if target.json then
              local ok, data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(source) end)
              if ok and type(data)=="table" and data.encoding=="base64" and type(data.content)=="string" then
                local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
                local bytes,value,bits={},0,0
                for char in data.content:gmatch(".") do
                  if char=="=" then break end
                  if not char:match("%s") then
                    local position=alphabet:find(char,1,true)
                    if not position then error("Base64 inválido") end
                    value,bits=value*64+position-1,bits+6
                    if bits>=8 then bits-=8; local divisor=2^bits; bytes[#bytes+1]=string.char(math.floor(value/divisor)); value%=divisor end
                  end
                end
                source=table.concat(bytes)
              else source="" end
            end
            chunk, failure=source~="" and loadstring(source) or nil
            if chunk then env.ExodusCachedLoader={url=state.entryURL,source=source}; break end
          else
            failure="HTTP " .. tostring(status)
            if status==403 or status==429 then break end
          end
        else failure=tostring(response) end
      end
      if chunk then break end
    end
    if not chunk and type(env.ExodusCachedLoader)=="table" and env.ExodusCachedLoader.url==state.entryURL then
      chunk, failure=loadstring(env.ExodusCachedLoader.source)
    end
    assert(chunk,failure or "Todas as fontes do loader falharam")
    chunk()
  end)
  if success then return end
  attempt += 1
  local delay = math.min(60, 5 * 2 ^ math.min(attempt - 1, 4))
  if delay > 5 then
    warn("[Exodus Auto Execute] Erro: " .. tostring(reason) .. "; nova tentativa em " .. delay .. "s.")
    pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title="Exodus · Erro", Text="Falha ao carregar. Nova tentativa em " .. delay .. "s.", Duration=5}) end)
  end
  task.delay(delay, start)
end
start()
]]
end
local function filesAvailable()
  return type(environment.readfile) == "function"
    and type(environment.writefile) == "function"
    and type(environment.isfile) == "function"
    and type(environment.isfolder) == "function"
    and type(environment.makefolder) == "function"
end
local function sync()
  if not channel then
    return
  end
  if not filesAvailable() then
    mode = "Executor sem persistência"
    return false
  end
  if not environment.isfolder("Exodus Hub") then
    environment.makefolder("Exodus Hub")
  end
  settings.entryURL = channel.entryURL()
  settings.revision = channel.revision
  environment.writefile(PATH, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(settings))
  local source = bootstrap()
  environment.writefile(SCRIPT, source)
  if startupDirectory then
    if not environment.isfolder(startupDirectory) then
      environment.makefolder(startupDirectory)
    end
    if anyEnabled() then
      local installed = pcall(environment.writefile, startupDirectory .. "/ExodusHub.luau", source)
      if not installed then
        startupDirectory = nil
      end
    elseif type(environment.delfile) == "function" and environment.isfile(startupDirectory .. "/ExodusHub.luau") then
      pcall(environment.delfile, startupDirectory .. "/ExodusHub.luau")
    end
  end
  if anyEnabled() and queue and not armed then
    queue(source)
    armed = true
  end
  mode = not anyEnabled() and "Desativado"
    or (startupDirectory and "Ao entrar e após teleporte" or (queue and "Após teleporte; inicializador salvo" or "Inicializador salvo"))
  return true
end
function AutoExecute.setup(deps)
  AutoExecute.teardown()
  mode, syncing = "Desativado", false
  utils = deps.Utils
  environment = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  queue = environment.queue_on_teleport
    or environment.queueonteleport
    or (environment.syn and environment.syn.queue_on_teleport)
    or (environment.fluxus and environment.fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
  if type(queue) ~= "function" then
    queue = nil
  end
  startupDirectory = nil
  local directoryAPI = environment.getautoexecpath or environment.getautoexecfolder
  if type(directoryAPI) == "function" then
    local ok, path = pcall(directoryAPI)
    if ok and type(path) == "string" and path ~= "" then
      startupDirectory = path
    end
  elseif type(environment.delta) == "table" and type(environment.delta.AddTab) == "function" then
    startupDirectory = "DeltaPlugins"
  end
  settings = { allGames = false, games = {} }
  if filesAvailable() then
    local ok, saved = pcall(function()
      if environment.isfile(PATH) then
        return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(environment.readfile(PATH))
      end
    end)
    if ok and type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.games) == "table" then
      settings.allGames = saved.allGames == true
      for key, value in pairs(saved.games) do
        if type(key) == "string" and value == true then
          settings.games[key] = true
        end
      end
    end
  end
  utils.setConfig({ AutoExecuteOnJoin = settings.allGames or settings.games[gameKey()] == true, AutoExecuteAllGames = settings.allGames })
  observer = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if syncing or (changes.AutoExecuteOnJoin == nil and changes.AutoExecuteAllGames == nil) then
      return
    end
    local previous = { allGames = settings.allGames, games = table.clone(settings.games), entryURL = settings.entryURL }
    if utils.getConfigValue("AutoExecuteOnJoin") ~= true then
      if settings.allGames then
        settings.games = {}
      end
      settings.allGames = false
      settings.games[gameKey()] = nil
    elseif changes.AutoExecuteAllGames ~= nil then
      settings.allGames = changes.AutoExecuteAllGames == true
      if not settings.allGames then
        settings.games = { [gameKey()] = true }
      end
    else
      settings.games[gameKey()] = true
      settings.allGames = utils.getConfigValue("AutoExecuteAllGames") == true
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(sync)
    if not ok or result == false then
      utils.recordError("AutoExecute", ok and mode or result)
      settings = previous
      if filesAvailable() then
        pcall(function() environment.writefile(PATH, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(previous)) end)
      end
    end
    syncing = true
    utils.setConfig({ AutoExecuteOnJoin = settings.allGames or settings.games[gameKey()] == true, AutoExecuteAllGames = settings.allGames })
    syncing = false
  end)
  return true
end
function AutoExecute.start(transport)
  channel = transport
  if anyEnabled() then
    local ok, reason = pcall(sync)
    if not ok then
      utils.recordError("AutoExecute", reason)
    end
  end
  return true
end
function AutoExecute.getStatus() return { mode = mode, startup = startupDirectory ~= nil, teleport = queue ~= nil } end
function AutoExecute.teardown()
  if observer then
    observer:Disconnect()
    observer = nil
  end
  utils, channel, armed = nil, nil, false
  return true
end
AutoExecute.__config =
  { schema = { AutoExecuteOnJoin = "boolean", AutoExecuteAllGames = "boolean" }, defaults = { AutoExecuteOnJoin = false, AutoExecuteAllGames = false } }
AutoExecute.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { getStatus = "internal.read" } },
  provides = { "setup", "start", "teardown", "getStatus" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "setConfig", "getConfigValue", "observeConfig", "recordError" } },
}
return AutoExecute

-- [[ server location sources ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules serverlocation

local Location = {}
local scope, result, failure, currentStatus
-- Region codes identify the datacenter area, not precise street coordinates.
local regions = {
  AMS = { "Países Baixos", "Amsterdã" },
  BOM = { "Índia", "Mumbai" },
  CDG = { "França", "Paris" },
  DFW = { "Estados Unidos", "Dallas" },
  FRA = { "Alemanha", "Frankfurt" },
  GRU = { "Brasil", "São Paulo" },
  HKG = { "Hong Kong", "Hong Kong" },
  IAD = { "Estados Unidos", "Ashburn" },
  LAX = { "Estados Unidos", "Los Angeles" },
  LHR = { "Reino Unido", "Londres" },
  MIA = { "Estados Unidos", "Miami" },
  NRT = { "Japão", "Tóquio" },
  ORD = { "Estados Unidos", "Chicago" },
  SEA = { "Estados Unidos", "Seattle" },
  SIN = { "Singapura", "Singapura" },
  SJC = { "Estados Unidos", "San Jose" },
  SYD = { "Austrália", "Sydney" },
  WAW = { "Polônia", "Varsóvia" },
}
local function text(value)
  if type(value) == "string" and value:match("%S") then
    return value
  end
  return nil
end
local function publicIP(value)
  if type(value) ~= "string" then
    return nil
  end
  local ip = value:match("^(%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)[|:]?%d*$")
  if not ip then
    return nil
  end
  local octets = {}
  for part in ip:gmatch("%d+") do
    local n = tonumber(part)
    if not n or n > 255 then
      return nil
    end
    octets[#octets + 1] = n
  end
  local a, b = octets[1], octets[2]
  if
    a == 0
    or a == 10
    or a == 127
    or a >= 224
    or (a == 100 and b >= 64 and b <= 127)
    or (a == 169 and b == 254)
    or (a == 172 and b >= 16 and b <= 31)
    or (a == 192 and b == 168)
    or (a == 192 and b == 0)
    or (a == 198 and (b == 18 or b == 19 or b == 51))
    or (a == 203 and b == 0)
  then
    return nil
  end
  return ip
end
local function attribute(object, name)
  local ok, value = pcall(function()
    local current = object:GetAttribute(name)
    if current ~= nil then
      return current
    end
    local child = object:FindFirstChild(name)
    return child and child:IsA("StringValue") and child.Value or nil
  end)
  return ok and text(value) or nil
end
function Location.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Location.setup(deps)
  Location.teardown()
  scope, result, failure = deps.Lifetime.scope(), {}, nil
  local owner = scope
  local environment = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  local candidates, seen = {}, {}
  local function add(callback)
    if type(callback) == "function" and not seen[callback] then
      candidates[#candidates + 1], seen[callback] = callback, true
    end
  end
  add(environment.request)
  add(environment.http_request)
  for _, name in ipairs({ "syn", "fluxus", "http" }) do
    if type(environment[name]) == "table" then
      add(environment[name].request)
    end
  end
  local status = { state = "reading", source = nil, error = nil }
  local function confirmed() return result.country ~= nil and result.estimated ~= true end
  local function readMetadata()
    local value = {}
    local ok, code = pcall(function() return game.ServerRegion end)
    local native = ok and text(code) and regions[string.upper(code)]
    if native then
      value = { country = native[1], city = native[2], source = "Região publicada pelo servidor" }
    end
    for _, root in ipairs({ game, workspace, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") }) do
      local objects = { root }
      for _, name in ipairs({ "ServerInfo", "ServerInformation", "ServerData" }) do
        local container = root:FindFirstChild(name)
        if container then
          objects[#objects + 1] = container
        end
      end
      for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
        value.country, value.city = value.country or attribute(object, "ServerCountry"), value.city or attribute(object, "ServerCity")
        local region = attribute(object, "ServerRegion")
        local mapped = region and regions[string.upper(region)]
        if mapped then
          value.country, value.city = value.country or mapped[1], value.city or mapped[2]
        end
      end
    end
    if value.country then
      value.source = value.source or "Informação publicada pelo jogo"
      result, failure, status.state, status.source = value, nil, "ready", value.source
    end
  end
  pcall(readMetadata)
  local cached = _G.ExodusServerLocationCache
  if
    not confirmed()
    and type(cached) == "table"
    and cached.placeId == game.PlaceId
    and cached.jobId == game.JobId
    and type(cached.expires) == "number"
    and cached.expires > os.time()
    and type(cached.value) == "table"
  then
    result, status.state = table.clone(cached.value), "ready"
  end
  local function fetch(url)
    local lastError
    for _, request in ipairs(candidates) do
      local ok, response = pcall(request, { Url = url, Method = "GET", Timeout = 5 })
      if ok and type(response) == "table" then
        local code = tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.status_code)
        local body = response.Body or response.body or response.ResponseBody
        if (not code or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" then
          return body
        end
        lastError = "HTTP " .. tostring(code or "invalid response")
        if code == 429 then
          return nil, lastError
        end
      else
        lastError = tostring(response)
      end
    end
    local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
    if ok and type(body) == "string" then
      return body
    end
    return nil, lastError or tostring(body)
  end
  local peer, attempted, worker
  local function resolve(value)
    local ip = publicIP(value)
    if not owner.alive or not ip then
      return
    end
    peer = ip
    if confirmed() or result.country or worker or attempted == ip then
      return
    end
    attempted, status.state = ip, "looking-up"
    worker = owner.defer(function()
      local found
      -- Sequential providers; one live lookup and no location of the player's connection.
      for _, url in ipairs({ "https://ipwho.is/" .. ip, "https://ipapi.co/" .. ip .. "/json/" }) do
        if not owner.alive or confirmed() then
          break
        end
        local body, err = fetch(url)
        if not owner.alive then
          return
        end
        if body then
          local ok, data = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
          if ok and type(data) == "table" and (data.ip or data.query) == ip and data.success ~= false and not data.error then
            local country = text(data.country_name) or text(data.country)
            if country then
              found = { country = country, city = text(data.city), estimated = true, source = "Localização aproximada do ponto de conexão do servidor" }
              break
            end
          end
          err = "Resposta de geolocalização inválida"
        end
        status.error = tostring(err)
      end
      worker = nil
      if not owner.alive or confirmed() then
        return
      end
      if found then
        result, failure, status.state, status.source, status.error = found, nil, "ready", found.source, nil
        _G.ExodusServerLocationCache = { placeId = game.PlaceId, jobId = game.JobId, expires = os.time() + 600, value = table.clone(found) }
      else
        status.state, failure = "unavailable", "Não foi possível consultar o país do servidor."
      end
    end)
  end
  local current = false
  local function readLog(message)
    if type(message) ~= "string" then
      return
    end
    local job = message:match("[Jj]oining game ['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]")
    if job then
      current = job == game.JobId
    end
    if type(game.JobId) == "string" and game.JobId ~= "" and message:find(game.JobId, 1, true) then
      current = true
    end
    if not current then
      return
    end
    local address = message:match("UDMUX Address%s*=%s*(%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)")
      or message:match("[Cc]onnecting to UDMUX server%s+(%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)")
      or message:match("[Cc]onnection accepted from%s+(%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)")
    if address then
      resolve(address)
    end
  end
  pcall(function() owner.connect(game:GetService("NetworkClient").ConnectionAccepted, resolve) end)
  pcall(function()
    local logs = game:GetService("LogService")
    owner.connect(logs.MessageOut, function(message) readLog(message) end)
    for _, entry in ipairs(logs:GetLogHistory()) do
      readLog(entry.message or entry.Message)
    end
  end)
  for _, service in ipairs({ "Workspace", "ReplicatedStorage" }) do
    local object = game:GetService(service)
    for _, name in ipairs({ "ServerCountry", "ServerCity", "ServerRegion" }) do
      owner.connect(object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name), readMetadata)
    end
    owner.connect(object.ChildAdded, function(child)
      if
        child.Name == "ServerInfo"
        or child.Name == "ServerInformation"
        or child.Name == "ServerData"
        or child.Name == "ServerRegion"
        or child.Name == "ServerCountry"
      then
        pcall(readMetadata)
      end
    end)
  end
  owner.delay(8, function()
    if not result.country and not worker then
      failure, status.state = "O cliente não expôs a localização do servidor.", "unavailable"
    end
  end)
  -- Retry bounded failures, not requests every frame; confirmed metadata needs no polling.
  local retries = 0
  local function retry()
    if not owner.alive or result.country or retries >= 2 then
      return
    end
    retries += 1
    pcall(readMetadata)
    if peer and not worker then
      attempted = nil
      resolve(peer)
    end
    if not result.country then
      owner.delay(30, retry)
    end
  end
  owner.delay(30, retry)
  owner.add(function() status.state = "stopped" end)
  currentStatus = status
  return true
end
function Location.getStatus() return table.clone(currentStatus or { state = "stopped" }) end
function Location.snapshot() return table.clone(result or {}), failure end
Location.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { snapshot = "internal.read" } },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "snapshot", "getStatus" },
  requires = { Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresMethods = { Lifetime = { "scope" } },
}
return Location

-- [[ automatic updates ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules updates

local Updates = {}
local utils, hub
local transport
local generation = 0
local checking = false
local pending
local CONFIG = { POLL_SECONDS = 300, SAFE_SECONDS = 0.4, STATE_INTERVAL = 0.1 }

function Updates.teardown()
  generation += 1
  checking, pending, transport = false, nil, nil
  return true
end
function Updates.setup(deps)
  Updates.teardown()
  utils, hub = deps.Utils, deps.Hub
  return true
end
function Updates.awaitSafe(isCurrent)
  local safeSince
  while utils and utils.isActive() and (not isCurrent or isCurrent()) do
    if hub.canUpdate() then
      safeSince = safeSince or os.clock()
      if os.clock() - safeSince >= CONFIG.SAFE_SECONDS then
        return true
      end
    else
      safeSince = nil
    end
    task.wait(CONFIG.STATE_INTERVAL)
  end
  return false
end
function Updates.check()
  if checking or not transport or not utils.isActive() then
    return false
  end
  checking = true
  local owner, channel = generation, transport
  local function current() return owner == generation and utils.isActive() end
  local ok, reason = xpcall(function()
    local revision, err = channel.latest()
    if not current() then
      return
    end
    if not revision then
      error(err, 0)
    end
    if revision == _G.ExodusLastLoadedRevision then
      return
    end
    pending = revision
    local chunk, prepareError = channel.prepare(revision)
    if not chunk then
      error(prepareError, 0)
    end
    if not current() then
      return
    end
    -- The replacement downloads first, then rechecks the policy before stopping this session.
    _G.ExodusRequestedRevision = { revision = revision, automatic = true }
    chunk()
  end, function(err) return debug.traceback(tostring(err), 2) end)
  if owner == generation then
    checking = false
    if not ok then
      utils.recordError("Updates", reason)
    end
  end
  return ok
end
function Updates.start(channel)
  assert(type(channel.latest) == "function" and type(channel.prepare) == "function", "Missing update transport")
  transport = channel
  local owner = generation
  local function schedule()
    task.delay(CONFIG.POLL_SECONDS, function()
      if owner ~= generation or not utils.isActive() then
        return
      end
      if utils.getConfigValue("AutoExecute") == true then
        Updates.check()
      end
      if owner == generation and utils.isActive() then
        schedule()
      end
    end)
  end
  schedule()
  return true
end
function Updates.getStatus() return { checking = checking, revision = pending } end
Updates.__config = { schema = { AutoExecute = "boolean" }, defaults = { AutoExecute = true } }
Updates.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "start", "check", "awaitSafe", "getStatus" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Hub = "hubapi" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "isActive", "getConfigValue", "recordError" }, Hub = { "canUpdate" } },
}
return Updates

--!optimize 2
-- @modules utils

local Utils = {}
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicated = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local state
local stateModule
local persistence
local diagnostics
local refreshNamespace
local configModule, modules = nil, {}
local connectionIndexes = { global = {}, character = {} }
local observerIndexes = { config = {} }
local configObservers = {}
local CONFIG = {
  API_VERSION = 2,
  VERSION = "3.0.0",
  NAME = "Exodus Hub",
  AUTHOR = "deltapolinha_2915",
  FOLDER = "Exodus Hub",
  HISTORY_LIMIT = 32,
}

local function snapshot(value) return type(value) == "table" and stateModule.copy(value) or {} end
local function setValues(target, source)
  for key, value in pairs(source or {}) do
    target[key] = value
  end
end
local function connectObserver(list, indexMap, observer)
  if type(observer) ~= "function" then
    error("Observer precisa ser uma função", 2)
  end
  local connection = { Connected = true, callback = observer }
  list[#list + 1] = connection
  indexMap[connection] = #list
  function connection:Disconnect()
    if not self.Connected then
      return
    end
    self.Connected = false
    local index = indexMap[self]
    if not index then
      return
    end
    local lastIndex = #list
    local last = list[lastIndex]
    list[index] = last
    list[lastIndex] = nil
    indexMap[self] = nil
    if last and last ~= self then
      indexMap[last] = index
    end
  end
  return connection
end
local function notify(list, value)
  if #list == 0 then
    return
  end
  for _, observer in ipairs(table.clone(list)) do
    if observer.Connected then
      local ok, err = pcall(observer.callback, value)
      if not ok and type(warn) == "function" then
        warn("Falha ao notificar observador: " .. tostring(err))
      end
    end
  end
end
function Utils.observeConfig(observer) return connectObserver(configObservers, observerIndexes.config, observer) end
local function track(list, indexMap, connection)
  if not connection or type(connection.Disconnect) ~= "function" then
    error("Conexão inválida", 2)
  end
  if not indexMap[connection] then
    list[#list + 1] = connection
    indexMap[connection] = #list
  end
  return connection
end
local function untrack(list, indexMap, connection)
  local index = indexMap[connection]
  if not index then
    return false
  end
  local lastIndex = #list
  local last = list[lastIndex]
  list[index] = last
  list[lastIndex] = nil
  indexMap[connection] = nil
  if last and last ~= connection then
    indexMap[last] = index
  end
  return true
end
local function disconnectAll(list, indexMap)
  while #list > 0 do
    local connection = list[#list]
    untrack(list, indexMap, connection)
    local ok, err = pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
    if not ok and type(warn) == "function" then
      warn("Falha ao desconectar: " .. tostring(err))
    end
  end
end
local function lifecycleSnapshot()
  local result = snapshot(state.lifecycle)
  result.schema, result.generatedAt = CONFIG.API_VERSION, os.clock()
  return result
end
local function stateSnapshot()
  return {
    schema = CONFIG.API_VERSION,
    generatedAt = os.clock(),
    active = state.active,
    lifecycle = snapshot(state.lifecycle),
    config = snapshot(state.config),
    moduleURLs = snapshot(state.urls),
    connectionCounts = {
      global = #state.globalConnections,
      character = #state.characterConnections,
    },
  }
end
local function diagnosticsSnapshot() return diagnostics.snapshot() end
refreshNamespace = function()
  if not state then
    return
  end
  local namespace = type(_G.Exodus) == "table" and _G.Exodus or {}
  namespace.Name, namespace.InternalName, namespace.Version, namespace.ApiVersion, namespace.Author =
    CONFIG.NAME, "Exodus", CONFIG.VERSION, CONFIG.API_VERSION, CONFIG.AUTHOR
  namespace.State, namespace.Config, namespace.ModuleURLs, namespace.Diagnostics =
    stateSnapshot(), snapshot(state.config), snapshot(state.urls), diagnostics.snapshot(false)
  _G.Exodus = namespace
end
local function recordTransition(...) return diagnostics.recordTransition(...) end
function Utils.ensureDataFolder() return persistence.ensureDataFolder() end
function Utils.loadConfig()
  persistence.load()
  local saved = _G.ExodusSessionSettings
  if type(saved) == "table" and saved.placeId == game.PlaceId and saved.jobId == game.JobId then
    local patch = {}
    for key, value in pairs(saved.values or {}) do
      local descriptor = configModule.describe(key)
      if descriptor and (descriptor.scope == "hub" or saved.profile == CONFIG.PROFILE) and configModule.validatePatch({ [key] = value }) then
        patch[key] = value
      end
    end
    Utils.setConfig(patch)
  end
  return true
end
function Utils.configure(deps)
  local profile = deps.GameContext.getProfile()
  CONFIG.AUTHOR = profile.author or "deltapolinha_2915"
  CONFIG.PROFILE = profile.id or "universal"
  CONFIG.LEGACY_FOLDER = CONFIG.PROFILE == "phantom-ball" and "Exodus Hub" or "Exodus Hub/hubs/" .. CONFIG.PROFILE
  CONFIG.FOLDER = "Exodus Hub"
  stateModule = deps.State
  state = stateModule.create()
  diagnostics = deps.Diagnostics.create({
    state = state,
    config = CONFIG,
    snapshot = snapshot,
    lifecycleSnapshot = lifecycleSnapshot,
    getModules = function() return modules end,
    refresh = function() refreshNamespace() end,
  })
  persistence = deps.Persistence.create({
    state = state,
    config = CONFIG,
    getConfigModule = function() return configModule end,
    setConfig = Utils.setConfig,
    migrate = deps.Hub.migrateConfig,
  })
  return true
end
function Utils.start()
  _G.ExodusStop = Utils.stop
  local previous = state.lifecycle.phase
  state.active = true
  state.lifecycle.generation += 1
  state.lifecycle.startedAt, state.lifecycle.stoppedAt, state.lifecycle.phase = os.clock(), 0, "starting"
  recordTransition("Utils", previous, "starting", "start")
  refreshNamespace()
  return stateSnapshot()
end
function Utils.stop()
  if not state or not state.active then
    return true
  end
  local previous = state.lifecycle.phase
  local wasActive = state.active
  local shutdownReason = _G.ExodusShutdownReason
  if shutdownReason == "restart" or shutdownReason == "reload" or shutdownReason == "update" then
    _G.ExodusSessionSettings = { placeId = game.PlaceId, jobId = game.JobId, profile = CONFIG.PROFILE, values = snapshot(state.config) }
  elseif shutdownReason == "close" then
    _G.ExodusSessionSettings = nil
  end
  state.active = false
  state.lifecycle.generation += 1
  state.active = false
  local saved, saveError = pcall(persistence.stop)
  if not saved then
    warn("Failed to save configuration: " .. tostring(saveError))
  end
  state.lifecycle.stoppedAt = os.clock()
  disconnectAll(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character)
  disconnectAll(state.globalConnections, connectionIndexes.global)
  state.config, state.urls, modules = {}, {}, {}
  disconnectAll(configObservers, observerIndexes.config)
  if type(_G.Exodus) == "table" then
    local exodus = _G.Exodus
    exodus.Started, exodus.UIReady, exodus.Runtime, exodus.UI, exodus.Context, exodus.Options = false, false, nil, nil, nil, nil

  end
  state.lifecycle.phase = "stopped"
  recordTransition("Utils", previous, "stopped", "stop")
  if wasActive and shutdownReason ~= "update" and shutdownReason ~= "restart" and type(print) == "function" then
    print("[Exodus] Closed.")
  end
  refreshNamespace()
  return true
end
function Utils.isActive() return state.active end
function Utils.getStateSnapshot() return stateSnapshot() end
function Utils.getConfig() return snapshot(state.config) end
function Utils.getConfigValue(key) return state.config[key] end
function Utils.getConfigSnapshot() return snapshot(state.config) end
function Utils.getModuleURLsSnapshot() return snapshot(state.urls) end
function Utils.getLifecycle() return lifecycleSnapshot() end
function Utils.getDiagnostics() return diagnosticsSnapshot() end
function Utils.setDiagnosticsModules(value)
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    error("Módulos de diagnóstico inválidos", 2)
  end
  modules = table.clone(value)
  refreshNamespace()
  return true
end
function Utils.setLifecyclePhase(value)
  if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
    return false
  end
  local previous = state.lifecycle.phase
  if previous ~= value then
    state.lifecycle.phase = value
    recordTransition("Lifecycle", previous, value, "phase_change")
  end
  return true
end
function Utils.recordTransition(source, fromState, toState, reason) recordTransition(source, fromState, toState, reason) end
function Utils.recordError(source, message) return diagnostics.recordError(source, message) end
function Utils.isFiniteNumber(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
function Utils.isNonNegativeFiniteNumber(value) return Utils.isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= 0 end
function Utils.setConfig(patch)
  if type(patch) ~= "table" then
    error("Config patch inválido: esperado table", 2)
  end
  local normalized
  if configModule then
    local result, reason = configModule.normalizePatch(patch)
    if type(result) ~= "table" then
      error("Config inválida: " .. tostring(reason), 2)
    end
    normalized = result
  else
    normalized = snapshot(patch)
  end
  local changes, persistentChanged = {}, false
  for key, value in pairs(normalized) do
    if state.config[key] ~= value then
      state.config[key], changes[key] = value, value
      if persistence.isPersistentKey(key) then
        persistentChanged = true
      end
    end
  end
  if next(changes) == nil then
    return true
  end
  notify(configObservers, table.freeze(changes))
  refreshNamespace()
  if persistentChanged then
    persistence.queue(changes)
  end
  return true
end
function Utils.resetConfig()
  if not configModule or type(configModule.defaults) ~= "function" then
    error("Config defaults indisponíveis", 2)
  end
  local defaults = configModule.defaults()
  local normalized, reason = configModule.normalizePatch(defaults)
  if type(normalized) ~= "table" then
    error("Config defaults inválidos: " .. tostring(reason), 2)
  end
  state.config = normalized
  notify(configObservers, table.freeze(snapshot(normalized)))
  refreshNamespace()
  persistence.queue()
  persistence.flush()
  return true
end
function Utils.setConfigModule(module)
  if
    type(module) ~= "table"
    or type(module.normalizePatch) ~= "function"
    or type(module.validate) ~= "function"
    or type(module.validatePatch) ~= "function"
    or type(module.defaults) ~= "function"
    or type(module.isPersistentKey) ~= "function"
  then
    error("API interna ausente: Config.normalizePatch/validate/validatePatch/defaults/isPersistentKey", 2)
  end
  configModule = module
  return true
end
function Utils.setModuleURLs(urls)
  if type(urls) ~= "table" then
    error("URLs de módulos inválidas", 2)
  end
  setValues(state.urls, urls)
  refreshNamespace()
  return true
end
function Utils.trackGlobal(connection) return track(state.globalConnections, connectionIndexes.global, connection) end
function Utils.untrackGlobal(connection) return untrack(state.globalConnections, connectionIndexes.global, connection) end
function Utils.trackCharacter(connection) return track(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character, connection) end
function Utils.untrackCharacter(connection) return untrack(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character, connection) end
function Utils.disconnectCharacterConnections() disconnectAll(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character) end
function Utils.getPlayers() return players end
function Utils.getReplicatedStorage() return replicated end
function Utils.getRunService() return runService end
function Utils.getWorkspace() return workspace end
function Utils.getLocalPlayer() return players.LocalPlayer end
function Utils.now() return os.clock() end
function Utils.name() return CONFIG.NAME end
function Utils.version() return CONFIG.VERSION end
function Utils.apiVersion() return CONFIG.API_VERSION end
function Utils.author() return CONFIG.AUTHOR end
Utils.__contract = {
  access = {
    default = "infrastructure.write",
    references = { "getLocalPlayer", "getPlayers", "getRunService", "getWorkspace", "getReplicatedStorage" },
    methods = {
      now = "internal.read",
      apiVersion = "internal.read",
      name = "internal.read",
      author = "internal.read",
      version = "internal.read",
      setConfig = "config.write",
      resetConfig = "config.write",
      loadConfig = "config.write",

      stop = "hub.control",
      start = "hub.control",
      ensureDataFolder = "tooling.execute",
      disconnectCharacterConnections = "lifecycle.write",
      recordError = "diagnostics.write",
      recordTransition = "diagnostics.write",
    },
    scoped = { "setConfig" },
  },
  requires = {
    GameContext = "gamecontext",
    Hub = "hubapi",
    State = "state",
    Persistence = "persistence",
    Diagnostics = "diagnostics",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    GameContext = { "getProfile" },
    Hub = { "migrateConfig" },
    State = { "create", "copy" },
    Persistence = { "create" },
    Diagnostics = { "create" },
  },
  provides = {
    "configure",
    "start",
    "stop",
    "ensureDataFolder",
    "loadConfig",
    "getDiagnostics",
    "getLifecycle",
    "isFiniteNumber",
    "isNonNegativeFiniteNumber",
    "isActive",
    "getConfig",
    "getConfigValue",
    "setConfig",
    "resetConfig",
    "setConfigModule",
    "setModuleURLs",
    "setDiagnosticsModules",
    "setLifecyclePhase",
    "getStateSnapshot",
    "getConfigSnapshot",
    "getModuleURLsSnapshot",
    "getPlayers",
    "getLocalPlayer",
    "getRunService",
    "getReplicatedStorage",
    "getWorkspace",
    "now",
    "apiVersion",
    "name",
    "author",
    "version",
    "trackGlobal",
    "untrackGlobal",

--!optimize 2
-- @modules state

local State = {}
function State.setup() return true end
function State.create()
  return {
    active = false,
    config = {},
    urls = {},
    globalConnections = {},
    characterConnections = {},
    lifecycle = {
      phase = "stopped",
      generation = 0,
      startedAt = 0,
      stoppedAt = 0,
    },
    diagnostics = { errors = {}, transitions = {}, lastTransitionAt = 0 },
  }
end
local function copy(value, visited)
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return value
  end
  visited = visited or {}
  if visited[value] then
    return visited[value]
  end
  local result = {}
  visited[value] = result
  for key, item in pairs(value) do
    result[copy(key, visited)] = copy(item, visited)
  end
  return result
end
function State.copy(value) return copy(value) end
State.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create", "copy" } }
return State

-- [[ generic component actions and shortcuts ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uicommands
local Commands = {}
function Commands.setup() return true end
function Commands.create(context)
  local shortcuts, handles, result = {}, {}, {}
  local actions = context.actions or {}
  function result.resolve(definition)
    if definition.action then
      local callback = assert((actions.callbacks or {})[definition.action], "Unknown action: " .. tostring(definition.action))
      definition.onClick, definition.onChange = callback, callback
      definition.getState = (actions.states or {})[definition.action]
    end
    if actions.resolve then
      actions.resolve(definition)
    end
    return definition
  end
  function result.attach(definition, handle)
    if definition.shortcutKey then
      shortcuts[#shortcuts + 1] = { definition = definition, handle = handle }
    end
    if definition.action then
      handles[definition.action] = handle
    end
    if actions.attach then
      actions.attach(definition, handle)
    end
  end
  function result.validateShortcut(key, binding)
    if binding == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
      return true
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(shortcuts) do
      if entry.definition.shortcutKey ~= key and context.utils.getConfigValue(entry.definition.shortcutKey) == binding then
        return false, "Atalho já usado"
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  function result.triggerShortcut(binding, priorityOnly)
    for _, entry in ipairs(shortcuts) do
      if
        (not priorityOnly or entry.definition.shortcutPriority == 0)
        and context.utils.getConfigValue(entry.definition.shortcutKey) == binding
        and entry.handle.activate
      then
        return entry.handle.activate()
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function result.refreshStates()
    for name, read in pairs(actions.states or {}) do
      local handle = handles[name]
      if handle and handle.setValue then
        handle.setValue(read())
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end
Commands.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Commands

-- [[ shared surface appearance ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiappearance

local Appearance = {}
function Appearance.setup() return true end
function Appearance.borderColor(background, light)
  local hue, saturation, value = background:ToHSV()
  if saturation < 0.1 then
    hue, saturation = 0.69, 0.50
  end
  saturation = math.clamp(saturation, 0.45, 0.80)
  local brightness = value > 0.72 and value * 0.70 or math.clamp(value + 0.14, 0.25, 0.55)
  return Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, brightness)
end
function Appearance.interactionColor(background, pressed)
  local hue, saturation, value = Appearance.borderColor(background):ToHSV()
  return Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, math.min(0.72, value + (pressed and 0.09 or 0.05)))
end
function Appearance.borderGradient(background, strength)
  local hue, saturation = background:ToHSV()
  local color = strength and strength > 0 and Appearance.interactionColor(background, strength > 1) or Appearance.borderColor(background)
  local _, tint, value = color:ToHSV()
  if saturation < 0.1 then
    hue = 0.69
  end
  local first = (hue - 0.025) % 1
  local last = (hue + 0.025) % 1
  return ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(first, tint, value), Color3.fromHSV(last, tint, value))
end
local function instance(class, properties, parent)
  local object = Instance.new(class)
  for key, value in pairs(properties) do
    object[key] = value
  end
  object.Parent = parent
  return object
end
local function palette(kind)
  if kind == "critical" then
    return Color3.fromRGB(153, 27, 27)
  end
  if kind == "success" then
    return Color3.fromRGB(20, 92, 58)
  end
  if kind == "warning" then
    return Color3.fromRGB(100, 67, 18)
  end
  return Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 130)
end
function Appearance.notification(parent, name)
  local card = instance("CanvasGroup", {
    Name = name,
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 18),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 26),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    GroupTransparency = 1,
    ClipsDescendants = true,
    ZIndex = 100,
  }, parent)
  instance("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }, card)
  local outline = instance("Frame", {
    Name = "Outline",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 102,
  }, card)
  instance("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9) }, outline)
  instance("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, outline)
  local content = instance("ScrollingFrame", {
    Name = "Content",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -12),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 6),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
    ScrollBarThickness = 0,
    ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
    Active = true,
    ClipsDescendants = true,
    ZIndex = 101,
  }, card)
  instance("TextLabel", {
    Name = "Message",
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    Text = "",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextSize = 11,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
    TextWrapped = true,
    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
    RichText = false,
    ZIndex = 101,
  }, content)
  return card
end
function Appearance.updateNotification(card, message, kind, viewport)
  local content = card:FindFirstChild("Content")
  -- Replace cards created by older notification surfaces rather than retain an incompatible layout.
  assert(content and content:IsA("ScrollingFrame"), "Unsupported notification surface")
  local label = content:FindFirstChild("Message")
  local maxWidth = math.max(24, math.min(280, viewport.X - 24))
  local padding = math.min(10, math.max(2, (maxWidth - 4) / 4))
  local measure = game:GetService("TextService")
  local value = tostring(message)
  local function bounds(width) return measure:GetTextSize(value, 11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Vector2.new(math.max(1, width), 100000)) end
  local size = bounds(maxWidth - padding * 2)
  local width = math.min(maxWidth, math.max(math.min(80, maxWidth), math.ceil(size.X) + padding * 2 + 2))
  size = bounds(width - padding * 2)
  local maxHeight = math.max(26, viewport.Y - 48)
  local height = math.min(maxHeight, math.max(26, math.ceil(size.Y) + 14))
  local overflow = size.Y + 12 > height
  if overflow then
    size = bounds(width - padding * 2 - 4)
  end
  card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
  card.BackgroundColor3 = palette(kind)
  card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
  local outline = card:FindFirstChild("Outline")
  local line = outline:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  line.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  local gradient = line:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") or instance("UIGradient", { Rotation = 20 }, line)
  gradient.Color = Appearance.borderGradient(card.BackgroundColor3)
  content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(padding, 6)
  content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -padding * 2, 1, -12)
  content.ScrollingEnabled, content.ScrollBarThickness = overflow, overflow and 2 or 0
  content.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  content.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.ceil(size.Y) + 2)
  content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
  label.Text = value
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, overflow and -4 or 0, 0, math.max(height - 12, math.ceil(size.Y) + 2))
  return card
end
Appearance.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "borderColor", "interactionColor", "borderGradient", "notification", "updateNotification" }, requires = {} }
return Appearance

--!optimize 2
-- @modules uicontrols

local Components = {}

function Components.setup() return true end
function Components.install(context)
  local kit = context.kit
  local Theme = context.Theme
  local options = context.options
  local components = context.components
  local C = context.C
  local inst = context.inst

  local control = context.control
  local title = context.title

  local hitbox = context.hitbox
  local commit = context.commit
  local shortcut = context.shortcut
  local bind = context.bind
  local read = context.read
  function components.keybind(parent, definition)
    assert(kit.isDesktop(), "Keybind controls are unavailable in mobile mode; enable PC UI in settings")
    local height = Theme.CARD_H
    local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
    title(handle, definition, 64, height)
    shortcut(handle, definition.key, -64)
    return handle
  end
  function components.button(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local height = definition.description and Theme.CARD_H + 22 or Theme.CARD_H
    local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
    title(handle, definition, definition.shortcutKey and 64 or 0, height)
    function handle.activate()
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
        return false
      end
      if definition.onClick then
        return definition.onClick() ~= false
      end
      return true
    end
    hitbox(handle, handle.activate)
    shortcut(handle, definition.shortcutKey, -64)
    function handle.setText(value) handle.Root.Title.Text = tostring(value) end
    return handle
  end
  function components.toggle(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local height = definition.description and Theme.CARD_H + 22 or Theme.CARD_H
    if definition.expandedDescription and definition.description then
      height = Theme.CARD_H + 40
    end
    local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
    title(handle, definition, definition.shortcutKey and 120 or 58, height)
    local checkbox = definition.kind == "checkbox"
    local tint = definition.color or C.toggleOn
    local track = inst("Frame", {
      Size = checkbox and UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28) or UDim2.fromOffset(48, 30),
      Position = checkbox and UDim2.new(1, -46, 0.5, -14) or UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -15),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.toggleOff,
      ZIndex = 8,
    }, handle.Root)
    if definition.expandedDescription and definition.description then
      track.Position = UDim2.new(1, checkbox and -46 or -62, 0, 8)
    end
    kit.corner(track, checkbox and 8 or Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    kit.stroke(track, checkbox and tint or nil)
    local thumb
    if checkbox then
      thumb = inst("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "✓",
        TextColor3 = C.text,
        TextSize = 22,
        TextTransparency = 1,
        Font = Theme.FONT.strong,
        ZIndex = 9,
      }, track)
    else
      thumb = inst("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = C.text, ZIndex = 9 }, track)
      kit.corner(thumb, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    end
    local checkScale = checkbox and inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.8 }, track) or nil
    local value = false
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = nextValue == true
      handle.motion.play(track, "control", { BackgroundColor3 = value and tint or C.toggleOff })
      if checkbox then
        handle.motion.play(thumb, "control", { TextTransparency = value and 0 or 1 })
        handle.motion.play(checkScale, "feedback", { Scale = value and 1 or 0.9 })
      else
        handle.motion.play(thumb, "control", { Position = UDim2.new(0, value and 24 or 4, 0.5, -10) })
      end
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    function handle.activate()
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
        return false
      end
      local current = value
      if definition.getState then
        current = definition.getState()
      end
      local requested = not current
      if commit(handle, definition, requested) then
        if definition.getState then
          handle.setValue(definition.getState())
        else
          handle.setValue(requested)
        end
        if options.notify and definition.toast ~= false then
          options.notify(tostring(definition.title or definition.text or "Option") .. (handle.getValue() and " On" or " Off"))
        end
        return true
      end
      return false
    end
    hitbox(handle, handle.activate)
    shortcut(handle, definition.shortcutKey, nil, definition.expandedDescription and definition.description ~= nil)
    if definition.getState then
      handle.setValue(definition.getState())
    else
      handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    end
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
  components.checkbox = components.toggle
end
Components.__contract = { component = true, provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
return Components
