--!optimize 2
-- @modules uidisplay

local Components = {}

function Components.setup() return true end
function Components.install(context)
  local kit = context.kit
  local components = context.components
  local C = context.C
  local TEXT = context.TEXT
  local inst = context.inst
  local text = context.text
  local control = context.control

  local bind = context.bind
  local read = context.read
  local finite = context.finite
  function components.label(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    definition = table.clone(definition)
    definition.kind = "label"
    local handle = control(parent, definition, 24)
    handle.Root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    local outline = handle.Root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if outline then
      outline:Destroy()
    end
    local label = text(handle.Root, definition.title or definition.text, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextSize = TEXT.caption, TextColor3 = C.accent })
    function handle.setText(value) label.Text = tostring(value) end
    return handle
  end
  function components.readout(parent, definition)
    local handle = control(parent, definition, 40)
    local value = text(handle.Root, "", {
      Name = "Value",
      RichText = true,
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20),
      TextSize = TEXT.body,
      TextWrapped = true,
      TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
      TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
    })
    local function resize()
      local scale, ancestor = 1, handle.Root
      while ancestor do
        local transform = ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        if transform then
          scale *= transform.Scale
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
      end
      local width = math.max(40, handle.Root.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(0.01, scale) - 24)
      local bounds = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(value.Text:gsub("<[^>]->", ""), value.TextSize, value.Font, Vector2.new(width, 100000))
      local height = math.max(20, math.ceil(bounds.Y))
      value.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, height)
      handle.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height + 20)
    end
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      local content = tostring(nextValue or "")
      if value.Text ~= content then
        value.Text = content
        resize()
      end
    end
    handle.scope.connect(handle.Root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), resize)
    return handle
  end
  function components.progressBar(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local handle = control(parent, definition, 8)
    handle.Root.ClipsDescendants = true
    local fill = inst("Frame", { Name = "Fill", BackgroundColor3 = definition.color or C.accent, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), ZIndex = 8 }, handle.Root)
    kit.corner(fill)
    local value
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = math.clamp(finite(nextValue) or 0, 0, 1)
      handle.motion.play(fill, "control", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(value, 1) })
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
  function components.divider(parent, definition)
    local handle = components.label(parent, definition or {})
    handle.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 1)
    handle.Root.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    handle.Root.BackgroundColor3 = C.border
    return handle
  end
end
Components.__contract = { component = true, provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
return Components

-- [[ dropdown ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uidropdown

-- module
local Components = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = { DROPDOWN_ROWS = 4 }

-- setup
function Components.setup() return true end

-- components
function Components.install(context)
  local kit = context.kit
  local Theme = context.Theme
  local Runtime = context.Runtime
  local UIS = context.UIS
  local RunService = context.RunService
  local options = context.options
  local components = context.components
  local C = context.C
  local TEXT = context.TEXT
  local inst = context.inst
  local text = context.text
  local control = context.control
  local title = context.title
  local button = context.button
  local commit = context.commit
  local bind = context.bind
  local read = context.read
  local choiceValue = context.choiceValue
  local choiceLabel = context.choiceLabel
  local popup = context.popup
  function components.dropdown(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local choices = definition.options or definition.choices or {}
    local handle = control(parent, definition, Theme.RATE_CARD_H)
    title(handle, definition, 0, 24)
    local trigger = button(handle.Root, "", { Name = "Select", Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 29) })
    local selectedLabel = text(trigger, "", {
      Name = "Selected",
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0),
      ZIndex = 11,
    })
    local arrow = kit.icon(trigger, "chevron", { Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14) })
    local value, openScope, menu, menuMotion, menuScale
    local selecting, closing, optionViews = false, false, {}
    local close
    local function finishClose(owner)
      if openScope ~= owner then
        return
      end
      if popup.close == close then
        popup.close = nil
      end
      openScope, menu, menuMotion, menuScale = nil, nil, nil, nil
      selecting, closing, optionViews = false, false, {}
      owner.destroy()
    end
    close = function(animated)
      if not openScope then
        return
      end
      handle.motion.play(arrow, "feedback", { Rotation = 0 })
      local owner = openScope
      if animated ~= false then
        if closing then
          return
        end
        closing = true
        menuMotion.play(menuScale, "feedback", { Scale = 0.96 })
        menuMotion.group(menu, "feedback", { GroupTransparency = 1 }, function() finishClose(owner) end)
        task.delay(0.5, function()
          if openScope == owner and closing then
            finishClose(owner)
          end
        end)
      else
        if popup.close == close then
          popup.close = nil
        end
        finishClose(owner)
      end
    end
    kit.feedback(
      handle.scope,
      trigger,
      function(active, pressed) trigger:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", active and (pressed and 2 or 1) or 0) end,
      function() return handle.enabled end
    )
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = nextValue
      local label = tostring(value or definition.placeholder or "Select")
      for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
        if choiceValue(choice) == value then
          label = choiceLabel(choice)
          break
        end
      end
      selectedLabel.Text = label
      for _, refresh in ipairs(optionViews) do
        refresh()
      end
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    local function open()
      if definition.choiceSource and options.choices then
        choices = options.choices(definition.choiceSource)
        handle.setValue(value)
      end
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended or #choices == 0 or not options.parent or not Runtime.isVisible(handle.Root) then
        return
      end
      kit.dismiss()
      openScope = Runtime.scope()
      popup.close = close
      local portal = inst("ScreenGui", {
        Name = "ExodusDropdown",
        ResetOnSpawn = false,
        IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        DisplayOrder = Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER,
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
      }, options.parent.Parent)
      openScope.add(Runtime.mountLayer(portal, options.parent.Parent, Theme.SCREEN_LAYERS.popup))
      menu = inst("CanvasGroup", { BackgroundColor3 = C.card, GroupTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 1 }, portal)
      kit.corner(menu)
      kit.stroke(menu)
      menuScale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.96 }, menu)
      local list = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Active = true,
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
        ScrollBarThickness = Theme.SCROLLBAR,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.accent,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
        ZIndex = 2,
      }, menu)
      menuMotion = kit.createMotion(openScope)
      openScope.add(portal, function() portal:Destroy() end)
      local ensureRoom = true
      local lastGeometry
      local items = {}
      local function position()
        if closing then
          return
        end
        if not trigger.Parent or not Runtime.isVisible(trigger) then
          close()
          return
        end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local view = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        local pos, size = trigger.AbsolutePosition, trigger.AbsoluteSize
        local ancestor = trigger.Parent
        local scroll
        while ancestor and ancestor ~= options.parent do
          if
            ancestor:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and (pos.Y + size.Y <= ancestor.AbsolutePosition.Y or pos.Y >= ancestor.AbsolutePosition.Y + ancestor.AbsoluteSize.Y)
          then
            close()
            return
          end
          if not scroll and ancestor:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            scroll = ancestor
          end
          ancestor = ancestor.Parent
        end
        local rootPosition, rootSize = handle.Root.AbsolutePosition, handle.Root.AbsoluteSize
        local geometry = { pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y, view.X, view.Y, rootPosition.Y, rootSize.Y }
        local unchanged = lastGeometry ~= nil
        for index, coordinate in ipairs(geometry) do
          if not lastGeometry or lastGeometry[index] ~= coordinate then
            unchanged = false
            break
          end
        end
        if unchanged and not ensureRoom then
          return
        end
        lastGeometry = geometry
        local layout = Theme.DROPDOWN
        local scale = math.max(0.1, size.Y / 28)
        local row, gap, pad = layout.rowHeight * scale, layout.rowGap * scale, layout.padding * scale
        local visibleRows = math.clamp(tonumber(definition.maxVisible) or CONFIG.DROPDOWN_ROWS, 1, #choices)
        local desired = visibleRows * (row + gap) + pad * 2
        local bottom = math.max(pos.Y + size.Y, handle.Root.AbsolutePosition.Y + handle.Root.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        local margin, spacing = layout.margin, layout.gap * scale
        local below = math.max(0, view.Y - bottom - spacing - margin)
        local moved = false
        if ensureRoom and scroll and below < desired then
          local room = math.max(0, handle.Root.AbsolutePosition.Y - scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y - pad)
          local shift = math.min(desired - below, room)
          if shift > 0 then
            scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(scroll.CanvasPosition.X, scroll.CanvasPosition.Y + shift / scale)
            moved = true
          end
        end
        ensureRoom = false
        if moved then
          menu.Visible = false
          lastGeometry = nil
          return
        end
        local above = math.max(0, pos.Y - spacing - margin)
        local upward = below < desired and above > below
        local height = math.min(desired, upward and above or below)
        if height <= 0 then
          close()
          return
        end
        local width = math.min(size.X, math.max(1, view.X - margin * 2))
        menu.Visible = true
        menu.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
        menu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
        menu.Position =
          UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(pos.X, margin, math.max(margin, view.X - width - margin)), upward and pos.Y - spacing - height or bottom + spacing)
        list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #choices * (row + gap) + pad * 2)
        for index, item in ipairs(items) do
          item.Size = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2 - Theme.SCROLLBAR, 0, row)
          item.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pad, pad + (index - 1) * (row + gap))
          item.TextSize = math.max(10, TEXT.body * scale)
        end
      end
      local activeItem, resetActive
      for index, choice in ipairs(choices) do
        local selected = choiceValue(choice) == value
        local item = button(list, choiceLabel(choice), {
          LayoutOrder = index,
          BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
          BackgroundTransparency = 1,
          TextColor3 = selected and C.text or C.subtext,
          ZIndex = 3,
        })
        items[#items + 1] = item
        local border = kit.stroke(item)
        border.Transparency = 1
        local reset
        local refresh
        refresh, reset = kit.feedback(openScope, item, function(active, pressed)
          if active and activeItem ~= item then
            if resetActive then
              resetActive()
            end
            activeItem, resetActive = item, reset
          elseif not active and activeItem == item then
            activeItem, resetActive = nil, nil
          end
          local selectedNow = selecting and choiceValue(choice) == value
          item:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", active and (pressed and 2 or 1) or 0)
          menuMotion.play(border, "feedback", { Transparency = (active or selectedNow) and 0 or 1 })
          menuMotion.play(item, "feedback", {
            BackgroundTransparency = selectedNow and 0.1 or 1,
            BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
            TextColor3 = (active or selectedNow) and C.text or C.subtext,
          })
        end, function() return not selecting and not closing end)
        optionViews[#optionViews + 1] = refresh
        openScope.connect(item.Activated, function()
          if selecting or closing then
            return
          end
          if not commit(handle, definition, choiceValue(choice)) then
            return
          end
          selecting = true
          handle.setValue(choiceValue(choice))
          local owner = openScope
          task.delay(Theme.DROPDOWN.selectionDelay, function()
            if owner.alive and openScope == owner then
              close(true)
            end
          end)
        end)
      end
      position()
      if not openScope then
        return
      end
      menuMotion.group(menu, "control", { GroupTransparency = 0 })
      menuMotion.play(menuScale, "control", { Scale = 1 })
      handle.motion.play(arrow, "feedback", { Rotation = 180 })
      openScope.connect(RunService.Heartbeat, position)
      openScope.connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
          close()
          return
        end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          return
        end
        local function inside(root)
          local pos, size = root.AbsolutePosition, root.AbsoluteSize
          return input.Position.X >= pos.X and input.Position.X <= pos.X + size.X and input.Position.Y >= pos.Y and input.Position.Y <= pos.Y + size.Y
        end
        if not inside(menu) and not inside(trigger) then
          close()
        end
      end)
    end
    handle.scope.add(function() close(false) end)
    handle.scope.connect(trigger.Activated, function()
      if openScope then
        close()
      else
        open()
      end
    end)
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
end

-- contract
Components.__contract = { component = true, provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }

return Components

-- [[ inputs ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiinputs

-- module
local Components = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = { INPUT_WIDTH = 62 }

-- setup
function Components.setup() return true end

-- components
function Components.install(context)
  local drags = context.drags
  local kit = context.kit
  local Theme = context.Theme
  local Runtime = context.Runtime
  local UIS = context.UIS
  local components = context.components
  local C = context.C
  local FONT = context.FONT
  local TEXT = context.TEXT
  local inst = context.inst
  local text = context.text
  local control = context.control
  local title = context.title
  local button = context.button
  local commit = context.commit
  local bind = context.bind
  local read = context.read
  local finite = context.finite
  function components.textInput(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local height = definition.description and Theme.CARD_H + 22 or Theme.CARD_H
    local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
    title(handle, definition, 76, height)
    local input = inst("TextBox", {
      Name = "Input",
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CONFIG.INPUT_WIDTH, 30),
      Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0.5, -15),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg,
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = TEXT.control,
      Font = FONT.strong,
      ClearTextOnFocus = false,
      PlaceholderText = definition.placeholder or "",
      ZIndex = 11,
    }, handle.Root)
    kit.corner(input)
    local border = kit.stroke(input)
    local value
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = nextValue
      if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() == input then
        return
      end
      input.Text = tostring(definition.format and definition.format(value) or value or "")
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    function handle.setText(nextText) input.Text = tostring(nextText) end
    function handle.getText() return input.Text end
    handle.scope.connect(input.Focused, function() input:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", 2) end)
    handle.scope.connect(input.FocusLost, function(enterPressed)
      input:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", 0)
      local nextValue = input.Text
      if definition.parse then
        nextValue = definition.parse(input.Text)
      end
      if definition.numeric then
        nextValue = finite(input.Text)
        if nextValue then
          nextValue = math.clamp(nextValue, definition.min or 0, definition.max or math.huge)
          nextValue = nextValue / (definition.displayScale or 1)
        end
      end
      if nextValue ~= nil and commit(handle, definition, nextValue) then
        value = nextValue
      end
      handle.setValue(read(definition.key, value))
      if definition.onSubmit then
        definition.onSubmit(input.Text, enterPressed)
      end
    end)
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
  components.number = function(parent, definition)
    local copy = table.clone(definition)
    copy.numeric = true
    copy.format = function(value) return tostring((finite(value) or 0) * (definition.displayScale or 1)) end
    return components.textInput(parent, copy)
  end
  function components.slider(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local minimum, maximum = finite(definition.min) or 0, finite(definition.max) or 100
    local step = finite(definition.increment or definition.step) or 1
    assert(maximum > minimum and step > 0, "slider requires max > min and increment > 0")
    local height = definition.compact and Theme.CARD_H or (definition.description and 88 or 68)
    local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
    title(handle, definition, 72, math.min(height - 24, 70))
    local label = text(handle.Root, "", {
      Name = "Value",
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 20),
      Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 5),
      TextSize = TEXT.caption,
      TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
    })
    local track = inst(
      "Frame",
      { Name = "Track", Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -17), BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg, ZIndex = 8 },
      handle.Root
    )
    kit.corner(track, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    local fill = inst("Frame", { Name = "Fill", BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, Size = UDim2.new(), ZIndex = 9 }, track)
    kit.corner(fill, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    local knob =
      inst("Frame", { Name = "Thumb", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundColor3 = C.text, ZIndex = 10 }, track)
    kit.corner(knob, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    local hit = button(
      handle.Root,
      "",
      { Name = "SliderHitbox", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 11 }
    )
    hit.NextSelectionLeft, hit.NextSelectionRight = hit, hit
    local value
    local function normalize(nextValue)
      return math.clamp(minimum + math.floor(((finite(nextValue) or minimum) - minimum) / step + 0.5) * step, minimum, maximum)
    end
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = normalize(nextValue)
      local alpha = (value - minimum) / (maximum - minimum)
      fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
      knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
      label.Text = tostring(math.floor(value * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000) .. (definition.valueName and " " .. definition.valueName or "")
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    local function change(nextValue)
      local normalized = normalize(nextValue)
      if normalized ~= value and commit(handle, definition, normalized) then
        handle.setValue(normalized)
      end
    end
    local cancelDrag = Runtime.bindDrag(handle.scope, hit, function(input)
      if handle.enabled and track.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
        change(minimum + math.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1) * (maximum - minimum))
      end
    end, function() return handle.enabled and not kit.suspended end)
    drags[cancelDrag] = true
    handle.scope.add(function() drags[cancelDrag] = nil end)
    handle.scope.connect(hit.InputBegan, function(input)
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
        change(value - step)
      end
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then
        change(value + step)
      end
    end)
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
end

-- contract
Components.__contract = { component = true, provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }

return Components

-- [[ mini ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uimini

local Mini = {}
function Mini.setup() return true end
local function surface(context, parent, definition)
  local inst, kit, C = context.inst, context.kit, context.C
  if not definition.panel then
    local size = definition.size or context.Theme.CLASH_SIZE
    local button = inst("TextButton", {
      Name = definition.name or "MiniUI",
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-size - 40, 0),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.red,
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      TextTransparency = 1,
      Text = "",
      TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
      TextSize = definition.textSize or 14,
      Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
      Active = true,
      Visible = false,
      ZIndex = 8,
    }, parent)
    local radius = kit.corner(button, 999)
    local outline = kit.stroke(button, nil, 2)
    outline.Transparency = 1
    return button, button, button, radius, outline
  end
  local root = inst("CanvasGroup", {
    Name = definition.name or "MiniPanel",
    Visible = false,
    GroupTransparency = 1,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(context.Theme.MINI_W, context.Theme.MINI_H),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.header,
    ZIndex = 15,
  }, parent)
  local radius = kit.corner(root, 14)
  kit.corner(
    inst("Frame", {
      Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8),
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, -4),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.accent,
      BackgroundTransparency = 0.92,
      ZIndex = 14,
    }, root),
    18
  )
  local outline = kit.stroke(root, nil, 1.5)
  local header = inst("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.22, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
    ZIndex = 16,
  }, root)
  kit.corner(header, 14)
  inst("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
    ZIndex = 16,
  }, header)
  kit.corner(
    inst("Frame", {
      Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 2),
      Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 0),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.accentPink,
      ZIndex = 17,
    }, header),
    1
  )
  inst("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = definition.title or "Ação",
    TextColor3 = C.subtext,
    TextScaled = true,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 17,
  }, header)
  local button = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "ActionButton",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.78, -8),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.22, 3),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.red,
    Text = "OFF",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextScaled = true,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 16,
  }, root)
  kit.corner(button, 10)
  inst("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 30, MinTextSize = 12 }, button)
  return root, button, header, radius, outline
end
function Mini.install(context)
  function context.components.mini(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local kit, C = context.kit, context.C
    local actionButton = definition.action == true
      or (
        definition.action == nil
        and definition.key == nil
        and definition.value == nil
        and definition.onActivate ~= nil
        and definition.onText == nil
        and definition.offText == nil
      )
    local scope = context.Runtime.scope()
    local motion = context.Runtime.motion(scope)
    local root, button, header, radius, outline = surface(context, parent, definition)
    local handle = { Root = root, Header = header, Button = button, scope = scope, enabled = true }
    local groupScale = context.inst("UIScale", { Name = "MiniScale", Scale = 1 }, root)
    local groupFactor = 1
    function handle.getScale() return groupFactor end
    local function refreshScale()
      local source = context.options.miniScale
      local scale = source and source.read and context.finite(source.read()) or 1
      scale = math.clamp(scale or 1, 0.5, 2)
      if groupFactor ~= scale then
        groupFactor = scale
        motion.play(groupScale, "control", { Scale = scale })
        if definition.onScaleChanged then
          definition.onScaleChanged()
        end
      end
    end
    local source = context.options.miniScale
    if source and source.observe then
      scope.add(source.observe(refreshScale))
    end
    refreshScale()
    local clickScale
    if actionButton then
      clickScale = button == root and groupScale or context.inst("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, button)
    end
    local current, shown, invisible, revision = nil, false, false, 0
    local shape
    local width = definition.panel and context.Theme.MINI_W or (definition.size or context.Theme.CLASH_SIZE)
    local height = definition.panel and context.Theme.MINI_H or width
    local target = definition.position or UDim2.fromOffset(14, 160)
    local hiddenX = definition.panel and ((workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X or 1920) + 30) or -width - 40
    root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hiddenX, target.Y.Offset)
    local tint, offColor = definition.color or definition.onColor or C.green, definition.offColor or (actionButton and definition.color) or C.red
    local caption = definition.text or definition.title or ""
    local onText = definition.onText or (actionButton and caption or (caption ~= "" and caption .. "\nON" or "ON"))
    local offText = definition.offText or (actionButton and caption or (caption ~= "" and caption .. "\nOFF" or "OFF"))
    local dragStart, initial, dragged, held
    local sizeScale = 1
    local function paint(immediate)
      button.Text = current and onText or offText
      if not definition.panel then
        button.TextSize = (current and (definition.onTextSize or definition.textSize or 14) or (definition.offTextSize or definition.textSize or 14))
          * sizeScale
      end
      local color = current and tint or offColor
      if immediate then
        button.BackgroundColor3 = color
      else
        motion.play(button, "control", { BackgroundColor3 = color })
      end
    end
    function handle.pulse()
      local pressed = definition.panel and UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.78, -12) or UDim2.fromOffset(width - 6, height - 6)
      local restored = definition.panel and UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.78, -8) or UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
      motion.play(button, "press", { Size = pressed }, function() motion.play(button, "feedback", { Size = restored }) end)
    end
    function handle.click()
      if not clickScale then
        return
      end
      local factor = clickScale == groupScale and groupFactor or 1
      motion.play(clickScale, "press", { Scale = 0.9 * factor }, function()
        motion.play(clickScale, "feedback", { Scale = 1.04 * factor }, function() motion.play(clickScale, "control", { Scale = factor }) end)
      end)
    end
    function handle.setValue(value)
      value = value == true
      if current == value then
        return
      end
      local first = current == nil
      current = value
      paint(first)
      if definition.panel and not first then
        handle.pulse()
      end
    end
    function handle.getValue() return current end
    function handle.setColor(value)
      assert(typeof(value) == "Color3", "Mini UI color must be Color3")
      tint = value
      if actionButton then
        offColor = value
      end
      paint(false)
    end
    function handle.setDimensions(x, y)
      assert(type(x) == "number" and x == x and math.abs(x) < math.huge and type(y) == "number" and y == y and math.abs(y) < math.huge, "Invalid Mini UI size")
      x, y = math.max(1, x), math.max(1, y)
      if x == width and y == height then
        return
      end
      width, height = x, y
      sizeScale = width / (definition.size or context.Theme.CLASH_SIZE)
      motion.play(root, "feedback", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) })
      paint(false)
    end
    function handle.setSize(value)
      assert(type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge, "Invalid Mini UI size")
      value = math.clamp(value, 28, 384)
      handle.setDimensions(value, definition.panel and value * context.Theme.MINI_H / context.Theme.MINI_W or value)
    end
    function handle.setShape(value)
      assert(value == "square" or value == "round", "Mini UI shape must be square or round")
      if shape == value or definition.panel then
        return
      end
      shape = value
      motion.play(radius, "control", { CornerRadius = shape == "round" and UDim.new(0.5, 0) or UDim.new(0.25, 0) })
    end
    function handle.setAppearance(scale, square)
      scale = math.clamp(tonumber(scale) or 1, 0.5, 2)
      handle.setShape(square == true and "square" or "round")
      if definition.panel then
        handle.setDimensions(context.Theme.MINI_W * scale, context.Theme.MINI_H * scale)
      else
        handle.setSize((definition.size or context.Theme.CLASH_SIZE) * scale)
      end
    end
    local function fade(value)
      local alpha = value and not invisible and 0 or 1
      if definition.panel then
        return motion.group(root, "panel", { GroupTransparency = alpha })
      end
      motion.play(outline, "panel", { Transparency = alpha })
      return motion.play(button, "panel", { TextTransparency = alpha, BackgroundTransparency = alpha })
    end
    function handle.setInvisible(value)
      value = value == true
      if value == invisible then
        return
      end
      invisible = value
      if shown then
        fade(true)
      end
    end
    function handle.setPosition(position, offscreenX)
      if target == position and hiddenX == offscreenX then
        return
      end
      target, hiddenX = position, offscreenX or hiddenX
      if shown then
        motion.play(root, "feedback", { Position = target })
      else
        root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hiddenX, target.Y.Offset)
      end
    end
    function handle.setVisible(value)
      value = value == true
      if shown == value then
        return
      end
      shown, revision = value, revision + 1
      local version = revision
      if value then
        root.Visible = true
      end
      motion.play(root, "panel", { Position = value and target or UDim2.fromOffset(hiddenX, target.Y.Offset) })
      local tween = fade(value)
      local function complete()
        if revision == version and root.Parent then
          root.Visible = value
        end
      end
      if tween then
        local connection
        connection = scope.connect(tween.Completed, function(state)
          scope.remove(connection)
          if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
            complete()
          end
        end)
      else
        complete()
      end
      if not value and held then
        held = nil
        if definition.onRelease then
          definition.onRelease()
        end
      end
    end
    function handle.setEnabled(value)
      handle.enabled = value == true
      button.Active, button.Selectable = handle.enabled, handle.enabled
    end
    function handle.setText(value)
      onText, offText = tostring(value), tostring(value)
      paint(false)
    end
    function handle.isDragging() return dragged == true end
    local function available() return handle.enabled and not kit.suspended and shown end
    if definition.draggable ~= false then
      context.Runtime.bindDrag(scope, header, function(input)
        if not dragStart then
          dragStart, initial, dragged = input.Position, root.Position, false
          return
        end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        if delta.X * delta.X + delta.Y * delta.Y < context.Theme.DRAG_THRESHOLD_SQ and not dragged then
          return
        end
        dragged = true
        local scale = math.max(0.01, root.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(1, root.Size.X.Offset))
        local view = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or parent.AbsoluteSize
        root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
          math.clamp(initial.X.Offset + delta.X / scale, 0, math.max(0, view.X / scale - root.Size.X.Offset)),
          math.clamp(initial.Y.Offset + delta.Y / scale, 0, math.max(0, view.Y / scale - root.Size.Y.Offset))
        )
        target = root.Position
      end, available)
    end
    scope.connect(button.InputBegan, function(input)
      if available() and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        held = input
        if definition.onPress then
          definition.onPress(input)
        end
      end
    end)
    local function release(input)
      if held and (input == nil or input == held) then
        held = nil
        if definition.onRelease then
          definition.onRelease(input)
        end
      end
      if not input or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if dragStart and dragged and definition.onDragEnd then
          definition.onDragEnd(root.Position)
        end
        dragStart, initial = nil, nil
      end
    end
    scope.connect(context.UIS.InputEnded, release)
    scope.connect(context.UIS.WindowFocusReleased, function() release(nil) end)
    scope.connect(button.Activated, function()
      if not available() or handle.isDragging() then
        return
      end
      if definition.key then
        local value = not current
        if not context.commit(handle, definition, value) then
          return
        end
        handle.setValue(value)
      end
      if actionButton then
        handle.click()
      elseif definition.pulse then
        handle.pulse()
      end
      if definition.onActivate then
        definition.onActivate()
      end
    end)
    function handle.destroy()
      release(nil)
      scope.destroy()
      root:Destroy()
    end
    handle.setShape(definition.shape or "round")
    if definition.key then
      handle.setValue(context.read(definition.key, definition.value))
      context.bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    else
      handle.setValue(definition.value)
    end
    if definition.scaleKey or definition.squareKey then
      local function appearance() handle.setAppearance(context.read(definition.scaleKey, 1), context.read(definition.squareKey, false)) end
      if definition.scaleKey then
        context.bind(handle, definition.scaleKey, appearance)
      end
      if definition.squareKey then
        context.bind(handle, definition.squareKey, appearance)
      end
      appearance()
    end
    handle.setVisible(definition.visible ~= false)
    scope.connect(root.Destroying, function()
      release(nil)
      scope.destroy()
    end)
    scope.add(function() kit.scope.forget(handle) end)
    kit.scope.add(handle, handle.destroy)
    return handle
  end
end
Mini.__contract = { component = true, provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
return Mini

-- [[ native ability ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uinativeability

local Ability = {}
local UIKit
function Ability.setup(deps)
  UIKit = deps.UIKit
  return true
end
function Ability.create(ability, options)
  options = options or {}
  local interface = ability and ability.Interface
  local original = interface and interface.MobileUIAbilityFrame
  if not original or not original.Parent then
    return nil
  end
  local kit = UIKit.create({
    parent = original.Parent,
    read = options.read,
    observe = options.observe,
    miniScale = options.miniScale,
  })
  local view = kit.Components.mini(original.Parent, {
    scaleKey = options.scaleKey,
    squareKey = options.squareKey,
    name = options.name,
    onText = "ON",
    offText = "OFF",
    onTextSize = 18,
    offTextSize = 16,
    visible = false,
    size = 64,
    position = original.Position,
    onPress = options.onPress,
  })
  view.Root.AnchorPoint = original.AnchorPoint
  local wasVisible = original.Visible
  original.Visible = false
  local handle = { original = original, clone = view.Root }
  function handle.setState(active, mobile)
    original.Visible = false
    view.setValue(active)
    view.setVisible(mobile)
  end
  function handle.destroy()
    kit.destroy()
    if original.Parent then
      original.Visible = wasVisible
    end
  end
  return handle
end
function Ability.reveal(ability)
  local frame = ability and ability.Interface and ability.Interface.MobileUIAbilityFrame
  if frame and frame.Parent then
    frame.Visible = true
  end
end
Ability.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { create = "ui.use", reveal = "ui.use" } },
  provides = { "setup", "create", "reveal" },
  requires = { UIKit = "uikit" },
  requiresMethods = { UIKit = { "create" } },
}
return Ability
sources.ui/components/notification.luau:
-- [[ corner notification ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uicornernotification

local Notification = {}
function Notification.setup() return true end
local function escape(value) return tostring(value):gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">"):gsub('"', """) end
local function render(message)
  if type(message) ~= "table" then
    return tostring(message or ""), tostring(message or ""), false
  end
  local rich, plain = {}, {}
  for _, part in ipairs(message) do
    local value = type(part) == "table" and tostring(part.text or "") or tostring(part)
    plain[#plain + 1] = value
    local text = escape(value)
    if type(part) == "table" and typeof(part.color) == "Color3" then
      local color = part.color
      text = string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', math.round(color.R * 255), math.round(color.G * 255), math.round(color.B * 255), text)
    end
    rich[#rich + 1] = text
  end
  return table.concat(rich), table.concat(plain), true
end
function Notification.create(context)
  local inst, C = context.inst, context.theme.COLORS
  local scope = context.scope.child()
  local cards, order, sequence = {}, {}, 0
  local layer =
    inst("Frame", { Name = "CornerNotifications", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 110 }, context.notifications.layer())
  scope.add(function() layer:Destroy() end)
  local function reflow()
    local offset = 14
    for _, id in ipairs(order) do
      local card = cards[id]
      local width = math.max(1, math.min(286, context.viewport().X - 28))
      local bounds = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(card.plain, 12, context.theme.FONT.body, Vector2.new(math.max(1, width - 30), 10000))
      local height = math.clamp(bounds.Y + 42, 64, 108)
      context.twPlay(card.Root, "control", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) })
      context.twPlay(card.Root, "panel", { Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, -offset), GroupTransparency = 0 })
      offset += height + 8
    end
  end
  local function dismiss(id)
    local card = cards[id]
    if not card then
      return false
    end
    cards[id] = nil
    table.remove(order, table.find(order, id))
    card.scope.remove("timer")
    context.twPlay(card.Root, "panel", {
      Position = UDim2.new(1, card.Root.Size.X.Offset + 16, 1, card.Root.Position.Y.Offset),
      GroupTransparency = 1,
    })
    local timer = task.delay(context.theme.MOTION.panel.duration, function()
      card.scope.forget("exit")
      card.scope.destroy()
    end)
    card.scope.add("exit", function() task.cancel(timer) end)
    reflow()
    return true
  end
  local function show(title, message, options)
    if not scope.alive then
      return false
    end
    options = options or {}
    if
      not context.deps.NotificationPolicy.shouldShow(
        context.deps.State.getConfig(),
        context.state.desktop,
        { category = options.important and "critical" or "system", topic = options.id }
      )
    then
      return false
    end
    sequence += 1
    local id = options.id or sequence
    dismiss(id)
    while #order >= 3 do
      dismiss(order[#order])
    end
    local text, plain, rich = render(options.segments or message)
    local width = math.max(1, math.min(286, context.viewport().X - 28))
    local bounds = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(plain, 12, context.theme.FONT.body, Vector2.new(math.max(1, width - 30), 10000))
    local height = math.clamp(bounds.Y + 42, 64, 108)
    local owner = scope.child()
    local root = inst("CanvasGroup", {
      Name = "Notice",
      AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
      Position = UDim2.new(1, width + 16, 1, -14),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
      GroupTransparency = 1,
      ClipsDescendants = true,
      ZIndex = 110,
    }, layer)
    owner.add(function() root:Destroy() end)
    context.corner(root, 12)
    context.stroke(root, nil, 1)
    local tint = typeof(options.color) == "Color3" and options.color or options.kind == "warning" and C.red or options.kind == "success" and C.green or C.accent
    inst("TextLabel", {
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 7),
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 20),
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      Text = tostring(title),
      AutoLocalize = false,
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      Font = context.theme.FONT.strong,
      TextSize = 13,
      TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
      TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
      ZIndex = 111,
    }, root)
    local body = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 30),
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -40),
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
      AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
      ScrollBarThickness = 2,
      ZIndex = 111,
    }, root)
    inst("TextLabel", {
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0),
      AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      Text = text,
      RichText = rich,
      AutoLocalize = false,
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      Font = context.theme.FONT.body,
      TextSize = 12,
      TextWrapped = true,
      TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
      ZIndex = 112,
    }, body)
    local track = inst(
      "Frame",
      { Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = tint, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8, ZIndex = 111 },
      root
    )
    local line = inst("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = tint, ZIndex = 112 }, track)
    context.corner(track, 2)
    context.corner(line, 2)
    local close = inst("TextButton", {
      Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 4),
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      Text = "×",
      AutoLocalize = false,
      TextColor3 = C.subtext,
      TextSize = 20,
      ZIndex = 113,
    }, root)
    cards[id] = { Root = root, scope = owner, plain = plain }
    table.insert(order, 1, id)
    owner.connect(close.Activated, function() dismiss(id) end)
    local duration = tonumber(options.duration) or 5
    if duration ~= duration or math.abs(duration) == math.huge then
      duration = 5
    end
    duration = math.clamp(duration, 0.5, 60)
    local timer = task.delay(context.theme.MOTION.panel.duration, function()
      owner.forget("timer")
      if not cards[id] or cards[id].scope ~= owner then
        return
      end
      local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(line, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) })
      owner.add(function() tween:Cancel() end)
      owner.connect(tween.Completed, function(status)
        if status == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and cards[id] and cards[id].scope == owner then
          dismiss(id)
        end
      end)
      tween:Play()
    end)
    owner.add("timer", function() task.cancel(timer) end)
    reflow()
    return { id = id, dismiss = function() return dismiss(id) end }
  end
  scope.connect(layer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), reflow)
  return { show = show, dismiss = dismiss, destroy = scope.destroy }
end
Notification.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Notification

-- [[ reusable mode and numeric value selector ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uirateselector
local Selector = {}
function Selector.setup() return true end
function Selector.install(context)
  local components, inst, kit = context.components, context.inst, context.kit
  local C, FONT, TEXT, UIS = context.C, context.FONT, context.TEXT, context.UIS
  local bind, read, finite, options = context.bind, context.read, context.finite, context.options
  function components.rate_selector(parent, definition)
    local choices = assert(definition.options, "Selector options required")
    local modeKey = assert(definition.key, "Selector mode key required")
    for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
      assert(type(choice) == "table" and (type(choice.valueKey) == "string" or choice.readOnly == true), "Each mode needs a value key or readOnly")
    end
    local handle = components.segmented(parent, { title = definition.title, key = modeKey, options = choices })
    local updateMode = handle.setValue
    handle.Root.Track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 30)
    local input = inst("TextBox", {
      Name = "ValueInput",
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 30),
      Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 28),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg,
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = TEXT.control,
      Font = FONT.strong,
      ClearTextOnFocus = false,
      ZIndex = 11,
    }, handle.Root)
    kit.corner(input)
    kit.stroke(input)
    local function selected()
      local mode = read(modeKey, definition.value or choices[1].value)
      for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
        if choice.value == mode then
          return choice
        end
      end
    end
    local function paint()
      local choice = selected()
      if not choice then
        return
      end
      updateMode(choice.value)
      input.TextEditable = choice.readOnly ~= true
      if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= input then
        input.Text = choice.readOnly and tostring(choice.label or choice.value) or tostring(read(choice.valueKey, 0))
      end
    end
    bind(handle, modeKey, paint)
    local seen = {}
    for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
      if choice.valueKey and not seen[choice.valueKey] then
        bind(handle, choice.valueKey, paint)
        seen[choice.valueKey] = true
      end
    end
    handle.scope.connect(input.FocusLost, function()
      local choice, value = selected(), finite(input.Text)
      if choice and not choice.readOnly and value and value >= (definition.min or 0) and (not definition.max or value <= definition.max) and options.write then
        options.write(choice.valueKey, value)
      end
      paint()
    end)
    paint()
    return handle
  end
end
Selector.__contract = { component = true, provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
return Selector

--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiselection

local Components = {}

function Components.setup() return true end
function Components.install(context)
  local kit = context.kit
  local Theme = context.Theme
  local UIS = context.UIS
  local options = context.options
  local components = context.components
  local C = context.C
  local FONT = context.FONT
  local TEXT = context.TEXT
  local inst = context.inst

  local control = context.control
  local title = context.title
  local button = context.button
  local commit = context.commit
  local bind = context.bind
  local read = context.read
  local finite = context.finite
  local choiceValue = context.choiceValue
  local choiceLabel = context.choiceLabel
  function components.segmented(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local choices = definition.options or definition.choices or {}
    assert(#choices > 0, "segmented requires options")
    local handle = control(parent, definition, Theme.RATE_CARD_H)
    title(handle, definition, 0, 24)
    local track = inst(
      "Frame",
      { Name = "Track", Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 28), BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg, ZIndex = 8 },
      handle.Root
    )
    kit.corner(track)
    local thumb = inst("Frame", { Name = "Thumb", Size = UDim2.new(1 / #choices, -4, 1, -4), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, ZIndex = 9 }, track)
    kit.corner(thumb)
    local buttons, value = {}, nil
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      if value == nextValue then
        return
      end
      value = nextValue
      for index, choice in ipairs(choices) do
        local selected = choiceValue(choice) == value
        if selected then
          local color = type(choice) == "table" and choice.color or nil
          color = color or (definition.colors and definition.colors[value]) or Theme.SELECTOR_COLORS[value] or C.accent
          handle.motion.play(thumb, "control", { Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / #choices, 2, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = color })
        end
        handle.motion.play(buttons[index], "control", { TextColor3 = selected and C.text or C.subtext })
      end
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    for index, choice in ipairs(choices) do
      local item = button(
        track,
        choiceLabel(choice),
        { Size = UDim2.new(1 / #choices, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale((index - 1) / #choices, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 10 }
      )
      buttons[index] = item
      handle.scope.connect(item.Activated, function()
        local nextValue = choiceValue(choice)
        if nextValue ~= value and commit(handle, definition, nextValue) then
          handle.setValue(nextValue)
        end
      end)
    end
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value or choiceValue(choices[1])))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end

end
Components.__contract = { component = true, provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
return Components

-- [[ reusable world-space labels and outlines ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiworldmarkers
local Markers = {}
local Services = { TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService") }
local function destroySafely(object)
  if object then
    pcall(function() object:Destroy() end)
  end
end
function Markers.setup() return true end
function Markers.label(name, parent)
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.Name = name
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.BorderSizePixel = 0
  label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
  label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
  label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
  label.TextWrapped = false
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
  label.Parent = parent
  return label
end
function Markers.billboard(name, adornee, parent)
  local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
  gui.Name = name
  gui.Adornee = adornee
  gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
  gui.LightInfluence = 0
  gui.MaxDistance = 0
  gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 24)
  gui.Parent = parent
  return gui
end
function Markers.highlight(esp, name, adornee, color)
  local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
  highlight:SetAttribute("UIComponent", true)
  highlight.Name = name
  highlight.Adornee = adornee
  highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
  highlight.FillColor = color
  highlight.FillTransparency = 1
  highlight.OutlineColor = color
  highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
  highlight.Parent = adornee
  Services.TweenService
    :Create(highlight, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { FillTransparency = esp.FillTransparency, OutlineTransparency = esp.OutlineTransparency })
    :Play()
  return highlight
end
function Markers.destroy(marker)
  if not marker then
    return
  end
  local gui, highlight = marker.Gui, marker.Highlight
  if gui and gui.Parent then
    for _, label in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
      if label:IsA("TextLabel") then
        Services.TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
      end
    end
  end
  if highlight and highlight.Parent then
    Services.TweenService:Create(highlight, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1 }):Play()
  end
  task.delay(0.18, function()
    destroySafely(gui)
    destroySafely(highlight)
  end)
end

Markers.__contract = { access = { default = "ui.use" }, provides = { "setup", "label", "billboard", "highlight", "destroy" }, requires = {} }
return Markers

-- [[ automatic floating visibility ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiassists
local Assists = {}
function Assists.setup() return true end
function Assists.create(context)
  local utils, gameInfo = context.deps.State, context.deps.Model
  local elapsed, automatic = 0, {}
  local function refresh()
    context.floating.refreshAbilities()
    local rules = not context.state.desktop and gameInfo.getVisibility() or {}
    local changed = false
    for key, visible in pairs(rules) do
      if automatic[key] ~= visible then
        changed = true
      end
    end
    for key in pairs(automatic) do
      if rules[key] == nil then
        changed = true
      end
    end
    if changed then
      automatic = rules
      context.floating.applyVisibility(rules)
    end
  end
  context.trackConn(context.services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    elapsed += dt
    if elapsed >= 0.1 then
      elapsed = 0
      refresh()
    end
  end))
  context.scope.add(utils.observeConfig(function()
    automatic = {}
    refresh()
  end))
  refresh()
  return {}
end
Assists.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Assists

-- [[ context ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uicontext

-- module
local Context = {}

-- configuration

-- setup
function Context.setup() return true end

-- context
function Context.create(deps, deviceDesktop)
  local CONFIG = deps.Theme.tokens
  local C = CONFIG.COLORS
  local PW, PH = CONFIG.PANEL_W, CONFIG.PANEL_H
  local UIS, RunService, Players = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("Players")
  local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
  local Utils = deps.State
  local UIState = {
    connections = {},
    panelOpen = false,
    initializing = true,
    primaryActive = false,
    clashBallOn = false,
    btnIsDragging = function() return false end,
    panelTween = nil,
    btnTween = nil,
    miniTween = nil,
    miniFadeTween = nil,
    miniGeneration = 0,
    desktop = false,
    closing = false,
    keyCapture = false,
    manualHoldInput = nil,
  }

  local context = { deps = deps, theme = CONFIG, state = UIState, refs = {} }
  context.services = { UIS = UIS, RunService = RunService, Players = Players }
  context.scope = deps.Runtime.scope()
  context.motion = deps.Runtime.motion(context.scope)
  if type(deviceDesktop) ~= "boolean" then
    deviceDesktop = UIS.KeyboardEnabled or UIS.MouseEnabled or not UIS.TouchEnabled
  end
  UIState.deviceDesktop = deviceDesktop
  UIState.desktop = Utils.getConfigValue("ForcePCUI") == true or deviceDesktop
  local function trackConn(connection) return context.scope.add(connection) end
  local function untrackConn(connection) context.scope.forget(connection) end
  local function safeDisconnect(connection)
    if connection then
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
  end
  local pulseButton
  local function inst(cls, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(cls)
    if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
      o.BorderSizePixel = 0
      o.AutoLocalize = false
    end
    if o:IsA("GuiButton") then
      o.AutoButtonColor = false
    end
    if props then
      for k, v in pairs(props) do
        o[k] = v
      end
    end
    if parent then
      o.Parent = parent
    end
    local buttonName = props and props.Name
    if cls == "TextButton" and pulseButton and buttonName ~= "CardHitbox" and buttonName ~= "SpamButton" and buttonName ~= "ExodusFloatingButton" then
      pulseButton(o)
    end
    return o
  end
  local function corner(obj, r) return inst("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r) }, obj) end
  local function stroke(obj, col, th) return context.kit.stroke(obj, col, th) end
  local function twPlay(obj, duration, props)
    if not obj or obj.Parent == nil then
      return nil
    end
    if context.motion and context.scope.alive then
      if obj:IsA("CanvasGroup") and props.GroupTransparency ~= nil then
        return context.motion.group(obj, duration, props)
      end
      return context.motion.play(obj, duration, props)
    end
    local profile = CONFIG.MOTION[type(duration) == "string" and duration or "control"]
    local tween = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(type(duration) == "number" and duration or profile.duration, profile.style, profile.direction), props)
    tween:Play()
    return tween
  end
  local function safeCancel(t)
    if t then
      context.motion.cancel(t)
    end
  end
  local function setTextIfChanged(label, text)
    if label.Text ~= text then
      label.Text = text
    end
  end
  local function viewport()
    local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    return currentCamera and currentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
  end
  local function canUseAbility(name)
    local available, reason = deps.Model.getAvailability(name)
    if not available and context.notifications then
      context.notifications.toast(reason)
    end
    return available
  end
  context.canUseAbility = canUseAbility
  local function setConfigValue(key, value)
    if value == true and (context.abilityKeys or {})[key] and not canUseAbility((context.abilityKeys or {})[key]) then
      return false
    end
    return Utils.setConfig({ [key] = value })
  end
  pulseButton = function(button)
    local scale = inst("UIScale", { Name = "PressScale", Scale = 1 }, button)
    local activeTween
    trackConn(button.Activated:Connect(function()
      safeCancel(activeTween)
      scale.Scale = 1
      local tween = twPlay(scale, "press", { Scale = 0.94 })
      activeTween = tween
      if not tween then
        return
      end
      local connection
      connection = trackConn(tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
        safeDisconnect(connection)
        untrackConn(connection)
        if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and button.Parent then
          activeTween = twPlay(scale, "feedback", { Scale = 1 })
        end
      end))
    end))
  end
  local function makeDraggable(handle, target, onDragEnd, disableOnMobile, coordinateScale, onDragMove, lifetime)
    local scope = lifetime or context.scope
    local function trackConn(connection) return scope.add(connection) end
    local dragInput, dragOffX, dragOffY = nil, 0, 0
    local state, wasDragged, startX, startY = "Idle", false, 0, 0
    local THRESH_SQ = CONFIG.DRAG_THRESHOLD_SQ
    trackConn(handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
      end
      if not UIState.panelOpen and target == context.refs.configPanel then
        return
      end
      if UIState.closing or not deps.Runtime.isVisible(handle) then
        return
      end
      if disableOnMobile and not UIState.desktop then
        return
      end
      if state ~= "Idle" then
        return
      end
      state, wasDragged, dragInput = "Pressed", false, input
      local abs = target.AbsolutePosition
      local anchor = target.AnchorPoint
      dragOffX, dragOffY = input.Position.X - abs.X - target.AbsoluteSize.X * anchor.X, input.Position.Y - abs.Y - target.AbsoluteSize.Y * anchor.Y
      startX, startY = input.Position.X, input.Position.Y
    end))
    trackConn(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
      if state == "Idle" or not dragInput then
        return
      end
      if UIState.closing or not deps.Runtime.isVisible(handle) then
        state, dragInput, wasDragged = "Idle", nil, false
        return
      end
      local isMouseDrag = dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      local isTouchDrag = dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == dragInput
      if not isMouseDrag and not isTouchDrag then
        return
      end
      local dx, dy = input.Position.X - startX, input.Position.Y - startY
      if state == "Pressed" and (dx * dx + dy * dy) >= THRESH_SQ then
        state, wasDragged = "Dragging", true
      end
      if state == "Dragging" then
        local vp, sz = viewport(), target.AbsoluteSize
        local scale = coordinateScale and coordinateScale() or (context.refs.responsiveScale and context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale or 1)
        scale = math.max(scale, 0.01)
        local parent = target.Parent
        local origin = parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.AbsolutePosition or Vector2.zero
        local anchor = target.AnchorPoint
        target.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
          (math.clamp(input.Position.X - dragOffX - sz.X * anchor.X, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - sz.X)) + sz.X * anchor.X - origin.X) / scale,
          (math.clamp(input.Position.Y - dragOffY - sz.Y * anchor.Y, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - sz.Y)) + sz.Y * anchor.Y - origin.Y) / scale
        )
        if onDragMove then
          onDragMove()
        end
      end
    end))
    local function releaseDrag()
      if state == "Idle" then
        return
      end
      state, dragInput = "Idle", nil
      if wasDragged and onDragEnd then
        onDragEnd()
      end
      task.defer(function()
        if state == "Idle" then
          wasDragged = false
        end
      end)
    end
    scope.add(function()
      state, dragInput, wasDragged = "Idle", nil, false
    end)
    trackConn(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
      if input == dragInput then
        releaseDrag()
      end
    end))
    trackConn(UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(releaseDrag))
    trackConn(handle:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
      if not handle.Visible then
        releaseDrag()
      end
    end))
    return function() return state == "Dragging" or wasDragged end
  end
  local function makeBtn(text, x, y, w, h, parent, bg)
    local b = inst("TextButton", {
      Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h),
      Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
      BackgroundColor3 = bg or C.btnBlue,
      BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
      Text = text,
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = 13,
      Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
      ZIndex = 7,
      Parent = parent,
    })
    corner(b, 8)
    stroke(b, nil, 1)
    return b
  end
  context.inst = inst
  context.corner = corner
  context.stroke = stroke
  context.twPlay = twPlay
  context.safeCancel = safeCancel
  context.setTextIfChanged = setTextIfChanged
  context.viewport = viewport
  context.setConfigValue = setConfigValue
  context.trackConn = trackConn
  context.untrackConn = untrackConn
  context.safeDisconnect = safeDisconnect
  context.makeDraggable = makeDraggable
  context.makeBtn = makeBtn
  local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
  context.playerGui = playerGui
  context.refs.screenGui = inst("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "ExodusUISystem",
    Enabled = false,
    DisplayOrder = CONFIG.DISPLAY_ORDER,
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
    Parent = playerGui,
  })
  context.scope.add(deps.Runtime.mountLayer(context.refs.screenGui, playerGui, CONFIG.SCREEN_LAYERS.window))
  context.kit = deps.UIKit.create({
    parent = context.refs.screenGui,
    read = Utils.getConfigValue,
    write = setConfigValue,
    observe = Utils.observeConfig,
    miniScale = deps.MiniScale,
    notify = function(...) return context.notifications.toast(...) end,
    choices = deps.Model.getChoices,
    validateShortcut = function(key, binding) return context.actions.validateShortcut(key, binding) end,
    onCapture = function(active) UIState.keyCapture = active end,
  })
  context.refs.responsiveScale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = context.refs.screenGui })
  local function updateResponsiveScale()
    local size = viewport()
    context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(0.1, math.min((size.X - 20) / PW, (size.Y - 20) / PH)))
    local scale = context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale
    local names = { "configPanel", "floatingButton" }
    for _, name in ipairs(context.miniBallRefs or {}) do
      names[#names + 1] = name
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
      local object = context.refs[name]
      if object and object.Parent and object.Visible then
        local pos, dimensions = object.AbsolutePosition, object.AbsoluteSize
        if name == "configPanel" or name == "floatingButton" or pos.X + dimensions.X > 0 then
          local x = math.clamp(pos.X, 0, math.max(0, size.X - dimensions.X))
          local y = math.clamp(pos.Y, 0, math.max(0, size.Y - dimensions.Y))
          if x ~= pos.X or y ~= pos.Y then
            object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x / scale, y / scale)
          end
        end
      end
    end

  end
  local cameraConnection
  local function bindCamera()
    if cameraConnection then
      safeDisconnect(cameraConnection)
      untrackConn(cameraConnection)
    end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    cameraConnection = camera and trackConn(camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateResponsiveScale)) or nil
    updateResponsiveScale()
  end
  trackConn(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(bindCamera))
  bindCamera()
  context.updateResponsiveScale = updateResponsiveScale
  function context.destroy()
    if not context.scope.alive then
      return
    end
    if UIState.manualHoldInput then
      local primary = context.inputDefinition.primary
      if primary and deps.Controls[primary.write] then
        deps.Controls[primary.write](false)
      end
    end
    if context.pages then
      context.pages.destroy()
    end
    if context.kit then
      context.kit.destroy()
    end
    context.scope.destroy()
    if context.refs.screenGui then
      context.refs.screenGui:Destroy()
    end
    if context.refs.informationGui then
      context.refs.informationGui:Destroy()
    end
    if context.notifications then
      context.notifications.clear("closing")
    end
    table.clear(context.refs)
  end
  return context
end

-- contract
Context.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }

return Context

-- [[ generic readout data binding ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uidetails
local Details = {}
function Details.setup() return true end
function Details.create(context)
  local previous, reported = {}, {}
  local function refresh()
    local ok, values = pcall(context.deps.Information.snapshot)
    if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    local keys = table.clone(previous)
    for key in pairs(values) do
      keys[key] = true
    end
    for key in pairs(keys) do
      if context.pages.getReadout(key) then
        local rendered, reason = pcall(context.pages.setReadout, key, values[key])
        if not rendered and not reported[key] then
          warn("[Exodus Readout] " .. tostring(reason))
        end
        reported[key] = not rendered
      end
    end
    previous = {}
    for key in pairs(values) do
      previous[key] = true
    end
    context.pages.refresh()
  end
  refresh()
  local elapsed = 0
  context.scope.connect(context.services.RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
    elapsed += dt
    if elapsed >= 0.5 and context.state.panelOpen then
      elapsed = 0
      refresh()
    end
  end)

-- [[ floating ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uifloating

local Controller = {}
function Controller.setup() return true end
function Controller.create(context)
  local utils, controls = context.deps.State, context.deps.Controls
  local entries, order, automatic = {}, {}, {}
  local controller = {}
  local function call(name, ...)
    local callback = type(name) == "function" and name or name and controls[name]
    if callback then
      local ok, accepted, reason = pcall(callback, ...)
      if not ok or accepted == false then
        context.notifications.toast(tostring(ok and reason or accepted), true)
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local function refresh(entry)
    local d, handle = entry.definition, entry.handle
    if d.read and controls[d.read] then
      handle.setValue(controls[d.read]())
    elseif d.key or d.option then
      handle.setValue(utils.getConfigValue(d.key or d.option) == true)
    end
    if d.scaleKey or d.squareKey then
      handle.setAppearance(
        d.scaleKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.scaleKey) or 1,
        d.squareKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.squareKey) == true or not d.squareKey and d.shape == "square"
      )
    end
    local visible = (not d.visibleKey and d.visible ~= false) or utils.getConfigValue(d.visibleKey) == true or automatic[d.visibleKey] == true
    if d.mobileOnly == true and context.state.desktop then
      visible = false
    end
    if d.ability then
      visible = visible and context.deps.Model.getAvailability(d.ability) == true
    end
    if not context.state.initializing then
      handle.setVisible(visible)
    end
    handle.setInvisible(d.invisibleKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.invisibleKey) == true)
  end
  function controller.add(definition)
    assert(type(definition) == "table", "Mini UI definition required")
    local d = table.clone(definition)
    local id = assert(d.id or d.prefix, "Mini UI id required")
    assert(not entries[id], "Duplicate Mini UI: " .. id)
    local function color(value) return type(value) == "string" and context.theme.COLORS[value] or value end
    local caption = d.text or d.label or d.title
    local action = d.action and not d.key and not d.read
    local handle, entry
    handle = context.kit.Components.mini(context.refs.screenGui, {
      name = "Mini_" .. id,
      text = d.text or d.label or d.title,
      value = d.value,
      color = color(d.color),
      onColor = color(d.onColor),
      offColor = color(d.offColor),
      onText = d.onText or (action and caption or nil),
      offText = d.offText or (action and caption or nil),
      textSize = d.textSize,
      onTextSize = d.onTextSize,
      offTextSize = d.offTextSize,
      pulse = d.pulse == true,
      panel = d.panel == true,
      action = action == true,
      title = d.title,
      draggable = false,
      size = d.size,
      shape = d.shape,
      visible = false,
      onScaleChanged = function()
        if entry then
          entry.layout()
        end
      end,
      onActivate = function()
        if d.modeKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.modeKey) == "Hold" then
          return
        end
        if d.key or d.option then
          local key = d.key or d.option
          context.setConfigValue(key, utils.getConfigValue(key) ~= true)
        elseif d.action then
          call(d.action, not handle.getValue())
        end
        if d.onActivate then
          call(d.onActivate, not handle.getValue())
        end
        if entries[id] then
          refresh(entries[id])
        end
      end,
      onPress = function(input)
        if d.modeKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.modeKey) == "Hold" then
          call(d.action, true)
        elseif d.onPress then
          call(d.onPress, input)
        end
        if entries[id] then
          refresh(entries[id])
        end
      end,
      onRelease = function(input)
        if d.modeKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.modeKey) == "Hold" then
          call(d.action, false)
        elseif d.onRelease then
          call(d.onRelease, input)
        end
        if entries[id] then
          refresh(entries[id])
        end
      end,
      onDragEnd = function(position)
        if d.xKey and d.yKey then
          utils.setConfig({ [d.xKey] = position.X.Offset, [d.yKey] = position.Y.Offset })
        end
      end,
    })
    entry = { definition = d, handle = handle }
    entries[id], order[#order + 1] = entry, entry
    handle.scope.add(function()
      entries[id] = nil
      local index = table.find(order, entry)
      if index then
        table.remove(order, index)
      end
      context.refs[id] = nil
      local ref = table.find(context.miniBallRefs, id)
      if ref then
        table.remove(context.miniBallRefs, ref)
      end
    end)
    context.refs[id] = handle.Root
    context.miniBallRefs[#context.miniBallRefs + 1] = id
    handle.isDragging = context.makeDraggable(handle.Header, handle.Root, function()
      if d.xKey and d.yKey then
        utils.setConfig({ [d.xKey] = handle.Root.Position.X.Offset, [d.yKey] = handle.Root.Position.Y.Offset })
      end
    end, false, nil, nil, handle.scope)
    function entry.layout()
      local factor = math.clamp(d.scaleKey and tonumber(utils.getConfigValue(d.scaleKey)) or 1, 0.5, 2)
      local multiplier = handle.getScale()
      local size = math.clamp((d.size or context.theme.CLASH_SIZE) * factor, 28, 384) * multiplier
      local scale = math.max(0.01, context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale)
      local raw = context.viewport()
      local view = raw / scale
      local index = table.find(order, entry) or 1
      local x = d.xKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.xKey) or nil
      local y = d.yKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.yKey) or nil
      local width, height = size, size
      local defaultX, defaultY, offscreen = 14, 0, -size - 40
      if d.panel then
        width = math.min(context.theme.MINI_W * factor * multiplier * (d.widthKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.widthKey) or 1), view.X)
        height = math.min(context.theme.MINI_H * factor * multiplier * (d.heightKey and utils.getConfigValue(d.heightKey) or 1), view.Y)
        defaultX, defaultY, offscreen = view.X - width - 14, view.Y / 2 - height / 2, view.X + 30
        handle.setDimensions(width / multiplier, height / multiplier)
      elseif d.defaultX then
        defaultX, defaultY = d.defaultX, view.Y / 2 + (d.offsetY or 0)
      else
        local gap, rows = size + 8, math.ceil(#order / 2)
        defaultX = 14 + ((index - 1) % 2) * gap
        defaultY = (view.Y - rows * gap) / 2 + math.floor((index - 1) / 2) * gap
      end
      local target = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x or defaultX, 0, math.max(0, view.X - width)), math.clamp(y or defaultY, 0, math.max(0, view.Y - height)))
      handle.setPosition(target, offscreen)
    end
    entry.layout()
    refresh(entry)
    return handle
  end
  context.miniBallRefs = {}
  for _, definition in ipairs(context.miniBalls or {}) do
    controller.add(definition)
  end
  function controller.sync()
    for _, entry in ipairs(order) do
      refresh(entry)
      entry.layout()
    end
  end
  function controller.layout()
    for _, entry in ipairs(order) do
      entry.layout()
    end
  end
  function controller.applyVisibility(rules)
    automatic = rules or {}
    controller.sync()
  end
  function controller.refreshAbilities()
    for _, entry in ipairs(order) do
      if entry.definition.ability then
        refresh(entry)
      end
    end
  end
  function controller.setPrimaryActive(value)
    context.state.primaryActive = value == true
    local primary = context.inputDefinition.primary
    call(primary and primary.write, value == true)
    controller.sync()
  end
  function controller.showPrimary(value)
    local primary = context.inputDefinition.primary
    if primary and primary.visibleKey then
      utils.setConfig({ [primary.visibleKey] = value == true })
    end
  end
  function controller.applyMiniScale() controller.layout() end
  context.scope.connect(context.refs.responsiveScale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"), controller.layout)
  return controller
end
Controller.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Controller
