-- [[ uiruntime ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiruntime

-- module
local Runtime = {}
local Theme
local lifetime
local layerScope
local layerParent
local layers, gameLayers = {}, {}
local layerSequence, reorderQueued = 0, false
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- configuration
local CONFIG = { DEFAULT_MOTION = "control" }
-- A descendant may be animated by more than one controller. Keep its original
-- appearance outside individual motion scopes so a hidden state never becomes
-- the baseline for its next entrance.
local faded = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- setup
function Runtime.setup(deps)
  Runtime.teardown()
  Theme, lifetime = deps.Theme.tokens, deps.Lifetime
  return true
end

-- lifetime
function Runtime.scope() return lifetime.scope() end

-- PlayerGui stays below Roblox CoreGui. Equal display orders use insertion order.
local function reorderLayers()
  if reorderQueued or not layerScope or not layerScope.alive then
    return
  end
  reorderQueued = true
  local owner = layerScope
  task.defer(function()
    if layerScope ~= owner or not owner.alive then
      return
    end
    reorderQueued = false
    local ordered = {}
    for gui, entry in pairs(layers) do
      if gui.Parent == layerParent then
        ordered[#ordered + 1] = entry
      end
    end
    table.sort(ordered, function(a, b) return a.rank == b.rank and a.sequence < b.sequence or a.rank < b.rank end)
    for _, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
      entry.gui.Parent = nil
      entry.gui.Parent = layerParent
    end
  end)
end
local function watchGameLayer(gui)
  if not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") or layers[gui] or gui:GetAttribute("ExodusLayer") or gameLayers[gui] then
    return
  end
  local scope = layerScope.child()
  gameLayers[gui] = scope
  scope.connect(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("DisplayOrder"), function()
    if gui.DisplayOrder >= Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER then
      reorderLayers()
    end
  end)
  scope.add(function() gameLayers[gui] = nil end)
  if gui.DisplayOrder >= Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER then
    reorderLayers()
  end
end
function Runtime.mountLayer(gui, parent, rank)
  assert(parent:IsA("PlayerGui"), "Hub layers must remain in PlayerGui")
  if not layerScope then
    layerParent, layerScope = parent, lifetime.scope()
    layerScope.connect(parent.ChildAdded, watchGameLayer)
    layerScope.connect(parent.ChildRemoved, function(child)
      if gameLayers[child] then
        gameLayers[child].destroy()
      end
    end)
    for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
      watchGameLayer(child)
    end
  end
  assert(parent == layerParent, "Mixed PlayerGui layer owners")
  if gameLayers[gui] then
    gameLayers[gui].destroy()
  end
  layerSequence += 1
  local entry = { gui = gui, rank = rank, sequence = layerSequence, Connected = true }
  layers[gui] = entry
  gui:SetAttribute("ExodusLayer", true)
  gui.DisplayOrder = Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER
  local scope = layerScope.child()
  function entry:Disconnect()
    if not self.Connected then
      return
    end
    self.Connected = false
    if layers[gui] == self then
      layers[gui] = nil
    end
    scope.destroy()
  end
  scope.connect(gui.Destroying, function() entry:Disconnect() end)
  scope.connect(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("DisplayOrder"), function()
    if gui.DisplayOrder ~= Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER then
      gui.DisplayOrder = Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER
    end
    reorderLayers()
  end)
  reorderLayers()
  return entry
end
function Runtime.teardown()
  if layerScope then
    layerScope.destroy()
  end
  for _, entry in pairs(layers) do
    entry.Connected = false
  end
  layers, gameLayers, layerScope, layerParent = {}, {}, nil, nil
  layerSequence, reorderQueued = 0, false
  return true
end

-- motion
function Runtime.motion(scope, reducedMotion)
  local owners, active = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), {}
  local motion = {}
  local paused = false
  local function release(tween)
    local entry = active[tween]
    if not entry then
      return
    end
    active[tween] = nil
    scope.remove(entry.connection)
    local properties = owners[entry.object]
    if properties then
      for key in pairs(entry.goals) do
        if properties[key] == tween then
          properties[key] = nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function motion.cancel(tween)
    if not tween then
      return
    end
    release(tween)
    tween:Cancel()
  end
  function motion.cancelAll(preserve)
    local pending = {}
    for tween in pairs(active) do
      if not preserve or not preserve(active[tween].object) then
        pending[#pending + 1] = tween
      end
    end
    for _, tween in ipairs(pending) do
      motion.cancel(tween)
    end
  end
  function motion.pause()
    paused = true
    motion.cancelAll()
  end
  function motion.resume() paused = false end
  function motion.play(object, preset, goals, onComplete)
    if paused or not scope.alive or not object or not object.Parent then
      return nil
    end
    local profile = Theme.MOTION[type(preset) == "string" and preset or CONFIG.DEFAULT_MOTION]
    assert(profile, "Unknown motion preset: " .. tostring(preset))
    local duration = reducedMotion and 0 or (type(preset) == "number" and preset or profile.duration)
    local properties = owners[object] or {}
    owners[object] = properties
    for key in pairs(goals) do
      motion.cancel(properties[key])
    end
    if duration <= 0 then
      for key, value in pairs(goals) do
        object[key] = value
      end
      if onComplete then
        onComplete()
      end
      return nil
    end
    local tween = TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(duration, profile.style, profile.direction), goals)
    local entry = { object = object, goals = goals }
    active[tween] = entry
    for key in pairs(goals) do
      properties[key] = tween
    end
    entry.connection = scope.connect(tween.Completed, function(state)
      release(tween)
      if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and onComplete then
        onComplete()
      end
    end)
    tween:Play()
    return tween
  end
  function motion.fade(root, preset, alpha, onComplete)
    root:SetAttribute("ExodusFadeAlpha", alpha)
    local objects = root:GetDescendants()
    table.insert(objects, 1, root)
    local rootTween
    for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
      local fields = {}
      if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "BackgroundTransparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "TextTransparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "ImageTransparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("UIStroke") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "Transparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "ScrollBarImageTransparency"
      end
      local saved = faded[object] or {}
      faded[object] = saved
      local goals = {}
      local opacity, ancestor = 1, object
      while ancestor do
        opacity *= 1 - (ancestor:GetAttribute("ExodusFadeAlpha") or 0)
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
      end
      for _, field in ipairs(fields) do
        if saved[field] == nil then
          saved[field] = object[field]
        end
        goals[field] = saved[field] + (1 - saved[field]) * (1 - opacity)
      end
      if next(goals) then
        local tween = motion.play(object, preset, goals, object == root and onComplete or nil)
        if object == root then
          rootTween = tween
        end
      end
    end
    return rootTween
  end
  function motion.group(object, preset, goals, onComplete)
    if paused or not scope.alive or not object or not object.Parent then
      return nil
    end
    if goals.GroupTransparency ~= nil then
      for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("UIStroke") then
          local base = child:GetAttribute("ExodusBaseTransparency")
          if base == nil then
            base = child.Transparency
            child:SetAttribute("ExodusBaseTransparency", base)
          end
          child.Transparency = base + (1 - base) * object.GroupTransparency
          motion.play(child, preset, { Transparency = base + (1 - base) * goals.GroupTransparency })
        end
      end
    end
    return motion.play(object, preset, goals, onComplete)
  end
  scope.add(motion.cancelAll)
  return motion
end

-- input
function Runtime.isVisible(object)
  while object do
    if object:IsA("GuiObject") and not object.Visible then
      return false
    end
    if object:IsA("LayerCollector") and not object.Enabled then
      return false
    end
    object = object.Parent
  end
  return true
end
function Runtime.bindDrag(scope, target, onChange, canStart)
  local owner
  local function release() owner = nil end
  local function available() return target.Parent ~= nil and Runtime.isVisible(target) and (not canStart or canStart()) end
  local function startsOnTarget(input)
    local point, position, size = input.Position, target.AbsolutePosition, target.AbsoluteSize
    if point.X < position.X or point.Y < position.Y or point.X > position.X + size.X or point.Y > position.Y + size.Y then
      return false
    end
    local gui = target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui") or target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("CoreGui")
    if not gui then
      return true
    end
    local ok, objects = pcall(function() return gui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X, point.Y) end)
    if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or #objects == 0 then
      return true
    end
    for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
      if object == target or object:IsDescendantOf(target) then
        return true
      end
      if object:IsA("GuiButton") and object.Active and not target:IsDescendantOf(object) then
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  scope.connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
    if owner or not available() then
      return
    end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      return
    end
    if not startsOnTarget(input) then
      return
    end
    owner = input
    onChange(input)
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
    if not owner then
      return
    end
    if not available() or owner.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or owner.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
      release()
      return
    end
    local mouse = owner.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    if mouse then
      if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        release()
        return
      end
      onChange(input)
    elseif input == owner then
      onChange(input)
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
    if input == owner then
      release()
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased, release)
  scope.add(release)
  return release
end

-- contract
Runtime.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "scope", "motion", "isVisible", "bindDrag", "mountLayer", "teardown" },
  requires = { Theme = "uitheme", Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresMethods = { Lifetime = { "scope" } },
  requiresData = { Theme = { "tokens" } },
}

return Runtime

-- [[ notification surface ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uisurface

local Surface = {}
local Appearance
function Surface.setup(deps)
  Appearance = deps.Appearance
  return true
end
function Surface.create(appearance, options)
  appearance, options = appearance or Appearance, options or {}
  local service = game:GetService("TweenService")
  local entering = 0.32
  local function layer()
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local parent = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not parent then
      return nil
    end
    local gui = parent:FindFirstChild("ExodusPersistentNotifications")
    if not gui then
      gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      gui.Name, gui.DisplayOrder = "ExodusPersistentNotifications", options.displayOrder or 2147483647
      gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false, true
      gui.ZIndexBehavior, gui.Parent = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global, parent
    end
    local frame = gui:FindFirstChild("NotificationLayer")
    if not frame then
      frame = Instance.new("Frame")
      frame.Name, frame.Size, frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.Parent = "NotificationLayer", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1, gui
    end
    return frame
  end
  local function key(value) return tostring(value or "general"):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "_") end
  local function animate(card, goals, done)
    local tween = service:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(entering, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goals)
    if done then
      tween.Completed:Once(function(status)
        if status == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
          done()
        end
      end)
    end
    tween:Play()
    return tween
  end
  local function reflow()
    local parent = layer()
    if not parent then
      return
    end
    local offset = 24
    for _, card in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
      if card:IsA("CanvasGroup") and card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationKey") and not card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationExiting") then
        if card.GroupTransparency > 0 then
          card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationEnteredAt", os.clock() + entering)
        end
        animate(card, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -offset), GroupTransparency = 0 })
        offset += card.Size.Y.Offset + 8
      end
    end
  end
  local function clear(id)
    local parent = layer()
    local card = parent and parent:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. key(id))
    if not card then
      return nil
    end
    local generation = (card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") or 0) + 1
    card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration", generation)
    card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationExiting", true)
    return animate(card, { GroupTransparency = 1, Position = card.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 12) }, function()
      if card.Parent and card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") == generation then
        card:Destroy()
        reflow()
      end
    end)
  end
  local function show(message, id, kind, duration)
    local parent = layer()
    if not parent then
      return false
    end
    id = key(id)
    local card = parent:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. id)
    if not card then
      card = appearance.notification(parent, "Notification_" .. id)
      card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationEnteredAt", os.clock() + entering)
    end
    card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationKey", id)
    card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationMessage", tostring(message))
    card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationKind", kind or "info")
    card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationExiting", false)
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    appearance.updateNotification(card, message, kind, camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080))
    local generation = (card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") or 0) + 1
    card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration", generation)
    card.Visible = true
    reflow()
    if duration == nil then
      duration = 2.5
    end
    if duration > 0 then
      task.delay(entering + duration, function()
        if card.Parent and card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") == generation then
          clear(id)
        end
      end)
    end
    return true
  end
  local function finish(id)
    local parent = layer()
    local card = parent and parent:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. key(id))
    if card then
      local remaining = (card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationEnteredAt") or 0) - os.clock()
      if remaining > 0 then
        task.wait(remaining)
      end
      local tween = clear(id)
      if tween then
        tween.Completed:Wait()
      end
    end
  end
  return { show = show, clear = clear, finish = finish, layer = layer }
end
Surface.__contract =
  { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = { Appearance = "uiappearance" }, requiresMethods = { Appearance = { "notification", "updateNotification" } } }
return Surface

-- [[ toolkit ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uikit

-- module
local UIKit = {}
local Theme
local Runtime
local Icons
local Appearance
local Installers = {}
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- configuration

-- setup
function UIKit.configure(installers) Installers = table.clone(installers) end
function UIKit.setup(deps)
  Theme, Runtime, Icons, Appearance = deps.Theme.tokens, deps.Runtime, deps.Icons, deps.Appearance
  return true
end

-- helpers
local function finite(value)
  local number = tonumber(value)
  return number and number == number and number > -math.huge and number < math.huge and number or nil
end
local function choiceValue(choice) return type(choice) == "table" and choice.value or choice end
local function choiceLabel(choice) return tostring(type(choice) == "table" and (choice.label or choice.value) or choice) end
local function keyName(value)
  if value == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
    return "—"
  end
  local names = {
    MouseButton1 = "M1",
    MouseButton2 = "M2",
    MouseButton3 = "M3",
    LeftControl = "LCtrl",
    RightControl = "RCtrl",
    LeftShift = "LShift",
    RightShift = "RShift",
  }

  local name = typeof(value) == "EnumItem" and value.Name or tostring(value or "—")
  return names[name] or name
end

-- library
function UIKit.create(options)
  options = options or {}
  local scope = Runtime.scope()
  local desktop = UIS.KeyboardEnabled or UIS.MouseEnabled or not UIS.TouchEnabled
  if options.read and options.read("ForcePCUI") == true then
    desktop = true
  end
  local motion = Runtime.motion(scope, options.reducedMotion)
  local C, FONT, TEXT = Theme.COLORS, Theme.FONT, Theme.TEXT
  local bindings, components, drags, observers = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local feedback = {}
  local controlOwners = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local popup, capture, capturedInput = {}, nil, nil
  local kit = { icon = Icons.create, Theme = Theme, Components = components, scope = scope, motion = motion, suspended = false }
  function kit.isDesktop() return desktop end
  local motions = { [motion] = true }
  function kit.createMotion(lifetime)
    local owned = Runtime.motion(lifetime, options.reducedMotion)
    motions[owned] = true
    lifetime.add(function() motions[owned] = nil end)
    return owned
  end
  local function read(key, fallback)
    local value = key and options.read and options.read(key)
    if value == nil then
      return fallback
    end
    return value
  end
  kit.read = read
  function kit.observe(callback)
    local connection = {}
    observers[connection] = callback
    function connection.Disconnect() observers[connection] = nil end
    return connection
  end
  scope.add(function() table.clear(observers) end)
  function kit.instance(class, properties, parent)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
      object.BorderSizePixel = 0
      object.AutoLocalize = false
    end
    if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
      object.AutoButtonColor = false
    end
    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
      object[key] = value
    end
    object.Parent = parent
    if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
      local ancestor = parent
      while ancestor do
        local owner = controlOwners[ancestor]
        if owner then
          owner.attachFeedback(object)
          break
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
      end
    end
    return object
  end
  local inst = kit.instance
  function kit.interactionColor(background, pressed) return Appearance.interactionColor(background, pressed) end
  function kit.borderColor(background) return Appearance.borderColor(background) end
  function kit.corner(root, radius) return inst("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or Theme.RADIUS.control) }, root) end
  function kit.stroke(root, color, thickness, light)
    local surface = root
    if root:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
      local inset = thickness or 1
      surface = inst("Frame", {
        Name = "Outline",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Active = false,
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, inset),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2),
        ZIndex = Theme.LAYERS.outline,
      }, root)
      local radius = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
      kit.corner(surface, radius and math.max(0, radius.CornerRadius.Offset - inset) or Theme.RADIUS.control)
    end
    local automatic = color == nil or color == C.border
    local function outlineColor() return Appearance.borderColor(root.BackgroundColor3, light) end
    local line =
      inst("UIStroke", { Color = automatic and outlineColor() or color, Thickness = thickness or 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, surface)
    line.Transparency = 0
    if automatic then
      line.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
      local gradient = inst("UIGradient", { Rotation = 20 }, line)
      local animation =
        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(gradient, TweenInfo.new(8, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Rotation = 40 })
      animation:Play()
      local function updateOutline() gradient.Color = Appearance.borderGradient(root.BackgroundColor3, root:GetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover") or 0) end
      updateOutline()
      local connection = root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(updateOutline)
      local hover = root:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ExodusBorderHover"):Connect(updateOutline)
      local cleanup
      cleanup = root.Destroying:Connect(function()
        connection:Disconnect()
        hover:Disconnect()
        animation:Cancel()
        cleanup:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    return line
  end
  local function text(parent, value, properties)
    local props = {
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      Text = tostring(value or ""),
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = TEXT.body,
      Font = FONT.label,
      TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
      TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
      ZIndex = 8,
    }

    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
      props[key] = value
    end
    return inst("TextLabel", props, parent)
  end
  function kit.isCapturing(input) return capture ~= nil or (input ~= nil and capturedInput == input) end
  function kit.cancelCapture()
    local pending = capture
    capture = nil
    if pending then
      pending.restore()
      if options.onCapture then
        options.onCapture(false)
      end
    end
  end
  function kit.dismiss()
    for _, reset in pairs(feedback) do
      reset()
    end
    for cancel in pairs(drags) do
      cancel()
    end
    if popup.close then
      popup.close()
    end
    kit.cancelCapture()
  end
  function kit.suspend()
    kit.suspended = true
    kit.dismiss()
    for owned in pairs(motions) do
      owned.pause()
    end
  end
  function kit.resume()
    kit.suspended = false
    for owned in pairs(motions) do
      owned.resume()
    end
    kit.refresh()
  end
  function kit.destroy()
    kit.dismiss()
    scope.destroy()
  end
  scope.add(kit.dismiss)
  local function bind(handle, key, refresh)
    if not key then
      return
    end
    local listeners = bindings[key] or {}
    bindings[key] = listeners
    listeners[refresh] = handle
    handle.scope.add(function()
      listeners[refresh] = nil
      if not next(listeners) then
        bindings[key] = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  function kit.refresh(changes)
    for key, listeners in pairs(bindings) do
      if not changes or changes[key] ~= nil then
        for refresh, handle in pairs(listeners) do
          if handle.scope.alive then
            refresh(read(key))
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, observer in pairs(observers) do
      observer(changes)
    end
  end
  if options.observe then
    scope.add(options.observe(kit.refresh))
  end
  scope.connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
    if not capture then
      return
    end
    local binding
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType.Name:match("^Gamepad") then
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
        capturedInput = input
        kit.cancelCapture()
        return
      end
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
        binding = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
      elseif input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
        binding = input.KeyCode
      end
    elseif
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
    then
      binding = input.UserInputType
    end
    if binding then
      capturedInput = input
      local pending = capture
      kit.cancelCapture()
      pending.pick(binding)
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased, kit.cancelCapture)
  function kit.feedback(lifetime, target, paint, enabled)
    local hovered, held = false, nil
    local function refresh()
      local allowed = not kit.suspended and (not enabled or enabled())
      paint(allowed and (hovered or held ~= nil), allowed and held ~= nil)
    end
    local function reset()
      hovered, held = false, nil
      refresh()
    end
    local function release(input)
      if held == input then
        if held.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          hovered = false
        end
        held = nil
        refresh()
      end
    end
    feedback[release] = reset
    lifetime.add(function() feedback[release] = nil end)
    lifetime.connect(target.MouseEnter, function()
      hovered = true
      refresh()
    end)
    lifetime.connect(target.MouseLeave, function()
      hovered = false
      refresh()
    end)
    lifetime.connect(target.InputBegan, function(input)
      if held or kit.suspended or (enabled and not enabled()) then
        return
      end
      if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          hovered = false
        end
        held = input
        refresh()
      end
    end)
    return refresh, reset
  end
  scope.connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
    for release in pairs(feedback) do
      release(input)
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased, function()
    for _, reset in pairs(feedback) do
      reset()
    end
  end)
  local function control(parent, definition, height, class)
    definition = definition or {}
    assert(not definition.desktopOnly or desktop, "Desktop-only UI is unavailable in mobile mode")
    assert(not definition.mobileOnly or not desktop, "Mobile-only UI is unavailable in desktop mode")
    local root = inst(class or "Frame", {
      Name = definition.name or definition.key or definition.kind or "Control",
      Size = definition.size or UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
      BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
      ZIndex = 6,
    }, parent)
    kit.corner(root, Theme.RADIUS.card)
    local border = kit.stroke(root)
    local childScope = Runtime.scope()
    local childMotion = kit.createMotion(childScope)
    local handle = { Root = root, Border = border, scope = childScope, motion = childMotion, enabled = true }
    scope.add(handle, function() handle.destroy() end)
    childScope.add(function() scope.forget(handle) end)
    childScope.connect(root.Destroying, childScope.destroy)
    local activeTargets = {}
    function handle.attachFeedback(target)
      kit.feedback(childScope, target, function(active, pressed)
        if definition.kind == "label" or definition.kind == "divider" then
          return
        end
        activeTargets[target] = active and (pressed and 2 or 1) or nil
        local strength = 0
        for _, value in pairs(activeTargets) do
          strength = math.max(strength, value)
        end
        root:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", strength)
      end, function() return handle.enabled end)
    end
    controlOwners[root] = handle
    handle.attachFeedback(root)
    childScope.add(function() controlOwners[root] = nil end)
    function handle.setEnabled(enabled)
      handle.enabled = enabled == true
      root.Active = handle.enabled
      if not handle.enabled and capture and capture.owner == handle then
        kit.cancelCapture()
      end
      for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("GuiButton") then
          descendant.Active = handle.enabled
          descendant.Selectable = handle.enabled
        end
        if descendant:IsA("TextBox") then
          descendant.TextEditable = handle.enabled
        end
      end
    end
    function handle.setVisible(visible) root.Visible = visible == true end
    function handle.destroy()
      childScope.destroy()
      root:Destroy()
    end
    if definition.enabled == false then
      handle.setEnabled(false)
    end
    return handle
  end
  local function title(handle, definition, rightSpace, height)
    local root = handle.Root
    local hasDescription = definition.description and definition.description ~= ""
    text(root, definition.title or definition.text, {
      Name = "Title",
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, hasDescription and 5 or 0),
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -(28 + (rightSpace or 0)), 0, hasDescription and 18 or height),
    })
    if hasDescription then
      text(root, definition.description, {
        Name = "Description",
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, definition.expandedDescription and 42 or 26),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(28 + (definition.expandedDescription and 0 or (rightSpace or 0))), 0, height - (definition.expandedDescription and 48 or 30)),
        TextColor3 = C.subtext,
        TextSize = TEXT.caption,
        Font = FONT.body,
        TextWrapped = true,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
      })
    end
  end
  local function button(parent, label, properties)
    local props = {
      Text = tostring(label),
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = TEXT.control,
      Font = FONT.strong,
      BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg,
      ZIndex = 10,
      Selectable = true,
    }

    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
      props[key] = value
    end
    local root = inst("TextButton", props, parent)
    kit.corner(root)
    if props.BackgroundTransparency ~= 1 then
      kit.stroke(root)
    end
    return root
  end
  local function hitbox(handle, callback, height)
    local root = button(handle.Root, "", {
      Name = "CardHitbox",
      Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, height and 0 or 1, height or 0),
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      ZIndex = 10,
    })
    local scale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, handle.Root)
    handle.scope.connect(root.Activated, function()
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
        return
      end
      handle.motion.play(scale, "press", { Scale = 0.97 }, function() handle.motion.play(scale, "feedback", { Scale = 1 }) end)
      callback()
    end)
    return root
  end
  local function commit(handle, definition, value)
    if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
      return false
    end
    if definition.key and options.write and options.write(definition.key, value) == false then
      if options.notify then
        options.notify("Unable to update " .. tostring(definition.title or definition.key), true)
      end
      return false
    end
    if definition.key and options.read and options.read(definition.key) ~= value then
      return false
    end
    local result
    if definition.onChange then
      result = definition.onChange(value)
    end
    if result == false and not definition.key then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  local function shortcut(handle, key, xOffset, topAligned)
    if not key or not desktop then
      return
    end
    local cap = button(handle.Root, keyName(read(key)), {
      Name = "Shortcut_" .. key,
      Position = topAligned and UDim2.new(1, xOffset or -126, 0, 10) or UDim2.new(1, xOffset or -126, 0.5, -13),
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 26),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
      TextSize = 11,
      ZIndex = 12,
    })
    local function paint(value) cap.Text = keyName(value) end
    bind(handle, key, paint)
    handle.scope.connect(cap.Activated, function()
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
        return
      end
      kit.cancelCapture()
      cap.Text = "..."
      capture = {
        restore = function()
          if cap.Parent then
            paint(read(key))
          end
        end,
        owner = handle,
        pick = function(value)
          if options.validateShortcut then
            local ok, reason = options.validateShortcut(key, value)
            if not ok then
              if options.notify then
                options.notify(reason or "Shortcut already assigned", true, { category = "system" })
              end
              return
            end
          end
          if not options.write or options.write(key, value) ~= false then
            paint(value)
          end
        end,
      }

      if options.onCapture then
        options.onCapture(true)
      end
    end)
    handle.scope.add(function()
      if capture and capture.owner == handle then
        kit.cancelCapture()
      end
    end)
  end
  local context = {
    drags = drags,
    kit = kit,
    Theme = Theme,
    Runtime = Runtime,
    UIS = UIS,
    RunService = RunService,
    options = options,
    components = components,
    C = C,
    FONT = FONT,
    TEXT = TEXT,
    inst = inst,
    text = text,
    control = control,
    title = title,
    button = button,
    hitbox = hitbox,
    commit = commit,
    shortcut = shortcut,
    bind = bind,
    read = read,
    finite = finite,
    choiceValue = choiceValue,
    choiceLabel = choiceLabel,
    keyName = keyName,
    popup = popup,
  }

  for _, installer in ipairs(Installers) do
    local previous = table.clone(components)
    installer.install(context)
    for name, factory in pairs(previous) do
      assert(components[name] == factory, "Component already registered: " .. name)
    end
    for name, factory in pairs(components) do
      assert(type(name) == "string" and type(factory) == "function", "Invalid component factory")
    end
  end
  components.tabs = components.segmented
  components.click = components.button
  components.scroll = components.slider
  components.off_on = components.toggle
  components.keybind_selector = function(parent, definition)
    assert(desktop, "Keybind controls are unavailable in mobile mode; enable PC UI in settings")
    return components.button(parent, definition)
  end
  return kit
end

-- contract
UIKit.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { configure = "infrastructure.write" } },
  provides = { "configure", "setup", "create" },
  requires = {
    Theme = "uitheme",
    Appearance = "uiappearance",
    Runtime = "uiruntime",
    Icons = "uiicons",
  },
  requiresData = { Theme = { "tokens" } },
  requiresMethods = {
    Appearance = { "borderColor", "interactionColor", "borderGradient" },
    Runtime = { "scope", "motion", "isVisible", "bindDrag", "mountLayer" },
    Icons = { "create" },
  },
}

return UIKit

-- [[ anti afk ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules antiafk

local AntiAFK = {}
local controller
local CONFIG = { schema = { AntiAFK = "boolean" }, defaults = { AntiAFK = true } }
function AntiAFK.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function AntiAFK.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  return true
end
function AntiAFK.setup(deps)
  AntiAFK.teardown()
  local utils = deps.Utils
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "AntiAFK",
    start = function(scope)
      local player = assert(utils.getLocalPlayer(), "LocalPlayer indisponível")
      local available, virtualUser = pcall(game.GetService, game, "VirtualUser")
      virtualUser = available and virtualUser or nil
      local pending, releaseThread
      local idle, lastInput, lastError = false, -math.huge, -math.huge
      local function release()
        local value = pending
        pending = nil
        if value then
          pcall(value.User.Button2Up, value.User, value.Position, value.Frame)
        end
      end
      scope.add(function()
        if releaseThread then
          pcall(task.cancel, releaseThread)
          releaseThread = nil
        end
        release()
      end)
      local function sendUser()
        assert(virtualUser, "VirtualUser indisponível")
        virtualUser:CaptureController()
        if type(virtualUser.ClickButton2) == "function" then
          local ok = pcall(virtualUser.ClickButton2, virtualUser, Vector2.zero)
          if ok then
            return
          end
        end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        release()
        local value = { User = virtualUser, Position = Vector2.zero, Frame = camera and camera.CFrame or CFrame.new() }
        virtualUser:Button2Down(value.Position, value.Frame)
        pending = value
        releaseThread = task.delay(0.15, function()
          releaseThread = nil
          if pending == value then
            release()
          end
        end)
      end
      scope.connect(player.Idled, function() idle = true end)
      deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, function()
        if not idle or os.clock() - lastInput < 30 then
          return
        end
        idle, lastInput = false, os.clock()
        local ok, reason = pcall(sendUser)
        if ok then
          return
        end
        release()
        local fallback, detail = pcall(function()
          local input = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
          local down, downError = pcall(input.SendMouseButtonEvent, input, 0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
          local up, upError = pcall(input.SendMouseButtonEvent, input, 0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
          assert(down and up, tostring(downError) .. " | " .. tostring(upError))
        end)
        if not fallback and os.clock() - lastError >= 5 then
          lastError = os.clock()
          utils.recordError("AntiAFK", tostring(reason) .. " | " .. tostring(detail))
        end
      end)
    end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
AntiAFK.__config = CONFIG
AntiAFK.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
}
return AntiAFK

-- [[ shared, reversible scene optimization ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules antilag
local AntiLag = {}
local utils, properties, spatial, lifetime, scheduler
local session, observer
local working, revision = false, 0
local CONFIG = {
  schema = {
    AntiLagEnabled = "boolean",
    AntiLagDistanceCull = "boolean",
    AntiLagRenderDistance = "rate",
    AntiLagKeepNear = "rate",
    AntiLagSimplifyFar = "boolean",
    AntiLagRemoveEffects = "boolean",
    AntiLagRemoveTextures = "boolean",
    AntiLagFlatMaterials = "boolean",
    AntiLagLowestGraphics = "boolean",
  },
  defaults = {
    AntiLagEnabled = false,
    AntiLagDistanceCull = true,
    AntiLagRenderDistance = 1200,
    AntiLagKeepNear = 128,
    AntiLagSimplifyFar = true,
    AntiLagRemoveEffects = true,
    AntiLagRemoveTextures = false,
    AntiLagFlatMaterials = true,
    AntiLagLowestGraphics = true,
  },
  constraints = { AntiLagRenderDistance = { min = 300, max = 6000 }, AntiLagKeepNear = { min = 64, max = 512 } },
}
local function setting(key)
  local value = utils and utils.getConfigValue(key)
  return if value == nil then CONFIG.defaults[key] else value
end
local function profile()
  return {
    StartEnabled = false,
    CullEnabled = setting("AntiLagDistanceCull"),
    CullDistance = math.max(setting("AntiLagRenderDistance"), setting("AntiLagKeepNear") * 2),
    CullKeepNear = setting("AntiLagKeepNear"),
    SimplifyFar = setting("AntiLagSimplifyFar"),
    Particles = setting("AntiLagRemoveEffects"),
    TrailsAndBeams = setting("AntiLagRemoveEffects"),
    LegacyEffects = setting("AntiLagRemoveEffects"),
    RemoveTextures = setting("AntiLagRemoveTextures"),
    FlatMaterials = setting("AntiLagFlatMaterials"),
    LowestGraphics = setting("AntiLagLowestGraphics"),
    PostEffects = true,
    Lights = true,
    Shadows = true,
    FlatLighting = true,
    FlatSky = true,
    Atmosphere = true,
    Clouds = true,
    NoFog = true,
    Water = true,
    TransparentWater = false,
    TerrainDecoration = true,
    MaintainEffects = true,
    RestoreLatest = false,
    FlatSkyTexture = "",
    BudgetMs = 1.2,
    MaxItemsPerFrame = 120,
    ReapplyInterval = 0.2,
  }
end
local function stop()
  local owner = session
  if not owner then
    return
  end
  if owner.spatial then
    owner.spatial:Destroy()
  end
  if owner.engine then
    owner.engine:Destroy()
    while owner.engine:GetStatus().Alive do
      game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
  end
  owner.scope.destroy()
  if session == owner then
    session = nil
  end
end
local function start()
  local settings
  pcall(function() settings = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings") end)
  local owner = { scope = lifetime.scope(), detail = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), profile = profile() }
  session = owner
  owner.engine = properties.create({
    Workspace = workspace,
    Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"),
    RunService = game:GetService("RunService"),
    CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService"),
    GameSettings = settings,
    Roots = { workspace, game:GetService("Lighting") },
    PhasesPerFrame = 2,
    ConnectPhysics = function(callback)
      local scope = owner.scope.child()
      scheduler.connectPhysics(scope, callback)
      return { Disconnect = scope.destroy }
    end,
    ExtraPolicy = function(object, target, watch)
      local state = owner.detail[object]
      if state == "hidden" then
        target.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
      elseif state == "simple" then
        target.Material, target.MaterialVariant, target.Reflectance = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, "", 0
      end
      return target, watch
    end,
  }, owner.profile)
  owner.spatial = spatial.create({
    Workspace = workspace,
    ConnectPhysics = function(callback)
      local scope = owner.scope.child()
      scheduler.connectPhysics(scope, callback)
      return { Disconnect = scope.destroy }
    end,
    GetFocusPosition = function()
      local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
      local root = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      return root and root.Position
    end,
    OnState = function(object, state)
      owner.detail[object] = state
      owner.engine:RefreshInstance(object, false)
    end,
  }, function(key) return owner.engine:GetOption(key) end)
  owner.engine:SetEnabled(true)
  owner.spatial:SetEnabled(true)
end
local function reconcile()
  revision += 1
  if working then
    return
  end
  working = true
  task.defer(function()
    local seen
    repeat
      seen = revision
      local ok, reason = pcall(function()
        if utils and utils.isActive() and setting("AntiLagEnabled") then
          if not session then
            start()
          else
            local requested = profile()
            session.engine:SetOptions(requested)
            session.profile = requested
            session.spatial:Refresh()
          end
        else
          stop()
        end
      end)
      if not ok then
        local reporting = utils
        local restored, restoreError = pcall(stop)
        if reporting then
          reporting.recordError("AntiLag", tostring(reason))
          reporting.setConfig({ AntiLagEnabled = false })
        end
        if not restored then
          warn("[Exodus AntiLag] " .. tostring(restoreError))
        end
      end
    until seen == revision
    working = false
  end)
end
function AntiLag.setEnabled(enabled)
  if not utils then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return utils.setConfig({ AntiLagEnabled = enabled == true })
end
function AntiLag.getStatus()
  return {
    enabled = session ~= nil,
    busy = working,
    engine = session and session.engine and session.engine:GetStatus(),
    spatial = session and session.spatial and session.spatial:GetStatus(),
  }
end
function AntiLag.teardown()
  utils = nil
  revision += 1
  if observer then
    observer:Disconnect()
    observer = nil
  end
  while working do
    game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
  end
  stop()
  return true
end
function AntiLag.setup(deps)
  AntiLag.teardown()
  utils, properties, spatial, lifetime, scheduler = deps.Utils, deps.Properties, deps.Spatial, deps.Lifetime, deps.Controller
  observer = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    for key in pairs(changes) do
      if CONFIG.schema[key] and (session or setting("AntiLagEnabled")) then
        reconcile()
        break
      end
    end
  end)
  if setting("AntiLagEnabled") then
    reconcile()
  end
  return true
end
AntiLag.__config = CONFIG
AntiLag.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "getStatus" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller", Properties = "renderproperties", Spatial = "renderspatial" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "isActive", "observeConfig", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "connectPhysics" },
    Properties = { "create" },
    Spatial = { "create" },
  },
}
return AntiLag

-- [[ properties ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules renderproperties

-- code
local Properties = {}
local shared
function Properties.setup(deps)
  shared = deps.Binding
  return true
end
local function createOptimizer(services, initialConfig)
  local Workspace = services.Workspace
  local Lighting = services.Lighting
  local roots = services.Roots or { Workspace, Lighting }
  local CollectionService = services.CollectionService
  local options = table.clone(initialConfig)
  local controller = {}
  local enabled, alive, destroying = false, true, false
  local journal, records = {}, {}
  local connections = {}
  local pending, queued, head, tail = {}, {}, 1, 0
  local scan = {}
  local dirty = {}
  local delayed = false
  local workerRunning = false
  local driver
  local generation = 0
  local unsupported = {}
  local unsupportedCount, restoreFailures, runtimeFailures = 0, 0, 0
  local changedProperties = 0
  local scheduleWorker, enqueue, process, restartScan
  local oneSequence = NumberSequence.new(1)
  local zeroLifetime = NumberRange.new(0)
  local white, black = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
  local skyProperties = { "SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp" }
  local function read(object, property)
    return pcall(function() return object[property] end)
  end
  local function reportUnavailable(key)
    if not unsupported[key] then
      unsupported[key] = true
      unsupportedCount += 1
      if key ~= "Terrain.Decoration" then
        warn("[AntiLag] Ajuste indisponivel neste cliente: " .. key)
      end
    end
  end
  local function unavailable(object, property) reportUnavailable(object.ClassName .. "." .. property) end
  local function inScope(object)
    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
      if object == root or object:IsDescendantOf(root) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function desiredFor(object)
    local target = {}
    local watch = true
    if object == services.GameSettings then
      if options.LowestGraphics then
        target.SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1
      end
      return target, false
    elseif object == Lighting then
      if options.Shadows then
        target.GlobalShadows = false
      end
      if options.FlatLighting then
        target.Ambient, target.OutdoorAmbient = white, white
        target.Brightness, target.ExposureCompensation = 0, 0
        target.EnvironmentDiffuseScale, target.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0, 0
        target.ColorShift_Top, target.ColorShift_Bottom = black, black
        local ok, soft = pcall(function() return Enum.LightingStyle.Soft end)
        if ok then
          target.LightingStyle = soft
        end
        target.PrioritizeLightingQuality = false
      end
      if options.NoFog then
        target.FogStart, target.FogEnd = 0, 1000000
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Terrain") then
      if options.Water then
        target.WaterWaveSize, target.WaterWaveSpeed, target.WaterReflectance = 0, 0, 0
        target.WaterTransparency = if options.TransparentWater then 1 else 0
      end
      if options.TerrainDecoration then
        target.Decoration = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
      if options.Particles then
        target.Enabled = false
        target.Lifetime = zeroLifetime
        target.Transparency = oneSequence
        target.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Beam") then
      if options.TrailsAndBeams then
        target.Enabled, target.Transparency = false, oneSequence
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Smoke") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Enabled, target.Opacity, target.LocalTransparencyModifier = false, 0, 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Fire") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Enabled, target.LocalTransparencyModifier = false, 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Sparkles") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Enabled, target.LocalTransparencyModifier = false, 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Highlight") then
      if options.LegacyEffects and object:GetAttribute("UIComponent") ~= true then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("ForceField") or object:IsA("Explosion") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Visible = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("PostEffect") then
      if options.PostEffects then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Light") then
      if options.Lights then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
      if options.Shadows then
        target.Shadows = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Atmosphere") then
      if options.Atmosphere then
        target.Density, target.Haze, target.Glare = 0, 0, 0
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Clouds") then
      if options.Clouds then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Sky") then
      if options.FlatSky then
        target.CelestialBodiesShown, target.StarCount = false, 0
        for _, property in ipairs(skyProperties) do
          target[property] = options.FlatSkyTexture
        end
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
      if options.RemoveTextures then
        target.Transparency = 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
      if options.RemoveTextures then
        target.TextureId = ""
      end
    elseif object:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
      if options.RemoveTextures then
        target.ColorMap, target.NormalMap, target.MetalnessMap, target.RoughnessMap = "", "", "", ""
      end
    elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
      watch = false
      if object:IsA("MeshPart") then
        target.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
        if options.RemoveTextures then
          target.TextureID = ""
        end
      end
      if options.Shadows then
        target.CastShadow = false
      end
      if options.FlatMaterials then
        target.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        target.MaterialVariant, target.Reflectance = "", 0
      end
      if options.HideTaggedDecorations and CollectionService:HasTag(object, "AntiLagDecoration") then
        target.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
      end
    end
    return target, watch and options.MaintainEffects
  end
  local function removeEntry(entry)
    if entry.connection then
      entry.connection:Disconnect()
      entry.connection = nil
    end
    journal[entry.object] = nil
    local index = entry.index
    local last = records[#records]
    records[index] = last
    if last then
      last.index = index
    end
    records[#records] = nil
  end
  local function restoreProperty(object, property, saved)
    if not shared.release(saved, object, property) then
      restoreFailures += 1
    end
  end
  local function restoreEntry(entry)
    removeEntry(entry)
    for property, saved in pairs(entry.properties) do
      restoreProperty(entry.object, property, saved)
      changedProperties -= 1
    end
  end
  local function delayDirty()
    if delayed then
      return
    end
    delayed = true
    task.delay(options.ReapplyInterval, function()
      delayed = false
      local batch = dirty
      dirty = {}
      if not alive or not enabled then
        return
      end
      for object in pairs(batch) do
        enqueue(object)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function updateWatcher(entry, watch)
    if not watch then
      if entry.connection then
        entry.connection:Disconnect()
        entry.connection = nil
      end
      return
    end
    if entry.connection then
      return
    end
    entry.connection = entry.object.Changed:Connect(function(property)
      if not enabled or not alive or journal[entry.object] ~= entry then
        return
      end
      local saved = entry.properties[property]
      if not saved then
        return
      end
      local ok, current = read(entry.object, property)
      if not ok or current == saved.applied then
        return
      end
      if options.RestoreLatest then
        saved.original = current
      end
      dirty[entry.object] = true
      delayDirty()
    end)
  end
  process = function(object)
    local special = object == services.GameSettings
    if not enabled or (not special and not inScope(object)) then
      if journal[object] then
        restoreEntry(journal[object])
      end
      return
    end
    local target, watch = desiredFor(object)
    if services.ExtraPolicy then
      target, watch = services.ExtraPolicy(object, target, watch, options)
    end
    local entry = journal[object]
    if entry then
      for property, saved in pairs(entry.properties) do
        if target[property] == nil then
          entry.properties[property] = nil
          restoreProperty(object, property, saved)
          changedProperties -= 1
        end
      end
    end
    for property, value in pairs(target) do
      if unsupported[object.ClassName .. "." .. property] then
        continue
      end
      local ok, current = read(object, property)
      if not ok then
        unavailable(object, property)
        continue
      end
      local saved = entry and entry.properties[property]
      if not saved and current == value and not watch then
        continue
      end
      if not entry then
        entry = { object = object, properties = {}, index = #records + 1 }
        journal[object], records[entry.index] = entry, entry
      end
      if not saved then
        saved = { original = current, applied = current }
        entry.properties[property] = saved
        changedProperties += 1
      elseif options.RestoreLatest and current ~= saved.applied then
        saved.original = current
      end
      if current ~= value then
        local previous = saved.applied
        saved.applied = value
        if not shared.apply(saved, object, property, value, 100) then
          saved.applied = previous
          unavailable(object, property)
          if saved.original == current then
            shared.release(saved, object, property)
            entry.properties[property] = nil
            changedProperties -= 1
          end
        end
      else
        shared.apply(saved, object, property, value, 100)
        saved.applied = value
      end
    end
    if entry then
      if next(entry.properties) == nil then
        removeEntry(entry)
      else
        updateWatcher(entry, watch)
      end
    end
  end
  local function popPending()
    if head > tail then
      return nil
    end
    local object = pending[head]
    pending[head] = nil
    head += 1
    queued[object] = nil
    if head > tail then
      pending, head, tail = {}, 1, 0
    end
    return object
  end
  local function nextScan()
    while #scan > 0 do
      local frame = scan[#scan]
      local object = frame.items[frame.index]
      if not object then
        scan[#scan] = nil
        continue
      end
      frame.index += 1
      local ok, children = pcall(function() return object:GetChildren() end)
      if ok and #children > 0 then
        scan[#scan + 1] = { items = children, index = 1 }
      end
      return object
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function workAvailable() return if enabled then head <= tail or #scan > 0 else #records > 0 end
  local function finishDestroy()
    alive = false
    if driver then
      driver:Disconnect()
      driver = nil
    end
    workerRunning = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
    connections, dirty, pending, queued, scan = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  end
  local function disconnectDriver()
    if driver then
      driver:Disconnect()
      driver = nil
    end
    workerRunning = false
  end
  local function work()
    if not alive then
      disconnectDriver()
      return
    end
    local phases = services.PhasesPerFrame or 2
    local deadline = os.clock() + options.BudgetMs / (1000 * phases)
    local limit = math.max(1, math.floor(options.MaxItemsPerFrame / phases))
    for count = 1, limit do
      if not workAvailable() or os.clock() >= deadline then
        break
      end
      if not enabled then
        restoreEntry(records[#records])
      else
        local object
        if count % 2 == 0 then
          object = popPending() or nextScan()
        else
          object = nextScan() or popPending()
        end
        if object then
          local ok, message = pcall(process, object)
          if not ok then
            runtimeFailures += 1
            if runtimeFailures <= 3 then
              warn("[AntiLag] " .. tostring(message))
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if not workAvailable() then
      disconnectDriver()
      if destroying and not enabled then
        finishDestroy()
      end
    end
  end
  scheduleWorker = function()
    if workerRunning or not alive then
      return
    end
    workerRunning = true
    driver = services.ConnectPhysics(work)
  end
  enqueue = function(object)
    if not alive or not enabled or queued[object] then
      return
    end
    tail += 1
    pending[tail], queued[object] = object, true
    scheduleWorker()
  end
  restartScan = function()
    generation += 1
    scan = { { items = table.clone(roots), index = 1 } }
    if services.GameSettings then
      enqueue(services.GameSettings)
    end
    if options.LowestGraphics and not services.GameSettings then
      reportUnavailable("UserGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel")
    end
    if enabled then
      process(Lighting)
      if services.GameSettings then
        process(services.GameSettings)
      end
    end
    scheduleWorker()
  end
  for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
    connections[#connections + 1] = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(enqueue)
    connections[#connections + 1] = root.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object)
      if journal[object] then
        enqueue(object)
      end
    end)
  end
  for _, signal in ipairs({
    CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("AntiLagDecoration"),
    CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("AntiLagDecoration"),
  }) do
    connections[#connections + 1] = signal:Connect(enqueue)
  end
  connections[#connections + 1] = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
    if enabled and object:IsA("Humanoid") and object.Parent then
      scan[#scan + 1] = { items = { object.Parent }, index = 1 }
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end)
  function controller:RefreshInstance(object, immediate)
    if not enabled or not alive then
      return
    end
    if immediate then
      local ok, message = pcall(process, object)
      if not ok then
        runtimeFailures += 1
        if runtimeFailures <= 3 then
          warn("[AntiLag] " .. tostring(message))
        end
      end
    else
      enqueue(object)
    end
  end
  function controller:RefreshSubtree(object)
    if enabled and alive and object then
      scan[#scan + 1] = { items = { object }, index = 1 }
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end
  function controller:SetEnabled(value)
    if not alive or destroying or enabled == value then
      return
    end
    enabled = value
    generation += 1
    if enabled then
      restartScan()
    else
      pending, queued, scan, dirty, head, tail = {}, {}, {}, {}, 1, 0
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end
  local batching = false
  local needsScan = false
  function controller:SetOption(key, value)
    if not alive or destroying or options[key] == nil then
      return false
    end
    if typeof(value) ~= typeof(options[key]) then
      return false
    end
    if type(value) == "number" and (value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge) then
      return false
    end
    if key == "BudgetMs" then
      value = math.clamp(value, 0.25, 4)
    end
    if key == "MaxItemsPerFrame" then
      value = math.floor(math.clamp(value, 8, 1000))
    end
    if key == "ReapplyInterval" then
      value = math.clamp(value, 0.1, 2)
    end
    local bounds = {
      CullDistance = { 128, 6000 },
      CullKeepNear = { 64, 512 },
      CullViewPadding = { 0, 100 },
      CullViewDegrees = { 2, 30 },
      CullHideDelay = { 0.05, 2 },
      CullInterval = { 0.06, 0.35 },
      CullBudgetMs = { 0.2, 1.5 },
      CullAbove = { 80, 600 },
      CullBelow = { 50, 400 },
      CullVerticalMargin = { 5, 30 },
    }

    if bounds[key] then
      value = math.clamp(value, bounds[key][1], bounds[key][2])
    end
    if options[key] == value then
      return true
    end
    options[key] = value
    local noScan = key == "ShowFPS"
      or key == "ShowMenu"
      or key == "StartEnabled"
      or key == "BudgetMs"
      or key == "MaxItemsPerFrame"
      or key == "ReapplyInterval"
      or key == "RestoreLatest"
      or string.sub(key, 1, 4) == "Cull"
      or key == "HideLobbyInMatch"
    if enabled and not noScan then
      if batching then
        needsScan = true
      else
        restartScan()
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  function controller:SetOptions(values)
    batching = true
    local accepted = true
    for key, value in pairs(values) do
      if not self:SetOption(key, value) then
        accepted = false
      end
    end
    batching = false
    if needsScan then
      needsScan = false
      restartScan()
    end
    return accepted
  end
  function controller:GetOption(key) return options[key] end
  function controller:GetStatus()
    return {
      Enabled = enabled,
      Alive = alive,
      Destroying = destroying,
      Busy = workerRunning or workAvailable(),
      Instances = #records,
      Properties = changedProperties,
      Unsupported = unsupportedCount,
      UnsupportedProperties = table.clone(unsupported),
      RestoreFailures = restoreFailures,
      RuntimeFailures = runtimeFailures,
      Generation = generation,
    }
  end
  function controller:Destroy()
    if not alive or destroying then
      return
    end
    self:SetEnabled(false)
    destroying = true
    if #records == 0 then
      finishDestroy()
    else
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end
  for _, key in ipairs({ "BudgetMs", "MaxItemsPerFrame", "ReapplyInterval" }) do
    controller:SetOption(key, options[key])
  end
  controller:SetEnabled(options.StartEnabled)
  return controller
end
Properties.create = createOptimizer
Properties.__contract = {
  access = { default = "render.write" },
  requires = { Binding = "propertybinding" },
  requiresMethods = { Binding = { "apply", "release" } },
  provides = { "setup", "create" },
}

return Properties

-- [[ budgeted distance detail; never deletes objects or culls by height ]]
--!optimize 2
--!native
-- @modules renderspatial
local Spatial = {}
function Spatial.setup() return true end
local function halfSize(object)
  local frame, size = object.CFrame, object.Size
  local right, up, look = frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, frame.LookVector
  return Vector3.new(
    (math.abs(right.X) * size.X + math.abs(up.X) * size.Y + math.abs(look.X) * size.Z) * 0.5,
    (math.abs(right.Y) * size.X + math.abs(up.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(look.Y) * size.Z) * 0.5,
    (math.abs(right.Z) * size.X + math.abs(up.Z) * size.Y + math.abs(look.Z) * size.Z) * 0.5
  )
end
local function distance(position, half, origin)
  local delta = position - origin
  local x, y, z = math.max(0, math.abs(delta.X) - half.X), math.max(0, math.abs(delta.Y) - half.Y), math.max(0, math.abs(delta.Z) - half.Z)
  return math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)
end
function Spatial.create(services, option)
  local controller = {}
  local active, alive, driver = false, true, nil
  local records, byObject, scan, pending = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local head, tail, cursor, hidden, simple = 1, 0, 1, 0, 0
  local function state(entry, value)
    if entry.state == value then
      return
    end
    if entry.state == "hidden" then
      hidden -= 1
    elseif entry.state == "simple" then
      simple -= 1
    end
    entry.state = value
    if value == "hidden" then
      hidden += 1
    elseif value == "simple" then
      simple += 1
    end
    services.OnState(entry.object, value)
  end
  local function forget(object)
    local entry = byObject[object]
    if not entry then
      return
    end
    state(entry, nil)
    local last = records[#records]
    records[entry.index] = last
    if last then
      last.index = entry.index
    end
    records[#records], byObject[object] = nil, nil
  end
  local function dynamic(object)
    if not object.Anchored then
      return true
    end
    local parent = object.Parent
    while parent and parent ~= services.Workspace do
      if parent:IsA("Model") and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        return true
      end
      parent = parent.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  local function register(object)
    if byObject[object] or not object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Terrain") then
      return
    end
    local entry = { object = object, index = #records + 1 }
    byObject[object], records[entry.index] = entry, entry
  end
  local function nextObject()
    if head <= tail then
      local object = pending[head]
      pending[head] = nil
      head += 1
      if head > tail then
        pending, head, tail = {}, 1, 0
      end
      return object, false
    end
    while #scan > 0 do
      local frame = scan[#scan]
      local object = frame.items[frame.index]
      if not object then
        scan[#scan] = nil
      else
        frame.index += 1
        return object, true
      end
    end
  end
  function controller:Tick()
    if not active or not alive then
      return
    end
    local camera = services.Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
      return
    end
    local focus = services.GetFocusPosition() or camera.CFrame.Position
    local view = camera.CFrame.Position
    local near = math.max(64, option("CullKeepNear") or 128)
    local limit = math.max(near * 2, option("CullDistance") or 1200)
    -- One fixed budget per phase, including indexing. No expensive bootstrap mode.
    local deadline, count = os.clock() + 0.0004, 0
    while count < 40 and os.clock() < deadline do
      local object, descend = nextObject()
      if not object then
        break
      end
      if object == services.Workspace or object:IsDescendantOf(services.Workspace) then
        if descend then
          local children = object:GetChildren()
          if #children > 0 then
            scan[#scan + 1] = { items = children, index = 1 }
          end
        end
        register(object)
      end
      count += 1
    end
    count = 0
    while count < math.min(#records, 100) and os.clock() < deadline do
      if cursor > #records then
        cursor = 1
      end
      local entry = records[cursor]
      if not entry then
        break
      end
      cursor += 1
      count += 1
      local object = entry.object
      if not object.Parent or not object:IsDescendantOf(services.Workspace) then
        forget(object)
      else
        local detail
        if not dynamic(object) then
          local half = halfSize(object)
          local range = math.min(distance(object.Position, half, focus), distance(object.Position, half, view))
          -- The nearest surface wins: large floors, nearby geometry and characters remain visible.
          if range > near then
            local margin = entry.state == "hidden" and -near * 0.15 or near * 0.15
            if option("CullEnabled") and range > limit + margin then
              detail = "hidden"
            elseif option("SimplifyFar") then
              detail = "simple"
            end
          end
        end
        state(entry, detail)
      end
    end
  end
  local function clear()
    for _, entry in ipairs(records) do
      state(entry, nil)
    end
    records, byObject, scan, pending = {}, {}, {}, {}
    head, tail, cursor, hidden, simple = 1, 0, 1, 0, 0
  end
  local connections = {}
  function controller:SetEnabled(value)
    if not alive or active == value then
      return
    end
    active = value
    if driver then
      driver:Disconnect()
      driver = nil
    end
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(connections)
    clear()
    if active then
      scan = { { items = { services.Workspace }, index = 1 } }
      connections[1] = services.Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
        tail += 1
        pending[tail] = object
      end)
      connections[2] = services.Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(forget)
      driver = services.ConnectPhysics(function() self:Tick() end)
    end
  end
  function controller:Refresh() self:Tick() end
  function controller:GetStatus() return { Tracked = #records, Hidden = hidden, Simplified = simple, Indexing = #scan > 0 or head <= tail } end
  function controller:Destroy()
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    self:SetEnabled(false)
    alive = false
  end
  return controller
end
Spatial.__contract = { access = { default = "render.write" }, provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Spatial

-- [[ autojump ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules autojump

local AutoJump = {}
local controller
function AutoJump.sync() return controller and controller.sync() or false end
function AutoJump.setEnabled(value) return controller and controller.setEnabled(value) or false end
function AutoJump.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  return true
end
function AutoJump.setup(deps)
  AutoJump.teardown()
  local utils = deps.Utils
  local function jump()
    local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local character = player and player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
      return
    end
    if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
      humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end
  end
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "AutoJump",
    start = function(scope) deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, jump) end,
    update = jump,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
AutoJump.__config = { persistent = { AutoJump = false }, schema = { AutoJump = "boolean" }, defaults = { AutoJump = false } }
AutoJump.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "sync", "setEnabled" },
}
return AutoJump

-- [[ camera ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules camera

local Camera = {}
local utils
local cameraEpoch = 0
local cameraInput
local cameraOriginal
local cameraWrapped
local configConnection
local cameraThread
local sensitivity = 1
local CONFIG = {
  DEFAULT_SENSITIVITY = 1,
  MODULE_SEARCH_RETRY = 0.5,
}

local function normalizeSensitivity(value)
  value = tonumber(value)
  if not value or value ~= value or value < 0 or value == math.huge then
    return CONFIG.DEFAULT_SENSITIVITY
  end
  return value
end
local function stopCamera()
  cameraEpoch += 1
  if cameraThread then
    pcall(task.cancel, cameraThread)
    cameraThread = nil
  end
  if cameraInput and cameraInput.getRotation == cameraWrapped then
    cameraInput.getRotation = cameraOriginal
  end
  cameraInput, cameraOriginal, cameraWrapped = nil, nil, nil
end
local function startCamera()
  stopCamera()
  local token = cameraEpoch
  cameraThread = task.spawn(function()
    while token == cameraEpoch and utils and utils.isActive() do
      local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
      local scripts = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
      local module = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
      local camera = module and module:FindFirstChild("CameraModule")
      local input = camera and camera:FindFirstChild("CameraInput")
      if input and input:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local loaded, api = pcall(require, input)
        if token ~= cameraEpoch or not utils then
          return
        end
        if loaded and type(api) == "table" and type(api.getRotation) == "function" then
          cameraInput, cameraOriginal = api, api.getRotation
          local original, boundUtils = cameraOriginal, utils
          local wrapped
          wrapped = function(...)
            local rotation = original(...)
            if token ~= cameraEpoch or utils ~= boundUtils or not boundUtils.isActive() then
              if api.getRotation == wrapped then
                api.getRotation = original
              end
              return rotation
            end
            return rotation * sensitivity
          end
          cameraWrapped = wrapped
          cameraInput.getRotation = cameraWrapped
          return
        end
      end
      task.wait(CONFIG.MODULE_SEARCH_RETRY)
    end
  end)
end
function Camera.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
  end
  Camera.teardown()
  utils = deps.Utils
  sensitivity = normalizeSensitivity(utils.getConfigValue("CameraSensitivity"))
  if sensitivity ~= CONFIG.DEFAULT_SENSITIVITY then
    startCamera()
  end
  configConnection = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.CameraSensitivity ~= nil then
      sensitivity = normalizeSensitivity(changes.CameraSensitivity)
      if sensitivity == CONFIG.DEFAULT_SENSITIVITY then
        stopCamera()
      elseif not cameraWrapped then
        startCamera()
      end
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(configConnection)
  return true
end
function Camera.teardown()
  if configConnection then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(configConnection)
    end
    configConnection:Disconnect()
    configConnection = nil
  end
  stopCamera()
  utils = nil
end
Camera.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = {
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "getConfigValue",
      "isActive",
      "observeConfig",
      "trackGlobal",
      "untrackGlobal",
    },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown" },
}
return Camera
