-- [[ dumper ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules dumper

-- module
local Dumper = {}
local activeToken
local activeCallbacks
local status = {
  running = false,
  startedAt = 0,
  folder = nil,
  total = 0,
  processed = 0,
  saved = 0,
  failed = 0,
  bytecode = 0,
}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  PREFIX = "SrcDump",
  PROGRESS_EVERY = 25,
  MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS = 11,
  RETRY_BATCH = 8,
  RETRY_DELAY = 1,
  RETRY_MAX_DELAY = 3,
  RETRY_TIME_BUDGET = 120,
  API_TIMEOUT = 10,
  INSTANCE_BATCH = 5000,
  SCRIPT_BATCH = 100,
  SAVE_BYTECODE = true,
  SAVE_DISASSEMBLY = true,
  INCLUDE_NIL_INSTANCES = true,
}

local SCRIPT_CLASSES = {
  Script = true,
  LocalScript = true,
  ModuleScript = true,
}

local REMOTE_CLASSES = {
  RemoteEvent = true,
  RemoteFunction = true,
  UnreliableRemoteEvent = true,
  BindableEvent = true,
  BindableFunction = true,
}

local SYSTEM_NAMES = {
  CoreGui = true,
  CorePackages = true,
  RobloxGui = true,
  RobloxReplicatedStorage = true,
  CoreScripts = true,
  RobloxDefault = true,
  RobloxPlayerScript = true,
}

-- helpers
local function emit(callbacks, name, ...)
  local callback = callbacks and callbacks[name]
  if type(callback) == "function" then
    pcall(callback, ...)
  end
end
local function log(message)
  if type(print) == "function" then
    pcall(print, "[SrcDump] " .. tostring(message))
  end
end
local function line(value) return tostring(value):gsub("[\r\n]", " ") end
local function safeProperty(object, key, fallback)
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return object[key] end)
  if ok and value ~= nil then
    return value
  end
  return fallback
end
local function objectName(object) return tostring(safeProperty(object, "Name", "Unnamed")) end
local function objectClass(object) return tostring(safeProperty(object, "ClassName", "Unknown")) end
local function objectPath(object)
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return object:GetFullName() end)
  return ok and value or objectName(object)
end
local function isInstance(object) return typeof(object) == "Instance" end
local function safeFilename(value)
  local result = tostring(value):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_"):gsub("_+", "_"):sub(1, 80)
  if result == "" or result == "." or result == ".." then
    return "unnamed"
  end
  return result
end
local function getEnvironment()
  if type(getfenv) == "function" then
    local ok, environment = pcall(getfenv)
    if ok and type(environment) == "table" then
      return environment
    end
  end
  if type(getgenv) == "function" then
    local ok, environment = pcall(getgenv)
    if ok and type(environment) == "table" then
      return environment
    end
  end
  return type(_G) == "table" and _G or {}
end
local function lookup(name)
  local environment = getEnvironment()
  local value = environment[name]
  if type(value) == "function" then
    return value
  end
  if type(_G) == "table" and type(_G[name]) == "function" then
    return _G[name]
  end
  return nil
end
local function ensureFolder(path)
  if type(isfolder) == "function" then
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
    if ok and exists then
      return true
    end
  end
  if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
    return false, "makefolder is unavailable"
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(makefolder, path)
  if ok then
    return true
  end
  if type(isfolder) == "function" then
    local checked, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
    if checked and exists then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false, tostring(err)
end
local function saveFile(path, content, createdFolders)
  if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
    return false, "writefile is unavailable"
  end
  local directory = path:match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
  if directory and not createdFolders[directory] then
    local current = ""
    for part in directory:gmatch("[^/]+") do
      current = current == "" and part or current .. "/" .. part
      if not createdFolders[current] then
        local ok, err = ensureFolder(current)
        if not ok then
          return false, "cannot create " .. current .. ": " .. tostring(err)
        end
        createdFolders[current] = true
      end
    end
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(writefile, path, content)
  if not ok then
    return false, tostring(err)
  end
  return true
end
local function allowed(object, allowDetached)
  if not isInstance(object) then
    return false
  end
  local current = object
  for _ = 1, 200 do
    if current == game then
      return true
    end
    if SYSTEM_NAMES[objectName(current)] then
      return false
    end
    local parent = safeProperty(current, "Parent")
    if not isInstance(parent) then
      return allowDetached == true
    end
    current = parent
  end
  return false
end
local function serialize(value)
  if type(value) == "string" then
    return string.format("%q", value)
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(tostring, value)
  return ok and line(result) or "<unavailable>"
end
local function attributes(object)
  local ok, values = pcall(function() return object:GetAttributes() end)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    return "{}"
  end
  local result = {}
  for key, value in pairs(values) do
    result[#result + 1] = line(key) .. "=" .. serialize(value)
  end
  table.sort(result)
  return "{" .. table.concat(result, ", ") .. "}"
end
local function tags(object, collection)
  if not collection then
    return "[]"
  end
  local ok, values = pcall(function() return collection:GetTags(object) end)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    return "[]"
  end
  table.sort(values)
  return "[" .. table.concat(values, ", ") .. "]"
end
local function errorText(value)
  local text = type(value) == "string" and value or ("returned " .. type(value))
  return line(text)
end
local SOURCE_ERRORS = {
  "failed to get script bytecode",
  "failed to get bytecode",
  "failed to decompile",
  "failed to extract",
  "decompilation failed",
  "decompiler error",
  "decompiler timed out",
  "script has no bytecode",
  "no bytecode available",
  "empty bytecode",
  "server scripts are impossible",
  "invalid argument",
  "server error",
  "decompilation error",
}

local function sourceError(value)
  local lower = tostring(value):lower():gsub("^%s*%-%-%[%[", ""):gsub("^%s*%-%-+%s*", ""):gsub("^%s+", "")
  for _, phrase in ipairs(SOURCE_ERRORS) do
    if lower:sub(1, #phrase) == phrase then
      return line(value)
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function timedCall(token, fn, argument, retryDeadline)
  if token.cancelled then
    return false, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local deadline = math.min(os.clock() + CONFIG.API_TIMEOUT, retryDeadline or math.huge)
  if os.clock() >= deadline then
    return false, "retry time budget exhausted"
  end
  local finished, success, result = false, false, nil
  local worker = task.defer(function()
    local ok, value = pcall(fn, argument)
    success, result, finished = ok, value, true
  end)
  while not finished and not token.cancelled and os.clock() < deadline do
    task.wait()
  end
  if finished then
    return success, result
  end
  if worker and type(task.cancel) == "function" then
    pcall(task.cancel, worker)
  end
  return false, token.cancelled and "Dump canceled" or "API timed out"
end
local function getGameName(token)
  local ok, product = timedCall(token, function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId) end)
  if ok and type(product) == "table" and type(product.Name) == "string" and product.Name:match("%S") then
    return product.Name
  end
  local name = safeProperty(game, "Name")
  if type(name) == "string" and name:match("%S") and name ~= "Game" and name ~= "game" then
    return name
  end
  return "Place_" .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
end
local function nextFolder(gameName)
  local base = CONFIG.PREFIX .. "_" .. safeFilename(gameName)
  if type(isfolder) ~= "function" then
    return base .. "_" .. tostring(os.time())
  end
  local index = 1
  while true do
    local candidate = base .. "_" .. index
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, candidate)
    if not ok then
      return base .. "_" .. tostring(os.time())
    end
    if not exists then
      return candidate
    end
    index += 1
  end
end
local function addDiscovery(api, add, errors, token)
  local ok, values = pcall(api)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    errors[#errors + 1] = "discovery failed: " .. errorText(values)
    return
  end
  local processed = 0
  for _, object in pairs(values) do
    if token.cancelled then
      return
    end
    processed += 1
    if processed % CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH == 0 then
      task.wait()
    end
    add(object, "executor", CONFIG.INCLUDE_NIL_INSTANCES)
  end
end

-- dump
local function run(token, callbacks)
  if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
    return nil, "writefile and makefolder are required"
  end
  local gameName = getGameName(token)
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local createdFolders = {}
  local base = nextFolder(gameName)
  local status = token.status
  local retryDeadline
  local function callAPI(fn, argument) return timedCall(token, fn, argument, retryDeadline) end
  local function save(path, content)
    if token.cancelled then
      return false, "Dump canceled"
    end
    return saveFile(path, content, createdFolders)
  end
  status.folder = base
  for _, path in ipairs({ base, base .. "/scripts", base .. "/remotes" }) do
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(path)
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[path] = true
  end
  if CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(base .. "/bytecode")
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create bytecode folder: " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[base .. "/bytecode"] = true
  end
  if CONFIG.SAVE_DISASSEMBLY then
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(base .. "/disassembly")
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create disassembly folder: " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[base .. "/disassembly"] = true
  end
  emit(callbacks, "onStatus", "Finding scripts...")
  local catalog, candidates, seen, discoveryErrors = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local function add(object, origin, detached)
    if seen[object] or not isInstance(object) then
      return
    end
    seen[object] = true
    local class = objectClass(object)
    local item = { instance = object, origin = origin, detached = detached }
    catalog[#catalog + 1] = item
    if SCRIPT_CLASSES[class] and allowed(object, detached) then
      item.path = objectPath(object)
      candidates[#candidates + 1] = item
    end
  end
  add(game, "game", false)
  local ok, descendants = pcall(function() return game:GetDescendants() end)
  if ok then
    for index, object in ipairs(descendants) do
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil, "Dump canceled"
      end
      add(object, "game:GetDescendants", false)
      if index % CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH == 0 then
        task.wait()
      end
    end
  else
    discoveryErrors[#discoveryErrors + 1] = "game:GetDescendants: " .. errorText(descendants)
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscripts", "getnilinstances", "getloadedmodules", "getinstances" }) do
    local api = lookup(name)
    if api then
      addDiscovery(api, add, discoveryErrors, token)
    end
  end
  status.total = #candidates
  emit(callbacks, "onProgress", 0, #candidates)
  local decompiler, disassembler = lookup("decompile"), lookup("disassemble")
  local closureReaders, readers = {}, {}
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscriptclosure", "getscriptfunction" }) do
    local fn = lookup(name)
    if fn then
      closureReaders[#closureReaders + 1] = { name = name, fn = fn }
    end
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscriptbytecode", "dumpstring" }) do
    local fn = lookup(name)
    if fn then
      readers[#readers + 1] = { name = name, fn = fn }
    end
  end
  local manifest, errors = {}, discoveryErrors
  local saved, failed, bytecodes, cacheHits = 0, 0, 0, 0
  local sourceCache, unresolved = {}, {}
  local folderByInstance, usedFolderNames = { [game] = "" }, { [""] = { _nilinstances = true } }
  local function folderFor(object)
    local chain, current = {}, safeProperty(object, "Parent")
    while isInstance(current) and current ~= game and folderByInstance[current] == nil and #chain < 200 do
      chain[#chain + 1] = current
      current = safeProperty(current, "Parent")
    end
    local folder = isInstance(current) and folderByInstance[current] or nil
    if folder == nil then
      folder = "_NilInstances"
    end
    for i = #chain, 1, -1 do
      local node = chain[i]
      local used = usedFolderNames[folder]
      if not used then
        used = {}
        usedFolderNames[folder] = used
      end
      local name = safeFilename(objectName(node))
      local candidate, suffix = name, 1
      while used[candidate:lower()] do
        suffix += 1
        candidate = name .. "__" .. suffix
      end
      used[candidate:lower()] = true
      folder = folder == "" and candidate or folder .. "/" .. candidate
      folderByInstance[node] = folder
    end
    return folder
  end
  local function concurrent(items, process, batchSize)
    batchSize = batchSize or CONFIG.SCRIPT_BATCH
    for first = 1, #items, batchSize do
      if token.cancelled then
        return false, "Dump canceled"
      end
      local pending, failure = 0, nil
      for index = first, math.min(#items, first + batchSize - 1) do
        local itemIndex, item = index, items[index]
        pending += 1
        task.defer(function()
          local ok, err = xpcall(function() process(itemIndex, item) end, function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end)
          if not ok then
            failure = failure or err
          end
          pending -= 1
        end)
      end
      repeat
        task.wait()
      until pending == 0
      if failure then
        return false, failure
      end
    end
    return not token.cancelled, token.cancelled and "Dump canceled" or nil
  end
  local processed = 0
  local function extract(index, item)
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local object, attempts = item.instance, {}
    local source, method, bytecode, closure
    local function attempt(label, fn, argument, validateSource)
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil
      end
      local success, value = callAPI(fn, argument)
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil
      end
      if not success then
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": error: " .. errorText(value)
        return nil
      end
      if type(value) ~= "string" or #value == 0 then
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": empty or invalid return (" .. type(value) .. ")"
        return nil
      end
      if validateSource then
        if not value:match("%S") then
          attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": empty source"
          return nil
        end
        local problem = sourceError(value)
        if problem then
          attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": " .. problem
          return nil
        end
      end
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": returned " .. #value .. " bytes"
      return value
    end
    do
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil, "Dump canceled"
      end
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "source attempt 1/" .. CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS
      local sourceOk, directSource = pcall(function() return object.Source end)
      if sourceOk and type(directSource) == "string" and directSource:match("%S") and not sourceError(directSource) then
        source, method = directSource, "Source"
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "Source: available"
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "Source: " .. (sourceOk and "empty or unavailable" or errorText(directSource))
      end
      if not bytecode and #readers > 0 then
        for _, reader in ipairs(readers) do
          bytecode = attempt(reader.name .. "(instance)", reader.fn, object, false)
          if bytecode then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not source and bytecode and sourceCache[bytecode] then
        source, method = sourceCache[bytecode], "cached bytecode"
        cacheHits += 1
      end
      if not source and decompiler then
        source = attempt("decompile(instance)", decompiler, object, true)
        if source then
          method = "decompile(instance)"
        end
      end
      if not source and bytecode and decompiler then
        source = attempt("decompile(bytecode)", decompiler, bytecode, true)
        if source then
          method = "decompile(bytecode)"
        end
      end
      if not source and decompiler then
        for _, reader in ipairs(closureReaders) do
          local success, value = callAPI(reader.fn, object)
          if success and type(value) == "function" then
            closure = value
            attempts[#attempts + 1] = reader.name .. ": function obtained"
            source = attempt("decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")", decompiler, closure, true)
            if source then
              method = "decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")"
              break
            end
          else
            attempts[#attempts + 1] = reader.name .. ": " .. (success and ("returned " .. type(value)) or errorText(value))
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if source and bytecode and not sourceCache[bytecode] then
      sourceCache[bytecode] = source
    end
    if not decompiler then
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "decompile: unavailable"
    end
    if #readers == 0 then
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "bytecode readers unavailable"
    end
    local folder = folderFor(object)
    local filename = ("%s__%s_%04d"):format(safeFilename(objectName(object)), objectClass(object), index)
    local stem = folder ~= "" and folder .. "/" .. filename or filename
    local bytecodeSaved = false
    if bytecode and CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
      local byteOk, byteError = save(base .. "/bytecode/" .. stem .. ".bin", bytecode)
      if byteOk then
        bytecodes += 1
        bytecodeSaved = true
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "save bytecode: " .. tostring(byteError)
      end
    end
    local context = line(safeProperty(object, "RunContext", "unavailable"))
    local header = table.concat({
      "-- SrcDump",
      "-- index: " .. index,
      "-- class: " .. objectClass(object),
      "-- path: " .. line(item.path),
      "-- discovered_by: " .. item.origin,
      "-- run_context: " .. context,
      "-- method: " .. tostring(method or "none"),
      "",
    }, "\n")
    local entry = {
      item = item,
      stem = stem,
      index = index,
      bytecode = bytecode,
      closure = closure,
      attempts = attempts,
      context = context,
      source = source,
      method = method,
      bytecodeSaved = bytecodeSaved,
    }

    if source then
      local savedOk, saveError = save(base .. "/scripts/" .. stem .. ".lua", header .. source .. "\n")
      if savedOk then
        saved += 1
        manifest[index] = "[OK] " .. line(item.path) .. " | " .. method .. " | scripts/" .. stem .. ".lua"
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "save source: " .. tostring(saveError)
        unresolved[#unresolved + 1] = entry
        failed += 1
        manifest[index] = "[PENDING] " .. line(item.path)
      end
    else
      unresolved[#unresolved + 1] = entry
      manifest[index] = "[PENDING] " .. line(item.path)
      failed += 1
    end
    processed += 1
    status.processed, status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = processed, saved, failed, bytecodes
    if processed == 1 or processed % CONFIG.PROGRESS_EVERY == 0 then
      emit(callbacks, "onProgress", processed, #candidates, item.path)
    end
  end
  local extracted, extractError = concurrent(candidates, extract)
  if not extracted then
    return nil, extractError
  end
  local collection
  pcall(function() collection = game:GetService("CollectionService") end)
  emit(callbacks, "onStatus", "Saving game data...")
  local tree = { "SrcDump - instances", "", "" }
  local remotes = { "SrcDump - remotes and bindables", "" }
  local remoteCount, instanceCount = 0, 0
  for index, item in ipairs(catalog) do
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local object = item.instance
    if allowed(object, item.detached) then
      local class = objectClass(object)
      local detail = ("[%s] %s | discovered=%s | attributes=%s | tags=%s"):format(
        class,
        line(item.path or objectPath(object)),
        item.origin,
        attributes(object),
        tags(object, collection)
      )
      instanceCount += 1
      tree[#tree + 1] = detail
      if REMOTE_CLASSES[class] then
        remoteCount += 1
        remotes[#remotes + 1] = detail
      end
    end
    if index % CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH == 0 then
      task.wait()
    end
  end
  tree[2] = "total=" .. instanceCount
  remotes[2] = "total=" .. remoteCount
  local treeOk, treeError = save(base .. "/tree.txt", table.concat(tree, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not treeOk then
    return nil, "cannot save tree.txt: " .. tostring(treeError)
  end
  local remoteOk, remoteError = save(base .. "/remotes/remotes.txt", table.concat(remotes, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not remoteOk then
    return nil, "cannot save remotes.txt: " .. tostring(remoteError)
  end
  local info = {
    "SrcDump - game information",
    "place_id=" .. tostring(game.PlaceId),
    "game_id=" .. tostring(game.GameId),
    "job_id=" .. tostring(game.JobId),
    "game_name=" .. line(gameName),
    "creator_id=" .. tostring(game.CreatorId),
    "creator_type=" .. tostring(game.CreatorType),
    "place_version=" .. tostring(game.PlaceVersion),
    "instances=" .. instanceCount,
    "scripts=" .. #candidates,
    "remotes=" .. remoteCount,
  }

  info[#info + 1] = "product_name=" .. line(gameName)
  local infoOk, infoError = save(base .. "/game_info.txt", table.concat(info, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not infoOk then
    return nil, "cannot save game_info.txt: " .. tostring(infoError)
  end
  local function retrySource(_, entry, round)
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local recovered = entry.source or (entry.bytecode and sourceCache[entry.bytecode])
    local recoveredMethod = entry.method or (recovered and "cached bytecode (later match)" or nil)
    if recovered and not entry.source then
      cacheHits += 1
    end
    entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = "source/save attempt " .. round .. "/" .. CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS
    if not recovered and not token.cancelled and os.clock() < retryDeadline then
      local object = entry.item.instance
      local sourceOk, source = pcall(function() return object.Source end)
      if sourceOk and type(source) == "string" and source:match("%S") and not sourceError(source) then
        recovered, recoveredMethod = source, "Source (retry)"
      end
      if not recovered then
        for _, reader in ipairs(readers) do
          local ok, value = callAPI(reader.fn, object)
          if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 then
            entry.bytecode = value
            if CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
              local byteOk, byteError = save(base .. "/bytecode/" .. entry.stem .. ".bin", value)
              if byteOk then
                if not entry.bytecodeSaved then
                  bytecodes += 1
                  entry.bytecodeSaved = true
                end
              else
                entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = "save bytecode: " .. tostring(byteError)
              end
            end
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not recovered and entry.bytecode and sourceCache[entry.bytecode] then
        recovered, recoveredMethod = sourceCache[entry.bytecode], "cached bytecode (retry)"
        cacheHits += 1
      end
      local function tryDecompile(argument, label)
        if recovered or not decompiler or token.cancelled then
          return
        end
        local ok, value = callAPI(decompiler, argument)
        if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and value:match("%S") and not sourceError(value) then
          recovered, recoveredMethod = value, label .. " (retry)"
        else
          entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = label .. ": " .. (ok and errorText(value) or "error: " .. errorText(value))
        end
      end
      tryDecompile(object, "decompile(instance)")
      if entry.bytecode then
        tryDecompile(entry.bytecode, "decompile(bytecode)")
      end
      if not recovered then
        for _, reader in ipairs(closureReaders) do
          local ok, closure = callAPI(reader.fn, object)
          if ok and type(closure) == "function" then
            tryDecompile(closure, "decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")")
          end
          if recovered or token.cancelled then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if recovered and entry.bytecode then
        sourceCache[entry.bytecode] = recovered
      end
    end
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    if recovered then
      entry.source, entry.method = recovered, recoveredMethod
      local header = table.concat({
        "-- SrcDump",
        "-- index: " .. entry.index,
        "-- class: " .. objectClass(entry.item.instance),
        "-- path: " .. line(entry.item.path),
        "-- discovered_by: " .. entry.item.origin,
        "-- run_context: " .. entry.context,
        "-- method: " .. recoveredMethod,
        "",
      }, "\n")
      local ok, err = save(base .. "/scripts/" .. entry.stem .. ".lua", header .. recovered .. "\n")
      if ok then
        saved += 1
        failed -= 1
        entry.saved = true
        manifest[entry.index] = "[OK] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | " .. recoveredMethod .. " | scripts/" .. entry.stem .. ".lua"
      else
        entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = "save source: " .. tostring(err)
      end
    end
    status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = saved, failed, bytecodes
  end
  local initialFailed, retryRounds = #unresolved, 0
  status.initialFailed, status.recovered, status.retryRound = initialFailed, 0, 0
  retryDeadline = os.clock() + CONFIG.RETRY_TIME_BUDGET
  for round = 2, CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS do
    if #unresolved == 0 or token.cancelled or os.clock() >= retryDeadline then
      break
    end
    local delayUntil = math.min(retryDeadline, os.clock() + math.min(CONFIG.RETRY_MAX_DELAY, CONFIG.RETRY_DELAY * (round - 1)))
    while not token.cancelled and os.clock() < delayUntil do
      task.wait(math.min(0.1, delayUntil - os.clock()))
    end
    if token.cancelled or os.clock() >= retryDeadline then
      break
    end
    retryRounds = round - 1
    status.retryRound = retryRounds
    emit(callbacks, "onStatus", ("Retry %d/%d: %d scripts remaining..."):format(retryRounds, CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS - 1, #unresolved))
    local retried, retryError = concurrent(unresolved, function(index, entry) retrySource(index, entry, round) end, CONFIG.RETRY_BATCH)
    if not retried then
      return nil, retryError
    end
    local remaining = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(unresolved) do
      if not entry.saved then
        remaining[#remaining + 1] = entry
      end
    end
    unresolved = remaining
    status.recovered = initialFailed - #unresolved
  end
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local function finalizeFailure(_, entry)
    if entry.source then
      manifest[entry.index] = "[ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | write failed"
      errors[#errors + 1] = "[WRITE_ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. "\n  " .. table.concat(entry.attempts, "\n  ")
    else
      if CONFIG.SAVE_DISASSEMBLY and disassembler then
        local function disassemble(argument)
          local ok, value = callAPI(disassembler, argument)
          if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and not sourceError(value) then
            return value
          end
          return nil
        end
        local assembly = disassemble(entry.item.instance)
        if not assembly and entry.bytecode then
          assembly = disassemble(entry.bytecode)
        end
        if not assembly and entry.closure then
          assembly = disassemble(entry.closure)
        end
        if assembly then
          save(base .. "/disassembly/" .. entry.stem .. ".txt", assembly .. "\n")
        end
      end
      local category = entry.bytecode and "bytecode available; source unavailable" or "bytecode unavailable to client"
      errors[#errors + 1] = "[SOURCE_ERROR] "
        .. line(entry.item.path)
        .. " | "
        .. objectClass(entry.item.instance)
        .. " | "
        .. category
        .. "\n  "
        .. table.concat(entry.attempts, "\n  ")
      manifest[entry.index] = "[ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | " .. category
    end
    status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = saved, failed, bytecodes
  end
  local retried, retryError = concurrent(unresolved, finalizeFailure, CONFIG.RETRY_BATCH)
  if not retried then
    return nil, retryError
  end
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  status.saved, status.failed = saved, failed
  local manifestOk, manifestError = save(base .. "/manifest.txt", table.concat(manifest, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not manifestOk then
    return nil, "cannot save manifest.txt: " .. tostring(manifestError)
  end
  local errorsOk, errorsError = save(base .. "/errors.txt", #errors > 0 and table.concat(errors, "\n\n") .. "\n" or "No errors.\n")
  if not errorsOk then
    return nil, "cannot save errors.txt: " .. tostring(errorsError)
  end
  local summaryOk, summaryError = save(
    base .. "/summary.txt",
    table.concat({
      "SrcDump",
      "folder=" .. base,
      "game_name=" .. line(gameName),
      "total_found=" .. #candidates,
      "decompiled_and_saved=" .. saved,
      "failed=" .. failed,
      "initial_failed=" .. initialFailed,
      "recovered_on_retry=" .. (initialFailed - failed),
      "retry_rounds=" .. retryRounds,
      "max_source_attempts=" .. CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS,
      "retry_budget_exhausted=" .. tostring(failed > 0 and os.clock() >= retryDeadline),
      "bytecode_saved=" .. bytecodes,
      "source_cache_hits=" .. cacheHits,
      "instances=" .. instanceCount,
      "remotes=" .. remoteCount,
      "note=Only content accessible to the client environment can be captured.",
      "",
    }, "\n")
  )
  if not summaryOk then
    return nil, "cannot save summary.txt: " .. tostring(summaryError)
  end
  log(("Finished: %d saved, %d failed (%d recovered on retry). Folder: %s"):format(saved, failed, initialFailed - failed, base))
  return {
    folder = base,
    total = #candidates,
    saved = saved,
    failed = failed,
    bytecode = bytecodes,
    initialFailed = initialFailed,
    recovered = initialFailed - failed,
    retryRounds = retryRounds,
  }
end

-- lifecycle
function Dumper.setup()
  Dumper.stop()
  return true
end
function Dumper.start(callbacks)
  if activeToken then
    return false, "A dump is already running"
  end
  if type(callbacks) ~= "table" then
    callbacks = {}
  end
  local token = { cancelled = false }
  activeToken, activeCallbacks = token, callbacks
  status = {
    running = true,
    startedAt = os.clock(),
    folder = nil,
    total = 0,
    processed = 0,
    saved = 0,
    failed = 0,
    bytecode = 0,
  }

  token.status = status
  task.spawn(function()
    local ok, result, reason = xpcall(
      function() return run(token, callbacks) end,
      function(errorValue) return debug and type(debug.traceback) == "function" and debug.traceback(tostring(errorValue), 2) or tostring(errorValue) end
    )
    if activeToken ~= token then
      return
    end
    local callbacks = activeCallbacks
    activeToken, activeCallbacks = nil, nil
    status.running = false
    if token.cancelled then
      emit(callbacks, "onCanceled")
      return
    end
    if not ok or not result then
      local message = not ok and result or reason or "Dump failed"
      emit(callbacks, "onError", message)
      return
    end
    status.folder = result.folder
    status.total, status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = result.total, result.saved, result.failed, result.bytecode
    emit(callbacks, "onComplete", table.clone(result))
  end)
  return true
end
function Dumper.stop()
  status.running = false
  if activeToken then
    local callbacks = activeCallbacks
    activeToken.cancelled = true
    activeToken, activeCallbacks = nil, nil
    emit(callbacks, "onCanceled")
    log("Dump canceled.")
  end
  return true
end
function Dumper.isRunning() return activeToken ~= nil end
function Dumper.getStatus() return table.clone(status) end
function Dumper.teardown() return Dumper.stop() end

-- contract
Dumper.__contract = {
  access = { default = "tooling.execute" },
  requires = {},
  provides = { "setup", "start", "stop", "isRunning", "getStatus", "teardown" },
}

return Dumper
sources.universal/fly.luau:
-- [[ fly ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules fly

local Fly = {}
local utils, controller, activation
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local enabled, generation = false, 0
local character, humanoid, root, velocity, gyro, saved
local attachThread, pendingCharacter, controlsThread, controlModule, controlSource
local retryAt, controlRetryAt, lastErrorAt = 0, 0, -math.huge
local pressed = {}
local directionKeys = { Forward = 0, Backward = 0, Left = 0, Right = 0, Up = 0, Down = 0 }
local bindings = {
  [Enum.KeyCode.W] = { "Forward", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.S] = { "Backward", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.A] = { "Left", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.D] = { "Right", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.E] = { "Up", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.Q] = { "Down", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.Space] = { "Up", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = { "Down", -1 },
}
local CONFIG = {
  persistent = { UniversalFly = false },
  schema = { UniversalFly = "boolean", UniversalFlySpeed = "rate" },
  defaults = { UniversalFly = false, UniversalFlySpeed = 1 },
}
local function clearControls()
  table.clear(pressed)
  for key in pairs(directionKeys) do
    directionKeys[key] = 0
  end
end
local function destroy(object)
  if object then
    pcall(object.Destroy, object)
  end
end
local function cancelAttach()
  local thread = attachThread
  attachThread, pendingCharacter = nil, nil
  if thread then
    pcall(task.cancel, thread)
  end
end
local function detach()
  destroy(velocity)
  destroy(gyro)
  if root and root.Parent then
    pcall(function()
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
      root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
  end
  if humanoid and humanoid.Parent and saved then
    pcall(function()
      humanoid.PlatformStand = saved.PlatformStand
      humanoid.AutoRotate = saved.AutoRotate
    end)
  end
  character, humanoid, root, velocity, gyro, saved = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end
local function report(reason)
  if utils and os.clock() - lastErrorAt >= 5 then
    lastErrorAt = os.clock()
    utils.recordError("Fly", tostring(reason))
  end
end
local function attach(model, human, part)
  detach()
  character, humanoid, root = model, human, part
  saved = { PlatformStand = human.PlatformStand, AutoRotate = human.AutoRotate }
  destroy(part:FindFirstChild("ExodusFlyVelocity"))
  destroy(part:FindFirstChild("ExodusFlyGyro"))
  velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
  velocity.Name = "ExodusFlyVelocity"
  velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
  velocity.P = 9e4
  velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
  velocity.Parent = part
  gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
  gyro.Name = "ExodusFlyGyro"
  gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
  gyro.P, gyro.D = 9e4, 1000
  gyro.CFrame = part.CFrame
  gyro.Parent = part
  human.PlatformStand, human.AutoRotate = true, false
end
local function queueAttach(model)
  if not enabled or not model or not activation or not activation.alive or pendingCharacter == model and attachThread then
    return
  end
  generation += 1
  local token, owner = generation, activation
  cancelAttach()
  pendingCharacter = model
  local thread
  thread = task.defer(function()
    local part = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    local human = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or model:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    if attachThread == thread then
      attachThread, pendingCharacter = nil, nil
    end
    if not enabled or not owner.alive or generation ~= token or utils.getLocalPlayer().Character ~= model then
      return
    end
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not human or not human:IsA("Humanoid") or human.Health <= 0 then
      return
    end
    local ok, reason = pcall(attach, model, human, part)
    if not ok then
      detach()
      retryAt = os.clock() + 0.5
      report(reason)
    end
  end)
  attachThread = thread
end
local function loadControls()
  if controlsThread or os.clock() < controlRetryAt or not activation or not activation.alive then
    return
  end
  if controlModule and controlSource and controlSource.Parent then
    return
  end
  controlModule, controlSource = nil, nil
  controlRetryAt = os.clock() + 0.5
  local owner = activation
  local thread
  thread = task.defer(function()
    local player = utils and utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local scripts = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local module = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
    local source = module and module:FindFirstChild("ControlModule")
    local ok, result = false, nil
    if source and source:IsA("ModuleScript") then
      ok, result = pcall(require, source)
    elseif module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
      source = module
      local ready, api = pcall(require, module)
      if ready and type(api) == "table" and type(api.GetControls) == "function" then
        ok, result = pcall(api.GetControls, api)
      end
    end
    if controlsThread == thread then
      controlsThread = nil
    end
    if owner.alive and activation == owner and ok and source and source.Parent and type(result) == "table" and type(result.GetMoveVector) == "function" then
      controlModule, controlSource = result, source
    end
  end)
  controlsThread = thread
end
local function direction(camera)
  if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
    clearControls()
    return Vector3.zero
  end
  local vertical = Vector3.new(0, directionKeys.Up + directionKeys.Down, 0)
  if UIS.TouchEnabled or UIS.GamepadEnabled then
    loadControls()
    if controlModule then
      local ok, move = pcall(controlModule.GetMoveVector, controlModule)
      if ok and typeof(move) == "Vector3" then
        return camera.CFrame.RightVector * move.X - camera.CFrame.LookVector * move.Z + vertical
      end
      controlModule, controlSource = nil, nil
    end
    if humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
      return humanoid.MoveDirection + vertical
    end
  end
  return camera.CFrame.LookVector * (directionKeys.Forward + directionKeys.Backward)
    + camera.CFrame.RightVector * (directionKeys.Left + directionKeys.Right)
    + vertical
end
local function update()
  if not enabled or not utils then
    return
  end
  local model = utils.getLocalPlayer().Character
  if
    model ~= character
    or not root
    or root.Parent ~= model
    or not humanoid
    or humanoid.Parent ~= model
    or humanoid.Health <= 0
    or not velocity
    or not velocity.Parent
    or not gyro
    or not gyro.Parent
  then
    detach()
    if model and not attachThread and os.clock() >= retryAt then
      local human = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not human or human.Health > 0 then
        queueAttach(model)
      end
    end
    return
  end
  local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not camera then
    velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    return
  end
  local move = direction(camera)
  if move.Magnitude > 1 then
    move = move.Unit
  end
  local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(utils.getConfigValue("UniversalFlySpeed")) or 1, 0.1, 10)
  velocity.Velocity = move * speed * 50
  gyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
  if not humanoid.PlatformStand then
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
  end
  if humanoid.AutoRotate then
    humanoid.AutoRotate = false
  end
end
local function stop()
  enabled = false
  generation += 1
  cancelAttach()
  local thread = controlsThread
  controlsThread = nil
  if thread then
    pcall(task.cancel, thread)
  end
  detach()
  clearControls()
  activation, controlModule, controlSource = nil, nil, nil
end
function Fly.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Fly.setValue(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setValue(value)
end
function Fly.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  stop()
  utils = nil
  return true
end
function Fly.setup(deps)
  Fly.teardown()
  utils = deps.Utils
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalFly",
    valueKey = "UniversalFlySpeed",
    min = 0.1,
    max = 10,
    start = function(scope)
      activation, enabled = scope, true
      retryAt, controlRetryAt = 0, 0
      scope.connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        local binding = bindings[input.KeyCode]
        if not processed and binding then
          pressed[input.KeyCode] = true
          directionKeys[binding[1]] = binding[2]
        end
      end)
      scope.connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
        local binding = bindings[input.KeyCode]
        if binding then
          pressed[input.KeyCode] = nil
          directionKeys[binding[1]] = 0
          for key in pairs(pressed) do
            local held = bindings[key]
            if held and held[1] == binding[1] then
              directionKeys[held[1]] = held[2]
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      scope.connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased, clearControls)
      local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
      scope.connect(player.CharacterAdded, queueAttach)
      scope.connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function(model)
        generation += 1
        cancelAttach()
        if model == character then
          detach()
        end
        clearControls()
      end)
      deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, function()
        local ok, reason = pcall(update)
        if not ok then
          detach()
          retryAt = os.clock() + 0.5
          report(reason)
        end
      end)
      queueAttach(player.Character)
      loadControls()
    end,
    stop = stop,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Fly.__config = CONFIG
Fly.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setValue" },
}
return Fly

-- [[ infinitejump ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules infinitejump

local InfiniteJump = {}

local Utils
local hub
local controller
local requested = false

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  persistent = { UniversalInfiniteJump = false },
  schema = { UniversalInfiniteJump = "boolean" },
  defaults = { UniversalInfiniteJump = false },
}

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local states = { InfiniteJump = false }
local connectionPool
local function disconnect(name)
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.disconnect(name)
  end
end
local function connect(name, signal, callback) return connectionPool.connect(name, signal, callback) end
local jumpButton
local lastJump = 0
local function jumpInAir()
  if not Utils or not states.InfiniteJump or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
    requested = false
    return
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit then
    requested = false
    return
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  if now - lastJump < 0.05 then
    return
  end
  requested = false
  lastJump = now
  humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
end
local function requestJump() requested = true end
local function attachJumpButton()
  if not Utils or not states.InfiniteJump then
    return
  end
  local button = hub.getJumpButton()
  if not button then
    local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local touch = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    local frame = touch and touch:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
    button = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
  end
  if button == jumpButton then
    return
  end
  disconnect("GameJump")
  jumpButton = button
  if button and button:IsA("GuiButton") then
    connect("GameJump", button.MouseButton1Down, requestJump)
  end
end
local function startInfiniteJump()
  requested = false
  lastJump = 0
  connect("InfiniteJump", UIS.JumpRequest, requestJump)
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  if gui then
    local queued = false
    connect("JumpGuiAdded", gui.DescendantAdded, function()
      if queued then
        return
      end
      queued = true
      task.defer(function()
        queued = false
        attachJumpButton()
      end)
    end)
    connect("JumpGuiRemoving", gui.DescendantRemoving, function(object)
      if object == jumpButton then
        disconnect("GameJump")
        jumpButton = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  attachJumpButton()
  return true
end
local function stopInfiniteJump()
  disconnect("InfiniteJump")
  disconnect("GameJump")
  disconnect("JumpGuiAdded")
  disconnect("JumpGuiRemoving")
  jumpButton = nil
  return true
end
function InfiniteJump.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function InfiniteJump.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  stopInfiniteJump()
  states.InfiniteJump = false
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.destroy()
    connectionPool = nil
  end
  Utils, hub = nil, nil
  return true
end
function InfiniteJump.setup(deps)
  InfiniteJump.teardown()
  Utils, hub = deps.Utils, deps.Hub
  connectionPool = deps.Lifetime.connections(Utils)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(Utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalInfiniteJump",
    start = function(scope)
      states.InfiniteJump = true
      deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, function()
        if requested then
          jumpInAir()
        end
      end)
      assert(startInfiniteJump())
    end,
    stop = function()
      requested = false
      states.InfiniteJump = false
      stopInfiniteJump()
    end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
InfiniteJump.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
InfiniteJump.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Hub = "hubapi", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Hub = { "getJumpButton" },
    Lifetime = { "connections", "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
}

return InfiniteJump

-- [[ invisicam ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules invisicam

local Invisicam = {}
local controller, assist
local CONFIG = { persistent = { UniversalInvisicam = false }, schema = { UniversalInvisicam = "boolean" }, defaults = { UniversalInvisicam = false } }
local function create(utils, connectPhysics)
  local Player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
  local Runtime = { ShuttingDown = false }
  local CameraAssist = {
    Enabled = false,
    Sources = {},
    Connection = nil,
    RaycastParams = nil,
    OverlapParams = nil,
    SavedOcclusionMode = nil,
    OcclusionModeManaged = false,
    OriginalLocalTransparency = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    CurrentOccluders = {},
    OccluderTransparency = 0.82,
    CheckInterval = 0.1,
    LastCheckAt = -math.huge,
    LastCamera = nil,
    LastCharacter = nil,
    LastWarningAt = -math.huge,
  }

  local OCCLUSION_MODE = Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam

  -- diagnostics
  function CameraAssist:_Warn(message)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - self.LastWarningAt < 5 then
      return
    end
    self.LastWarningAt = now
    utils.recordError("Invisicam", message)
  end

  -- visibility
  function CameraAssist:_FadeOccluder(part)
    if self.OcclusionModeManaged or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
      return
    end
    if self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] == nil then
      local readOk, original = pcall(function() return part.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
      if not readOk then
        return
      end
      self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] = original
    end
    self.CurrentOccluders[part] = true
    pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = self.OccluderTransparency end)
  end
  function CameraAssist:_IsOccluder(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
      return false
    end
    local ok, transparency, localTransparency = pcall(function() return part.Transparency, part.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
    return ok and transparency < 0.98 and localTransparency < 0.98
  end
  function CameraAssist:_RestoreUnusedOccluders()
    for part, original in pairs(self.OriginalLocalTransparency) do
      if not self.CurrentOccluders[part] then
        if part.Parent then
          pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = original end)
        end
        self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] = nil
      end
    end
  end
  function CameraAssist:_RestoreAllOccluders()
    for part, original in pairs(self.OriginalLocalTransparency) do
      if part.Parent then
        pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = original end)
      end
      self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] = nil
    end
    table.clear(self.CurrentOccluders)
  end
  function CameraAssist:_TracePath(origin, targetPosition, excludedParts, excludedInstances)
    local direction = targetPosition - origin
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
      return false
    end
    local occluded = false
    for _ = 1, 16 do
      self.RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludedInstances
      local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, self.RaycastParams)
      if not result then
        return occluded
      end
      local instance = result.Instance
      if instance == Workspace.Terrain then
        return true
      end
      if not instance:IsA("BasePart") or excludedParts[instance] then
        return occluded
      end
      if self:_IsOccluder(instance) then
        occluded = true
        self:_FadeOccluder(instance)
      end
      excludedParts[instance] = true
      table.insert(excludedInstances, instance)
    end
    return occluded
  end
  local function getBodySamples(part)
    local size = part.Size
    local axes = {
      { Size = size.X, Vector = part.CFrame.RightVector },
      { Size = size.Y, Vector = part.CFrame.UpVector },
      { Size = size.Z, Vector = part.CFrame.LookVector },
    }

    table.sort(axes, function(left, right) return left.Size > right.Size end)
    local samples = { part.Position }
    for index = 1, math.min(2, #axes) do
      local offset = axes[index].Vector * axes[index].Size * 0.42
      table.insert(samples, part.Position + offset)
      table.insert(samples, part.Position - offset)
    end
    return samples
  end
  function CameraAssist:_UpdateOccluders(camera, character, humanoid, root)
    local cameraPosition = camera.CFrame.Position
    table.clear(self.CurrentOccluders)
    local excludedParts = { [character] = true }
    local excludedInstances = { character }
    self.RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludedInstances
    self.OverlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludedInstances
    local insideParts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(cameraPosition), Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08), self.OverlapParams)
    for _, part in ipairs(insideParts) do
      if self:_IsOccluder(part) then
        self:_FadeOccluder(part)
        if not excludedParts[part] then
          excludedParts[part] = true
          table.insert(excludedInstances, part)
        end
      end
    end
    local targets = {}
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
      if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= root and part.Transparency < 1 then
        table.insert(targets, part)
      end
    end
    if #targets == 0 then
      self:_RestoreUnusedOccluders()
      return
    end
    if humanoid.Health > 0 then
      for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
        for _, sample in ipairs(getBodySamples(target)) do
          local pathExcludedParts = {}
          local pathExcludedInstances = {}
          for _, instance in ipairs(excludedInstances) do
            pathExcludedParts[instance] = true
            table.insert(pathExcludedInstances, instance)
          end
          self:_TracePath(cameraPosition, sample, pathExcludedParts, pathExcludedInstances)
        end
      end
    end
    self:_RestoreUnusedOccluders()
  end
  function CameraAssist:_Update()
    if not self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if self.OcclusionModeManaged then
      local modeOk, currentMode = pcall(function() return Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode end)
      if modeOk and currentMode ~= OCCLUSION_MODE then
        local setOk = pcall(function() Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = OCCLUSION_MODE end)
        if not setOk then
          self.OcclusionModeManaged = false
        end
      end
    end
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not camera or not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
      self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
      return
    end
    if self.LastCamera ~= camera or self.LastCharacter ~= character then
      self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
      self.LastCamera, self.LastCharacter = camera, character
      self.LastCheckAt = -math.huge
    end
    if self.OcclusionModeManaged then
      self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
      return
    end
    for part in pairs(self.OriginalLocalTransparency) do
      if part.Parent then
        pcall(function()
          if part.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= self.OccluderTransparency then
            part.LocalTransparencyModifier = self.OccluderTransparency
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    if now - self.LastCheckAt < self.CheckInterval then
      return
    end
    self.LastCheckAt = now
    local ok, updateError = pcall(function() self:_UpdateOccluders(camera, character, humanoid, root) end)
    if not ok then
      self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
      self:_Warn("não foi possível atualizar a transparência da câmera: " .. tostring(updateError))
    end
  end

  -- lifecycle
  function CameraAssist:_HasActiveSource()
    for _, active in pairs(self.Sources) do
      if active then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function CameraAssist:_Activate()
    if self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    self.Enabled = true
    self.LastCheckAt = -math.huge
    local readOk, originalMode = pcall(function() return Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode end)
    if readOk then
      local setOk, setError = pcall(function() Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = OCCLUSION_MODE end)
      if setOk then
        self.SavedOcclusionMode = originalMode
        self.OcclusionModeManaged = true
      else
        self:_Warn("o modo Invisicam não pôde ser ativado: " .. tostring(setError))
      end
    end
    local setupOk, setupError = pcall(function()
      local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
      raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
      local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
      overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
      overlapParams.MaxParts = 32
      self.RaycastParams = raycastParams
      self.OverlapParams = overlapParams
      local updateScope = self.Scope.child()
      self.Connection = { Disconnect = updateScope.destroy }
      connectPhysics(updateScope, function()
        local updateOk, updateError = pcall(function() self:_Update() end)
        if not updateOk then
          self:_Warn("erro ao atualizar a câmera: " .. tostring(updateError))
        end
      end)
    end)
    if not setupOk then
      self:_Deactivate()
      self:_Warn("não foi possível iniciar a assistência da câmera: " .. tostring(setupError))
    end
  end
  function CameraAssist:_Deactivate()
    self.Enabled = false
    if self.Connection then
      pcall(function() self.Connection:Disconnect() end)
      self.Connection = nil
    end
    if self.OcclusionModeManaged then
      pcall(function() Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = self.SavedOcclusionMode end)
    end
    self.SavedOcclusionMode = nil
    self.LastCamera, self.LastCharacter = nil, nil
    self.OcclusionModeManaged = false
    self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
    self.RaycastParams = nil
    self.OverlapParams = nil
  end
  function CameraAssist:Shutdown()
    table.clear(self.Sources)
    self:_Deactivate()
  end

  return CameraAssist
end
function Invisicam.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  if value ~= true and assist then
    table.clear(assist.Sources)
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Invisicam.setSource(source, enabled)
  if not controller or type(source) ~= "string" or source == "" then
    return false
  end
  assist.Sources[source] = enabled == true and true or nil
  return controller.sync()
end
function Invisicam.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  if assist then
    assist:Shutdown()
    assist = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Invisicam.setup(deps)
  Invisicam.teardown()
  local utils = deps.Utils
  assist = create(utils, deps.Controller.connectPhysics)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalInvisicam",
    isEnabled = function() return utils.getConfigValue("UniversalInvisicam") == true or assist:_HasActiveSource() end,
    start = function(scope)
      assist.Scope = scope
      assist:_Activate()
      return assist.Enabled
    end,
    stop = function() assist:_Deactivate() end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Invisicam.__config = CONFIG
Invisicam.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { setSource = "world.write" } },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setSource" },
}
return Invisicam

-- [[ jump power ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules jumppower

local JumpPower = {}
local controller, binding
local CONFIG = {
  persistent = { UniversalJumpPowerEnabled = false },
  schema = { UniversalJumpPowerEnabled = "boolean", UniversalJumpPower = "rate" },
  defaults = { UniversalJumpPowerEnabled = false },
  resolveDefaults = function(context)
    local player = context and context.player or game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local character = player and player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local starter = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")
    local power = humanoid and humanoid.JumpPower or starter.CharacterJumpPower
    local usePower = humanoid and humanoid.UseJumpPower
    if not humanoid then
      usePower = starter.CharacterUseJumpPower
    end
    if usePower == false then
      local height = humanoid and humanoid.JumpHeight or starter.CharacterJumpHeight
      power = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 2 * workspace.Gravity * height))
    end
    return { UniversalJumpPower = type(power) == "number" and power or 50 }
  end,
}
function JumpPower.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function JumpPower.setValue(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setValue(value)
end
function JumpPower.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  if binding then
    binding.restore()
    binding = nil
  end
  return true
end
function JumpPower.setup(deps)
  JumpPower.teardown()
  local utils = deps.Utils
  binding = deps.Properties.create(utils, function(humanoid, originals)
    local value = math.clamp(tonumber(utils.getConfigValue("UniversalJumpPower")) or 50, 0, 300)
    local usePower = originals.UseJumpPower
    if usePower == nil then
      usePower = humanoid.UseJumpPower
    end
    if usePower then
      return { JumpPower = value }
    end
    local gravity = game:GetService("Workspace").Gravity
    if gravity <= 0 then
      return { UseJumpPower = true, JumpPower = value }
    end
    return { JumpHeight = value * value / (2 * gravity) }
  end)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalJumpPowerEnabled",
    valueKey = "UniversalJumpPower",
    min = 0,
    max = 300,
    start = function(scope) deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, binding.update) end,
    stop = binding.restore,
    update = binding.update,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
JumpPower.__config = CONFIG
JumpPower.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller", Properties = "characterproperties" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },

}

-- [[ no fog ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules nofog

local NoFog = {}
local controller, binding
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CONFIG = { schema = { UniversalNoFog = "boolean" }, defaults = { UniversalNoFog = false } }
function NoFog.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function NoFog.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  if binding then
    binding.restore()
    binding = nil
  end
  return true
end
function NoFog.setup(deps)
  NoFog.teardown()
  local fogValues = { FogStart = 0, FogEnd = 1000000 }
  local atmosphereValues = { Density = 0, Haze = 0 }
  binding = deps.Binding.create(function() return Lighting end, function() return fogValues end)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(deps.Utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalNoFog",
    start = function(scope)
      local atmospheres = {}
      local function remove(object)
        local entry = atmospheres[object]
        if entry then
          entry.restore()
          atmospheres[object] = nil
        end
      end
      local function add(object)
        if not object:IsA("Atmosphere") or atmospheres[object] then
          return
        end
        local entry = deps.Binding.create(function() return object.Parent == Lighting and object or nil end, function() return atmosphereValues end)
        atmospheres[object] = entry
        entry.update()
      end
      scope.add(function()
        for _, entry in pairs(atmospheres) do
          entry.restore()
        end
        table.clear(atmospheres)
      end)
      scope.connect(Lighting.ChildAdded, add)
      scope.connect(Lighting.ChildRemoved, remove)
      for _, object in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        add(object)
      end
      deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, function()
        binding.update()
        for _, entry in pairs(atmospheres) do
          entry.update()
        end
      end)
    end,
    stop = binding.restore,
    update = binding.update,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
NoFog.__config = CONFIG
NoFog.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller", Binding = "propertybinding" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
    Binding = { "create" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
}
return NoFog

-- [[ noclip ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules noclip

local Noclip = {}
local controller, rootScope, physicsScope, bindingScope
local utils, lifetime, scheduler, player, character
local owners, parts = {}, {}
local CONFIG = { persistent = { UniversalNoclip = false }, schema = { UniversalNoclip = "boolean" }, defaults = { UniversalNoclip = false } }

local function restorePart(part)
  local entry = parts[part]
  if not entry then
    return
  end
  parts[part] = nil
  entry.scope.destroy()
  if part.Parent then
    pcall(function() part.CanCollide = entry.original end)
  end
end
local function restoreCharacter()
  if bindingScope then
    bindingScope.destroy()
    bindingScope = nil
  end
  character = nil
  for part in pairs(parts) do
    restorePart(part)
  end
end
local function enforce(part, entry)
  if parts[part] ~= entry or not character or not part:IsDescendantOf(character) then
    return
  end
  if part.CanCollide then
    part.CanCollide = false
  end
end
local function watchPart(part)
  if not part:IsA("BasePart") or parts[part] then
    return
  end
  local entry = { original = part.CanCollide, scope = bindingScope.child() }
  parts[part] = entry
  entry.scope.connect(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"), function() enforce(part, entry) end)
  enforce(part, entry)
end
local function bindCharacter(nextCharacter)
  if character == nextCharacter then
    return
  end
  restoreCharacter()
  if not nextCharacter then
    return
  end
  character, bindingScope = nextCharacter, rootScope.child()
  bindingScope.connect(character.DescendantAdded, watchPart)
  bindingScope.connect(character.DescendantRemoving, restorePart)
  for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
    watchPart(part)
  end
end
local function step()
  if not next(owners) then
    return
  end
  local current = player and player.Character
  if current and not current.Parent then
    current = nil
  end
  bindCharacter(current)
  for part, entry in pairs(parts) do
    if not part.Parent or not character or not part:IsDescendantOf(character) then
      restorePart(part)
    else
      enforce(part, entry)
    end
  end
end
local function stopPhysics()
  if physicsScope then
    physicsScope.destroy()
    physicsScope = nil
  end
  restoreCharacter()
end
function Noclip.isEnabled() return next(owners) ~= nil end
function Noclip.acquire(owner)
  if owner == nil or not rootScope or not rootScope.alive then
    return false
  end
  owners[owner] = true
  if not physicsScope then
    physicsScope = rootScope.child()
    scheduler.connectPhysics(physicsScope, step)
  end
  step()
  return true
end
function Noclip.release(owner)
  if owner ~= nil then
    owners[owner] = nil
  end
  if not next(owners) then
    stopPhysics()
  end
  return true
end
function Noclip.setEnabled(value)
  if value ~= true then
    table.clear(owners)
    stopPhysics()
  end
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Noclip.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  table.clear(owners)
  stopPhysics()
  if rootScope then
    rootScope.destroy()
    rootScope = nil
  end
  utils, lifetime, scheduler, player = nil, nil, nil, nil
  return true
end
function Noclip.setup(deps)
  Noclip.teardown()
  utils, lifetime, scheduler = deps.Utils, deps.Lifetime, deps.Controller
  player, rootScope = utils.getLocalPlayer(), lifetime.scope()
  local cleanup = { Disconnect = rootScope.destroy }
  utils.trackGlobal(cleanup)
  rootScope.add(function() utils.untrackGlobal(cleanup) end)
  rootScope.add(function()
    table.clear(owners)
    stopPhysics()
  end)
  if player then
    rootScope.connect(player.CharacterAdded, function(current)
      if next(owners) then
        bindCharacter(current)
        step()
      end
    end)
    rootScope.connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function(current)
      if character == current then
        restoreCharacter()
      end
    end)
  end
  controller = scheduler.create(utils, lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalNoclip",
    start = function() return Noclip.acquire(Noclip) end,
    stop = function() Noclip.release(Noclip) end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Noclip.__config = CONFIG
Noclip.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { acquire = "world.write", release = "world.write" } },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "isEnabled", "acquire", "release" },
}
return Noclip

-- [[ server navigation ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules servers

local Servers = {}

local utils
local failureConnection
local generation = 0
local busy = false
local busyUntil = 0
local reporter = nil
local pendingServerId

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  MAX_PING_MS = 100,
  MAX_PAGES = 3,
  PAGE_SIZE = 100,
  PAGE_DELAY = 0.5,
  TELEPORT_TIMEOUT = 15,
}

-- helpers
local function finite(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v > -math.huge and v < math.huge end
local function begin(callback)
  if not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return nil, "Hub inativo"
  end
  if busy and os.clock() < busyUntil then
    return nil, "Já existe uma busca ou um teleporte em andamento"
  end
  generation = generation + 1
  busy, busyUntil, reporter, pendingServerId = true, os.clock() + 60, callback, nil
  return generation
end
local function report(message)
  if type(reporter) == "function" then
    local ok, reason = pcall(reporter, message)
    if not ok and utils then
      utils.recordError("Servers.callback", reason)
    end
  end
end
local function teleport(serverId, token)
  if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  if not player then
    busy = false
    return false, "Jogador indisponível"
  end
  busyUntil, pendingServerId = os.clock() + CONFIG.TELEPORT_TIMEOUT, serverId
  local ok, err = pcall(function() game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, serverId, player) end)
  if token ~= generation or not utils then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  if not ok then
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    return false, tostring(err)
  end
  task.delay(CONFIG.TELEPORT_TIMEOUT, function()
    if token ~= generation or not busy or not utils then
      return
    end
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    report("O teleporte não foi concluído; você pode tentar novamente")
  end)
  return true
end

-- actions
function Servers.rejoin(callback)
  local token, err = begin(callback)
  if not token then
    return false, err
  end
  if type(game.JobId) ~= "string" or game.JobId == "" then
    busy = false
    return false, "Servidor atual indisponível"
  end
  report("Reconectando ao servidor atual...")
  return teleport(game.JobId, token)
end
function Servers.hop(callback)
  local token, err = begin(callback)
  if not token then
    return false, err
  end
  local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
  local best, cursor
  local seenCursors = {}
  report("Buscando servidores com ping informado de até " .. CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS .. " ms...")
  for page = 1, CONFIG.MAX_PAGES do
    if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
      return false, "Operação cancelada"
    end
    local url = ("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%s/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=%d&excludeFullGames=true"):format(
      tostring(game.PlaceId),
      CONFIG.PAGE_SIZE
    )
    if cursor then
      url = url .. "&cursor=" .. http:UrlEncode(cursor)
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url)) end)
    if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
      return false, "Operação cancelada"
    end
    if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.data) ~= "table" then
      busy = false
      return false, "Falha ao consultar servidores: " .. tostring(result)
    end
    for _, server in ipairs(result.data) do
      if
        type(server) == "table"
        and type(server.id) == "string"
        and server.id ~= ""
        and server.id ~= game.JobId
        and finite(server.playing)
        and finite(server.maxPlayers)
        and server.playing >= 0
        and server.maxPlayers > 0
        and server.playing < server.maxPlayers
        and finite(server.ping)
        and server.ping > 0
        and server.ping <= CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS
      then
        if not best or server.ping < best.ping or (server.ping == best.ping and server.playing < best.playing) then
          best = server
        end
      end
    end
    cursor = result.nextPageCursor
    if type(cursor) ~= "string" or cursor == "" or seenCursors[cursor] then
      break
    end
    seenCursors[cursor] = true
    if page < CONFIG.MAX_PAGES then
      task.wait(CONFIG.PAGE_DELAY)
    end
  end
  if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  if not best then
    busy = false
    return false, "Nenhum outro servidor com vaga e ping informado de até " .. CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS .. " ms foi encontrado"
  end
  report(("Entrando no servidor com menor ping informado: %.0f ms..."):format(best.ping))
  return teleport(best.id, token)
end

-- lifecycle
function Servers.teardown()
  generation = generation + 1
  busy, reporter, pendingServerId = false, nil, nil
  if failureConnection then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(failureConnection)
    end
    failureConnection:Disconnect()
    failureConnection = nil
  end
  utils = nil
  return true
end
function Servers.setup(deps)
  Servers.teardown()
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "Utils ausente"
  end
  utils = deps.Utils
  failureConnection = game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, _, message, placeId, options)
    if not utils or player ~= utils.getLocalPlayer() or placeId ~= game.PlaceId or not busy or not pendingServerId then
      return
    end
    if options and options.ServerInstanceId ~= "" and options.ServerInstanceId ~= pendingServerId then
      return
    end
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    report("Teleporte falhou: " .. tostring(message))
    utils.recordError("Servers", message)
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(failureConnection)
  return true
end

-- contract
Servers.__contract = {
  access = { default = "tooling.execute" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "isActive", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" } },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "rejoin", "hop" },
}

return Servers

-- [[ speed ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules speed

local Speed = {}
local controller, binding
local CONFIG = {
  persistent = { UniversalSpeedEnabled = false },
  schema = { UniversalSpeedEnabled = "boolean", UniversalSpeed = "rate" },
  defaults = { UniversalSpeedEnabled = false },
  resolveDefaults = function(context)
    local player = context and context.player or game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local character = player and player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local value = humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed or game:GetService("StarterPlayer").CharacterWalkSpeed
    return { UniversalSpeed = type(value) == "number" and value or 16 }
  end,
}
function Speed.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Speed.setValue(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setValue(value)
end
function Speed.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  if binding then
    binding.restore()
    binding = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Speed.setup(deps)
  Speed.teardown()
  local utils = deps.Utils
  binding = deps.Properties.create(utils, function(humanoid)
    local value = math.clamp(tonumber(utils.getConfigValue("UniversalSpeed")) or 16, 0, 200)
    return { WalkSpeed = value }
  end)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalSpeedEnabled",
    valueKey = "UniversalSpeed",
    min = 0,
    max = 200,
    start = function(scope) deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, binding.update) end,
    stop = binding.restore,
    update = binding.update,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Speed.__config = CONFIG
Speed.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller", Properties = "characterproperties" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
    Properties = { "create" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setValue" },
}
return Speed
