-- [[ autopearl ]]
--!optimize 2
local Pearl = {}
local native, geometry, target, units, ballistics, tuning, utils, aim, prediction
local shot, motion, retryAt, follow = nil, nil, 0, nil
local speed, gravity, drag, inheritance = 30, 12, 0.99, 0
local renderLead, measuredLatency = 1 / 60, nil
function Pearl.setup(deps)
  native, geometry, target, units, ballistics, tuning, utils, aim, prediction =
    deps.Native, deps.Geometry, deps.Target, deps.Units, deps.Ballistics, deps.Options.tuning, deps.Utils, deps.Aim, deps.Prediction
  return true
end
local function restore(snap)
  if not shot or shot.restored or not snap or shot.character ~= snap.character then
    return false
  end
  if shot.requestAt and snap.now - shot.requestAt < 0.5 then
    return false
  end
  local previous = shot.previous
  if not shot.manual and previous == shot.tool then
    previous = nil
  end
  shot.restored = native.restore(snap, previous, shot.manual)
  return shot.restored
end
function Pearl.reset()
  follow = nil
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  if shot and (shot.phase == "confirm" or shot.phase == "restore") and snap and shot.character == snap.character then
    motion = nil
    return
  end
  restore(snap)
  shot, motion, retryAt = nil, nil, 0
end
function Pearl.busy() return shot ~= nil and shot.phase ~= "flight" end
function Pearl.pending() return shot ~= nil end
function Pearl.escaping() return shot ~= nil and shot.phase == "flight" and shot.escape == true end
function Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
  if shot and shot.phase == "equip" then
    restore(snap)
    shot = nil
  end
end
function Pearl.observe(snap)
  local followed = target.tracked(snap)
  if followed then
    motion = prediction.sample(followed.root, followed.character, snap.now, motion)
  else
    motion = nil
  end
  if not shot or shot.character ~= snap.character then
    return
  end
  if shot.phase == "confirm" then
    local state = native.useState(snap, shot)
    if snap.now - shot.requestAt < 0.5 then
      return
    end
    if state == nil and not shot.failed and not shot.calibrated then
      return
    end
    state = state == true or shot.calibrated == true
    if state == false then
      shot.failed, shot.restoreAt, shot.phase = true, snap.now, "restore"
    else
      shot.failed, shot.restoreAt, shot.phase = false, snap.now, "restore"
      shot.untilAt = math.max(snap.now + 0.2, shot.requestAt + shot.plan.duration + 0.7)
      if shot.chosen then
        target.attacked(snap, shot.chosen)
      end
    end
  end
  if shot.phase == "restore" and not native.blocked(snap) then
    if restore(snap) or snap.now - shot.restoreAt >= 1 then
      if shot.failed or shot.manual then
        local delay = shot.failed and 1 or 0.15
        shot, retryAt = nil, snap.now + delay
      else
        shot.phase = "flight"
      end
      return true
    end
  elseif shot.phase == "flight" then
    local moved = units.distance(snap.root.Position, shot.requestRoot) >= 2
    local arrived = moved and units.distance(snap.root.Position, units.toWorld(shot.plan.landing)) < 3
    if arrived or snap.now >= shot.untilAt then
      shot, retryAt = nil, snap.now + 0.15
    end
  end
end
function Pearl.projectile(action, _id, kind, position, velocity, acceleration, resistance)
  if
    action ~= "Projectile"
    or kind ~= "Pearl"
    or not shot
    or not shot.requestAt
    or shot.calibrated
    or shot.phase == "equip"
    or os.clock() - shot.requestAt > 1
    or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3"
    or typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3"
  then
    return
  end
  local measured = units.toBlocks(velocity)
  if (units.toBlocks(position) - shot.plan.origin).Magnitude > 2 or measured.Magnitude < 1 or measured.Unit:Dot(shot.plan.direction) < 0.95 then
    return
  end
  -- Other players' pearls must not change our launch model.
  local elapsed = os.clock() - shot.requestAt
  if elapsed > 0 and elapsed < 1 then
    measuredLatency = elapsed
  end
  shot.calibrated = true
  local movement, direction = shot.requestVelocity, shot.plan.direction
  local perpendicular = movement - direction * movement:Dot(direction)
  if perpendicular.Magnitude > 0.15 then
    inheritance = math.clamp(perpendicular:Dot(measured - direction * measured:Dot(direction)) / perpendicular:Dot(perpendicular), 0, 1)
  end
  local launchSpeed = (measured - movement * inheritance):Dot(direction)
  if (perpendicular.Magnitude > 0.15 or movement.Magnitude < 0.5) and launchSpeed >= 10 and launchSpeed <= 80 then
    speed = launchSpeed
  end
  if type(acceleration) == "number" and acceleration > 0 then
    gravity = units.toBlocks(acceleration)
  end
  if type(resistance) == "number" and resistance > 0 and resistance <= 1 then
    drag = resistance
  end
end
local function params(snap)
  local ignored = { snap.character, snap.camera }
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    if player.Character then
      ignored[#ignored + 1] = player.Character
    end
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "LocalItemVisuals", "LocalBowVisuals", "PredictedBlocks", "ArenaPvPBots" }) do
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
    if folder then
      ignored[#ignored + 1] = folder
    end
  end
  local ray = RaycastParams.new()
  ray.FilterType, ray.RespectCanCollide, ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, ignored
  return ray
end
-- Emergency escape alone uses a safe landing surface. Combat never calls this path.
function Pearl.route(snap, position, elevated)
  local ray, origin = params(snap), units.toBlocks(snap.eye)
  local floor = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(position + Vector3.new(0, elevated and 12 or -0.75, 0)), units.offset(0, elevated and -48 or -24, 0), ray)
  if not floor then
    return nil
  end
  local landing = units.toBlocks(floor.Position)
  if (landing - units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position)).Magnitude < 4 then
    return nil
  end
  local direction, duration = ballistics.solve(origin, landing, speed, gravity, ray, tuning.pearlMaxFlight, drag)
  return direction and { direction = direction, duration = duration, landing = landing, origin = origin } or nil
end
local function nearGround(snap, value, ray)
  local gap = units.toBlocks(value.root.Position - snap.root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
  if gap.Magnitude >= tuning.pearlLobRangeBlocks then
    return true
  end
  local feet = value.root.Position - units.offset(0, 1.25, 0)
  local hit = workspace:Raycast(feet + units.offset(0, 1 / 32, 0), units.offset(0, -tuning.pearlTargetHeightBlocks - 1 / 32, 0), ray)
  return hit ~= nil
    and hit.Normal.Y >= 0.65
    and hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water
    and hit.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey") ~= "lava"
    and hit.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey") ~= "water"
end
local function plan(snap, value)
  local ray = params(snap)
  if not nearGround(snap, value, ray) then
    return nil, "height"
  end
  local roundTrip = measuredLatency
  local ok, ping = pcall(snap.player.GetNetworkPing, snap.player)
  if ok and type(ping) == "number" and ping > 0 then
    -- Player:GetNetworkPing is one-way: account for the observed pose and outgoing Use.
    roundTrip = math.clamp(ping * 2, 0, 1)
  elseif not roundTrip then
    local readable, value = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
    if readable and type(value) == "number" then
      roundTrip = math.clamp(value / 1000, 0, 1)
    end
  end
  local latency = renderLead + (roundTrip or 0)
  local predicted = prediction.actor(value.root, value.character, motion, latency, ray, true)
  local others = {}
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local human = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if player ~= snap.player and player ~= value.player and root and human and human.Health > 0 then
      others[#others + 1] = prediction.actor(root, character, nil, latency, ray, false)
    end
  end
  local route, reason = ballistics.intercept(
    units.toBlocks(snap.eye),
    predicted,
    others,
    speed,
    gravity,
    drag,
    units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) * inheritance,
    ray,
    tuning.pearlMaxFlight,
    units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position),
    value.distance <= 6,
    function(direction) return aim.canTurn(snap, direction, tuning.pursuitScreenMargin) end,
    {
      allowHigh = (units.toBlocks(value.root.Position - snap.root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude >= tuning.pearlLobRangeBlocks,
      groundAim = (units.toBlocks(value.root.Position - snap.root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude < tuning.pearlLobRangeBlocks,
      lobRange = tuning.pearlLobRangeBlocks,
      lowPitch = math.sin(math.rad(tuning.pearlLowPitchDegrees)),
      landingRadius = tuning.pearlLandingRadiusBlocks,

    route.revision = motion.revision
    route.tolerance = math.clamp(math.atan(0.12 / math.max(1, (route.landing - route.origin).Magnitude)), math.rad(0.03), math.rad(0.5))

end
local function rangeAllows(snap)
  if not shot or not shot.chosen then
    return true
  end
  if not nearGround(snap, shot.chosen, params(snap)) then
    return false
  end
  local launch = shot.plan.direction * speed + units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) * inheritance
  if not shot.plan.high and launch.Unit.Y <= math.sin(math.rad(tuning.pearlLowPitchDegrees)) then
    return true

  return (units.toBlocks(shot.chosen.root.Position - snap.root.Position) * flat).Magnitude >= tuning.pearlLobRangeBlocks

end
local function advance(snap)

    return

    restore(snap)

    return
  end
  if not shot.aimedAt or snap.now - shot.aimedAt > 0.1 then
    return
  end
  if shot.chosen then
    if not target.isCurrent(snap, shot.chosen) then
      Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
      return
    end
    local fresh = plan(snap, shot.chosen)
    if not fresh then
      Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
      return
    end
    shot.plan, shot.planAt = fresh, snap.now
  end
  local real = native.realAim(snap)
  local tolerance = math.cos(shot.plan.tolerance or math.rad(0.5))
  if real:Dot(shot.plan.direction) < tolerance or snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(shot.plan.direction) < tolerance then
    return
  end
  if shot.chosen then
    local verified = shot.plan.verify(real)
    if not verified then
      Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
      return
    end
    shot.plan.direction, shot.plan.landing, shot.plan.duration = real, verified.landing, verified.duration
  end
  shot.count, shot.requestAt = tonumber(shot.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 0, snap.now
  shot.requestRoot, shot.requestVelocity = snap.root.Position, units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
  shot.phase = "confirm"
  shot.failed = not native.use(snap, shot.tool, shot.plan.direction)
  if not shot.escape and shot.chosen then
    follow = {
      player = shot.chosen.player,
      character = shot.chosen.character,
      owner = snap.character,
      untilAt = snap.now + shot.plan.duration + 2,
    }
  end
end
function Pearl.launch(snap, route, escaping)
  Pearl.observe(snap)
  if shot or not route or snap.now < retryAt or native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  if (tonumber(snap.player:GetAttribute("ItemCooldown_Pearl")) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
    return false
  end
  local tool = native.find(snap, "Pearl", true)
  if not tool then
    return false
  end
  shot = {
    phase = "equip",
    character = snap.character,
    tool = tool,
    previous = snap.tool,
    escape = escaping == true,
    plan = route,
    deadline = snap.now + 1.5,
  }
  if escaping then
    follow = nil
  end
  return true
end
-- Manual use shares the confirmation and restoration state, without pursuit or auto aiming.
function Pearl.throw(snap)
  Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
  if shot and shot.phase == "flight" then
    shot = nil
  end
  local route = { direction = snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector, origin = units.toBlocks(snap.eye), duration = 0 }
  if not Pearl.launch(snap, route) then
    return false, "Pearl indisponível ou em uso."
  end
  shot.manual, shot.aimedAt, follow = true, snap.now, nil
  advance(snap)
  return true
end
function Pearl.advance(snap) advance(snap) end
function Pearl.aim(snap, dt)
  renderLead = math.clamp(dt or 1 / 60, 0, 0.05)
  if shot and shot.manual then
    if shot.phase == "equip" then
      shot.plan.direction, shot.plan.origin, shot.aimedAt = snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector, units.toBlocks(snap.eye), snap.now
    end
    return true
  end
  if not shot or shot.phase ~= "equip" then
    if shot and (shot.escape or shot.requestAt and snap.now - shot.requestAt < 0.5) then
      return shot.phase == "confirm"
    end
    if not follow or not utils.getConfigValue("MCAimAssist") then
      return false
    end
    local current = target.tracked(snap)
    local root = follow.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local human = follow.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if
      snap.character ~= follow.owner
      or snap.now >= follow.untilAt
      or follow.player.Character ~= follow.character
      or not root
      or not human
      or human.Health <= 0
      or current and current.character ~= follow.character
      or aim.paused(snap)
      or aim.yielding(snap, { root = root })
    then
      follow = nil
      return false
    end
    if current and current.distance <= tuning.focusRangeBlocks and utils.getConfigValue("MCAimLock") then
      return false
    end
    aim.step(snap, nil, dt, follow.character)
    return true
  end
  if not rangeAllows(snap) then
    Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
    return false
  end
  if not shot.escape and (not target.isCurrent(snap, shot.chosen) or not aim.canTurn(snap, shot.plan.direction, tuning.pursuitScreenMargin)) then
    Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
    return false
  end
  if
    aim.turn(snap, shot.plan.direction, dt, shot.escape, tuning.pursuitScreenMargin)
    and snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(shot.plan.direction) >= math.cos(shot.plan.tolerance or math.rad(0.5))
  then
    shot.aimedAt = snap.now
  end
  return true
end
function Pearl.prepare(snap)
  if shot and shot.character ~= snap.character then
    shot, motion = nil, nil
  end
  Pearl.observe(snap)
  if shot and shot.manual then
    advance(snap)
    return
  end
  local value = target.current(snap)
  if shot and shot.phase ~= "equip" then
    return
  end
  if not utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoPearl") or not value then
    Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
    return
  end
  local weapon = native.weapon(snap, value) or snap.tool
  local near = target.near(snap)
  if near and geometry.direction(snap, near, weapon) then
    Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
    return
  end
  if not motion or not motion.ready then
    Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
    return
  end
  if shot then
    if not shot.chosen or value.id ~= shot.chosen.id then
      Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
      return
    end
    if not shot.planAt or snap.now - shot.planAt >= 0.05 or shot.plan.revision ~= motion.revision then
      local route = plan(snap, value)
      if not route then
        Pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
        return
      end
      shot.plan, shot.planAt = route, snap.now
    end
    advance(snap)
    return
  end
  if snap.now < retryAt or native.blocked(snap) then
    return
  end
  if not aim.looking(snap, value) then
    return
  end
  if not native.find(snap, "Pearl", true) or (tonumber(snap.player:GetAttribute("ItemCooldown_Pearl")) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
    return
  end
  local route = plan(snap, value)
  if not route then
    retryAt = snap.now + 0.2
    return
  end
  if Pearl.launch(snap, route) then
    shot.chosen = value
  end
end
Pearl.__contract = {
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "reset",
    "prepare",
    "observe",
    "busy",
    "pending",
    "projectile",
    "route",
    "launch",
    "advance",
    "escaping",
    "cancelPrepared",
    "aim",
    "throw",
  },
  requires = {
    Native = "mcpnative",
    Geometry = "mcpgeometry",
    Target = "mcptarget",
    Units = "mcpunits",
    Ballistics = "mcpballistics",
    Options = "mcpoptions",
    Utils = "utils",
    Aim = "mcpaim",
    Prediction = "mcpmotion",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Native = { "snapshot", "find", "weapon", "restore", "equip", "use", "useState", "blocked", "realAim" },
    Geometry = { "direction" },
    Target = { "current", "tracked", "near", "attacked", "abandon", "isCurrent" },
    Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset", "distance" },
    Ballistics = { "solve", "intercept" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
    Aim = { "canTurn", "turn", "looking", "paused", "yielding", "step" },
    Prediction = { "sample", "actor" },
  },
  requiresData = { Options = { "tuning" } },
}

-- [[ mcpaim ]]
--!optimize 2
local Aim = {}
local geometry, utils, units, tuning, input, gui, world, scope
local humanoids, held, lastLook, lastCamera = {}, nil, nil, nil
local manualAt, resumeAt, stick = -math.huge, 0, false
local manualSerial, checkedSerial = 0, 0
local lockRoot, lockSide
function Aim.reset()
  held, lastLook, lastCamera, resumeAt = nil, nil, nil, 0
  checkedSerial = manualSerial
  lockRoot, lockSide = nil, nil
end
function Aim.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  humanoids, stick = {}, false
  Aim.reset()
end
function Aim.setup(deps)
  Aim.teardown()
  geometry, utils, units, tuning = deps.Geometry, deps.Utils, deps.Units, deps.Options.tuning
  input, gui, world = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("GuiService"), utils.getWorkspace()
  scope = deps.Lifetime.scope()
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("MobileAimAssist")
  local ok, base = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  if ok and type(base) == "table" and type(base.Adjust) == "function" then
    local original = base.Adjust
    local function adjust(frame)
      if utils.isActive() and utils.getConfigValue("MCAimAssist") then
        return frame
      end
      return original(frame)
    end
    base.Adjust = adjust
    scope.add(function()
      if base.Adjust == adjust then
        base.Adjust = original
      end
    end)
  end
  local function add(value)
    if value:IsA("Humanoid") then
      humanoids[value] = true
    end
  end
  scope.connect(world.DescendantAdded, add)
  scope.connect(world.DescendantRemoving, function(value) humanoids[value] = nil end)
  for _, value in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
    add(value)
  end
  scope.connect(input.InputChanged, function(event, processed)
    if event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then
      stick = event.Position.Magnitude > 0.12
    elseif
      not processed
      and event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      and event.Delta.Magnitude > 0.5
      and (input.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default or input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2))
    then
      manualAt, manualSerial = os.clock(), manualSerial + 1
    elseif not processed and event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and event.Delta.Magnitude > 0.1 then
      local camera = world.CurrentCamera
      if camera and event.Position.X >= camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5 then
        manualAt, manualSerial = os.clock(), manualSerial + 1
      end
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(input.InputEnded, function(event)
    if event.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then
      stick = false
    end
  end)
  return true
end
function Aim.looking(snap, value)
  if not value or not value.root.Parent then
    return false
  end
  -- Direction only: terrain and trees do not count as looking away.
  local point = snap.camera:WorldToViewportPoint(value.root.Position)
  local size = snap.camera.ViewportSize
  local margin = tuning.pursuitScreenMargin
  return point.Z > 0 and point.X >= -size.X * margin and point.X <= size.X * (1 + margin) and point.Y >= -size.Y * margin and point.Y <= size.Y * (1 + margin)
end
function Aim.canTurn(snap, direction, margin)
  if snap.now < resumeAt then
    return false
  end
  local localDirection = snap.camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
  if localDirection.Z >= -1e-5 then
    return false
  end
  local size = snap.camera.ViewportSize
  local vertical = math.tan(math.rad(snap.camera.FieldOfView) / 2) * (1 + 2 * (margin or 0))
  return math.abs(localDirection.Y / -localDirection.Z) <= vertical * 0.98
    and math.abs(localDirection.X / -localDirection.Z) <= vertical * size.X / math.max(1, size.Y) * 0.98
end
local function intent(snap, value)
  local manual = manualSerial ~= checkedSerial or stick
  if not manual or not value or lastCamera ~= snap.camera or not lastLook then
    return 0
  end
  local delta = value.root.Position - snap.camera.CFrame.Position
  if delta.Magnitude < 0.001 then
    return 0
  end
  local desired, look = delta.Unit, snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
  if lastLook:Dot(look) > math.cos(math.rad(0.1)) then
    return 0
  end
  checkedSerial = manualSerial
  local before = math.acos(math.clamp(lastLook:Dot(desired), -1, 1))
  local after = math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(desired), -1, 1))
  if after > before + math.rad(0.35) then
    return 1
  end
  if after < before - math.rad(0.35) then
    return -1
  end
  return 0
end
function Aim.yielding(snap, value) return intent(snap, value) == 1 end
function Aim.returning(snap, value) return intent(snap, value) == -1 end
function Aim.paused(snap) return snap.now < resumeAt end
function Aim.pause(snap)
  Aim.reset()
  resumeAt = snap.now + 0.75
  checkedSerial = manualSerial
end
function Aim.turn(snap, desired, dt, emergency, margin)
  if snap.now < resumeAt or not emergency and not Aim.canTurn(snap, desired, margin) then
    return false
  end
  local frame = snap.camera.CFrame
  local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(frame.LookVector:Dot(desired), -1, 1))
  local turn = math.min(angle, math.rad(360) * math.clamp(dt or 1 / 60, 0, 1 / 15))
  local axis = frame.LookVector:Cross(desired)
  if axis.Magnitude < 1e-6 and angle > 0.001 then
    axis = frame.UpVector
  end
  if axis.Magnitude > 1e-6 then
    snap.camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(frame.Position) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, turn) * frame.Rotation
  end
  lastLook, lastCamera = snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector, snap.camera
  return lastLook:Dot(desired) >= math.cos(math.rad(0.75))
end
function Aim.observe(snap)
  lastLook, lastCamera = snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector, snap.camera
end
local function lockPoint(snap, focus)
  local root = focus.root
  local forward = root.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
  if forward.Magnitude < 1e-5 then
    return geometry.point(focus.character, root)
  end
  forward = forward.Unit
  local facing = units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position - root.Position):Dot(forward)
  if lockRoot ~= root then
    lockRoot, lockSide = root, facing >= 0 and 1 or -1
  elseif facing > 0.5 then
    lockSide = 1
  elseif facing < -0.5 then
    lockSide = -1
  end
  local side = geometry.blocking(focus.character) and -1 or lockSide
  -- Keep the torso point inside the body, without chasing its lateral edges.
  return root.Position + units.offset(0, focus.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking") and 3 / 64 or 5 / 32, 0) + forward * units.toWorld(side / 8)
end
local function direction(snap, model, range, point)
  local human = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if
    not model
    or model == snap.character
    or not model.Parent
    or model:IsDescendantOf(snap.camera)
    or model:GetAttribute("Invisible") == true
    or not human
    or human.Health <= 0
    or not root
    or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
  then
    return nil
  end
  local distance = units.distance(root.Position, snap.root.Position)
  if distance > range then
    return nil
  end
  point = point or geometry.point(model, root)
  if not geometry.visible(snap, point, model, snap.camera.CFrame.Position) then
    return nil
  end
  local delta = point - snap.camera.CFrame.Position
  if delta.Magnitude < 0.001 then
    return nil
  end
  local projected, visible = snap.camera:WorldToViewportPoint(point)
  return delta.Unit, distance, visible and projected.Z > 0
end
local function assist(snap)
  if snap.now < resumeAt then
    return nil
  end
  local look = snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
  if held then
    local aim, distance, visible = direction(snap, held, tuning.assistRangeBlocks)
    if aim then
      local manual = snap.now - manualAt < 0.15 or input.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad and stick
      if manual and lastCamera == snap.camera and lastLook then
        local before = math.acos(math.clamp(lastLook:Dot(aim), -1, 1))
        if math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(aim), -1, 1)) > before + math.rad(0.2) then
          held, resumeAt = nil, snap.now + 0.35
          return nil
        end
      end
      if distance <= tuning.focusRangeBlocks or visible and look:Dot(aim) >= math.cos(math.rad(20)) then
        return aim
      end
    end
    held = nil
  end
  local best, score
  for human in pairs(humanoids) do
    local aim, _, visible = direction(snap, human.Parent, tuning.assistRangeBlocks)
    local rank = aim and look:Dot(aim)
    if visible and rank >= math.cos(math.rad(20)) and (not score or rank > score) then
      held, best, score = human.Parent, aim, rank
    end
  end
  return best
end
function Aim.step(snap, focus, dt, recovery)
  local lock, enabled = utils.getConfigValue("MCAimLock"), utils.getConfigValue("MCAimAssist")
  if snap.now < resumeAt then
    return
  end
  if not (lock or enabled) or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or gui.MenuIsOpen then
    Aim.reset()
    return
  end
  local aim, pull, speed, radius
  if lock and focus then
    local point = lockPoint(snap, focus)
    local distance
    aim, distance = direction(snap, focus.character, tuning.focusRangeBlocks, point)
    if aim then
      held, pull = focus.character, 24
      -- Close crossings must not whip the camera around and redirect forward input into an orbit.
      speed = math.rad(360) * math.clamp((distance - 0.45) / 1.55, 0, 1)
      radius = math.atan(0.1 / math.max(0.1, units.distance(point, snap.camera.CFrame.Position)))

    lockRoot, lockSide = nil, nil
  end

    if recovery then
      if snap.now - manualAt < 0.15 or stick then
        return
      end
      local root = recovery:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local delta = root and geometry.point(recovery, root) - snap.camera.CFrame.Position
      aim = delta and delta.Magnitude > 0.001 and delta.Unit or nil
      radius = math.rad(6)
    else
      aim = assist(snap)
    end
    pull, speed = 10, math.rad(84)
    if input.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad then
      pull, speed = 2.9, math.rad(24)
    end
  end
  local frame = snap.camera.CFrame
  if aim then
    local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(frame.LookVector:Dot(aim), -1, 1))
    local elapsed = math.clamp(dt or 1 / 60, 0, 1 / 15)
    local turn = math.min(math.max(0, angle - (radius or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-pull * elapsed)), speed * elapsed)

  provides = { "setup", "reset", "step", "teardown", "looking", "canTurn", "yielding", "pause", "turn", "observe", "returning", "paused" },

    Utils = { "getWorkspace", "isActive", "getConfigValue" },
    Units = { "distance", "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
  },
  requiresData = { Options = { "tuning" } },
}

-- [[ mcpmelee ]]
--!optimize 2
local Melee = {}
local native, geometry, target, utils
local cycle, retryAt = nil, 0
local function enabled(key) return utils.getConfigValue(key) == true end
function Melee.setup(deps)
  native, geometry, target, utils = deps.Native, deps.Geometry, deps.Target, deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Melee.reset()
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  if snap then
    native.sprint(snap, false)
  end
  cycle, retryAt = nil, 0
end
function Melee.request(snap, chosen)
  if not chosen or not enabled("MCAutoCrit") or snap.tool and not geometry.melee(snap.tool) then
    return false
  end
  if cycle and cycle.chosen.id == chosen.id and cycle.tool == snap.tool then
    local wait = math.max(0.8, 1 / (geometry.stats(snap.tool).speed or 1.6) + 0.6)
    if snap.now - cycle.at >= wait then
      Melee.reset()
      return false
    end
    cycle.manual = true
    return true
  end
  cycle = { chosen = chosen, character = snap.character, tool = snap.tool, manual = true, at = snap.now, phase = geometry.grounded(snap) and "ready" or "air" }
  return true
end
local function chosen(snap)
  if cycle and (cycle.character ~= snap.character or not target.isCurrent(snap, cycle.chosen) or snap.now - cycle.at > 2) then
    Melee.reset()
  end
  if cycle then
    return cycle.chosen
  end
  return enabled("MCAutoSword") and target.near(snap) or nil
end
function Melee.prepare(snap)
  local value = chosen(snap)
  if not value or native.blocked(snap) or snap.now < retryAt then
    return
  end
  local tool
  if cycle and cycle.manual then
    tool = snap.tool
  else
    tool = native.weapon(snap, value)
  end
  if not tool and not (cycle and cycle.manual) or not geometry.direction(snap, value, tool) then
    return
  end
  if snap.tool ~= tool then
    native.equip(snap, tool)
    return
  end
  if not enabled("MCAutoCrit") then
    return
  end
  local speed = geometry.stats(tool).speed or 1.6
  local window = geometry.criticalWindow(snap)
  if not cycle then
    if native.charge(snap) + speed * (window or 0) < 1 then
      return
    end
    cycle = { chosen = value, character = snap.character, tool = tool, at = snap.now, phase = geometry.grounded(snap) and "ready" or "air" }
  end
  if cycle.tool and cycle.tool ~= tool then
    Melee.reset()
    return
  end
  cycle.tool = tool
  if cycle.phase == "ready" then
    if native.charge(snap) + speed * (window or 0) < 1 then
      return
    end
    if geometry.jumpRisk(snap) or window == nil then
      cycle.phase = "ground"
      return
    end
    native.sprint(snap, true)
    if native.jump(snap) then
      cycle.phase, cycle.jumpAt = "jump", snap.now
    end
  elseif cycle.phase == "jump" then
    if not geometry.grounded(snap) then
      cycle.phase = "air"
    elseif snap.now - cycle.jumpAt > 0.6 then
      cycle.phase = "ground"
    end
  elseif cycle.phase == "air" and geometry.grounded(snap) then
    -- A missed fall window must not leave the attack permanently pending.
    cycle.phase = cycle.jumpAt and "ground" or "ready"
  end
  if cycle.phase == "air" or cycle.phase == "jump" then
    native.sprint(snap, true)
  end
end
function Melee.strike(snap)
  local value = chosen(snap)
  if not value or native.blocked(snap) or snap.now < retryAt then
    return
  end
  local tool
  if cycle then
    tool = cycle.tool
  else
    tool = native.weapon(snap, value)
  end
  if not tool and not (cycle and cycle.manual) or snap.tool ~= tool then
    return
  end
  local direction = geometry.direction(snap, value, tool)
  if not direction then
    if cycle then
      Melee.reset()
    end
    return
  end
  if enabled("MCAutoCrit") then
    if not cycle then
      return
    end
    if cycle.phase == "jump" and not geometry.grounded(snap) then
      cycle.phase = "air"
    end
    local charged = native.charge(snap) + (geometry.stats(tool).speed or 1.6) * 0.025 >= 1
    if not charged or not (cycle.phase == "ground" or geometry.falling(snap)) then
      return
    end
    -- Stop sprint immediately before the native attack; do not wait for replicated request flags.
    native.sprint(snap, true, true)
  end
  if native.attack(snap, value, direction) then
    target.attacked(snap, value)
    native.sprint(snap, false)
    cycle, retryAt = nil, snap.now + 1 / 7
  end
end
Melee.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "request", "prepare", "strike" },
  requires = { Native = "mcpnative", Geometry = "mcpgeometry", Target = "mcptarget", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Native = { "snapshot", "sprint", "blocked", "weapon", "equip", "charge", "jump", "attack" },
    Geometry = { "grounded", "direction", "stats", "jumpRisk", "criticalWindow", "melee", "falling" },
    Target = { "isCurrent", "near", "attacked" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
  },
}
return Melee

-- [[ mcptarget ]]
--!optimize 2
local Target = {}
local geometry, native, units, tuning, players, aim
local owner, fight, health, attempted
local serial, activity = 0, -math.huge
local swings = {}
function Target.setup(deps)
  geometry, native, units, tuning, players, aim = deps.Geometry, deps.Native, deps.Units, deps.Options.tuning, game:GetService("Players"), deps.Aim
  return true
end
function Target.reset()
  owner, fight, health, attempted, swings = nil, nil, nil, nil, {}
  serial, activity = serial + 1, -math.huge
end
local function candidate(player, snap, range)
  local character = player and player.Character
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local human = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if
    not player
    or player == snap.player
    or player.Parent ~= players
    or not root
    or not human
    or human.Health <= 0
    or character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    or not geometry.allowed(character)
  then
    return nil
  end
  local distance = units.distance(root.Position, snap.root.Position)
  if distance > range then
    return nil
  end
  return { player = player, character = character, root = root, humanoid = human, distance = distance }
end
function Target.tracked(snap)
  if not fight then
    return nil
  end
  local value = owner == snap.character and candidate(fight.player, snap, math.huge)
  if not value or value.character ~= fight.character then
    fight, attempted, swings = nil, nil, {}
    return nil
  end
  value.id = fight.id
  return value
end
function Target.current(snap)
  local value = Target.tracked(snap)
  return fight and not fight.suspended and value or nil
end
local function suspend(snap, value)
  if fight and value.distance > tuning.focusRangeBlocks then
    fight.suspended, fight.resumeUntil, fight.sawOutside = true, snap.now + tuning.pursuitResumeSeconds, not aim.looking(snap, value)
    aim.pause(snap)
  else
    Target.abandon(snap, value)
  end
end
function Target.abandon(snap, value)
  if fight and (not value or value.id == fight.id) and owner == snap.character then
    fight, attempted, swings = nil, nil, {}
    aim.pause(snap)
  end
end
function Target.observeView(snap)
  local value = Target.tracked(snap)
  if not value then
    return
  end
  if fight.suspended then
    if snap.now > fight.resumeUntil then
      Target.abandon(snap, value)
      return
    end
    local looking = aim.looking(snap, value)
    if not looking then
      fight.sawOutside = true
    end
    if looking and (fight.sawOutside or aim.returning(snap, value)) then
      fight.suspended, fight.lookAt = false, snap.now
      aim.reset()
    end
    return
  end
  if aim.yielding(snap, value) then
    suspend(snap, value)
    return
  end
  if aim.looking(snap, value) then
    fight.lookAt = snap.now
  end
  if snap.now - fight.lookAt > tuning.lookAwaySeconds and snap.now - fight.replyAt > tuning.retaliationSeconds then
    Target.abandon(snap, value)
  end
end
function Target.near(snap)
  local value = Target.current(snap)
  return value and value.distance <= tuning.focusRangeBlocks and value or nil
end
function Target.isCurrent(snap, value)
  local current = Target.current(snap)
  return current ~= nil and value ~= nil and current.id == value.id and current.character == value.character
end
local function select(snap, value)
  serial += 1
  fight = { player = value.player, character = value.character, id = serial, at = snap.now, lookAt = snap.now, replyAt = -math.huge }
  aim.reset()
  value.id, attempted, swings = serial, nil, {}
end
function Target.manual(snap, direction)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    Target.reset()
    owner = snap.character
  end
  if native.blocked(snap) then
    return nil
  end
  direction = direction or snap.player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection") or snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
  local chosen, nearest
  for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
    local value = candidate(player, snap, tuning.focusRangeBlocks)
    local distance = value and geometry.hit(snap, value, snap.tool, direction)
    if distance and (not nearest or distance < nearest) then
      chosen, nearest = value, distance
    end
  end
  activity = snap.now
  if not chosen then
    return nil
  end
  local current = Target.current(snap)
  if not current or current.character ~= chosen.character then
    select(snap, chosen)
  else
    chosen.id = current.id
  end
  fight.at, attempted = snap.now, { at = snap.now, id = fight.id }
  return chosen
end
function Target.noteSwing(source)
  if typeof(source) ~= "Instance" then
    return
  end
  local character = source
  if source:IsA("Player") then
    character = source.Character
  end
  if not character or not character:IsA("Model") then
    return
  end
  local player = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  local value = snap and candidate(player, snap, tuning.focusRangeBlocks)
  if value and geometry.incoming(snap, value) then
    swings[player] = snap.now
  end
end
function Target.threat(snap)
  local best
  for player, at in pairs(swings) do
    if snap.now - at > 0.35 then
      swings[player] = nil
    else
      local value = candidate(player, snap, tuning.focusRangeBlocks)
      if value and geometry.incoming(snap, value) and (not best or value.distance < best.distance) then
        best = value
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end
function Target.observe(snap)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    Target.reset()
    owner = snap.character
  end
  local current = Target.current(snap)
  if current and aim.yielding(snap, current) then
    suspend(snap, current)
    current = nil
  end
  local hurt = health and snap.humanoid.Health < health
  health = snap.humanoid.Health
  if hurt then
    activity = snap.now
    if fight then
      fight.hurtAt = snap.now
    end
  end
  if current then
    local best = current
    for player, at in pairs(swings) do
      if snap.now - at > 0.35 then
        swings[player] = nil
        continue
      end
      local value = candidate(player, snap, tuning.focusRangeBlocks)
      local responding = current.distance > tuning.focusRangeBlocks or fight.hurtAt and math.abs(at - fight.hurtAt) <= 0.35
      if value and responding and value.distance < best.distance and geometry.visible(snap, value.root.Position, value.character) then
        best = value
      end
      if value and value.player == current.player then
        fight.replyAt = snap.now
      end
    end
    if best ~= current then
      select(snap, best)
      fight.replyAt = snap.now
    end
  end
  Target.observeView(snap)
end
function Target.hit(now)
  if fight and attempted and attempted.id == fight.id and now - attempted.at < 1 then
    fight.at, activity = now, now
  end
  attempted = nil
end
function Target.attacked(snap, value)
  if Target.isCurrent(snap, value) then
    fight.at, activity, attempted = snap.now, snap.now, { at = snap.now, id = fight.id }
  end
end
function Target.quiet(snap, seconds) return snap.now - activity >= seconds end
Target.__contract = {
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "reset",
    "manual",
    "observe",
    "current",
    "tracked",
    "near",
    "isCurrent",
    "hit",
    "noteSwing",
    "attacked",
    "quiet",
    "abandon",
    "threat",
    "observeView",
  },
  requires = { Geometry = "mcpgeometry", Native = "mcpnative", Units = "mcpunits", Options = "mcpoptions", Aim = "mcpaim" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Geometry = { "allowed", "hit", "incoming", "visible" },
    Native = { "snapshot", "blocked" },
    Units = { "distance" },
    Aim = { "reset", "pause", "looking", "yielding", "returning" },
  },
  requiresData = { Options = { "tuning" } },
}
return Target

-- [[ mcpballistics ]]
--!native
--!optimize 2
local Ballistics = {}
local units
local STEP = 0.05
function Ballistics.setup(deps)
  units = deps.Units
  return true
end
-- Exact sums for move -> drag -> gravity, including the fractional final tick.
local function coefficients(time, drag)
  local n = math.floor(time / STEP)
  local fraction = time - n * STEP
  if math.abs(1 - drag) < 1e-7 then
    return n * STEP + fraction, STEP * STEP * n * (n - 1) / 2 + fraction * STEP * n
  end
  local power = drag ^ n
  local sum = (1 - power) / (1 - drag)
  return STEP * sum + fraction * power, STEP / (1 - drag) * (STEP * (n - sum) + fraction * (1 - power))
end
local function safeFloor(hit, destination, params)
  if hit.Normal.Y < 0.65 or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or (units.toBlocks(hit.Position) - destination).Magnitude > 15 / 32 then
    return false
  end
  local block = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey")
  if block == "lava" or block == "water" then
    return false
  end
  local feet = units.toBlocks(hit.Position) + Vector3.new(0, 3 / 64, 0)
  for _, offset in ipairs({ Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(13 / 64, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-13 / 64, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 13 / 64), Vector3.new(0, 0, -13 / 64) }) do
    if workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(feet + offset), units.offset(0, 2, 0), params) then
      return false
    end
    local floor = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(feet + offset), units.offset(0, -0.25, 0), params)
    if not floor or floor.Normal.Y < 0.65 or floor.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
      return false
    end
    local key = floor.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey")
    if key == "lava" or key == "water" then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function clear(origin, velocity, gravity, drag, duration, destination, params)
  local position = origin
  for _ = 1, math.ceil((duration + STEP) / STEP) do
    local offset = velocity * STEP
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(position), units.toWorld(offset), params)
    if hit then
      return safeFloor(hit, destination, params)
    end
    position += offset
    velocity = velocity * drag - Vector3.new(0, gravity * STEP, 0)
  end
  return false
end
-- Positions are blocks; speed is blocks/s and gravity is blocks/s^2.
function Ballistics.solve(origin, destination, speed, gravity, params, maxFlight, drag)
  drag, maxFlight = drag or 0.99, maxFlight or 6
  if speed <= 0 or gravity <= 0 or drag <= 0 or drag > 1 or maxFlight <= STEP then
    return nil
  end
  local delta = destination - origin
  local function required(time)
    local travel, drop = coefficients(time, drag)
    local velocity = (delta + Vector3.new(0, gravity * drop, 0)) / travel
    return velocity:Dot(velocity) - speed * speed, velocity
  end
  local low, lowError = 0.001, required(0.001)
  for tick = 1, math.ceil(maxFlight / STEP) do
    local high = math.min(tick * STEP, maxFlight)
    local highError = required(high)
    if lowError * highError <= 0 then
      local left, right, error = low, high, lowError
      for _ = 1, 20 do
        local mid = (left + right) * 0.5
        local value = required(mid)
        if error * value <= 0 then
          right = mid
        else
          left, error = mid, value
        end
      end
      local duration = (left + right) * 0.5
      local _, velocity = required(duration)
      local direction = velocity.Unit
      if clear(origin, direction * speed, gravity, drag, duration, destination, params) then
        return direction, duration
      end
    end
    low, lowError = high, highError
  end
  return nil
end
local function boxFraction(origin, delta, low, high)
  local near, far = 0, 1
  for _, axis in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
    if math.abs(delta[axis]) < 1e-8 then
      if origin[axis] < low[axis] or origin[axis] > high[axis] then
        return nil
      end
    else
      local first, last = (low[axis] - origin[axis]) / delta[axis], (high[axis] - origin[axis]) / delta[axis]
      if first > last then
        first, last = last, first
      end
      near, far = math.max(near, first), math.min(far, last)
      if near > far then
        return nil
      end
    end
  end
  return near
end
local function actorHit(position, offset, actor, time, step, margin)
  local before, after = actor.predict(time), actor.predict(time + step)
  local crouch = actor.crouch and 0.3 or 0
  margin = margin or 0
  return boxFraction(
    position - before,
    offset - (after - before),
    Vector3.new(-0.3 + margin, -1.25 + margin, -0.3 + margin),
    Vector3.new(0.3 - margin, 0.71875 - crouch - margin, 0.3 - margin)
  )
end
local function hitsPlayer(origin, velocity, gravity, drag, duration, target, others, params, ownPosition, policy)
  if policy and policy.groundAim and velocity.Y >= 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local position, time, contact = origin, 0, nil
  for _ = 1, math.ceil((duration + 0.5) / STEP) do
    local offset = velocity * STEP
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(position), units.toWorld(offset), params)
    local fraction = actorHit(position, offset, target, time, STEP, 0.06)
    local solid = hit and hit.Distance / units.toWorld(offset.Magnitude) or math.huge
    for _, other in ipairs(others) do
      local earlier = actorHit(position, offset, other, time, STEP)
      if earlier and earlier < solid then
        return nil
      end
    end
    if not contact and fraction and fraction < solid then
      contact = time + STEP * fraction
    end
    if hit then
      if not contact and not (policy and policy.groundAim) then
        return nil
      end
      local impact, impactTime = units.toBlocks(hit.Position), time + STEP * solid
      local expected = target.predict(impactTime)
      local gap = impact - expected
      local radius = policy and policy.groundAim and 0.65 or policy and policy.landingRadius or 1.25
      local height = -(gap.Y + 1.25)
      local validHeight = math.abs(height) <= 0.5
      if policy and policy.groundAim then
        validHeight = height >= -0.1 and height <= 2
      end
      -- The dump's projectile visuals ignore characters. Also prove that continuing
      -- past the body cannot send the pearl to a distant terrain impact.
      if (gap * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude > radius or not validHeight or (impact - ownPosition).Magnitude < 3 or not safeFloor(hit, impact, params) then
        return nil
      end
      return contact or impactTime, impact, impactTime
    end
    position += offset
    velocity = velocity * drag - Vector3.new(0, gravity * STEP, 0)
    time += STEP
  end
  return nil
end
-- Close pursuit targets the floor below predicted feet; distant pursuit intercepts the body.
function Ballistics.intercept(origin, target, others, speed, gravity, drag, inherited, params, maxFlight, ownPosition, near, canAim, policy)
  local aimOffset = Vector3.new(0, -1.05, 0)
  local outsideView = false
  local function required(time)
    local travel, drop = coefficients(time, drag)
    local destination = target.predict(time) + aimOffset
    if policy and policy.groundAim then
      local feet = target.predict(time) - Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0)
      local floor = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(feet + Vector3.new(0, 1 / 32, 0)), units.offset(0, -2 - 1 / 32, 0), params)
      if not floor then
        return math.huge, Vector3.zero
      end
      destination = units.toBlocks(floor.Position) - Vector3.new(0, 1 / 64, 0)
    end
    local velocity = (destination - origin + Vector3.new(0, gravity * drop, 0)) / travel - inherited
    return velocity:Dot(velocity) - speed * speed, velocity
  end
  local low, previous = 0.001, required(0.001)
  for tick = 1, math.ceil(maxFlight / STEP) do
    local high = tick * STEP
    local error = required(high)
    if previous * error <= 0 then
      local left, right, sign = low, high, previous
      for _ = 1, 18 do
        local mid = (left + right) / 2
        local value = required(mid)
        if sign * value <= 0 then
          right = mid
        else
          left, sign = mid, value
        end
      end
      local duration = (left + right) / 2
      local _, velocity = required(duration)
      local direction = velocity.Unit
      local launchVelocity = direction * speed + inherited
      local highShot = policy and (direction.Y > policy.lowPitch or launchVelocity.Unit.Y > policy.lowPitch)
      local predictedGap = (target.predict(duration) - ownPosition) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
      -- Height never grants permission: both current and future horizontal range must be far.
      if policy and policy.groundAim and direction.Y >= 0 or highShot and (not policy.allowHigh or predictedGap.Magnitude < policy.lobRange) then
        low, previous = high, error
        continue
      end
      local contact, impact, impactTime = hitsPlayer(origin, launchVelocity, gravity, drag, duration, target, others, params, ownPosition, policy)
      if contact then
        if not canAim or canAim(direction) then
          return {
            direction = direction,
            duration = impactTime,
            landing = impact,
            origin = origin,
            high = highShot == true,
            verify = function(actualDirection)
              if policy and policy.groundAim and actualDirection.Y >= 0 then
                return nil
              end
              local body, point, at =
                hitsPlayer(origin, actualDirection * speed + inherited, gravity, drag, duration, target, others, params, ownPosition, policy)
              return body and { landing = point, duration = at } or nil
            end,
          }
        end
        outsideView = true
      end
    end
    low, previous = high, error
  end
  return nil, outsideView and "view" or nil
end

  { provides = { "setup", "solve", "intercept" }, requires = { Units = "mcpunits" }, requiresMethods = { Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset" } } }

-- [[ mcpgeometry ]]
--!optimize 2
local Geometry = {}
local units, world, players, weapons, boxes, shields, rules
function Geometry.setup(deps)
  units, world, players = deps.Units, deps.Utils.getWorkspace(), game:GetService("Players")
  local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
  local function library(name)
    local source = storage:FindFirstChild(name)
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
    return ok and type(value) == "table" and value or nil
  end
  weapons, boxes, shields, rules = library("VoxelWeapons"), library("VoxelMeleeGeometry"), library("ShieldRules"), library("SpawnBowRules")
  if
    not weapons
    or type(weapons.Stats) ~= "function"
    or not boxes
    or type(boxes.Hit) ~= "function"
    or type(boxes.Box) ~= "function"
    or type(boxes.Eye) ~= "function"
  then
    error("MCPvP: VoxelWeapons/VoxelMeleeGeometry indisponíveis ou incompatíveis com o dump.")
  end
  return true
end
function Geometry.stats(tool)
  local value = weapons.Stats(tool)
  return { type = value.type, speed = value.speed, reach = value.reachBlocks or units.toBlocks(value.reach), damage = value.damage }
end
function Geometry.melee(tool)
  if not tool then
    return false
  end
  local kind = Geometry.stats(tool).type
  return kind == "sword"
    or kind == "axe"
    or kind == "spear"
    or kind == "pickaxe"
    or kind == "mace" and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Breach")) or 0) > 0 and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Density")) or 0) <= 0
end
function Geometry.blocking(character) return shields ~= nil and shields.IsBlocking(character) == true end
function Geometry.allowed(character)
  if rules then
    return rules.CanShoot(character)
  end
  if not character or character:GetAttribute("ArenaProtected") == true or character:GetAttribute("DuelCombatActive") == false then
    return false
  end
  local player = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
  return player
    and player:GetAttribute("InArena") == true
    and player:GetAttribute("ArenaProtected") ~= true
    and player:GetAttribute("DuelCombatActive") ~= false
end
function Geometry.eye(root, character) return boxes.Eye(root.Position, character:GetAttribute("Sneaking")) end
function Geometry.grounded(snap)
  local value = snap.character:GetAttribute("VoxelGrounded")
  return value == true or value == nil and snap.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
end
function Geometry.falling(snap)
  return not Geometry.grounded(snap)
    and (tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalFallDistance")) or 0) > 0
    and units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) < -1 / 32
    and not snap.humanoid.Sit
    and not snap.humanoid.PlatformStand
    and snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalInWater") ~= true
    and snap.character:GetAttribute("InLava") ~= true
    and snap.player:GetAttribute("LocalGliding") ~= true
    and snap.character:GetAttribute("Gliding") ~= true
end
local function params(snap, actors)
  local ignored = { snap.character, snap.camera }
  if actors then
    for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player.Character then
        ignored[#ignored + 1] = player.Character
      end
    end
    local bots = world:FindFirstChild("ArenaPvPBots")
    if bots then
      ignored[#ignored + 1] = bots
    end
  end
  local value = RaycastParams.new()
  value.FilterType, value.RespectCanCollide, value.IgnoreWater = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, actors == true
  value.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
  return value
end
function Geometry.visible(snap, point, character, origin)
  origin = origin or snap.eye
  local hit = world:Raycast(origin, point - origin, params(snap, false))
  return not hit or character and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end
function Geometry.point(character, root)
  local rear = Vector3.zero
  if shields and shields.IsBlocking(character) then
    rear = -root.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1) * units.toWorld(0.25)
  end
  return root.Position + units.offset(0, character:GetAttribute("Sneaking") and 3 / 64 or 5 / 32, 0) + rear
end
function Geometry.hit(snap, target, tool, direction)
  if not Geometry.allowed(target.character) or target.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local reach = units.toWorld(Geometry.stats(tool).reach or 3)
  local distance = boxes.Hit(snap.eye, direction, target.root.Position, target.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking"), reach)
  if not distance then
    return nil
  end
  local obstruction = world:Raycast(snap.eye, direction * distance, params(snap, true))
  if obstruction and obstruction.Distance < distance - units.toWorld(1 / 320) then
    return nil
  end
  local function closer(character)
    if character == snap.character or character == target.character then
      return false
    end
    local human, root = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not human or human.Health <= 0 or not root then
      return false
    end
    local other = boxes.Hit(snap.eye, direction, root.Position, character:GetAttribute("Sneaking"), distance)
    return other ~= nil and other < distance
  end
  for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player.Character and closer(player.Character) then
      return nil
    end
  end
  local bots = world:FindFirstChild("ArenaPvPBots")
  if bots then
    for _, character in ipairs(bots:GetChildren()) do
      if closer(character) then
        return nil
      end
    end
  end
  local crystals = world:FindFirstChild("EndCrystals")
  if crystals then
    for _, crystal in ipairs(crystals:GetChildren()) do
      local feet = crystal:GetAttribute("CrystalFeet")
      if typeof(feet) == "Vector3" then
        local other = boxes.Box(snap.eye, direction, feet - units.offset(1, 0, 1), feet + units.offset(1, 2, 1), distance)
        if other and other < distance then
          return nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return units.toBlocks(distance)
end
function Geometry.direction(snap, target, tool)
  if not target or not target.character.Parent or not target.root.Parent then
    return nil
  end
  local relative = units.toBlocks(snap.eye - target.root.Position)
  local crouch = target.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking") and 0.3 or 0
  local points = {
    Geometry.point(target.character, target.root),
    target.root.Position
      + units.toWorld(Vector3.new(math.clamp(relative.X, -3 / 8, 3 / 8), math.clamp(relative.Y, -1.25, 0.18 - crouch), math.clamp(relative.Z, -3 / 8, 3 / 8))),
    target.root.Position + units.offset(0, 0.5 - crouch, 0),
  }
  for _, point in ipairs(points) do
    local delta = point - snap.eye
    if delta.Magnitude > 0.001 and Geometry.hit(snap, target, tool, delta.Unit) then
      return delta.Unit
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Geometry.incoming(snap, target)
  local eye = Geometry.eye(target.root, target.character)
  local aim = target.player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection")
  if typeof(aim) ~= "Vector3" or aim.Magnitude < 0.001 then
    aim = target.root.CFrame.LookVector
  end
  if aim.Magnitude < 0.001 then
    return false
  end
  local reach = Geometry.stats(target.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")).reach or 3
  local distance = boxes.Hit(eye, aim.Unit, snap.root.Position, snap.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking"), units.toWorld(reach))
  if not distance then
    return false
  end
  local obstruction = world:Raycast(eye, aim.Unit * distance, params(snap, true))
  return not obstruction or obstruction.Distance >= distance - units.toWorld(1 / 320)
end
function Geometry.aerialMace(snap, target)
  if Geometry.stats(target.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")).type ~= "mace" then
    return false
  end
  local floor = world:Raycast(target.root.Position, units.offset(0, -3.75, 0), params(snap, true))
  return target.character:GetAttribute("VoxelGrounded") ~= true and (not floor or units.toBlocks(target.root.Position.Y - snap.root.Position.Y) > 2.5)
end
local function clearance(snap)
  local ray, room = params(snap, true), 1.3
  local feet = snap.root.Position - units.offset(0, 1.25, 0)
  for _, offset in ipairs({ Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0.28, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-0.28, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.28), Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.28) }) do
    local top = feet + units.toWorld(offset + Vector3.new(0, 1.9, 0))
    local hit = world:Raycast(top, units.offset(0, 1.36, 0), ray)
    if hit then
      room = math.min(room, math.max(0, units.toBlocks(hit.Distance) - 0.06))
    end
  end
  return room
end
function Geometry.headroom(snap) return clearance(snap) >= 1.3 - 1 / 320 end
function Geometry.criticalWindow(snap)
  local room = clearance(snap)
  if room < 3 / 64 then
    return nil
  end
  -- Under a low ceiling, charge first: the head collision creates a much shorter fall window.
  return room >= 1.3 - 1 / 320 and 0.28 or 0
end
function Geometry.jumpRisk(snap)
  local crystals, seen = game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("EndCrystal"), {}
  local folder = world:FindFirstChild("EndCrystals")
  if folder then
    for _, value in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
      crystals[#crystals + 1] = value
    end
  end
  local ray = params(snap, true)
  local ignored = ray.FilterDescendantsInstances
  for _, value in ipairs(crystals) do
    ignored[#ignored + 1] = value
  end
  ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
  local origins = {}
  for _, crystal in ipairs(crystals) do
    local feet = crystal:GetAttribute("CrystalFeet")
    if crystal.Parent and typeof(feet) == "Vector3" and not seen[crystal] then
      seen[crystal] = true
      origins[#origins + 1] = units.toBlocks(feet)
    end
  end
  local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
  overlap.FilterType, overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, ignored
  for _, block in ipairs(world:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(snap.root.Position), units.offset(5, 6, 5), overlap)) do
    local key = string.lower(tostring(block:GetAttribute("BlockKey") or block.Name))
    if key == "obsidian" then
      local top = block.Position + Vector3.new(0, block.Size.Y / 2, 0)
      if not world:Raycast(top + units.offset(0, 1 / 64, 0), units.offset(0, 2, 0), ray) then
        origins[#origins + 1] = units.toBlocks(top)
      end
    end
  end
  local start = units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position) - Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0)
  local motion = units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
  for _, origin in ipairs(origins) do
    local height, vy = 0, 8.4
    for tick = 0, 12 do
      local predicted = start + motion * (tick * 0.05) + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
      local delta = predicted - origin
      -- Local estimate only: the server's maximum-damage formula is absent from the dump.
      if delta.Y >= -1 / 64 and delta.Y <= 2 and math.abs(delta.X) <= 1.3 and math.abs(delta.Z) <= 1.3 then
        local exposed = true
        for _, y in ipairs({ 3 / 64, 1, 1.95 }) do
          local from = origin + Vector3.new(0, 1 / 64, 0)
          if world:Raycast(units.toWorld(from), units.toWorld(predicted + Vector3.new(0, y, 0) - from), ray) then
            exposed = false
            break
          end
        end
        if exposed then
          return true
        end
      end
      height += vy * 0.05
      vy = (vy - 1.6) * 0.98
      if height < 0 then
        break
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
Geometry.__contract = {
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "stats",
    "allowed",
    "eye",
    "grounded",
    "falling",
    "visible",
    "point",
    "hit",
    "direction",
    "incoming",
    "aerialMace",
    "jumpRisk",
    "headroom",
    "criticalWindow",
    "melee",
    "blocking",
  },
  requires = { Units = "mcpunits", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Units = { "toWorld", "toBlocks", "offset" }, Utils = { "getWorkspace" } },
}
return Geometry

-- [[ mcpmotion ]]
--!optimize 2
local Motion = {}
local units, collision, surface
local STEP, AIR_DRAG, VERTICAL_DRAG = 0.05, 0.91, 0.98
local FLAT = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
local function finite(vector)
  return typeof(vector) == "Vector3" and vector.X == vector.X and vector.Y == vector.Y and vector.Z == vector.Z and vector.Magnitude < 512
end
local function mode(character)
  if character:GetAttribute("Gliding") == true or character:GetAttribute("InCobweb") == true then
    return "controlled"
  end
  if character:GetAttribute("LocalInWater") == true or character:GetAttribute("InWater") == true or character:GetAttribute("InLava") == true then
    return "controlled"
  end
  return "normal"
end
function Motion.setup(deps)
  units = deps.Units
  local function library(name)
    local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild(name)
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
    return ok and type(value) == "table" and value or nil
  end
  collision, surface = library("VoxelBlockCollision"), library("VoxelSurface")
  if collision and (type(collision.Collect) ~= "function" or type(collision.Resolve) ~= "function" or type(collision.Support) ~= "function") then
    collision = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Motion.sample(root, character, now, previous)
  local position = units.toBlocks(root.Position)
  local reported = units.toBlocks(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
  if not finite(reported) then
    reported = Vector3.zero
  end
  local teleport, epoch = character:GetAttribute("PearlTeleportAt"), character:GetAttribute("MovementCorrectionEpoch")
  if not previous or previous.character ~= character then
    return {
      character = character,
      position = position,
      velocity = reported,
      reported = reported,
      control = Vector3.zero,
      acceleration = Vector3.zero,
      at = now,
      revision = 0,
      teleport = teleport,
      epoch = epoch,
      mode = mode(character),
    }
  end
  local elapsed = now - previous.at
  local changed = (reported - previous.reported).Magnitude > 3
  if elapsed < 0.04 and not changed then
    return previous
  end
  if elapsed <= 0 then
    return previous
  end
  local offset = position - previous.position
  local discontinuity = teleport ~= previous.teleport
    or epoch ~= previous.epoch
    or offset.Magnitude > math.max(4, (reported.Magnitude + previous.velocity.Magnitude) * elapsed * 2 + 0.75)
  if discontinuity or elapsed > 0.35 then
    return Motion.sample(root, character, now, nil)
  end
  if offset.Magnitude < 0.001 and not changed and reported.Magnitude > 0.1 then
    return previous
  end
  local observed = offset / elapsed
  local velocity = reported.Magnitude > 0.1 and reported or (finite(observed) and observed or reported)
  -- Prefer fresh positional evidence when a turn arrives before its velocity packet.
  if
    finite(observed)
    and observed.Magnitude > 1
    and reported.Magnitude > 0.1
    and observed.Unit:Dot(reported.Unit) < 0.6
    and (observed - reported).Magnitude > 4
  then
    velocity = observed
  end
  if changed then
    velocity = reported
  end
  local flat, old = velocity * FLAT, previous.velocity * FLAT
  local damping = (previous.grounded and (previous.groundDrag or 0.546) or AIR_DRAG) ^ (elapsed / STEP)
  local expectedY = -78.4 + (previous.velocity.Y + 78.4) * VERTICAL_DRAG ^ (elapsed / STEP)
  local impulse = (flat - (previous.control + (old - previous.control) * damping)).Magnitude > 3 or math.abs(velocity.Y - expectedY) > 3
  local control = previous.control
  if not impulse and damping < 0.999 then
    local inferred = (flat - old * damping) / (1 - damping)
    local limit = math.max(8, flat.Magnitude, old.Magnitude, control.Magnitude)
    if inferred.Magnitude > limit then
      inferred = inferred.Unit * limit
    end
    control = previous.ready and control:Lerp(inferred, 0.5) or inferred
  end
  if flat.Magnitude < 0.15 and (observed * FLAT).Magnitude < 0.5 then
    control = Vector3.zero
  elseif flat:Dot(old) < 0 and flat.Magnitude <= math.max(1, old.Magnitude) * 2 then
    control = flat
  end
  local acceleration = (velocity - previous.velocity) / elapsed
  if acceleration.Magnitude > 64 then
    acceleration = acceleration.Unit * 64
  end
  return {
    character = character,
    position = position,
    velocity = velocity,
    reported = reported,
    control = control,
    acceleration = acceleration,
    at = now,
    revision = previous.revision + 1,
    ready = true,
    teleport = teleport,
    epoch = epoch,
    grounded = previous.grounded,
    groundDrag = previous.groundDrag,
    mode = mode(character),
  }
end
function Motion.actor(root, character, sample, latency, params, detailed)
  local position = units.toBlocks(root.Position)
  local velocity = sample and sample.velocity or units.toBlocks(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
  if not finite(velocity) then
    velocity = Vector3.zero
  end
  local control = sample and sample.control or (velocity.Magnitude <= 8 and velocity * FLAT or Vector3.zero)
  local acceleration = sample and sample.acceleration or Vector3.zero
  local movementMode = sample and sample.mode or mode(character)
  local grounded = character:GetAttribute("VoxelGrounded") == true and math.abs(velocity.Y) < 0.5
  local overlap
  if detailed then
    overlap = OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType, overlap.RespectCanCollide, overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, params.FilterDescendantsInstances
    if collision then
      local boxes = collision.Collect(workspace, units.toWorld(position), Vector3.zero, overlap)
      grounded = velocity.Y <= 0.5 and collision.Support(units.toWorld(position), boxes, units.toWorld(0.04)) ~= nil
    else
      local feet = units.toWorld(position - Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0))
      grounded = velocity.Y <= 0.5 and workspace:Raycast(feet, units.offset(0, -0.12, 0), params) ~= nil
    end
    if sample then
      sample.grounded = grounded
      if grounded and surface and type(surface.Ground) == "function" and type(surface.Under) == "function" then
        sample.groundDrag = surface.Ground(surface.Under(workspace, root.Position, units.toWorld(1.25), params))
      end
    end
  end
  local points, ticks = { position }, 0
  local function step()
    local movement, groundDrag = velocity * STEP, 0.546
    if detailed and collision then
      local worldPosition, worldMovement = units.toWorld(position), units.toWorld(movement)
      local boxes = collision.Collect(workspace, worldPosition, worldMovement, overlap)
      if grounded and surface and type(surface.Ground) == "function" and type(surface.Under) == "function" then
        groundDrag = surface.Ground(surface.Under(workspace, worldPosition, units.toWorld(1.25), params))
      end
      local resolved, flags = collision.Resolve(
        worldPosition,
        worldMovement,
        boxes,
        grounded or velocity.Y < 0,
        grounded and movement.Y <= 0 and character:GetAttribute("Sneaking") == true
      )
      position += units.toBlocks(resolved)
      velocity = Vector3.new(flags.x and 0 or velocity.X, flags.y and 0 or velocity.Y, flags.z and 0 or velocity.Z)
      grounded = flags.grounded == true
    elseif detailed then
      local hit =
        workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(units.toWorld(position + Vector3.new(0, -0.35, 0))), units.offset(0.58, 1.78, 0.58), units.toWorld(movement), params)
      if hit and movement.Magnitude > 1e-6 then
        position += movement * math.max(0, (units.toBlocks(hit.Distance) - 1 / 320) / movement.Magnitude)
        local normal = hit.Normal
        velocity -= normal * velocity:Dot(normal)
        grounded = movement.Y <= 0 and normal.Y > 0.65
      else
        position += movement
        grounded = false
      end
    else
      position += movement
    end
    if movementMode == "controlled" then
      -- Sustained non-ballistic motion follows measured acceleration, not an invented jump.
      velocity += acceleration * (STEP * 0.85 ^ ticks)
    else
      local horizontal = control + (velocity * FLAT - control) * (grounded and groundDrag or AIR_DRAG)
      -- Same move -> (vy - 1.6) * 0.98 tick used by VoxelAirMovement, in blocks.
      velocity = horizontal + Vector3.new(0, grounded and 0 or (velocity.Y - 1.6) * VERTICAL_DRAG, 0)
    end
    ticks += 1
    points[ticks + 1] = position
  end
  return {
    crouch = character:GetAttribute("Sneaking"),
    predict = function(time)
      local elapsed = math.max(0, time + latency)
      local tick = math.floor(elapsed / STEP)
      while ticks <= tick do
        step()
      end
      return points[tick + 1]:Lerp(points[tick + 2], (elapsed - tick * STEP) / STEP)
    end,
  }
end
Motion.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "sample", "actor" },
  requires = { Units = "mcpunits" },
  requiresMethods = { Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset" } },
}
return Motion

-- [[ mcpunits ]]
--!optimize 2
local Units = {}
local scale = 3.2
function Units.setup()
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("VoxelWeapons")
  local ok, weapons = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  local block = ok and type(weapons) == "table" and weapons.Block
  scale = type(block) == "number" and block == block and block > 0 and block < math.huge and block or 3.2
  return true
end
-- Numbers and Vector3s retain fractional blocks; no grid rounding belongs here.
function Units.toBlocks(worldValue) return worldValue / scale end
function Units.toWorld(blockValue) return blockValue * scale end
function Units.offset(x, y, z) return Vector3.new(x, y, z) * scale end
function Units.distance(worldA, worldB) return (worldA - worldB).Magnitude / scale end
Units.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset", "distance" }, requires = {} }
return Units
