-- [[ gameruntime ]]
--!optimize 2
local Runtime = {}
local modules, scope, owner
function Runtime.setup() return true end
function Runtime.reset()
  if not modules then
    return
  end
  modules.mcpmelee.reset()
  modules.autopearl.reset()
  modules.mcptarget.reset()
  modules.mcpaim.reset()
  modules.mcpsurvival.reset()
end
function Runtime.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  if modules then
    Runtime.reset()
    modules.mcpsupplies.reset()
    modules.mcpnative.teardown()
  end
  modules, owner = nil, nil
end
function Runtime.bind(loaded)
  Runtime.teardown()
  modules, scope = loaded, loaded.lifetime.scope()
  local native, target, melee, pearl, supplies, aim, survival =
    loaded.mcpnative, loaded.mcptarget, loaded.mcpmelee, loaded.autopearl, loaded.mcpsupplies, loaded.mcpaim, loaded.mcpsurvival
  local function run(name, fn, ...)
    local ok, reason = pcall(fn, ...)
    if not ok then
      if name == "pearl" then
        pearl.reset()
      elseif name == "melee" then
        melee.reset()
      elseif name == "aim" then
        aim.reset()
      else
        Runtime.reset()
        supplies.reset()
      end
      loaded.utils.recordError("mcpvp." .. name, tostring(reason))
    end
  end
  local characterScope
  local function synchronize(snap)
    if owner == snap.character then
      return
    end
    Runtime.reset()
    supplies.reset()
    native.reset()
    owner = snap.character
    if characterScope then
      characterScope.destroy()
    end
    characterScope = loaded.lifetime.scope()
    for _, attribute in ipairs({ "OffhandItem", "TotemPoppedAt" }) do
      characterScope.connect(owner:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute), function()
        run("supplies", function()
          local current = loaded.utils.isActive() and native.snapshot()
          if current and current.character == owner then
            supplies.step(current, not pearl.busy() and not survival.busy())
          end
        end)
      end)
    end
  end
  scope.add(function()
    if characterScope then
      characterScope.destroy()
      characterScope = nil
    end
  end)
  local function snapshot()
    if not loaded.utils.isActive() then
      return nil
    end
    local snap = native.snapshot()
    if snap then
      synchronize(snap)
    end
    return snap
  end
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ControllerInput")
  local ok, controller = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  if not ok then
    controller = nil
  end
  local input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  local function gate(snap, direction)
    if not loaded.utils.isActive() then
      return true
    end
    if survival.busy() or pearl.busy() or supplies.busy() then
      -- Item automation must never swallow the player's own native input.
      return true
    end
    if native.blocked(snap) then
      return true
    end
    synchronize(snap)
    local chosen
    if controller and controller.IsHeld("Attack") then
      chosen = target.manual(snap, direction)
    else
      chosen = target.near(snap)
      direction = direction or snap.player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection") or snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
      if chosen and not loaded.mcpgeometry.hit(snap, chosen, snap.tool, direction) then
        chosen = nil
      end
    end
    return not melee.request(snap, chosen)
  end
  if controller and type(controller.BeginTouch) == "function" then
    local original, lifetime = controller.BeginTouch, scope
    local function begin(action)
      if lifetime.alive and action == "Attack" and not native.isDispatching() then
        run("input", function()
          local snap = snapshot()
          if snap then
            target.manual(snap)
          end
        end)
      end
      return original(action)
    end
    controller.BeginTouch = begin
    scope.add(function()
      if controller.BeginTouch == begin then
        controller.BeginTouch = original
      end
    end)
  end
  local warned = false
  scope.connect(controller and controller.InputBegan or input.InputBegan, function(event, processed)
    run("input", function()
      if processed or native.isDispatching() or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then
        return
      end
      local attack = controller and controller.Matches(event, "Attack") or not controller and event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      if not attack then
        return
      end
      local snap = snapshot()
      if not snap then
        return
      end
      target.manual(snap)
      if loaded.utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit") and not native.gate(gate) and not warned then
        warned = true
        loaded.utils.recordError("mcpvp.manual", "O executor não permite adiar o clique nativo para o crítico manual.")
      end
    end)
  end)
  local remotes, scanAt = {}, 0
  local function bindRemote(folderName, name, callback)
    local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild(folderName)
    local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
    local old = remotes[name]
    if old and old.remote == remote then
      return
    end
    if old then
      old.connection:Disconnect()
      remotes[name] = nil
    end
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      remotes[name] = { remote = remote, connection = scope.connect(remote.OnClientEvent, function(...) run(name, callback, ...) end) }
    end
  end
  native.gate(gate)
  local service = game:GetService("RunService")
  scope.connect(service.PreSimulation, function()
    run("frame", function()
      local snap = snapshot()
      if not snap then
        if owner then
          Runtime.reset()
          supplies.reset()
          owner = nil
        end
        return
      end
      if snap.now >= scanAt then
        scanAt = snap.now + 1
        native.gate(gate)
        bindRemote("VoxelCombat", "Swing", target.noteSwing)
        bindRemote("VoxelCombat", "Feedback", function(kind, blocked)
          if kind == "HitConfirm" and not blocked then
            target.hit(os.clock())
          end
        end)
        bindRemote("Remotes", "ItemAction", pearl.projectile)
      end
      target.observe(snap)
      if pearl.observe(snap) then
        snap = native.snapshot()
        if not snap then
          return
        end
      end
      local surviving = survival.step(snap, not supplies.busy() and not native.busy())
      supplies.step(snap, not pearl.busy() and not surviving)
      if surviving or supplies.busy() or native.blocked(snap) then
        melee.reset()
        return
      end
      run("pearl", pearl.prepare, snap)
      if pearl.busy() or native.busy() then
        melee.reset()
        return
      end
      snap = native.snapshot()
      if snap then
        run("melee", melee.prepare, snap)
      end
    end)
  end)
  scope.connect(service.PostSimulation, function()
    run("melee", function()
      local snap = snapshot()
      if not snap or survival.busy() or supplies.busy() or pearl.busy() or native.busy() then
        return
      end
      melee.strike(snap)
    end)
  end)
  local binding = "ExodusMCPAim_" .. tostring(scope)
  scope.add(function() service:UnbindFromRenderStep(binding) end)
  service:BindToRenderStep(binding, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
    loaded.mcpinventory.present()
    run("aim", function()
      local snap = snapshot()
      if snap then
        target.observeView(snap)
        survival.move(snap)
        if not supplies.busy() and not native.blocked(snap) then
          local aimingPearl = pearl.aim(snap, dt)
          if not aimingPearl and not pearl.busy() and not survival.busy() then
            aim.step(snap, target.near(snap), dt)
          end
        end
        aim.observe(snap)
      end
    end)
  end)
  return { mode = "mcpvp" }
end
function Runtime.createAPI(loaded)
  return {
    getUIConfig = function() return loaded.gameui.definition end,
    resetState = Runtime.reset,
    controls = {
      onStopPvP = Runtime.reset,
      onThrowPearl = function()
        local snap = loaded.utils.isActive() and loaded.mcpnative.snapshot()
        if not snap then
          return false, "Personagem indisponível."
        end
        if loaded.mcpsupplies.busy() or loaded.mcpsurvival.busy() or loaded.mcpnative.blocked(snap) then
          return false, "Aguarde a ação atual terminar."
        end
        return loaded.autopearl.throw(snap)
      end,
    },
    updateBlockers = { loaded.autopearl.pending, loaded.mcpsupplies.busy, loaded.mcpsurvival.busy, loaded.mcpnative.busy },
    migrateConfig = loaded.mcpoptions.migrateConfig,
  }
end
Runtime.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "reset", "teardown", "bind", "createAPI" }, requires = {} }
return Runtime

-- [[ mcpbridge ]]
--!optimize 2
local Bridge = {}
local utils, owner, nextScan = nil, nil, 0
local functions = {}
local names = {
  VoxelCombatClient = { performAttack = "attack" },
  ItemClient = { use = "use" },
  VoxelPackHUD = { refreshTools = "refresh", setOpen = "open", selectSlot = "select" },
}
function Bridge.setup(deps)
  utils = deps.Utils
  return true
end
local function inputFunction(key, scripts, env)
  if type(env.getconnections) ~= "function" then
    return nil
  end
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ControllerInput")
  local ok, controller = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  if not ok or type(controller) ~= "table" or not controller.InputBegan then
    return nil
  end
  local connected, connections = pcall(env.getconnections, controller.InputBegan)
  if not connected or type(connections) ~= "table" then
    return nil
  end
  for _, connection in pairs(connections) do
    local readable, listener = pcall(function() return connection.Function end)
    if not readable or type(listener) ~= "function" then
      continue
    end
    local scoped, environment = pcall(getfenv, listener)
    local script = scoped and environment and environment.script
    if typeof(script) ~= "Instance" or script.Parent ~= scripts or not names[script.Name] then
      continue
    end
    local values = Bridge.upvalues(listener)
    if values then
      for _, fn in pairs(values) do
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
          continue
        end
        local named, name = pcall(debug.info, fn, "n")
        if named and names[script.Name][name] == key then
          return { fn = fn, source = script }
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Bridge.get(key)
  local scripts = utils.getLocalPlayer():FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
  if scripts ~= owner then
    owner, functions, nextScan = scripts, {}, 0
  end
  local cached = functions[key]
  if cached and cached.source.Parent == scripts then
    return cached.fn
  end
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  if not scripts then
    return nil
  end
  local linked = inputFunction(key, scripts, env)
  if linked then
    functions[key] = linked
    return linked.fn
  end
  if os.clock() < nextScan or type(env.getgc) ~= "function" then
    return nil
  end
  nextScan = os.clock() + 1
  local ok, objects = pcall(env.getgc, false)
  if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" then
    return nil
  end
  local candidates, references = {}, {}
  for _, fn in pairs(objects) do
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
      continue
    end
    local success, environment = pcall(getfenv, fn)
    local source = success and environment and environment.script
    if typeof(source) ~= "Instance" or source.Parent ~= scripts or not names[source.Name] then
      continue
    end
    local values = Bridge.upvalues(fn)
    if values then
      for _, value in pairs(values) do
        if type(value) == "function" then
          references[value] = (references[value] or 0) + 1
        end
      end
    end
    local named, name = pcall(debug.info, fn, "n")
    local field = named and names[source.Name][name]
    if field then
      candidates[#candidates + 1] = { key = field, fn = fn, source = source }
    end
  end
  for _, entry in ipairs(candidates) do
    local current = functions[entry.key]
    if not current or current.source.Parent ~= scripts or (references[entry.fn] or 0) > (references[current.fn] or 0) then
      functions[entry.key] = entry
    end
  end
  return functions[key] and functions[key].fn
end
function Bridge.upvalues(fn)
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  local getter = env.getupvalues or env.debug and env.debug.getupvalues
  if not fn or type(getter) ~= "function" then
    return nil
  end
  local ok, values = pcall(getter, fn)
  return ok and type(values) == "table" and values or nil
end
function Bridge.teardown()
  owner, functions, nextScan = nil, {}, 0
end
Bridge.__contract =
  { provides = { "setup", "get", "upvalues", "teardown" }, requires = { Utils = "utils" }, requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer" } } }
return Bridge

-- [[ mcpnative ]]
--!optimize 2
local Native = {}
local utils, bridge, geometry, inventory, player, storage, controller, charge
local dispatching, callback, hooked, original, hooker, restoreAim
local lastAttack, lastUse, nextHook = -math.huge, {}, 0
local observed, heldTool, equippedAt = nil, nil, -math.huge
local preferred, expected, holdingUse
local sprintOwner, sprintWasOn, sprintAt
local missingInput = false
local dispatchUntil = 0
local function releaseStaleInput()
  if dispatching and os.clock() >= dispatchUntil then
    if restoreAim then
      restoreAim()
    else
      dispatching = false
    end
  end
end
local function library(name)
  local source = storage:FindFirstChild(name)
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  return ok and type(value) == "table" and value or nil
end
function Native.setup(deps)
  utils, bridge, geometry, inventory = deps.Utils, deps.Bridge, deps.Geometry, deps.Inventory
  player, storage = utils.getLocalPlayer(), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
  controller, charge = library("ControllerInput"), library("HeldItemFov")
  return true
end
function Native.snapshot()
  releaseStaleInput()
  local character = player.Character
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local human = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not root or not human or human.Health <= 0 or not camera or not geometry.allowed(character) then
    return nil
  end
  local tool, now = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool"), os.clock()
  if observed ~= character then
    observed, heldTool, equippedAt = character, tool, -math.huge
    preferred, expected = geometry.stats(tool).type and tool or nil, nil
  elseif heldTool ~= tool then
    if tool and tool ~= expected and geometry.stats(tool).type ~= nil then
      preferred = tool
    end
    heldTool, equippedAt, expected = tool, now, nil
  end
  return { player = player, character = character, root = root, humanoid = human, camera = camera, eye = geometry.eye(root, character), tool = tool, now = now }
end
function Native.blocked(snap)
  releaseStaleInput()
  return dispatching == true
    or (controller and controller.IsBlocked())
    or player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("DrinkingPotion") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("BowDrawStarted")
    or player:GetAttribute("OffhandUsing") == true
    or snap.root.Anchored
end
function Native.find(snap, kind, hotbarOnly)
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    local tool = slots and slots[slot]
    if
      tool
      and tool.Parent
      and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0
      and (geometry.stats(tool).type == kind or tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == kind)
    then
      return tool
    end
  end
  if hotbarOnly then
    return nil
  end
  for _, parent in ipairs({ snap.character, player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") }) do
    for _, tool in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
      if
        tool:IsA("Tool")
        and (geometry.stats(tool).type == kind or tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == kind)
        and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0
      then
        return tool
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Native.equip(snap, tool)
  if not tool or not tool.Parent or (tool.Parent ~= snap.character and tool.Parent ~= player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")) then
    return false
  end
  if dispatching and tool.Parent ~= snap.character then
    return false
  end
  expected = tool
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  if slots then
    for slot = 1, 9 do
      if slots[slot] == tool then
        return inventory.select(snap, slot)
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  return snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") == tool
end
local function selectable(snap, tool)
  if not tool or not tool.Parent or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  if tool.Parent ~= snap.character and tool.Parent ~= player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
    return false
  end
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  if not slots then
    return true
  end
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if slots[slot] == tool then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
function Native.restore(snap, previous, exact)
  if exact then
    if selectable(snap, previous) then
      return Native.equip(snap, previous)
    elseif previous == nil then
      snap.humanoid:UnequipTools()
      return snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") == nil
    end
  end
  local tool = selectable(snap, preferred) and preferred
    or selectable(snap, previous) and geometry.stats(previous).type and previous
    or Native.find(snap, "sword", true)
    or selectable(snap, previous) and previous
  return not tool or Native.equip(snap, tool)
end
function Native.weapon(snap, target)
  local tool = preferred
  if tool and not selectable(snap, tool) then
    tool = nil
  end
  -- A manually selected Density mace suspends ground combos instead of forcing a sword.
  if tool and not geometry.melee(tool) then
    return nil
  end
  tool = tool or (geometry.melee(snap.tool) and snap.tool) or Native.find(snap, "sword", true)
  if target and geometry.blocking(target.character) then
    local slots = inventory.slots()
    for slot = 1, 9 do
      local axe = slots and slots[slot]
      if selectable(snap, axe) and geometry.stats(axe).type == "axe" then
        return axe
      end
    end
  end
  return tool
end
function Native.holdUse(snap, begin)
  if not controller or type(controller.BeginTouch) ~= "function" or type(controller.EndTouch) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  if begin then
    if holdingUse == snap.character then
      return true
    end
    if Native.blocked(snap) then
      return false
    end
    dispatching, dispatchUntil = true, os.clock() + 0.5
    local ok, accepted = pcall(controller.BeginTouch, "Use")
    dispatching = false
    holdingUse = ok and accepted and snap.character or nil
    return holdingUse ~= nil
  end
  if holdingUse then
    pcall(controller.EndTouch, "Use")
    holdingUse = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Native.charge(snap)
  local speed = geometry.stats(snap.tool).speed or 1.6
  local at = math.max(lastAttack, equippedAt, tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalAttackSwing")) or -math.huge)
  local current = math.clamp((snap.now - at) * speed, 0, 1)
  if charge and type(charge.Charge) == "function" then
    local ok, value = pcall(charge.Charge)
    if ok and type(value) == "number" then
      current = math.min(current, math.clamp(value, 0, 1))
    end
  end
  return current
end
function Native.realAim(snap)
  local direction = player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection")
  return typeof(direction) == "Vector3" and direction.Magnitude > 0.001 and direction.Unit or snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
end
local function call(action, snap, direction)
  if Native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local visibleUse = action == "Use" and snap.tool and snap.tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == "Pearl"
  if
    visibleUse
    and (snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(direction) < math.cos(math.rad(0.75)) or Native.realAim(snap):Dot(direction) < math.cos(math.rad(0.75)))
  then
    return false
  end
  local fn = bridge.get(action == "Attack" and "attack" or "use")
  local oldDirection, oldFrame = player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection"), player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame")
  local aimFrame
  local function restore()
    if restoreAim ~= restore then
      return
    end
    -- Release ownership first, even if an attribute restoration fails.
    restoreAim, dispatching = nil, false
    local ok, reason = pcall(function()
      if not visibleUse and player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection") == direction then
        player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection", oldDirection)
      end
      if not visibleUse and aimFrame and player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame") == aimFrame then
        player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame", oldFrame)
      end
    end)
    if not ok then
      utils.recordError("mcpvp.input.restore", tostring(reason))
    end
  end
  restoreAim, dispatching, dispatchUntil = restore, true, os.clock() + 0.5
  local marker = snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalAttackSwing")
  local ok, accepted = pcall(function()
    if not visibleUse then
      aimFrame = CFrame.lookAt(snap.eye, snap.eye + direction)
      player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection", direction)
      player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame", aimFrame)
    end
    if fn then
      return fn(direction) ~= false
    end
    if not controller or type(controller.BeginTouch) ~= "function" or type(controller.EndTouch) ~= "function" then
      if not missingInput then
        utils.recordError("mcpvp.input", "Ataque/uso nativo e ControllerInput indisponíveis.")
        missingInput = true
      end
      return false
    end
    if not controller.BeginTouch(action) then
      return false
    end
    controller.EndTouch(action)
    return true
  end)
  if fn or not ok then
    restore()
  else
    task.defer(restore)
  end
  if not ok then
    utils.recordError("mcpvp.native." .. action, tostring(accepted))
    return false
  end
  if action == "Use" and fn then
    local class = snap.tool and snap.tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")
    local config = library("GameConfig")
    local item = config and config.Items[class]
    local drinking = class == "InvisPotion" or item and item.effect and not item.splash
    -- ItemClient returns nil for both rejection and success. Non-drinking uses
    -- advance LocalAttackSwing only when the native function actually submits Use.
    if not drinking then
      return snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalAttackSwing") ~= marker
    end
  end
  return accepted == true
end
function Native.useState(snap, action, effect)
  if action.character ~= snap.character then
    return false
  end
  local tool = action.tool
  if not tool.Parent or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or action.count) < action.count then
    return true
  end
  if effect and (tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Effect_" .. effect)) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
    return true
  end
  -- Expiry is cancellation, never a fabricated consumption confirmation.
  if snap.now - action.requestAt >= 3 then
    return false
  end
  return nil
end
function Native.attack(snap, target, direction)
  if snap.now - lastAttack < 1 / 7 or Native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  direction = direction or geometry.direction(snap, target, snap.tool)
  if not direction then
    return false
  end
  lastAttack = snap.now
  return call("Attack", snap, direction)
end
function Native.use(snap, tool, direction)
  local class = tool and tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")
  if type(class) ~= "string" or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 0) < 1 or not Native.equip(snap, tool) or Native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local config = library("GameConfig")
  local cooldown = config and config.Items[class] and config.Items[class].cooldown or 0.36
  if snap.now - (lastUse[class] or -math.huge) < cooldown then
    return false
  end
  if (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("ItemCooldown_" .. class)) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
    return false
  end
  snap.tool = tool
  local sent = call("Use", snap, direction)
  if sent then
    lastUse[class] = snap.now
  end
  return sent
end
function Native.jump(snap)
  if Native.blocked(snap) or snap.humanoid.Sit or snap.humanoid.PlatformStand then
    return false
  end
  snap.humanoid.Jump = true
  snap.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
  return true
end
function Native.sprint(snap, stop, force)
  local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("VoxelCombat")
  local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Sprint")
  if not remote then
    return
  end
  if stop then
    if sprintOwner ~= snap.character then
      sprintOwner, sprintWasOn = snap.character, snap.character:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true or snap.character:GetAttribute("SprintRequested") == true
    end
    if force or snap.now >= (sprintAt or 0) then
      remote:FireServer(false)
      sprintAt = snap.now + 0.08
    end
  elseif sprintOwner then
    if
      sprintOwner == snap.character
      and sprintWasOn
      and player:GetAttribute("SprintToggleEnabled") == true
      and snap.humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
    then
      remote:FireServer(true)
    end
    sprintOwner, sprintWasOn, sprintAt = nil, nil, nil
  end
end
function Native.gate(fn)
  callback = fn
  if hooked or not fn or os.clock() < nextHook then
    return hooked ~= nil
  end
  nextHook = os.clock() + 1
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  local attack = bridge.get("attack")
  if not attack or type(env.hookfunction) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  local previous
  local ok, value = pcall(env.hookfunction, attack, function(direction)
    if dispatching or not callback then
      return previous(direction)
    end
    local snap = Native.snapshot()
    if not snap then
      return previous(direction)
    end
    local success, allow = pcall(callback, snap, direction)
    if not success then
      utils.recordError("mcpvp.manual", tostring(allow))
      return previous(direction)
    end
    if allow then
      return previous(direction)
    end
  end)
  if ok and type(value) == "function" then
    previous, original, hooked, hooker = value, value, attack, env.hookfunction
  end
  return hooked ~= nil
end
function Native.isDispatching() return dispatching == true end
function Native.busy()
  releaseStaleInput()
  return dispatching == true
end
function Native.reset()
  Native.holdUse(nil, false)
  preferred, expected = nil, nil
  if restoreAim then
    restoreAim()
  end
  local snap = Native.snapshot()
  if snap then
    Native.sprint(snap, false)
  end
  lastAttack, lastUse, observed, heldTool, equippedAt = -math.huge, {}, nil, nil, -math.huge
end
function Native.teardown()
  callback = nil
  if hooked and original and hooker then
    pcall(hooker, hooked, original)
  end
  hooked, original, hooker = nil, nil, nil
  Native.reset()
end
Native.__contract = {
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "snapshot",
    "blocked",
    "find",
    "equip",
    "charge",
    "weapon",
    "restore",
    "holdUse",
    "attack",
    "use",
    "useState",
    "realAim",
    "jump",
    "sprint",
    "gate",

-- [[ mcpinventory ]]
--!optimize 2
local Inventory = {}
local utils, bridge, cachedFn, values, lease, pending
local retryAt, nextToggle = 0, 0
local controller
function Inventory.setup(deps)
  utils, bridge = deps.Utils, deps.Bridge
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ControllerInput")
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  controller = ok and value or nil
  return true
end
local function owned(tool)
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  return typeof(tool) == "Instance"
    and tool:IsA("Tool")
    and (tool.Parent == player.Character or tool.Parent == player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
    and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0
end
function Inventory.slots()
  local fn = bridge.get("refresh")
  if fn ~= cachedFn then
    cachedFn, values = fn, nil
  end
  if values then
    return values
  end
  local upvalues = bridge.upvalues(fn)
  if not upvalues then
    return nil
  end
  for _, value in pairs(upvalues) do
    if type(value) ~= "table" or getmetatable(value) ~= nil then
      continue
    end
    local valid, count = true, 0
    for slot, tool in pairs(value) do
      if type(slot) ~= "number" or slot % 1 ~= 0 or slot < 1 or slot > 36 or typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
        valid = false
        break
      end
      count += 1
    end
    if valid and count > 0 then
      values = value
      return value
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Inventory.find(kind, first, last)
  local slots = Inventory.slots()
  if slots then
    for slot = first or 1, last or 36 do
      local tool = slots[slot]
      if owned(tool) and tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == kind then
        return tool, slot
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Inventory.select(snap, slot)
  local slots, select = Inventory.slots(), bridge.get("select")
  local tool = slots and slots[slot]
  if not owned(tool) or slot < 1 or slot > 9 then
    return false
  end
  if select then
    pcall(select, slot)
  end
  snap.tool = snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  if snap.tool == tool then
    return true
  end
  -- EquipTool is a fallback only for an item already proved to be in the hotbar.
  if slots[slot] ~= tool or not owned(tool) then
    return false
  end
  pcall(snap.humanoid.EquipTool, snap.humanoid, tool)
  snap.tool = snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  return snap.tool == tool
end
local function visible()
  local gui = utils.getLocalPlayer():FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  local hud = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("VoxelPackHUD")
  local panel = hud and hud:FindFirstChild("Inventory", true)
  if not panel or not panel:IsA("GuiObject") or panel.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 or panel.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  local ancestor = panel
  while ancestor and ancestor ~= gui do
    if ancestor:IsA("GuiObject") and not ancestor.Visible or ancestor:IsA("ScreenGui") and not ancestor.Enabled then
      return false
    end
    ancestor = ancestor.Parent
  end
  return ancestor == gui
end
local function setOpen(value)
  local function matches() return visible() == value and (utils.getLocalPlayer():GetAttribute("MenuOpen") == true) == value end
  if matches() then
    return true
  end
  local fn = bridge.get("open")
  if fn then
    pcall(fn, value)
  end
  if matches() then
    return true
  end
  -- Use the real inventory binding when direct access is unavailable.
  if controller and type(controller.BeginTouch) == "function" and type(controller.EndTouch) == "function" and os.clock() >= nextToggle then
    nextToggle = os.clock() + 0.2
    pcall(function()
      if controller.BeginTouch("Inventory") then
        controller.EndTouch("Inventory")
      end
    end)
  end
  return matches()
end
function Inventory.open(snap)
  if lease and lease.character ~= snap.character then
    Inventory.reset()
  end
  if snap.now < retryAt or not visible() and snap.player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") then
    return false
  end
  if not lease then
    lease = { character = snap.character, owned = not visible(), frames = 0, deadline = snap.now + 3 }
  end
  lease.closeRequested = nil
  if not visible() then
    lease.frames, lease.visibleAt = 0, nil
    setOpen(true)
  end
  return visible() and snap.player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") == true and lease.frames >= 2 and lease.visibleAt ~= nil and snap.now - lease.visibleAt >= 0.12
end
function Inventory.present()
  if lease and visible() then
    lease.frames += 1
    lease.visibleAt = lease.visibleAt or os.clock()
  end
end
function Inventory.close(force)
  if not lease then
    return true
  end
  if lease.owned then
    if not force and lease.visibleAt and os.clock() - lease.visibleAt < 0.3 then
      lease.closeRequested = true
      return false
    end
    if not setOpen(false) then
      lease.closeRequested = true
      return false
    end
  end
  lease = nil
  return true
end
function Inventory.move(snap, tool, from, to)
  local slots = Inventory.slots()
  if not slots or not owned(tool) or slots[from] ~= tool or to < 1 or to > 9 or owned(slots[to]) or not Inventory.open(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local previous = slots[to]
  slots[from], slots[to] = previous, tool
  if not pcall(cachedFn) then
    slots[from], slots[to] = tool, previous
    return false
  end
  return slots[to] == tool
end
local function restoreHand(snap, operation)
  if operation.hand and operation.previous and (not snap.tool or snap.tool == operation.tool) then
    local slots = Inventory.slots()
    for slot = 1, 9 do
      if slots and slots[slot] == operation.previous then
        Inventory.select(snap, slot)
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
function Inventory.step(snap)
  if lease then
    if lease.character ~= snap.character or snap.now >= lease.deadline then
      Inventory.close(true)
      retryAt = snap.now + 1
    elseif lease.closeRequested then
      Inventory.close()
    end
  end
  if not pending then
    return
  end
  if pending.character ~= snap.character then
    pending = nil
    return
  end
  local consumed = not owned(pending.tool) or (tonumber(pending.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 0) < pending.count
  local popped = snap.character:GetAttribute("TotemPoppedAt")
  local confirmed = consumed and (snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" or popped ~= nil and popped ~= pending.pop)
    or pending.done and pending.accepted and snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem"
  if confirmed or pending.done and not pending.accepted then
    restoreHand(snap, pending)
    pending, retryAt = nil, confirmed and 0 or snap.now + 1
  elseif snap.now - pending.at >= 3 then
    if not pending.expired then
      pending.expired = true
      restoreHand(snap, pending)
      Inventory.close(true)
    end
    -- A yielding RPC may finish later; don't launch a duplicate while it is outstanding.
    if pending.done then
      pending, retryAt = nil, snap.now + 1
    end
  end
end
function Inventory.totem(snap)
  Inventory.step(snap)
  if pending then
    if pending.expired then
      return nil
    end
    return false
  end
  if snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" then
    return true
  end
  if snap.now < retryAt then
    return false
  end
  local tool, slot = Inventory.find("Totem")
  if not tool then
    return false
  end
  local previous = snap.tool
  if slot <= 9 then
    if not Inventory.select(snap, slot) then
      return false
    end
  elseif not Inventory.open(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
  local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("InventoryAction")
  if not remote then
    return false
  end
  local operation = {
    tool = tool,
    character = snap.character,
    count = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1,
    pop = snap.character:GetAttribute("TotemPoppedAt"),
    hand = slot <= 9,
    previous = previous,
    at = snap.now,
  }
  pending = operation
  task.spawn(function()
    -- Never send a reserve transfer if the inventory closed before dispatch.
    if utils.getLocalPlayer().Character ~= operation.character or not operation.hand and not visible() then
      operation.done, operation.accepted = true, false
      return
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "EquipOffhand", tool)
    operation.done, operation.accepted = true, ok and result ~= nil and result ~= false
    if operation.accepted and utils.getLocalPlayer().Character == operation.character and cachedFn then
      pcall(cachedFn)
    end
  end)
  return false
end
function Inventory.busy() return lease ~= nil or pending ~= nil and pending.hand and not pending.expired end
function Inventory.reset()
  Inventory.close(true)
  if pending and pending.character ~= utils.getLocalPlayer().Character then
    pending = nil
  end
  retryAt = 0
end
function Inventory.teardown()
  Inventory.reset()
  cachedFn, values = nil, nil
end
Inventory.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "slots", "find", "select", "open", "present", "close", "move", "step", "totem", "busy", "reset", "teardown" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Bridge = "mcpbridge" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer" }, Bridge = { "get", "upvalues" } },
}
return Inventory

-- [[ mcpsupplies ]]
--!optimize 2
local Supplies = {}
local inventory, native, utils
local owner, layout, seen, potion, awaiting = nil, {}, {}, nil, {}
local effects = { { key = "MCAutoStrength", class = "StrengthPotion", effect = "strength" }, { key = "MCAutoSpeed", class = "SpeedPotion", effect = "speed" } }
local function enabled(key) return utils.getConfigValue(key) == true end
local function alive(tool) return tool and tool.Parent and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0 end
local function identity(tool)
  return alive(tool) and tool.Name .. "|" .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")) .. "|" .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("BlockKey")) or nil
end
local function destination(slots, wanted)
  -- An exhausted stack still owns its slot. Backup items cannot claim it.
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(slots[slot]) and wanted and layout[slot] == wanted then
      return slot
    end
  end
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(slots[slot]) and not layout[slot] then
      return slot
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Supplies.setup(deps)
  inventory, native, utils = deps.Inventory, deps.Native, deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Supplies.reset()
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  if potion and snap and potion.character == snap.character then
    return
  end
  owner, layout, seen, potion, awaiting = nil, {}, {}, nil, {}
  inventory.reset()
end
function Supplies.busy() return inventory.busy() or potion ~= nil end
local function finish(snap)
  if not inventory.close() then
    return
  end
  native.restore(snap, potion.previous)
  awaiting[potion.effect] = snap.now + (potion.confirmed and 0.5 or 1)
  potion = nil
end
local function servicePotion(snap, slots)
  if potion.character ~= snap.character then
    potion = nil
    return
  end
  if potion.phase == "confirm" then
    local state = native.useState(snap, potion, potion.effect)
    if state == nil then
      return
    end
    potion.confirmed, potion.phase = state, "cleanup"
  end
  if potion.phase == "cleanup" then
    potion.cleanupAt = potion.cleanupAt or snap.now
    if snap.now - potion.cleanupAt > 3 then
      inventory.close(true)
      native.restore(snap, potion.previous)
      awaiting[potion.effect] = snap.now + 2
      potion = nil
      return
    end
    finish(snap)
    return
  end
  local inHotbar = false
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if slots[slot] == potion.tool then
      inHotbar = true
      break
    end
  end
  if snap.now - potion.at > 4 or not alive(potion.tool) or not inHotbar then
    potion.phase = "cleanup"
    return
  end
  if not inventory.close() or native.blocked(snap) then
    return
  end
  if native.equip(snap, potion.tool) then
    potion.count, potion.requestAt = tonumber(potion.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1, snap.now
    if native.use(snap, potion.tool, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) then
      potion.phase = "confirm"
    end
  end
end
local function refill(snap, slots)
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(slots[slot]) and layout[slot] then
      for from = 10, 36 do
        local tool = slots[from]
        if identity(tool) == layout[slot] then
          if not inventory.move(snap, tool, from, slot) then
            return false
          end
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function beginPotion(snap, slots, effect, tool)
  potion = {
    character = snap.character,
    tool = tool,
    effect = effect.effect,
    previous = snap.tool,
    at = snap.now,
    phase = "use",
  }
  servicePotion(snap, slots)
  return true
end
function Supplies.step(snap, allowBackground)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    owner, layout, seen, potion, awaiting = snap.character, {}, {}, nil, {}
    inventory.reset()
  end
  inventory.step(snap)
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  if not slots then
    if potion and snap.now - potion.at > 4 then
      inventory.close(true)
      native.restore(snap, potion.previous)
      potion = nil
    end
    return
  end
  if potion then
    servicePotion(snap, slots)
    return
  end
  if allowBackground == false and not inventory.busy() or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") then
    return
  end
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    local tool = slots[slot]
    if alive(tool) then
      layout[slot] = identity(tool)
    elseif alive(seen[slot]) then
      -- A live stack moved by the player is not an exhausted stack.
      layout[slot] = nil
    end
    seen[slot] = alive(tool) and tool or nil
  end
  if enabled("MCAutoTotem") and snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") ~= "totem" and inventory.find("Totem") then
    if inventory.totem(snap) == false then
      return
    end
  end
  -- All depleted items are restored before considering an extra hotbar totem.
  if enabled("MCAutoRefill") and not refill(snap, slots) then
    return
  end
  if allowBackground ~= false and enabled("MCAutoPotion") then
    for _, effect in ipairs(effects) do
      if
        enabled(effect.key)
        and snap.now >= (awaiting[effect.effect] or 0)
        and (tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Effect_" .. effect.effect)) or 0) <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
      then
        local tool = inventory.find(effect.class, 1, 9)
        if tool and beginPotion(snap, slots, effect, tool) then
          return
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if enabled("MCAutoTotem") and snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" and not inventory.find("Totem", 1, 9) then
    local tool, from = inventory.find("Totem", 10, 36)
    local to = tool and destination(slots, identity(tool))
    if to and not inventory.move(snap, tool, from, to) then
      return
    end
  end
  inventory.close()
end
Supplies.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "step", "busy" },
  requires = { Inventory = "mcpinventory", Native = "mcpnative", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Inventory = { "slots", "find", "move", "close", "totem", "step", "busy", "reset" },
    Native = { "snapshot", "equip", "restore", "use", "useState", "blocked" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
  },
}
return Supplies

-- [[ native voxel collision adapter ]]
--!optimize 2
local Adapter = {}
local native, original, replacement
function Adapter.teardown()
  if native and native.Resolve == replacement then
    pcall(function() native.Resolve = original end)
  end
  native, original, replacement = nil, nil, nil
  return true
end
function Adapter.setup(deps)
  Adapter.teardown()
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("VoxelBlockCollision")
  if not source then
    return true
  end
  local ok, module = pcall(require, source)
  if not ok or type(module) ~= "table" or type(module.Resolve) ~= "function" then
    return true
  end
  local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
  native, original = module, module.Resolve
  replacement = function(position, movement, ...)
    local model = player and player.Character
    local root = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if deps.Noclip.isEnabled() and root and typeof(position) == "Vector3" and typeof(movement) == "Vector3" and (position - root.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
      return movement, { x = false, y = false, z = false, grounded = false }
    end
    return original(position, movement, ...)
  end
  local installed = pcall(function() native.Resolve = replacement end)
  if not installed then
    deps.Utils.recordError("MCPvP.Noclip", "O controlador nativo de colisão não permite adaptação neste executor.")
    Adapter.teardown()
  end
  return true
end
Adapter.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "teardown" },
  requires = { Noclip = "noclip", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Noclip = { "isEnabled" }, Utils = { "recordError" } },
}
return Adapter

-- [[ mcpsurvival ]]
--!optimize 2
local Survival = {}
local native, geometry, target, pearl, inventory, units, utils
local owner, apple, escape, routeJob, walking
local health, damage, interval, hurtAt, hits = nil, 0, 0.6, nil, 0
local nextApple, nextRoute, episode = 0, 0, false
local generation, eatingDuration = 0, 1.6
local FLAT = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
function Survival.setup(deps)
  native, geometry, target, pearl, inventory, units, utils = deps.Native, deps.Geometry, deps.Target, deps.Pearl, deps.Inventory, deps.Units, deps.Utils
  return true
end
local function stopWalking(snap)
  if not walking then
    return
  end
  walking = nil
  if snap then
    snap.humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
  end
end
function Survival.reset()
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  if apple and snap and owner == snap.character and snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") then
    return
  end
  native.holdUse(nil, false)
  stopWalking(snap)
  owner, apple, escape, routeJob, health = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  damage, interval, hurtAt, hits, nextApple, nextRoute, episode = 0, 0.6, nil, 0, 0, 0, false
  generation += 1
end
function Survival.busy() return apple ~= nil or escape ~= nil end
local function findApple()
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    local tool = slots and slots[slot]
    if tool and tool.Parent and tool.Name == "Gold Apple" and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0 then
      return tool
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function finishApple(snap, completed)
  native.holdUse(nil, false)
  apple.finishedAt = apple.finishedAt or snap.now
  if not native.restore(snap, apple.previous) and snap.now - apple.finishedAt < 1 then
    return false
  end
  apple, nextApple = nil, snap.now + (completed and eatingDuration or 0.8)
  if escape then
    escape.fed = completed == true
    if completed then
      escape.progressAt = snap.now
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function eat(snap)
  if not apple then
    return false
  end
  local tool = apple.tool
  local consumed = not tool.Parent or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or apple.count) < apple.count
  if consumed then
    finishApple(snap, true)
    return true
  end
  if apple.started then
    local untilAt = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingUntil")) or 0
    local since = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingStarted")) or 0
    local duration = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingDuration")) or untilAt - since
    if duration > 0 and duration < 10 then
      eatingDuration = duration
    end
    local serverNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local active = untilAt > serverNow or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") == true
    local expired = untilAt > 0 and serverNow > untilAt + 0.5 or untilAt <= 0 and snap.now - apple.started > math.max(3, eatingDuration + 1)
    if active and not expired then
      apple.ack = true
      if escape then
        escape.progressAt = snap.now
      end
      return true
    end
    if active and expired then
      -- Cancel a stale native hold, never a still-running first apple.
      finishApple(snap)
      return true
    end
    -- No synthetic release or equipment change while the native eating action is active.
    if snap.tool ~= tool or apple.ack or snap.now - apple.started > 2.5 then
      finishApple(snap)
    end
    return true
  end
  if snap.now > apple.deadline then
    finishApple(snap)
  elseif native.equip(snap, tool) and native.holdUse(snap, true) then
    apple.started = snap.now
  end
  return true
end
local function beginApple(snap)
  if apple or snap.now < nextApple or native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local tool = findApple()
  if not tool then
    return false
  end
  apple = { tool = tool, previous = snap.tool, count = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1, deadline = snap.now + 1 }
  return eat(snap)
end
local function rayParams(snap)
  local ray = RaycastParams.new()
  local ignored = { snap.character, snap.camera }
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    if player.Character then
      ignored[#ignored + 1] = player.Character
    end
  end
  ray.FilterType, ray.RespectCanCollide, ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, ignored
  return ray
end
local function away(snap)
  local source = escape and escape.foe
  if source and source.Parent then
    escape.position = source.Position
  end
  local direction = escape and escape.position and (snap.root.Position - escape.position) * FLAT or -snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector * FLAT
  return direction.Magnitude > 0.001 and direction.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
end
local function turn(direction, angle)
  local sine, cosine = math.sin(math.rad(angle)), math.cos(math.rad(angle))
  return Vector3.new(direction.X * cosine - direction.Z * sine, 0, direction.X * sine + direction.Z * cosine)
end
local ESCAPE_DISTANCES, ESCAPE_ANGLES = { 24, 18, 12, 8, 4, 2 }, { 0, 35, -35, 70, -70, 110, -110, 180 }
local function escapeRoute(snap)
  local origin = units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position)
  if not escape.search or (escape.search.origin - origin).Magnitude > 0.5 then
    escape.search = { origin = origin, direction = away(snap), index = 1 }
  end
  local search = escape.search
  local threat = escape.position and units.toBlocks(escape.position)
  -- Bound trajectory work per frame, including a completely enclosed hole.
  for _ = 1, 4 do
    local distance = ESCAPE_DISTANCES[math.floor((search.index - 1) / #ESCAPE_ANGLES) + 1]
    if not distance then
      escape.search = nil
      return nil, false
    end
    local angle = ESCAPE_ANGLES[(search.index - 1) % #ESCAPE_ANGLES + 1]
    search.index += 1
    local route = pearl.route(snap, origin + turn(search.direction, angle) * distance, true)
    if route and (not threat or (route.landing - threat).Magnitude > (origin - threat).Magnitude + 1) then
      escape.search = nil
      return route, false
    end
  end
  return nil, true
end
local function requestWalk(snap)
  if routeJob or walking then
    return
  end
  local token, character, origin, direction = generation, snap.character, snap.root.Position, away(snap)
  routeJob = token
  task.spawn(function()
    local success, reason = pcall(function()
      local ray = rayParams(snap)
      local pathService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
      for _, angle in ipairs({ 0, 60, -60, 120, -120, 180 }) do
        if token ~= generation then
          return
        end
        local destination = origin + units.toWorld(turn(direction, angle) * 5)
        local floor = workspace:Raycast(destination + units.offset(0, 6, 0), units.offset(0, -12, 0), ray)
        local key = floor and floor.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey")
        if not floor or floor.Normal.Y < 0.65 or floor.Material == Enum.Material.Water or key == "lava" or key == "water" then
          continue
        end
        if workspace:Raycast(floor.Position + units.offset(0, 1 / 64, 0), units.offset(0, 2, 0), ray) then
          continue
        end
        local path = pathService:CreatePath({
          AgentRadius = units.toWorld(0.28),
          AgentHeight = units.toWorld(1.96),
          AgentCanJump = true,
          AgentJumpHeight = units.toWorld(1.25),
          WaypointSpacing = units.toWorld(0.75),
        })
        local ok = pcall(path.ComputeAsync, path, origin, floor.Position + units.offset(0, 1.25, 0))
        if token ~= generation then
          return
        end
        if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
          local points = path:GetWaypoints()
          if #points > 1 then
            walking = { character = character, points = points, index = 2, at = os.clock(), position = origin, progress = os.clock() }
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    if token == generation then
      routeJob = nil
      if not success then
        utils.recordError("mcpvp.escape.path", tostring(reason))
      end
    end
  end)
end
function Survival.move(snap)
  if not walking or not escape or walking.character ~= snap.character then
    return
  end
  local point = walking.points[walking.index]
  if not point or snap.now - walking.at > 5 then
    stopWalking(snap)
    return
  end
  if units.distance(snap.root.Position, walking.position) > 0.3 then
    walking.position, walking.progress = snap.root.Position, snap.now
  end
  if snap.now - walking.progress > 0.8 then
    stopWalking(snap)
    return
  end
  local delta = (point.Position - snap.root.Position) * FLAT
  if units.toBlocks(delta.Magnitude) < 0.5 then
    walking.index += 1
    return
  end
  snap.humanoid:Move(delta.Unit, false)
  if point.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump and geometry.grounded(snap) and geometry.headroom(snap) and not geometry.jumpRisk(snap) then
    native.jump(snap)
  end
end
local function observeHealth(snap)
  if health and snap.humanoid.Health < health then
    local loss = health - snap.humanoid.Health
    if hurtAt and snap.now - hurtAt >= 0.15 and snap.now - hurtAt <= 3 then
      interval = interval * 0.5 + (snap.now - hurtAt) * 0.5
      hits += 1
    else
      hits = 1
    end
    damage = damage > 0 and damage * 0.5 + loss * 0.5 or loss
    hurtAt = snap.now
    if not escape then
      episode = false
    end
  end
  health = snap.humanoid.Health
end
local function appleDue(snap, value)
  if not value or hits < 2 or not hurtAt or snap.now - hurtAt > 3 or damage <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  if geometry.stats(value.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")).type ~= "sword" then
    return false
  end
  local absorption = tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Absorption")) or tonumber(snap.player:GetAttribute("Absorption")) or 0
  local hitsLeft = math.max(1, math.ceil((snap.humanoid.Health + absorption) / damage))
  local nextHit = math.max(0, interval - (snap.now - hurtAt))
  local timeToPop = nextHit + (hitsLeft - 1) * interval
  local tool = findApple()
  local duration = tool and tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingDuration")) or eatingDuration
  return timeToPop <= duration + 0.2
end
function Survival.step(snap, available)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    Survival.reset()
    owner = snap.character
  end
  observeHealth(snap)
  if escape and escape.foe and escape.foe.Parent then
    escape.position = escape.foe.Position
  end
  if apple then
    eat(snap)
    return true
  end
  if utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoEscape") ~= true then
    if escape or routeJob or walking then
      escape, routeJob = nil, nil
      generation += 1
      stopWalking(snap)
    end
    return false
  end
  local hasTotem = snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" or native.find(snap, "Totem") ~= nil
  if hasTotem or snap.humanoid.Health > snap.humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.6 then
    episode = false
  end
  local value = target.current(snap)
  if not escape and not episode and not hasTotem and snap.humanoid.Health <= snap.humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.5 then
    local threat = value or target.threat(snap)
    escape = {
      foe = threat and threat.root,
      position = threat and threat.root.Position,
      origin = snap.root.Position,
      progressPosition = snap.root.Position,
      progressAt = snap.now,
      fed = false,
    }
    pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
    target.abandon(snap)
    generation += 1
  end
  if not escape then
    if available and not pearl.busy() and hasTotem and appleDue(snap, value) then
      return beginApple(snap)
    end
    return false
  end
  if units.distance(snap.root.Position, escape.progressPosition) >= 0.5 or pearl.escaping() then
    escape.progressPosition, escape.progressAt = snap.root.Position, snap.now
  end
  if snap.now - escape.progressAt >= 3 and not pearl.busy() then
    -- An impossible retreat must return control instead of disabling combat forever.
    escape, routeJob, episode = nil, nil, true
    generation += 1
    stopWalking(snap)
    return false
  end
  if not available then
    return true
  end
  if pearl.busy() then
    pearl.advance(snap)
    return true
  end
  if pearl.escaping() then
    escape.launched = true
  end
  if (escape.launched or pearl.pending() or not native.find(snap, "Pearl", true)) and not escape.fed then
    if beginApple(snap) then
      return true
    end
    if not findApple() then
      escape.fed = true
    end
  end
  if (escape.search or snap.now >= nextRoute) and not pearl.pending() and not escape.launched then
    nextRoute = snap.now + 0.5
    local route, searching
    if native.find(snap, "Pearl", true) then
      route, searching = escapeRoute(snap)
    end
    if route then
      stopWalking(snap)
      pearl.launch(snap, route, true)
    elseif not searching then
      requestWalk(snap)
      if not escape.fed and beginApple(snap) then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  local far = escape.position and units.distance(snap.root.Position, escape.position) >= 12
  local moved = units.distance(snap.root.Position, escape.origin) >= 8
  if escape.fed and (far or not escape.position and moved or snap.humanoid.Health > snap.humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.6 or hasTotem) then
    escape, episode, routeJob = nil, true, nil
    generation += 1
    stopWalking(snap)
    return false
  end
  -- A failed landing or a closing opponent permits another escape route.
  if escape.launched and not pearl.pending() and not far and (escape.position or not moved) then
    escape.launched = false
  end
  Survival.move(snap)
  return true
end
Survival.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "busy", "step", "move" },
  requires = {
    Native = "mcpnative",
    Geometry = "mcpgeometry",
    Target = "mcptarget",
    Pearl = "autopearl",
    Inventory = "mcpinventory",
    Units = "mcpunits",
    Utils = "utils",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Native = { "snapshot", "restore", "equip", "holdUse", "blocked", "find", "jump" },
    Geometry = { "stats", "grounded", "headroom", "jumpRisk" },
    Target = { "current", "threat", "abandon" },
    Pearl = { "route", "launch", "advance", "busy", "pending", "escaping", "cancelPrepared" },
    Inventory = { "slots" },
    Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset", "distance" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "recordError" },
  },
}
return Survival

-- [[ MM2 runtime composition ]]
--!optimize 2
local Runtime = {}
local api, owner, scope, modules
function Runtime.setup() return true end
function Runtime.teardown()
  if owner then
    owner.ShuttingDown = true
  end
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
  end
  api, owner, scope, modules = nil, nil, nil, nil
  return true
end
function Runtime.bind(loaded)
  Runtime.teardown()
  modules, scope = loaded, loaded.lifetime.scope()
  owner = { ShuttingDown = false, Tasks = {}, Connections = {} }
  function owner:Track(connection)
    if not connection then
      return nil
    end
    self.Connections[connection] = true
    scope.add(connection)
    return connection
  end
  function owner:TrackTask(thread)
    if not thread then
      return nil
    end
    self.Tasks[thread] = true
    scope.add(thread, function()
      if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" then
        pcall(task.cancel, thread)
      end
    end)
    return thread
  end
  function owner:OnShutdown(callback) scope.add(callback) end
  local services = {}
  for _, name in ipairs({
    "Players",
    "RunService",
    "UserInputService",
    "Workspace",
    "TweenService",
    "PathfindingService",
    "ReplicatedStorage",
    "CollectionService",
    "HttpService",
  }) do
    services[name] = game:GetService(name)
  end
  local pending = {}
  local function notify(title, message, options)
    options = options or { duration = 5 }
    if not loaded.ui.notifyCorner(title, message, options) then
      if #pending >= 6 then
        table.remove(pending, 1)
      end
      pending[#pending + 1] = { title, message, options, os.clock() }
    end
  end
  api = {
    Roblox = services,
    UI = loaded.ui,
    Player = loaded.utils.getLocalPlayer(),
    Runtime = owner,
    Config = { MapRefreshInterval = 1 },
    Features = {},
    Services = {},
    Notify = notify,
    IsActive = loaded.utils.isActive,
    Get = loaded.utils.getConfigValue,
    Util = {
      FormatError = function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end,
      DestroySafely = function(instance)
        if instance then
          pcall(function() instance:Destroy() end)
        end
      end,
      IsFiniteVector3 = function(v)
        return typeof(v) == "Vector3"
          and v.X == v.X
          and v.Y == v.Y
          and v.Z == v.Z
          and math.abs(v.X) < 1000000
          and math.abs(v.Y) < 1000000
          and math.abs(v.Z) < 1000000
      end,
    },
  }
  api.Features.Noclip = {
    Acquire = function(_, lease) return loaded.noclip.acquire(lease) end,
    Release = function(_, lease) return loaded.noclip.release(lease) end,
  }
  api.Features.Invisicam = { SetSource = function(_, source, value) return loaded.invisicam.setSource(source, value) end }
  for _, entry in ipairs({ { "Coin", "mm2coin" }, { "Match", "mm2match" }, { "Drops", "mm2drops" }, { "Map", "mm2map" } }) do
    api.Services[entry[1]] = loaded[entry[2]].create(api)
  end
  for _, entry in ipairs({
    { "ESP", "mm2esp" },
    { "AutoFarm", "mm2farm" },
    { "AutoGunPickup", "mm2pickup" },
    { "MapTools", "mm2maptools" },
    { "MurderCombat", "mm2combat" },
    { "ShootMurder", "mm2shoot" },
    { "Alerts", "mm2alerts" },
  }) do
    api.Features[entry[1]] = loaded[entry[2]].create(api)
  end
  local f = api.Features
  local function toggle(target, value)
    if value then
      target:Start()
    else
      target:Stop()
    end
  end
  local bindings = {
    AutoFarm = function(v)
      if v then
        f.AutoFarm:Start()
      else
        f.AutoFarm:Stop(true)
      end
    end,
    AvoidMurdererCoins = function(v) f.AutoFarm.AvoidMurderer = v == true end,
    ResetWhenBagFull = function(v) f.AutoFarm:SetResetWhenBagFull(v) end,
    FarmSpeed = function(v) f.AutoFarm.Speed = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 40, 5, 100) end,
    ManualShootMurder = function(v) f.ShootMurder:SetManualEnabled(v) end,
    ManualShootMurderAccuracy = function(v) f.ShootMurder:SetManualAccuracy(v) end,
    AutoShootMurder = function(v) f.ShootMurder:SetAutoEnabled(v) end,
    AutoShootMurderAccuracy = function(v) f.ShootMurder:SetAutoAccuracy(v) end,
    LegitSheriff = function(v) f.ShootMurder:SetWaitForKnife(v) end,
    AutoKnifeAttack = function(v) f.MurderCombat:SetAutoAttack(v) end,
    AutoKnifeAttackTargets = function(v) f.MurderCombat:SetAttackTargets(v) end,
    AutoKnifeThrow = function(v) f.MurderCombat:SetAutoThrow(v) end,
    AutoKnifeThrowTargets = function(v) f.MurderCombat:SetThrowTargets(v) end,
    AutoGunPickup = function(v) toggle(f.AutoGunPickup, v) end,
    GunPickupSafety = function(v) f.AutoGunPickup:SetSafetyEnabled(v) end,
    AutoTeleportToGun = function(v) f.MapTools:SetAutoGunTeleport(v) end,
    FavoriteMap = function(v) f.MapTools:SetFavoriteMaps(v) end,
    ESPEnabled = function(v) toggle(f.ESP, v) end,
    ESPShowIdentity = function(v) f.ESP.ShowIdentity = v == true end,
    ESPShowUsername = function(v) f.ESP.ShowUsername = v == true end,
    ESPShowSelf = function(v) f.ESP:SetShowSelf(v) end,
    ESPShowDistance = function(v) f.ESP.ShowDistance = v == true end,
    AlertRoleAndMurderer = function(v) f.Alerts:SetRoleAndMurdererEnabled(v) end,
    AlertGunDropped = function(v) f.Alerts:SetGunDroppedEnabled(v) end,
  }
  for _, filter in ipairs({ "Murderer", "Sheriff", "Innocent", "CandyCoin", "Gun" }) do
    bindings["ESP" .. filter] = function(value) f.ESP:SetFilter(filter, value) end
  end
  local function apply(key, value)
    if not bindings[key] then
      return
    end
    local ok, err = pcall(bindings[key], value)
    if not ok then
      loaded.utils.recordError("MM2." .. key, tostring(err))
    end
  end
  for key in pairs(bindings) do
    if key ~= "AutoFarm" and key ~= "ESPEnabled" and key ~= "AutoGunPickup" then
      apply(key, loaded.utils.getConfigValue(key))
    end
  end
  for _, key in ipairs({ "ESPEnabled", "AutoGunPickup", "AutoFarm" }) do
    apply(key, loaded.utils.getConfigValue(key))
  end
  scope.add(loaded.utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    for key, value in pairs(changes) do
      apply(key, value)
      if value == true and key == "ManualShootMurder" then
        notify("Shoot Murder manual", "A Mini UI só aparece durante a partida quando você for Xerife ou Herói.", {
          id = "mm2.manual-shoot-role",
          duration = 5,
          color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 155, 255),
        })
      elseif value == true and key == "ManualKnifeThrow" then
        notify("Lançamento manual", "A Mini UI só aparece durante a partida quando você for Assassino.", {
          id = "mm2.manual-knife-role",
          duration = 5,
          color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65),
        })
      end
    end
  end))
  local elapsed = 0
  scope.connect(services.RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
    elapsed += dt
    if elapsed < 1 then
      return
    end
    elapsed = 0
    for connection in pairs(owner.Connections) do
      if connection.Connected == false then
        owner.Connections[connection] = nil
        scope.forget(connection)
      end
    end
    for thread in pairs(owner.Tasks) do
      if coroutine.status(thread) == "dead" then
        owner.Tasks[thread] = nil
        scope.forget(thread)
      end
    end
    for i = #pending, 1, -1 do
      local notice = pending[i]
      if os.clock() - notice[4] > 8 or loaded.ui.notifyCorner(notice[1], notice[2], notice[3]) then
        table.remove(pending, i)
      end
    end
  end)
  return { mode = "mm2" }
end
function Runtime.createAPI(loaded)
  local function feature(name) return api and api.Features[name] end
  local function shoot()
    local f = feature("ShootMurder")
    if not f then
      return false, "Combate ainda não carregou."
    end
    if f:TryShoot(false) then
      return true
    end
    return false, "Nenhum disparo disponível: confira o papel, a visibilidade do alvo e o intervalo da arma."
  end
  local function throw()
    local f = feature("MurderCombat")
    if not f then
      return false, "Combate ainda não carregou."
    end
    if f:ThrowManual() then
      return true
    end
    return false, "Nenhum alvo disponível na mira, ou a faca ainda está no intervalo de lançamento."
  end
  return {
    getUIConfig = function() return loaded.gameui.definition end,
    getChoices = function(name)
      local map = feature("MapTools")
      if not map then
        return { "None" }
      end
      if name == "mm2Players" then
        return map:GetPlayerOptions()
      end
      if name == "mm2Maps" then
        return map:GetFavoriteMapOptions()
      end
      return {}
    end,
    getAbilityAvailability = function(name)
      if not api then
        return false
      end
      local match = api.Services.Match
      local data = match:GetPlayerData()
      local mine = data and data[api.Player.Name]
      if not match:IsAlive(api.Player, mine) or not match:GetRoundContext() then
        return false
      end
      if name == "mm2Shoot" then
        return mine.Role == "Sheriff" or mine.Role == "Hero"
      end
      if name == "mm2Throw" then
        return mine.Role == "Murderer"
      end
      return false
    end,
    controls = { onMM2Shoot = shoot, onMM2Throw = throw },
    createActions = function()
      local function mapCall(method, ...)
        local map = feature("MapTools")
        if map then
          return map[method](map, ...)
        end
      end
      local function selected() return game:GetService("Players"):FindFirstChild(loaded.utils.getConfigValue("MapTargetPlayer") or "") end
      return {
        callbacks = {
          mm2Shoot = shoot,
          mm2Throw = throw,
          mm2Map = function() return mapCall("TeleportToMap") end,
          mm2Lobby = function() return mapCall("TeleportToLobby") end,
          mm2Murderer = function() return mapCall("TeleportToRole", "Murderer") end,
          mm2Gun = function() return mapCall("TeleportToGun") end,
          mm2GunHolder = function() return mapCall("TeleportToRole", "GunHolder") end,
          mm2Player = function() return mapCall("TeleportToPlayer", selected()) end,
          mm2Walk = function() return mapCall("WalkToPlayer", selected()) end,
        },
      }
    end,
    updateBlockers = {
      function()
        local f = feature("AutoFarm")
        return f and f.Farming
      end,
      function()
        local f = feature("AutoGunPickup")
        return f and f.Busy
      end,
    },
  }
end
Runtime.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "bind", "createAPI" },
  requires = {},
}
return Runtime

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2alerts
-- [[ alerts ]]

-- code

local function create(API)
  local Player = API.Player
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Runtime = API.Runtime
  local MatchService = API.Services.Match
  local Alerts = {
    RoleAndMurdererEnabled = true,
    GunDroppedEnabled = true,
    Running = false,
    Thread = nil,
    Connections = {},
    ActiveMap = nil,
    LastRoleSignature = nil,
    SeenGuns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
  }

  local function notify(title, content) API.Notify(title, content) end
  local function isAlive(target, profile)
    if not target or type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true or target:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      return false
    end
    local character = target.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return character ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and character:IsDescendantOf(Services.Workspace)
  end
  function Alerts:RefreshRoles()
    if not self.RoleAndMurdererEnabled then
      return
    end
    local inRound, map = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    if not inRound or not map then
      self.ActiveMap = nil
      self.LastRoleSignature = nil
      return
    end
    if self.ActiveMap ~= map then
      self.ActiveMap = map
      self.LastRoleSignature = nil
    end
    local data = MatchService:GetPlayerData()
    local localProfile = data and data[Player.Name]
    if type(localProfile) ~= "table" or type(localProfile.Role) ~= "string" or localProfile.Role == "" or not isAlive(Player, localProfile) then
      return
    end
    local murdererName = localProfile.Role == "Murderer" and (Player.DisplayName or Player.Name) or nil
    if not murdererName then
      for playerName, profile in pairs(data) do
        if playerName ~= Player.Name and type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role == "Murderer" then
          local target = Services.Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)
          if isAlive(target, profile) then
            murdererName = target.DisplayName or target.Name
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if not murdererName then
      return
    end
    local signature = tostring(localProfile.Role) .. "|" .. murdererName
    if signature == self.LastRoleSignature then
      return
    end
    self.LastRoleSignature = signature
    API.Notify("Papéis da rodada", {
      { text = "Seu cargo: " },
      { text = localProfile.Role, color = localProfile.Role == "Murderer" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 155, 255) },
      { text = " · Assassino: " },
      { text = murdererName, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65) },
    }, { duration = 5, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), id = "mm2.roles" })
  end
  function Alerts:OnGunDropped(instance)
    if not self.GunDroppedEnabled or self.SeenGuns[instance] then
      return
    end
    self.SeenGuns[instance] = true
    task.delay(0.15, function()
      if not self.Running or not instance or not instance.Parent or not instance:IsDescendantOf(Services.Workspace) then
        return
      end
      local inRound, map = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
      if inRound and map then
        notify("Arma caiu", "Uma arma foi derrubada no mapa.")
      end
    end)
  end
  function Alerts:Start()
    if self.Running or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    self.Running = true
    table.clear(self.SeenGuns)
    for _, gun in ipairs(API.Services.Drops:GetAll()) do
      self.SeenGuns[gun] = true
    end
    self.Connections.GunAdded = Runtime:Track(API.Services.Drops:ObserveAdded(function(instance) self:OnGunDropped(instance) end))
    local thread
    thread = task.spawn(function()
      while self.Running and not Runtime.ShuttingDown do
        local ok, errorMessage = pcall(function() self:RefreshRoles() end)
        if not ok then
          warn("[Exodus MM2] Avisos recuperando após erro: " .. tostring(errorMessage))
        end
        task.wait(1)
      end
      if self.Thread == thread then
        self.Thread = nil
      end
    end)
    self.Thread = Runtime:TrackTask(thread)
  end
  function Alerts:Stop()
    self.Running = false
    local thread = self.Thread
    self.Thread = nil
    if thread then
      pcall(task.cancel, thread)
    end
    for key, connection in pairs(self.Connections) do
      if connection then
        pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
      end
      self.Connections[key] = nil
    end
    self.ActiveMap = nil
    self.LastRoleSignature = nil
  end
  function Alerts:SetRoleAndMurdererEnabled(enabled)
    self.RoleAndMurdererEnabled = enabled == true
    if self.RoleAndMurdererEnabled or self.GunDroppedEnabled then
      self:Start()
    else
      self:Stop()
    end
  end
  function Alerts:SetGunDroppedEnabled(enabled)
    self.GunDroppedEnabled = enabled == true
    if self.RoleAndMurdererEnabled or self.GunDroppedEnabled then
      self:Start()
    else
      self:Stop()
    end
  end
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function() Alerts:Stop() end)
  return Alerts
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2coin
-- [[ coinservice ]]

local function create(API)

  -- services
  local CoinService = {}

  -- cointypes
  function CoinService:NormalizeKind(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
      return nil
    end
    local normalized = string.lower(value)
    if normalized == "candy" then
      return "candy"
    end
    if normalized == "coin" then
      return "coin"
    end
    return nil
  end
  function CoinService:GetKind(part)
    if not part then
      return nil
    end
    local kind = self:NormalizeKind(part:GetAttribute("CoinID"))
    if kind then
      return kind
    end
    return part:FindFirstChild("CoinVisual") and "coin" or nil
  end

  -- eligibility
  function CoinService:IsCollectable(part, container)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Parent or not container then
      return false
    end
    if not part:IsDescendantOf(container) or part:GetAttribute("Collected") then
      return false
    end
    if not part:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") then
      return false
    end
    local kind = self:GetKind(part)
    if not kind then
      return false
    end
    local visual = part:FindFirstChild("CoinVisual")
    local isNewMM2Candy = kind == "candy" and part.Transparency == 1
    if visual then
      if visual:GetAttribute("Delete") or visual:GetAttribute("Collected") then
        return false
      end
      local mainCoin = visual:FindFirstChild("MainCoin")
      local visualIsReady = mainCoin and mainCoin:IsA("BasePart") and mainCoin.Transparency < 0.95
      if not visualIsReady and not isNewMM2Candy then
        return false
      end
    elseif not isNewMM2Candy then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end

  -- enumeration
  function CoinService:GetCollectableParts(container)
    local parts = {}
    if not container then
      return parts
    end
    for _, instance in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
      if instance:IsA("BasePart") and self:IsCollectable(instance, container) then
        table.insert(parts, instance)
      end
    end
    return parts
  end
  return CoinService
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module
