--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2combat
-- [[ murdercombat ]]

-- code

local function create(API)
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Players, Workspace = Services.Players, Services.Workspace
  local ReplicatedStorage, RunService = Services.ReplicatedStorage, Services.RunService
  local Player, Runtime, MatchService = API.Player, API.Runtime, API.Services.Match
  local CollectionService = Services.CollectionService
  local CONFIG = {
    MELEE_RANGE = 8,
    THROW_MAX_RANGE = 240,
    DEFAULT_KNIFE_SPEED = 96,
  }

  local MELEE_RANGE = CONFIG.MELEE_RANGE
  local THROW_MAX_RANGE = CONFIG.THROW_MAX_RANGE
  local DEFAULT_KNIFE_SPEED = CONFIG.DEFAULT_KNIFE_SPEED
  local Combat = {
    AutoAttack = false,
    AutoThrow = false,
    AttackTargets = "All",
    ThrowTargets = "Auto",
    RoleData = nil,
    RoleDataAt = 0,
    Motion = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    LastRemoteWarning = 0,
    Destroyed = false,
  }

  local function warnRemote()
    if os.clock() - Combat.LastRemoteWarning > 8 then
      Combat.LastRemoteWarning = os.clock()
      warn("[Exodus MM2] Não encontrei um remote compatível de lançamento de faca.")
    end
  end
  local function getRoleData()
    Combat.RoleDataAt = os.clock()
    Combat.RoleData = MatchService:GetPlayerData()
    return Combat.RoleData
  end
  local function characterInfo(target, profile)
    if target == Player or type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.Dead or profile.Killed or target:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      return nil
    end
    local character = target.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
      return nil
    end
    return character, humanoid, root
  end
  local function getContext()
    local active, character, humanoid, root = MatchService:GetContext()
    if not active then
      return nil
    end
    local profiles = getRoleData()
    local mine = profiles and profiles[Player.Name]
    if type(mine) ~= "table" or mine.Role ~= "Murderer" or mine.Dead or mine.Killed or character:GetAttribute("Zombie") == true then
      return nil
    end
    local knife = character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
    if not knife then
      local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
      knife = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife")
      if knife and knife:IsA("Tool") then
        humanoid:EquipTool(knife)
      end
      if not knife or knife.Parent ~= character then
        return nil
      end
    end
    if not knife:IsA("Tool") or knife:GetAttribute("Disabled") == true then
      return nil
    end
    return character, humanoid, root, knife, profiles
  end
  local function acceptedRole(role, mode)
    if mode == "All" or mode == "Nearest" or mode == "Auto" then
      return role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" or role == "Innocent"
    end
    if mode == "Sheriff/Hero" then
      return role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero"
    end
    if mode == "Innocent" then
      return role == "Innocent"
    end
    return false
  end
  local function getOrigin(character, root, knife)
    local handle = knife:FindFirstChild("RightHandle") or knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
      return handle.Position
    end
    return root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
  end
  local function raycast(origin, destination, localCharacter, mapContainer)
    local ignores = { localCharacter }
    if mapContainer then
      table.insert(ignores, mapContainer)
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
      table.insert(ignores, item)
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    for _ = 1, 12 do
      params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignores
      local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, destination - origin, params)
      if not result or result.Instance.Transparency ~= 1 then
        return result
      end
      table.insert(ignores, result.Instance)
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function visible(origin, part, targetCharacter, ownCharacter, coinContainer)
    local result = raycast(origin, part.Position, ownCharacter, coinContainer)
    return result == nil or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter)
  end
  local function getMotion(target, root)
    local now, pos = os.clock(), root.Position
    local raw = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local state = Combat.Motion[target]
    local velocity = raw
    if state and state.Root == root then
      local dt = now - state.At
      if dt > 0.015 and dt < 0.5 then
        local sampled = (pos - state.Position) / dt
        if sampled.Magnitude < 120 then
          velocity = raw * 0.65 + sampled * 0.35
        end
      end
    end
    Combat.Motion[target] = { Root = root, At = now, Position = pos }
    return velocity
  end
  local function getPing()
    local ok, ping = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
    return ok and math.clamp(tonumber(ping) or 0, 0, 300) / 2000 or 0
  end
  local function predictPosition(root, humanoid, velocity, origin, speed, ownCharacter, coinContainer)
    local t, ping = 0, getPing()
    local targetPosition = root.Position
    local jumping = humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
    local floorY
    if jumping then
      local ground = raycast(root.Position, root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 25, 0), root.Parent, coinContainer)
      if ground and ground.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        floorY = ground.Position.Y + math.max(2.0, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y * 0.5)
      end
    end
    for _ = 1, 4 do
      t = math.clamp((targetPosition - origin).Magnitude / speed + ping, 0, 2.8)
      local y = root.Position.Y
      if jumping then
        y += velocity.Y * t - 0.5 * Workspace.Gravity * t * t
        if floorY then
          y = math.max(y, floorY)
        end
      else
        y += math.clamp(velocity.Y, -8, 8) * t
      end
      targetPosition = Vector3.new(root.Position.X + velocity.X * t, y, root.Position.Z + velocity.Z * t)
    end
    return targetPosition, t
  end
  local function getKnifeSpeed(knife)
    local speed = tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("ProjectileSpeed"))
    if speed and speed >= 10 then
      return math.clamp(speed, 30, 400)
    end
    for _, projectile in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("ThrowingKnife")) do
      speed = tonumber(projectile:GetAttribute("ThrowSpeed"))
      if speed and speed >= 10 then
        return math.clamp(speed, 30, 400)
      end
    end
    -- Knife.ThrowSpeed is the charge duration in the native KnifeClient.
    -- Only projectile ThrowSpeed (or an explicit ProjectileSpeed) is velocity.
    return DEFAULT_KNIFE_SPEED
  end
  local function getTargets(root, profiles, mode)
    local list = {}
    for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local profile = profiles[target.Name]
      if type(profile) == "table" and acceptedRole(profile.Role, mode) then
        local character, humanoid, targetRoot = characterInfo(target, profile)
        if character then
          local distance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
          table.insert(list, {
            Player = target,
            Character = character,
            Humanoid = humanoid,
            Root = targetRoot,
            Role = profile.Role,
            Distance = distance,
          })
        end
      end
    end
    return list
  end
  local function getMeleeRange(knife, targetRoot)
    local configured = tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("StabRange") or knife:GetAttribute("KnifeReach"))
    local radius = configured and math.clamp(configured, 4, 16) or MELEE_RANGE
    return radius
  end
  local function chooseMelee(character, root, knife, profiles)
    local nearest, shortest
    local _, _, coinContainer = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local origin = getOrigin(character, root, knife)
    for _, entry in ipairs(getTargets(root, profiles, Combat.AttackTargets)) do
      if entry.Distance <= getMeleeRange(knife, entry.Root) and (not shortest or entry.Distance < shortest) then
        local part = entry.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or entry.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or entry.Root
        if visible(origin, part, entry.Character, character, coinContainer) then
          nearest, shortest = entry, entry.Distance
        end
      end
    end
    return nearest
  end
  local function tryStab(knife, target)
    local events = knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
    local stabbed = events and events:FindFirstChild("KnifeStabbed")
    local touched = events and events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")
    local hitPart = target.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
      or target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
      or target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
      or target.Root
    if stabbed and stabbed:IsA("RemoteEvent") and touched and touched:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      stabbed:FireServer()
      touched:FireServer(hitPart)
      return true
    end
    local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Stab", true)
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      remote:FireServer(hitPart)
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  local function chooseThrow(character, root, knife, profiles)
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
      return nil
    end
    local mode, origin = Combat.ThrowTargets, getOrigin(character, root, knife)
    local _, _, coinContainer = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local speed, preferred, bestPriority, bestScore = getKnifeSpeed(knife), nil, nil, nil
    local center = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
    local cone = math.rad(math.clamp(tonumber(API.Get("KnifeCone")) or 35, 5, 85))
    for _, entry in ipairs(getTargets(root, profiles, mode)) do
      if entry.Distance <= THROW_MAX_RANGE then
        local part = entry.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or entry.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or entry.Root
        local projected, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local offset = part.Position - camera.CFrame.Position
        local angle = offset.Magnitude > 0.001 and math.acos(math.clamp(camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit), -1, 1)) or 0
        local sheriff = entry.Role == "Sheriff" or entry.Role == "Hero"
        if onScreen and projected.Z > 0 and (angle <= cone or sheriff) then
          local cameraClear = visible(camera.CFrame.Position, part, entry.Character, character, coinContainer)
          if cameraClear and visible(origin, part, entry.Character, character, coinContainer) then
            local velocity = getMotion(entry.Player, entry.Root)
            local aim, flightTime = predictPosition(entry.Root, entry.Humanoid, velocity, origin, speed, character, coinContainer)
            aim += part.Position - entry.Root.Position
            local blocked = raycast(origin, aim, character, coinContainer)
            if not blocked or blocked.Instance:IsDescendantOf(entry.Character) then
              local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(projected.X, projected.Y) - center).Magnitude / math.max(1, math.min(center.X, center.Y))
              local score = screenDistance + math.min(entry.Distance / 100, 1) * 0.18 - math.clamp((14 - entry.Distance) / 14, 0, 1) * 0.8
              if mode == "Nearest" then
                score = entry.Distance
              end
              local priority = sheriff and 0 or 1
              if not bestPriority or priority < bestPriority or priority == bestPriority and score < bestScore then
                bestPriority, bestScore = priority, score
                preferred = { Entry = entry, Aim = aim, Origin = origin, Speed = speed, TravelTime = flightTime }
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return preferred
  end
  local function simulateProjectile(origin, direction, speed, character, hitRemote)
    local _, _, coinContainer = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local traveled, last = 0, origin
    while traveled < THROW_MAX_RANGE and character.Parent and hitRemote.Parent and not Runtime.ShuttingDown do
      local dt = math.clamp(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.001, 0.3)
      local nextPosition = last + direction * (dt * speed)
      local hit = raycast(last, nextPosition, character, coinContainer)
      if hit then
        hitRemote:FireServer(hit.Instance, hit.Position)
        return
      end
      traveled += (nextPosition - last).Magnitude
      last = nextPosition
    end
  end
  local function tryThrow(knife, data, character)
    local direction = data.Aim - data.Origin
    if direction.Magnitude < 1 then
      return false
    end
    direction = direction.Unit
    local throwStart = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ThrowStart", true)
    local throwHit = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ThrowHit", true)
    if throwStart and throwStart:IsA("RemoteEvent") and throwHit and throwHit:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      throwStart:FireServer(data.Origin, direction)
      Runtime:TrackTask(task.spawn(simulateProjectile, data.Origin, direction, data.Speed, character, throwHit))
      return true
    end
    local events = knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
    local legacy = events and events:FindFirstChild("KnifeThrown")
    if legacy and legacy:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      local handle = knife:FindFirstChild("Handle") or knife:FindFirstChild("RightHandle")
      local origin = handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and handle.CFrame or CFrame.new(data.Origin)
      legacy:FireServer(origin, CFrame.new(data.Aim))
      return true
    end
    local direct = knife:FindFirstChild("Throw")
    if direct and direct:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      direct:FireServer(CFrame.new(data.Origin), data.Aim)
      return true
    end
    warnRemote()
    return false
  end
  function Combat:Update()
    if self.Destroyed or not API.IsActive() or not self.AutoAttack and not self.AutoThrow then
      return
    end
    if self.AutoAttack then
      local character, _, root, knife, profiles = getContext()
      if character and knife and profiles then
        local target = chooseMelee(character, root, knife, profiles)
        if target and os.clock() >= (self.NextKnifeAt or 0) and tryStab(knife, target) then
          self.NextKnifeAt = os.clock() + 0.85
        end
      end
    end
    if self.AutoThrow then
      self:ThrowManual()
    end
  end
  function Combat:ThrowManual()
    if self.Destroyed or Runtime.ShuttingDown or not API.IsActive() or os.clock() < (self.NextKnifeAt or 0) then
      return false
    end
    local character, _, root, knife, profiles = getContext()
    if not character or not knife or not profiles then
      return false
    end
    local selected = chooseThrow(character, root, knife, profiles)
    if not selected then
      return false
    end
    if not tryThrow(knife, selected, character) then
      return false
    end
    local charge = tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("ThrowSpeed"))
    local fallback = charge and charge > 0 and charge < 5 and charge * 2 or 0.85
    self.NextKnifeAt = os.clock() + math.clamp(tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("ThrowCooldown")) or fallback, 0.1, 5)
    return true
  end
  function Combat:SetAutoAttack(value) self.AutoAttack = value == true end
  function Combat:SetAutoThrow(value) self.AutoThrow = value == true end
  function Combat:SetAttackTargets(mode)
    if mode == "All" or mode == "Sheriff/Hero" or mode == "Innocent" then
      self.AttackTargets = mode
    end
  end
  function Combat:SetThrowTargets(mode)
    if mode == "Auto" or mode == "Sheriff/Hero" or mode == "Innocent" or mode == "Nearest" then
      self.ThrowTargets = mode
    end
  end
  function Combat:Destroy()
    self.Destroyed = true
    self.AutoAttack = false
    self.AutoThrow = false
    self.RoleData = nil
    table.clear(self.Motion)
  end
  Runtime:Track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Combat.Destroyed or Runtime.ShuttingDown or os.clock() < (Combat.NextUpdateAt or 0) then
      return
    end
    Combat.NextUpdateAt = os.clock() + 0.05
    local ok, err = pcall(function() Combat:Update() end)
    if not ok then
      warn("[Exodus MM2] Murder Combat: " .. tostring(err))
    end
  end))
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function() Combat:Destroy() end)
  return Combat
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

-- [[ shared dropped gun index ]]
--!optimize 2
local Module = {}
function Module.setup() return true end
function Module.create(API)
  local workspace, collection = API.Roblox.Workspace, API.Roblox.CollectionService
  local runtime, players = API.Runtime, API.Roblox.Players
  local records, tagged, listeners = {}, {}, {}
  local Drops = {}
  local function held(object)
    for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
      local model = player.Character
      if model and object:IsDescendantOf(model) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function add(object)
    if records[object] or not object.Parent or object.Name ~= "GunDrop" and not tagged[object] then
      return
    end
    if not object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or held(object) then
      return
    end
    records[object] = true
    for connection, callback in pairs(listeners) do
      if connection.Connected then
        callback(object)
      end
    end
  end
  function Drops:GetPart(object)
    if not object or not object.Parent then
      return nil
    end
    if object:IsA("BasePart") then
      return object
    end
    if object:IsA("Model") and object.PrimaryPart then
      return object.PrimaryPart
    end
    return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
  end
  function Drops:GetAll()
    local result = {}
    for object in pairs(records) do
      if object.Parent and object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not held(object) then
        result[#result + 1] = object
      else
        records[object] = nil
      end
    end
    return result
  end
  function Drops:ObserveAdded(callback)
    local connection = { Connected = true }
    listeners[connection] = callback
    function connection:Disconnect()
      self.Connected = false
      listeners[self] = nil
    end
    return connection
  end
  runtime:Track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(add))
  runtime:Track(workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object) records[object] = nil end))
  runtime:Track(collection:GetInstanceAddedSignal("GunDrop"):Connect(function(object)
    tagged[object] = true
    add(object)
  end))
  runtime:Track(collection:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("GunDrop"):Connect(function(object)
    tagged[object] = nil
    if object.Name ~= "GunDrop" then
      records[object] = nil
    end
  end))
  for _, object in ipairs(collection:GetTagged("GunDrop")) do
    tagged[object] = true
    add(object)
  end
  if type(workspace.GetDescendants) == "function" then
    for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
      if object.Name == "GunDrop" then
        add(object)
      end
    end
  end
  runtime:OnShutdown(function()
    table.clear(records)
    table.clear(tagged)
    table.clear(listeners)
  end)
  return Drops
end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2esp
-- [[ esp ]]

local function create(API)
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Player = API.Player
  local Runtime = API.Runtime
  local Util = API.Util
  local CoinService = API.Services.Coin
  local MatchService = API.Services.Match
  local Workspace = Services.Workspace

  -- state
  local ESP = {
    Enabled = false,
    ShowIdentity = true,
    ShowUsername = true,
    ShowSelf = true,
    ShowDistance = true,
    NameTextSizeNear = 12,
    NameTextSizeFar = 17,
    UsernameTextSizeMin = 10,
    NameScaleNearDistance = 24,
    NameScaleFarDistance = 240,
    RefreshInterval = 0.75,
    FillTransparency = 0.82,
    OutlineTransparency = 0,
    Thread = nil,
    RenderConnection = nil,
    PulseInterval = 5,
    LastPulseAt = 0,
    PulseSnapshot = nil,
    RepairScheduled = false,
    RoleRemote = nil,
    RoleChangedConnection = nil,
    RoleData = nil,
    RoleDataAt = 0,
    RoleDataRefreshInterval = 1.25,
    RoleDataCacheLifetime = 2,
    InRound = false,
    LastErrorAt = 0,
    PlayerMarkers = {},
    LastKnownRoles = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    CoinMarkers = {},
    GunMarkers = {},
    GunMotion = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    Filters = {
      Murderer = true,
      Sheriff = true,
      Innocent = true,
      Player = true,
      Self = true,
      CandyCoin = false,
      Gun = true,
    },
    Colors = {
      Murderer = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65),
      Sheriff = Color3.fromRGB(70, 155, 255),
      Innocent = Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 120),
      Player = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235),
      Self = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235),
      CandyCoin = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 70),
      Gun = Color3.fromRGB(70, 225, 255),
    },
  }

  local STUD_TO_METERS = 0.28
  local destroySafely = Util.DestroySafely
  local function getLabelColor(color) return color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.38) end
  local function getNameTextSize(esp, distance)
    distance = tonumber(distance) or esp.NameScaleFarDistance
    local progress = math.clamp((distance - esp.NameScaleNearDistance) / math.max(esp.NameScaleFarDistance - esp.NameScaleNearDistance, 1), 0, 1)
    return math.floor(esp.NameTextSizeNear + (esp.NameTextSizeFar - esp.NameTextSizeNear) * progress + 0.5)
  end
  local function getDistance(fromPart, toPart, fallback)
    if fromPart and fromPart:IsA("BasePart") and toPart and toPart:IsA("BasePart") then
      return (fromPart.Position - toPart.Position).Magnitude
    end
    return fallback
  end
  local createTextLabel, createBillboard, createHighlight, destroyMarker =
    API.UI.createWorldLabel, API.UI.createWorldBillboard, API.UI.createWorldHighlight, API.UI.destroyWorldMarker

  -- rolecategories
  local function getRoleCategory(role)
    if role == "Murderer" then
      return "Murderer"
    end
    if role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" then
      return "Sheriff"
    end
    if role == "Innocent" then
      return "Innocent"
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function getRoleLabel(role)
    if role == "Murderer" then
      return "Assassino"
    end
    if role == "Sheriff" then
      return "Xerife"
    end
    if role == "Hero" then
      return "Herói"
    end
    if role == "Innocent" then
      return "Inocente"
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function getObjectLabelAdornee(adornee, fallback)
    if adornee and adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
      return adornee
    end
    if adornee and adornee:IsA("Model") then
      if adornee.PrimaryPart then
        return adornee.PrimaryPart
      end
      local part = adornee:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
      if part then
        return part
      end
    end
    return fallback
  end

  -- markercleanup
  function ESP:ClearMap(map)
    for key, marker in pairs(map) do
      if type(marker) == "table" then
        destroyMarker(marker)
      else
        destroySafely(marker)
      end
      map[key] = nil
    end
  end
  function ESP:ClearAll()
    for _, marker in pairs(self.PlayerMarkers) do
      destroyMarker(marker)
    end
    table.clear(self.PlayerMarkers)
    table.clear(self.LastKnownRoles)
    self:ClearMap(self.CoinMarkers)
    self:ClearMap(self.GunMarkers)
    local playerGui = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local oldIndicators = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("ExodusESPIndicators")
    if oldIndicators then
      destroySafely(oldIndicators)
    end
  end

  -- roledata
  function ESP:ConnectRoleChanges()
    if self.RoleChangedConnection then
      return
    end
    local remote = MatchService:GetRemote({ "PlayerDataChanged" }, "RemoteEvent")
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      return
    end
    self.RoleChangedConnection = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(changes)
      if type(changes) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
      local roleData = self.RoleData or {}
      for playerName, profile in pairs(changes) do
        if type(playerName) == "string" and type(profile) == "table" then
          roleData[playerName] = profile
          local target = Services.Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)
          if profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true then
            if target then
              self.LastKnownRoles[target] = nil
            end
          elseif type(profile.Role) == "string" then
            if target then
              self.LastKnownRoles[target] = profile.Role
            end
          end
        end
      end
      self.RoleData = roleData
      self.RoleDataAt = os.clock()
      self:ScheduleRepair()
    end)
  end
  function ESP:GetRoleData()
    self.RoleData = MatchService:GetPlayerData()
    self.RoleDataAt = os.clock()
    return self.RoleData
  end

  -- playermarkers
  function ESP:CreatePlayerMarker(target, character, root, color)
    local highlight = createHighlight(self, "ExodusPlayerESP", character, color)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local nameAdornee = head and head:IsA("BasePart") and head or root
    local gui = createBillboard("ExodusPlayerName", nameAdornee, root)
    gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, nameAdornee.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.55, 0)
    local identityLabel = createTextLabel("Identity", gui)
    local usernameLabel = createTextLabel("Username", gui)
    local distanceLabel = createTextLabel("Distance", gui)
    return {
      Character = character,
      Root = root,
      Gui = gui,
      IdentityLabel = identityLabel,
      UsernameLabel = usernameLabel,
      DistanceLabel = distanceLabel,
      NameAdornee = nameAdornee,
      Highlight = highlight,
    }
  end
  function ESP:UpdatePlayerLabels(marker, username, identity, color, distance)
    local categoryEnabled = marker.Category ~= nil and self.Filters[marker.Category] == true
    local showIdentity = self.ShowIdentity == true and categoryEnabled
    local showDistance = self.ShowDistance == true and marker.IsSelf ~= true and categoryEnabled
    local showUsername = self.ShowUsername == true and categoryEnabled
    local identitySize = getNameTextSize(self, distance)
    local usernameSize = math.max(self.UsernameTextSizeMin, identitySize - 3)
    local identityHeight = identitySize + 1
    local usernameHeight = usernameSize + 1
    local offsetY = 0
    local labelColor = getLabelColor(color)
    marker.IdentityLabel.Text = identity
    marker.IdentityLabel.TextColor3 = labelColor
    marker.IdentityLabel.TextSize = identitySize
    marker.IdentityLabel.Visible = showIdentity
    marker.UsernameLabel.Text = username
    marker.UsernameLabel.TextColor3 = labelColor
    marker.UsernameLabel.TextSize = usernameSize
    marker.UsernameLabel.Visible = showUsername
    local distanceText = type(distance) == "number"
        and distance == distance
        and math.abs(distance) < math.huge
        and (tostring(math.floor(math.max(distance, 0) * STUD_TO_METERS)) .. "m")
      or "-- m"
    marker.DistanceLabel.Text = distanceText
    marker.DistanceLabel.TextColor3 = labelColor
    marker.DistanceLabel.TextSize = math.max(11, showIdentity and identitySize or usernameSize)
    marker.DistanceLabel.Visible = showDistance
    local primaryLabel, primaryHeight
    if showIdentity then
      if showUsername then
        marker.UsernameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        marker.UsernameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, offsetY)
        marker.UsernameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, usernameHeight)
        offsetY += usernameHeight
      end
      primaryLabel, primaryHeight = marker.IdentityLabel, identityHeight
    elseif showUsername then
      primaryLabel, primaryHeight = marker.UsernameLabel, usernameHeight
    end
    if primaryLabel then
      primaryLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
      if showDistance then
        marker.DistanceLabel.Text = " " .. distanceText
      end
      local primaryWidth = math.max(1, math.ceil(primaryLabel.TextBounds.X))
      local distanceWidth = showDistance and math.max(1, math.ceil(marker.DistanceLabel.TextBounds.X)) or 0
      local rowWidth = primaryWidth + distanceWidth
      local rowHeight = math.max(primaryHeight, showDistance and (marker.DistanceLabel.TextSize + 1) or 0)
      local rowX = (260 - rowWidth) * 0.5
      primaryLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rowX, offsetY)
      primaryLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(primaryWidth, rowHeight)
      if showDistance then
        marker.DistanceLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        marker.DistanceLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rowX + primaryWidth, offsetY)
        marker.DistanceLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(distanceWidth, rowHeight)
      end
      offsetY += rowHeight
    elseif showDistance then
      marker.DistanceLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
      local distanceWidth = math.ceil(marker.DistanceLabel.TextBounds.X)
      marker.DistanceLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((260 - distanceWidth) * 0.5, offsetY)
      marker.DistanceLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(distanceWidth, marker.DistanceLabel.TextSize + 2)
      offsetY += marker.DistanceLabel.TextSize + 2
    end
    marker.Gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, math.max(offsetY, 1))
    marker.Gui.Enabled = offsetY > 0
  end
  function ESP:SetFilter(filter, enabled)
    if self.Filters[filter] == nil then
      return false
    end
    self.Filters[filter] = enabled == true
    if enabled then
      return true
    end
    if filter == "Murderer" or filter == "Sheriff" or filter == "Innocent" then
      for target, marker in pairs(self.PlayerMarkers) do
        if marker.Category == filter then
          destroyMarker(marker)
          self.PlayerMarkers[target] = nil
        end
      end
    elseif filter == "CandyCoin" then
      self:ClearMap(self.CoinMarkers)
    elseif filter == "Gun" then
      self:ClearMap(self.GunMarkers)
    end
    return true
  end
  function ESP:SetShowSelf(enabled)
    self.ShowSelf = enabled == true
    self.Filters.Self = self.ShowSelf
    if not self.ShowSelf then
      local marker = self.PlayerMarkers[Player]
      if marker then
        destroyMarker(marker)
        self.PlayerMarkers[Player] = nil
      end
    elseif self.Enabled then
      self:ScheduleRepair()
    end
    return true
  end
  function ESP:UpdateDistances()
    if not self.Enabled or not self.ShowDistance then
      return
    end
    local localCharacter = Player.Character
    local localRoot = localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not localRoot or not localRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
      return
    end
    for target, marker in pairs(self.PlayerMarkers) do
      if
        target == Player
        or not marker.Root
        or not marker.Root.Parent
        or not marker.Gui
        or not marker.Gui.Parent
        or not marker.UsernameLabel
        or not marker.UsernameLabel.Parent
        or not marker.IdentityLabel
        or not marker.IdentityLabel.Parent
        or not marker.DistanceLabel
        or not marker.DistanceLabel.Parent
      then
        continue
      end
      local color = self.Colors[marker.ColorCategory or marker.Category]
      if color then
        self:UpdatePlayerLabels(marker, marker.UsernameLabel.Text, marker.IdentityLabel.Text, color, getDistance(localRoot, marker.Root))
      end
    end
  end
  function ESP:RefreshPlayers(roleData, inMatch)
    if not inMatch then
      table.clear(self.LastKnownRoles)
    end
    local keepWorld = {}
    local localCharacter = Player.Character
    local localRoot = localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    for _, target in ipairs(Services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local isSelf = target == Player
      if isSelf and not self.ShowSelf then
        continue
      end
      local profile = roleData and roleData[target.Name]
      local character = target.Character
      local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local aliveAttribute = target:GetAttribute("Alive")
      local profileSaysDead = type(profile) == "table" and (profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true)
      local worldAvailable = character and character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart")
      if not worldAvailable then
        self.LastKnownRoles[target] = nil
        continue
      end
      local roleActive = inMatch == true and aliveAttribute ~= false and not profileSaysDead
      if profileSaysDead then
        self.LastKnownRoles[target] = nil
      end
      local role = roleActive and (type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role or self.LastKnownRoles[target]) or nil
      if roleActive and type(profile) == "table" and type(profile.Role) == "string" then
        self.LastKnownRoles[target] = profile.Role
      end
      local roleCategory = getRoleCategory(role)
      local roleLabel = type(role) == "string" and (getRoleLabel(role) or role) or nil
      local category = isSelf and "Self" or roleCategory or "Player"
      local identity = isSelf and (roleLabel and ("Você · " .. roleLabel) or "Você") or roleLabel or "Sem papel"
      if category and identity and self.Filters[category] == true and worldAvailable then
        keepWorld[target] = true
        local colorCategory = isSelf and (roleCategory or "Player") or category
        local color = self.Colors[colorCategory]
        local distance = getDistance(localRoot, root)
        local marker = self.PlayerMarkers[target]
        local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local nameAdornee = head and head:IsA("BasePart") and head or root
        if
          not marker
          or marker.Character ~= character
          or marker.Root ~= root
          or marker.NameAdornee ~= nameAdornee
          or not marker.Gui.Parent
          or not marker.Highlight.Parent
        then
          if marker then
            destroyMarker(marker)
          end
          marker = self:CreatePlayerMarker(target, character, root, color)
          self.PlayerMarkers[target] = marker
        end
        marker.Category = category
        marker.ColorCategory = colorCategory
        marker.Role = roleCategory and role or nil
        marker.IsSelf = isSelf
        self:UpdatePlayerLabels(marker, target.Name, identity, color, distance)
        marker.Highlight.FillColor = color
        marker.Highlight.FillTransparency = self.FillTransparency
        marker.Highlight.OutlineColor = color
        marker.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = self.OutlineTransparency
      end
    end
    for target, marker in pairs(self.PlayerMarkers) do
      if not keepWorld[target] then
        destroyMarker(marker)
        self.PlayerMarkers[target] = nil
      end
    end
  end

  -- coinmarkers
  local function getCoinVisualAdornee(part)
    local visual = part:FindFirstChild("CoinVisual")
    if not visual then
      return part
    end
    if visual:IsA("Model") or visual:IsA("BasePart") then
      return visual
    end
    local model = visual:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model", true)
    if model then
      return model
    end
    local mainCoin = visual:FindFirstChild("MainCoin", true)
    if mainCoin and mainCoin:IsA("BasePart") then
      return mainCoin
    end
    return visual:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) or part
  end
  function ESP:RefreshCoins(container)
    local keep = {}
    local localCharacter = Player.Character
    local localRoot = localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    for _, part in ipairs(CoinService:GetCollectableParts(container)) do
      local kind = CoinService:GetKind(part)
      local adornee = getCoinVisualAdornee(part)
      local labelAdornee = getObjectLabelAdornee(adornee, part)
      if kind and self.Filters.CandyCoin then
        keep[part] = true
        local marker = self.CoinMarkers[part]
        if not marker or not marker.Gui.Parent or not marker.Highlight.Parent or marker.Highlight.Adornee ~= adornee or marker.Gui.Adornee ~= labelAdornee then
          if marker then
            destroyMarker(marker)
          end
          marker = {
            Highlight = createHighlight(self, "ExodusCandyCoinESP", adornee, self.Colors.CandyCoin),
            Gui = createBillboard("ExodusCandyCoinName", labelAdornee, labelAdornee),
          }

          marker.Gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, labelAdornee.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.45, 0)
          marker.IdentityLabel = createTextLabel("Identity", marker.Gui)
          self.CoinMarkers[part] = marker
        end
        local label = kind == "candy" and "Candy" or "Coin"
        local distance = getDistance(localRoot, part, self.NameScaleFarDistance)
        local textSize = getNameTextSize(self, distance)
        marker.IdentityLabel.Text = label
        marker.IdentityLabel.TextColor3 = getLabelColor(self.Colors.CandyCoin)
        marker.IdentityLabel.TextSize = textSize
        marker.IdentityLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        marker.IdentityLabel.Visible = self.ShowIdentity == true
        marker.Gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, textSize + 8)
        marker.Gui.Enabled = self.ShowIdentity == true
        marker.Highlight.FillColor = self.Colors.CandyCoin
        marker.Highlight.FillTransparency = self.FillTransparency
        marker.Highlight.OutlineColor = self.Colors.CandyCoin
        marker.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = self.OutlineTransparency
      end
    end
    for part, marker in pairs(self.CoinMarkers) do
      if not keep[part] then
        destroyMarker(marker)
        self.CoinMarkers[part] = nil
      end
    end
  end

  -- gunmarkers
  local function addGunPart(gunParts, instance, heldRoots)
    local part
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") and instance:IsDescendantOf(Services.Workspace) then
      part = instance
    elseif instance:IsA("Model") and instance:IsDescendantOf(Services.Workspace) then
      part = instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    elseif instance:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
      part = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end
    if not part or not part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
      return
    end
    local ancestor = part
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= Workspace do
      if ancestor:IsA("Tool") or heldRoots[ancestor] then
        return
      end
      ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    gunParts[part] = true
  end
  local function isGunStationary(esp, part, now)
    local velocityOk, velocity = pcall(function() return part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
    local positionOk, position = pcall(function() return part.Position end)
    if not velocityOk or not positionOk or not Util.IsFiniteVector3(velocity) or not Util.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
      esp.GunMotion[part] = nil
      return false
    end
    local motion = esp.GunMotion[part]
    if velocity.Magnitude > 0.5 or not motion or (position - motion.Position).Magnitude > 0.08 then
      esp.GunMotion[part] = { Position = position, Since = now }
      return false
    end
    motion.Position = position
    return now - motion.Since >= 0.2
  end
  function ESP:RefreshGuns()
    local gunParts = {}
    local visibleGunParts = {}
    if self.Filters.Gun then
      local heldRoots = {}
      for _, target in ipairs(Services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if target.Character then
          heldRoots[target.Character] = true
        end
        local backpack = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if backpack then
          heldRoots[backpack] = true
        end
      end
      for _, gun in ipairs(API.Services.Drops:GetAll()) do
        addGunPart(gunParts, gun, heldRoots)
      end
    end
    local localCharacter = Player.Character
    local localRoot = localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    for part in pairs(gunParts) do
      if not isGunStationary(self, part, os.clock()) then
        continue
      end
      visibleGunParts[part] = true
      local marker = self.GunMarkers[part]
      if not marker or not marker.Gui.Parent or not marker.Highlight.Parent then
        if marker then
          destroyMarker(marker)
        end
        local gui = createBillboard("ExodusGunName", part, part)
        gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.45, 0)
        marker = {
          Highlight = createHighlight(self, "ExodusGunESP", part, self.Colors.Gun),
          Gui = gui,
          IdentityLabel = createTextLabel("Identity", gui),
        }

        self.GunMarkers[part] = marker
      end
      local distance = getDistance(localRoot, part, self.NameScaleFarDistance)
      local textSize = getNameTextSize(self, distance)
      marker.IdentityLabel.Text = "Arma"
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextColor3 = getLabelColor(self.Colors.Gun)
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextSize = textSize
      marker.IdentityLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
      marker.IdentityLabel.Visible = self.ShowIdentity == true
      marker.Gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, textSize + 8)
      marker.Gui.Enabled = self.ShowIdentity == true
      marker.Highlight.FillColor = self.Colors.Gun
      marker.Highlight.FillTransparency = self.FillTransparency
      marker.Highlight.OutlineColor = self.Colors.Gun
      marker.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = self.OutlineTransparency
    end
    for part, marker in pairs(self.GunMarkers) do
      if not visibleGunParts[part] then
        destroyMarker(marker)
        self.GunMarkers[part] = nil
      end
    end
    for part in pairs(self.GunMotion) do
      if not gunParts[part] then
        self.GunMotion[part] = nil
      end
    end
  end

  -- refresh
  function ESP:Refresh(cachedRolesOnly)
    local inMatch, _, container = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    self.InRound = inMatch == true
    if not inMatch then
      self.RoleData = nil
      self.RoleDataAt = 0
      table.clear(self.LastKnownRoles)
    end
    local needsRoleData = inMatch and (self.ShowSelf or self.Filters.Murderer or self.Filters.Sheriff or self.Filters.Innocent)
    local roleData
    if needsRoleData then
      if cachedRolesOnly then
        roleData = self.RoleData
      else
        roleData = self:GetRoleData()
      end
    end
    self:RefreshPlayers(roleData, inMatch)
    if self.Filters.CandyCoin and container then
      self:RefreshCoins(container)
    else
      self:ClearMap(self.CoinMarkers)
    end
    if self.Filters.Gun then
      self:RefreshGuns()
    else
      self:ClearMap(self.GunMarkers)
    end
  end
  function ESP:ScheduleRepair()
    if self.RepairScheduled or not self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    self.RepairScheduled = true
    task.defer(function()
      if self.Enabled and not Runtime.ShuttingDown then
        local ok, errorMessage = xpcall(function() self:Refresh() end, Util.FormatError)
        if not ok then
          self:ReportError("reparação de marcadores", errorMessage)
        end
      end
      self.RepairScheduled = false
    end)
  end
  local function reapplyLabel(label)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextTransparency = 0
    label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
  end
  local function markerNeedsRepair(marker, includeUsername)
    if not marker or not marker.Gui or not marker.Highlight then
      return true
    end
    if not marker.Gui.Parent or not marker.Highlight.Parent then
      return true
    end
    if not marker.IdentityLabel or marker.IdentityLabel.Parent ~= marker.Gui then
      return true
    end
    if not includeUsername then
      return false
    end
    return not marker.UsernameLabel or marker.UsernameLabel.Parent ~= marker.Gui or not marker.DistanceLabel or marker.DistanceLabel.Parent ~= marker.Gui
  end
  function ESP:ReapplyMarkers()
    if not self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local needsRepair = false
    local localCharacter = Player.Character
    local localRoot = localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    for target, marker in pairs(self.PlayerMarkers) do
      if not marker.Category or self.Filters[marker.Category] ~= true then
        destroyMarker(marker)
        self.PlayerMarkers[target] = nil
        continue
      end
      local character = target.Character
      local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local profile = self.RoleData and self.RoleData[target.Name]
      local profileSaysDead = type(profile) == "table" and (profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true)
      if
        not character
        or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
        or not humanoid
        or humanoid.Health <= 0
        or (marker.Role and (target:GetAttribute("Alive") == false or profileSaysDead))
      then
        if profileSaysDead then
          self.LastKnownRoles[target] = nil
        end
        destroyMarker(marker)
        self.PlayerMarkers[target] = nil
        self:ScheduleRepair()
        continue
      end
      if
        markerNeedsRepair(marker, true)
        or not marker.Character
        or not marker.Character.Parent
        or not marker.Root
        or not marker.Root.Parent
        or not marker.NameAdornee
        or not marker.NameAdornee.Parent
      then
        needsRepair = true
        continue
      end
      local color = self.Colors[marker.ColorCategory or marker.Category]
      if not color then
        needsRepair = true
        continue
      end
      local highlight = marker.Highlight
      highlight.Adornee = marker.Character
      highlight.Parent = marker.Character
      highlight.Enabled = true
      highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
      highlight.FillColor = color
      highlight.FillTransparency = self.FillTransparency
      highlight.OutlineColor = color
      highlight.OutlineTransparency = self.OutlineTransparency
      local gui = marker.Gui
      gui.Adornee = marker.NameAdornee
      gui.Parent = marker.Root
      gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
      gui.LightInfluence = 0
      gui.MaxDistance = 0
      gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, marker.NameAdornee.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.55, 0)
      self:UpdatePlayerLabels(marker, marker.UsernameLabel.Text, marker.IdentityLabel.Text, color, getDistance(localRoot, marker.Root))
      reapplyLabel(marker.IdentityLabel)
      reapplyLabel(marker.UsernameLabel)
      reapplyLabel(marker.DistanceLabel)
    end
    for part, marker in pairs(self.CoinMarkers) do
      if markerNeedsRepair(marker, false) or not part.Parent then
        needsRepair = true
        continue
      end
      local adornee = getCoinVisualAdornee(part)
      local labelAdornee = getObjectLabelAdornee(adornee, part)
      local highlight = marker.Highlight
      highlight.Adornee = adornee
      highlight.Parent = adornee
      highlight.Enabled = true
      highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
      highlight.FillColor = self.Colors.CandyCoin
      highlight.FillTransparency = self.FillTransparency
      highlight.OutlineColor = self.Colors.CandyCoin
      highlight.OutlineTransparency = self.OutlineTransparency
      local gui = marker.Gui
      gui.Adornee = labelAdornee
      gui.Parent = labelAdornee
      gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
      gui.LightInfluence = 0
      gui.MaxDistance = 0
      gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, labelAdornee.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.45, 0)
      marker.IdentityLabel.Visible = self.ShowIdentity == true and self.Filters.CandyCoin == true
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextColor3 = getLabelColor(self.Colors.CandyCoin)
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextTransparency = 0
      marker.IdentityLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
      gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, marker.IdentityLabel.TextSize + 8)
      gui.Enabled = marker.IdentityLabel.Visible
      reapplyLabel(marker.IdentityLabel)
    end
    for part, marker in pairs(self.GunMarkers) do
      if markerNeedsRepair(marker, false) or not part.Parent then
        needsRepair = true
        continue
      end
      local color = self.Colors.Gun
      local highlight = marker.Highlight
      highlight.Adornee = part
      highlight.Parent = part
      highlight.Enabled = true
      highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
      highlight.FillColor = color
      highlight.FillTransparency = self.FillTransparency
      highlight.OutlineColor = color
      highlight.OutlineTransparency = self.OutlineTransparency
      local gui = marker.Gui
      gui.Adornee = part
      gui.Parent = part
      gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
      gui.LightInfluence = 0
      gui.MaxDistance = 0
      gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.45, 0)
      marker.IdentityLabel.Visible = self.ShowIdentity == true and self.Filters.Gun == true
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextColor3 = getLabelColor(color)
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
      marker.IdentityLabel.TextTransparency = 0
      marker.IdentityLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
      gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, marker.IdentityLabel.TextSize + 8)
      gui.Enabled = marker.IdentityLabel.Visible
      reapplyLabel(marker.IdentityLabel)
    end
    if needsRepair then
      self:ScheduleRepair()
    end
  end
  local function hideMarkerForPreRender(marker)
    if marker.Highlight and marker.Highlight.Parent then
      marker.Highlight.Enabled = false
    end
    if marker.Gui and marker.Gui.Parent then
      marker.Gui.Enabled = false
    end
  end
  function ESP:HideMarkersForPreRender()
    for _, marker in pairs(self.PlayerMarkers) do
      hideMarkerForPreRender(marker)
    end
    for _, marker in pairs(self.CoinMarkers) do
      hideMarkerForPreRender(marker)
    end
    for _, marker in pairs(self.GunMarkers) do
      hideMarkerForPreRender(marker)
    end
  end
  function ESP:ReportError(context, errorMessage)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - self.LastErrorAt < 5 then
      return
    end
    self.LastErrorAt = now
    warn("[Exodus MM2] ESP recuperando após erro em " .. context .. ": " .. tostring(errorMessage))
  end

  -- lifecycle
  function ESP:Start()
    if self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local pulseSnapshot = self.PulseSnapshot
    self.PulseSnapshot = nil
    self:ClearAll()
    if pulseSnapshot then
      self.RoleData = pulseSnapshot.RoleData
      self.RoleDataAt = pulseSnapshot.RoleDataAt
      self.InRound = pulseSnapshot.InRound
      for target, role in pairs(pulseSnapshot.LastKnownRoles) do
        self.LastKnownRoles[target] = role
      end
    end
    self.Enabled = true
    self:ConnectRoleChanges()
    local refreshed, refreshError = xpcall(function() self:Refresh(pulseSnapshot ~= nil) end, Util.FormatError)
    if not refreshed then
      self:ReportError("atualização inicial", refreshError)
    end
    self.LastPulseAt = os.clock()
    self.RenderConnection = Runtime:Track(Services.RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
      local now = os.clock()
      if not self.Enabled then
        return
      end
      self:UpdateDistances()
      if now - self.LastPulseAt < self.PulseInterval then
        return
      end
      local needsRoleData = self.InRound and (self.ShowSelf or self.Filters.Murderer or self.Filters.Sheriff or self.Filters.Innocent)
      if needsRoleData and not self.RoleData then
        return
      end
      self.LastPulseAt = now
      self:ScheduleRepair()
    end))
    local thread
    thread = task.spawn(function()
      while self.Enabled and not Runtime.ShuttingDown do
        local ok, errorMessage = xpcall(function() self:Refresh() end, Util.FormatError)
        if not ok then
          self:ReportError("atualização", errorMessage)
        end
        task.wait(self.RefreshInterval)
      end
      if self.Thread == thread then
        self.Thread = nil
      end
      self:ClearAll()
    end)
    self.Thread = thread
  end
  function ESP:Stop()
    self.Enabled = false
    local thread = self.Thread
    self.Thread = nil
    if self.RenderConnection then
      pcall(function() self.RenderConnection:Disconnect() end)
      self.RenderConnection = nil
    end
    if thread then
      pcall(task.cancel, thread)
    end
    if self.RoleChangedConnection then
      pcall(function() self.RoleChangedConnection:Disconnect() end)
      self.RoleChangedConnection = nil
    end
    self:ClearAll()
    if not self.PulseSnapshot then
      self.RoleData = nil
      self.RoleDataAt = 0
    end
  end
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function() ESP:Stop() end)
  return ESP
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2farm
-- [[ autofarm ]]

local function create(API)
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Player = API.Player
  local Runtime = API.Runtime
  local Util = API.Util
  local Workspace = Services.Workspace
  local CoinService = API.Services.Coin
  local MapService = API.Services.Map
  local MatchService = API.Services.Match
  local TOUCH_DISTANCE = 3.5
  local PASS_THROUGH_DISTANCE = 1.5
  local ROLE_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 0.5
  local AVOID_MURDERER_COIN_DISTANCE = 45
  local CONFIG = {
    AVOID_MURDERER_PLAYER_DISTANCE = 40,
  }

  local AVOID_MURDERER_PLAYER_DISTANCE = CONFIG.AVOID_MURDERER_PLAYER_DISTANCE
  local NO_ROLE_VALUES = { unknown = true, none = true, norole = true, sempapel = true, unassigned = true, waiting = true, lobby = true }

  -- state
  local Farm = {
    Enabled = false,
    Farming = false,
    Speed = 40,
    Thread = nil,
    Tween = nil,
    ProximityConnection = nil,
    BagFull = false,
    ResetWhenBagFull = false,
    AvoidMurderer = false,
    BagResetTriggered = false,
    BagResetThread = nil,
    MaintenanceConnection = nil,
    NoclipLease = false,
    FarmingCharacter = nil,
    FarmingHumanoid = nil,
    SavedHumanoidState = nil,
    ActivationCharacter = nil,
    ActivationRoot = nil,
    ActivationCFrame = nil,
    PassedCoins = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    CollectionSerial = 0,
    PassedContainer = nil,
    LastErrorAt = 0,
    RoleData = nil,
    NextRoleRefreshAt = 0,
    ThreatRoot = nil,
    ThreatRefreshAt = 0,
  }

  -- touchsupport
  local function getTouchFunction()
    local ok, touchFunction = pcall(function() return firetouchinterest end)
    if ok and type(touchFunction) == "function" then
      return touchFunction
    end
    return nil
  end

  -- diagnostics
  function Farm:ReportError(context, errorMessage)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - self.LastErrorAt < 5 then
      return
    end
    self.LastErrorAt = now
    warn("[Exodus MM2] Auto Farm recuperando após erro em " .. context .. ": " .. tostring(errorMessage))
  end
  function Farm:GetRoleData(force)
    local now = os.clock()
    if not force and now < self.NextRoleRefreshAt then
      return self.RoleData
    end
    self.NextRoleRefreshAt = now + ROLE_REFRESH_INTERVAL
    local ok, roleData = pcall(MatchService.GetPlayerData, MatchService)
    self.RoleData = ok and type(roleData) == "table" and roleData or nil
    return self.RoleData
  end
  function Farm:HasAssignedRole()
    local roleData = self:GetRoleData()
    local profile = roleData and roleData[Player.Name]
    local role = type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role or nil
    if type(role) ~= "string" or profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true then
      return false
    end
    local normalizedRole = string.lower(role):gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
    return normalizedRole ~= "" and not NO_ROLE_VALUES[normalizedRole]
  end
  function Farm:GetMurdererRoot()
    if not self.AvoidMurderer then
      return nil
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < self.ThreatRefreshAt then
      return self.ThreatRoot and self.ThreatRoot.Parent and self.ThreatRoot or nil
    end
    self.ThreatRefreshAt = now + 0.2
    self.ThreatRoot = nil
    local roleData = self:GetRoleData()
    local localProfile = roleData and roleData[Player.Name]
    if type(localProfile) == "table" and localProfile.Role == "Murderer" then
      return nil
    end
    if type(roleData) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    for name, profile in pairs(roleData) do
      if name ~= Player.Name and type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role == "Murderer" and profile.Dead ~= true and profile.Killed ~= true then
        local target = Services.Players:FindFirstChild(name)
        local character = target and target.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if MatchService:IsAlive(target, profile) and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
          self.ThreatRoot = root
          return root
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function Farm:IsNearMurderer(position, threshold)
    if not self.AvoidMurderer or not Util.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
      return false
    end
    local threatRoot = self:GetMurdererRoot()
    return threatRoot ~= nil and (threatRoot.Position - position).Magnitude < (threshold or AVOID_MURDERER_COIN_DISTANCE)
  end
  function Farm:GetActiveContext()
    if Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      self.RoleData = nil
      self.NextRoleRefreshAt = 0
      return false
    end
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if
      not character
      or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
      or not humanoid
      or humanoid.Health <= 0
      or not root
      or not root:IsA("BasePart")
      or not self:HasAssignedRole()
    then
      return false
    end
    local container = MapService:GetCoinContainer()
    if not container or not container.Parent then
      return false
    end
    return true, character, humanoid, root, container
  end
  function Farm:ResetCharacterForFullBag()
    if not self.Enabled or not self.BagFull or not self.ResetWhenBagFull or self.BagResetTriggered or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return false
    end
    if MatchService:GetLocalRole() ~= "Innocent" then
      return false
    end
    local inMatch, character, humanoid = MatchService:GetContext()
    if not inMatch or not character or not humanoid then
      return false
    end
    self.BagResetTriggered = true
    self:StopFarming()
    local thread
    thread = task.spawn(function()
      task.wait(0.5)
      local canReset = self.Enabled
        and self.BagFull
        and self.ResetWhenBagFull
        and not Runtime.ShuttingDown
        and Player.Character == character
        and humanoid.Parent ~= nil
        and humanoid.Health > 0
        and Player:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
      if canReset and MatchService:GetLocalRole() == "Innocent" then
        local resetOk, resetError = pcall(function() humanoid.Health = 0 end)
        if not resetOk then
          self.BagResetTriggered = false
          self:ReportError("reset da bolsa cheia", resetError)
        end
      else
        self.BagResetTriggered = false
      end
      if self.BagResetThread == thread then
        self.BagResetThread = nil
      end
    end)
    self.BagResetThread = thread
    return true
  end
  function Farm:SetResetWhenBagFull(enabled)
    self.ResetWhenBagFull = enabled == true
    if not self.ResetWhenBagFull then
      self:CancelBagReset()
    elseif self.Enabled and self.BagFull then
      self:ResetCharacterForFullBag()
    end
  end
  function Farm:CancelBagReset()
    local thread = self.BagResetThread
    self.BagResetThread = nil
    if thread then
      pcall(task.cancel, thread)
      self.BagResetTriggered = false
    end
  end
  function Farm:ResetBagState()
    self:CancelBagReset()
    self.BagFull = false
    self.BagResetTriggered = false
  end

  -- noclip
  function Farm:EnableNoclip()
    if self.NoclipLease then
      return
    end
    local noclip = API.Features.Noclip
    if noclip and type(noclip.Acquire) == "function" then
      self.NoclipLease = noclip:Acquire(self) == true
    end
  end
  function Farm:DisableNoclip()
    if not self.NoclipLease then
      return
    end
    self.NoclipLease = false
    local noclip = API.Features.Noclip
    if noclip and type(noclip.Release) == "function" then
      noclip:Release(self)
    end
  end

  -- coincollection
  function Farm:TouchOnce(root, coin)
    if not self.Enabled or not root or not root.Parent or not coin or not coin.Parent then
      return
    end
    local touchFunction = getTouchFunction()
    if not touchFunction then
      return false
    end
    local enterOk = pcall(touchFunction, root, coin, 0)
    local exitOk = pcall(touchFunction, root, coin, 1)
    return enterOk and exitOk
  end
  function Farm:TouchCoinInRange(root, coin, container, coinPosition)
    if
      not self.Enabled
      or not self.Farming
      or not self:HasAssignedRole()
      or Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false
      or not root
      or not root.Parent
      or self:IsNearMurderer(root.Position, AVOID_MURDERER_PLAYER_DISTANCE)
      or self.PassedCoins[coin]
      or not CoinService:IsCollectable(coin, container)
    then
      return false
    end
    coinPosition = coinPosition or MapService:GetCoinPositions(container)[coin]
    if not coinPosition or (root.Position - coinPosition).Magnitude > TOUCH_DISTANCE then
      return false
    end
    self:TouchOnce(root, coin)
    return true
  end

  -- proximitycollection
  function Farm:StartProximityCollection()
    if self.ProximityConnection then
      return
    end
    self.ProximityConnection = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not self.Enabled or not self.Farming or self.BagFull then
        return
      end
      local ok, errorMessage = xpcall(function()
        local inMatch, _, _, root, container = self:GetActiveContext()
        if not inMatch then
          return
        end
        for coin, coinPosition in pairs(MapService:GetCoinPositions(container)) do
          self:TouchCoinInRange(root, coin, container, coinPosition)
        end
      end, Util.FormatError)
      if not ok then
        self:ReportError("coleta por proximidade", errorMessage)
      end
    end)
  end
  function Farm:StopProximityCollection()
    if self.ProximityConnection then
      pcall(function() self.ProximityConnection:Disconnect() end)
      self.ProximityConnection = nil
    end
  end

  -- farmmovement
  function Farm:StartFarming(character, humanoid, root)
    if self.Farming and self.FarmingCharacter == character then
      return true
    end
    if
      not character
      or not humanoid
      or humanoid.Health <= 0
      or not root
      or Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false
      or not Util.IsFiniteVector3(root.Position)
    then
      return false
    end
    self.FarmingCharacter = character
    self.FarmingHumanoid = humanoid
    self.SavedHumanoidState = {
      PlatformStand = humanoid.PlatformStand,
      FallingDown = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown),
      Ragdoll = humanoid:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll),
    }
    self.Farming = true
    local oldGravity = root:FindFirstChild("FarmGravity")
    if oldGravity then
      oldGravity:Destroy()
    end
    local gravity = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
    gravity.Name = "FarmGravity"
    gravity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
    gravity.D = 1000
    gravity.P = 10000
    gravity.Position = root.Position
    gravity.Parent = root
    root.CFrame = root.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
    self:EnableNoclip()
    self.MaintenanceConnection = Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not self.Enabled or not self.Farming or Player.Character ~= character or Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false or not root.Parent then
        self:StopFarming()
        return
      end
      pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        local activeGravity = root:FindFirstChild("FarmGravity")
        if activeGravity and activeGravity:IsA("BodyPosition") then
          activeGravity.Position = root.Position
        end
        if humanoid.Parent then
          humanoid.PlatformStand = true
        end
      end)
    end)
    return true
  end

  -- movementcleanup
  function Farm:StopFarming()
    local wasFarming = self.Farming
    local character = self.FarmingCharacter
    local humanoid = self.FarmingHumanoid
    local savedState = self.SavedHumanoidState
    self.Farming = false
    if self.Tween then
      pcall(function() self.Tween:Cancel() end)
      self.Tween = nil
    end
    if self.MaintenanceConnection then
      pcall(function() self.MaintenanceConnection:Disconnect() end)
      self.MaintenanceConnection = nil
    end
    self:DisableNoclip()
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root then
      local gravity = root:FindFirstChild("FarmGravity")
      if gravity then
        pcall(function() gravity:Destroy() end)
      end
      pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if wasFarming then
          root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
          root.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        end
      end)
    end
    if humanoid and humanoid.Parent and savedState then
      pcall(function()
        humanoid.PlatformStand = savedState.PlatformStand
        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, savedState.FallingDown)
        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, savedState.Ragdoll)
      end)
    end
    self.FarmingCharacter = nil
    self.FarmingHumanoid = nil
    self.SavedHumanoidState = nil
  end
  function Farm:StopMotion() self:StopFarming() end
  function Farm:RestoreActivationPosition()
    local character = self.ActivationCharacter
    local savedRoot = self.ActivationRoot
    local savedCFrame = self.ActivationCFrame
    self.ActivationCharacter = nil
    self.ActivationRoot = nil
    self.ActivationCFrame = nil
    if not character or Player.Character ~= character or not savedRoot or not savedCFrame then
      return false
    end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or root ~= savedRoot or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
      return false
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local excluded = {}
    for _, target in ipairs(Services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if target.Character then
        table.insert(excluded, target.Character)
      end
    end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
    pcall(function() params.RespectCanCollide = true end)
    local savedPosition = savedCFrame.Position
    local floor = Workspace:Raycast(savedPosition + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -8.5, 0), params)
    if not floor or savedPosition.Y - floor.Position.Y > 8 or floor.Position.Y > savedPosition.Y + 0.5 then
      return false
    end
    local restored = pcall(function()
      local antiFling = API.Features.AntiFling
      if antiFling and type(antiFling.AllowTeleport) == "function" then
        antiFling:AllowTeleport(0.35)
      end
      root.CFrame = savedCFrame
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
      root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
    return restored
  end

  -- coincollectionloop
  function Farm:CollectCoin(coin, character, humanoid, root, container, coinPosition)
    if not self.Enabled or not self:HasAssignedRole() or Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false or not CoinService:IsCollectable(coin, container) then
      return
    end
    local succeeded, errorMessage = xpcall(function()
      local collectionSerial = self.CollectionSerial
      if self.Farming and self.FarmingCharacter ~= character then
        self:StopFarming()
      end
      if not self.Farming and not self:StartFarming(character, humanoid, root) then
        return
      end
      coinPosition = coinPosition or MapService:GetCoinPositions(container)[coin] or coin.Position
      if not Util.IsFiniteVector3(coinPosition) or not Util.IsFiniteVector3(root.Position) then
        return
      end
      local speed = tonumber(self.Speed)
      if not speed or speed ~= speed or speed == math.huge then
        speed = 40
      end
      speed = math.max(speed, 1)
      local target = coinPosition - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
      local approach = target - root.Position
      local approachDistance = approach.Magnitude
      if approachDistance ~= approachDistance or approachDistance == math.huge then
        return
      end
      if approachDistance > 0.001 then
        target += approach.Unit * PASS_THROUGH_DISTANCE
      end
      if not Util.IsFiniteVector3(target) then
        return
      end
      local duration = math.max((target - root.Position).Magnitude / speed, 1 / 60)
      local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(target) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
      local tween = Services.TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { CFrame = targetCFrame })
      self.Tween = tween
      tween:Play()
      local deadline = os.clock() + duration + 0.5
      while
        self.Enabled
        and self.Farming
        and Player.Character == character
        and Player:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
        and humanoid.Health > 0
        and root.Parent
        and os.clock() < deadline
      do
        if self:IsNearMurderer(root.Position, AVOID_MURDERER_PLAYER_DISTANCE) or self:IsNearMurderer(coinPosition, AVOID_MURDERER_COIN_DISTANCE) then
          pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
          if self.Tween == tween then
            self.Tween = nil
          end
          return
        end
        local inMatch, activeCharacter, activeHumanoid, activeRoot, activeContainer = self:GetActiveContext()
        if
          not inMatch
          or activeCharacter ~= character
          or activeHumanoid ~= humanoid
          or activeRoot ~= root
          or activeContainer ~= container
          or not self:HasAssignedRole()
          or not coin.Parent
          or not coin:IsDescendantOf(container)
          or not CoinService:IsCollectable(coin, container)
        then
          break
        end
        self:TouchCoinInRange(root, coin, container, coinPosition)
        if self.CollectionSerial ~= collectionSerial or not CoinService:IsCollectable(coin, container) then
          break
        end
        if tween.PlaybackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
          break
        end
        Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
      end
      local routeCompleted = tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
      if self.Tween == tween then
        pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
        self.Tween = nil
      end
      if self.Enabled and self.Farming and root.Parent and coin.Parent and coin:IsDescendantOf(container) and CoinService:IsCollectable(coin, container) then
        self:TouchCoinInRange(root, coin, container, coinPosition)
      end
      if routeCompleted and coin.Parent and coin:IsDescendantOf(container) and CoinService:IsCollectable(coin, container) then
        self.PassedCoins[coin] = true
      end
    end, Util.FormatError)
    if not succeeded then
      self:ReportError("coleta", errorMessage)
    end
  end

  -- lifecycle
  function Farm:Start()
    if self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local character = Player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    self.ActivationCharacter = character
    self.ActivationRoot = root
    self.ActivationCFrame = root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.CFrame or nil
    self.Enabled = true
    self.RoleData = nil
    self.NextRoleRefreshAt = 0
    self.ThreatRoot = nil
    self.ThreatRefreshAt = 0
    table.clear(self.PassedCoins)
    self.PassedContainer = nil
    local invisicam = API.Features.Invisicam
    if invisicam and type(invisicam.SetSource) == "function" then
      pcall(invisicam.SetSource, invisicam, "AutoFarm", true)
    end
    local thread
    thread = task.spawn(function()
      while self.Enabled and not Runtime.ShuttingDown do
        local ok, errorMessage = xpcall(function()
          local inMatch, character, humanoid, root, container = self:GetActiveContext()
          if not inMatch then
            self:StopFarming()
            Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            return
          end
          if self.BagFull then
            self:StopFarming()
            Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            return
          end
          if self:IsNearMurderer(root.Position, AVOID_MURDERER_PLAYER_DISTANCE) then
            self:StopFarming()
            Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            return
          end
          if self.PassedContainer ~= container then
            table.clear(self.PassedCoins)
            self.PassedContainer = container
          end
          local coin, _, coinPosition = MapService:GetNearestCoin(
            container,
            root.Position,
            nil,
            self.PassedCoins,
            function(_, position) return not self:IsNearMurderer(position, AVOID_MURDERER_COIN_DISTANCE) end
          )
          if coin then
            self:CollectCoin(coin, character, humanoid, root, container, coinPosition)
          else
            Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
          end
        end, Util.FormatError)
        if not ok then
          self:ReportError("ciclo", errorMessage)
          Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
      end
      if self.Thread == thread then
        self.Thread = nil
      end
      self:StopFarming()
      self:StopProximityCollection()
    end)
    self.Thread = thread
    self:StartProximityCollection()
    if self.BagFull then
      self:ResetCharacterForFullBag()
    end
  end
  function Farm:Stop(restoreActivationPosition)
    self.Enabled = false
    local thread = self.Thread
    self.Thread = nil
    if thread then
      pcall(task.cancel, thread)
    end
    self:CancelBagReset()
    self:StopFarming()
    self:StopProximityCollection()
    local invisicam = API.Features.Invisicam
    if invisicam and type(invisicam.SetSource) == "function" then
      pcall(invisicam.SetSource, invisicam, "AutoFarm", false)
    end
    if restoreActivationPosition == true then
      self:RestoreActivationPosition()
    else
      self.ActivationCharacter = nil
      self.ActivationRoot = nil
      self.ActivationCFrame = nil
    end
  end
  Runtime:Track(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() Farm:StopMotion() end))
  Runtime:Track(Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Alive"):Connect(function()
    if Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      Farm:StopMotion()
    end
  end))

  -- roundevents
  local function bindFarmRoundEvents()
    local remotes = Services.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
    if not gameplay then
      return
    end
    local coinCollected = gameplay:FindFirstChild("CoinCollected")
    if coinCollected and coinCollected:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      Runtime:Track(coinCollected.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(coinType, count, maximum)
        if not CoinService:NormalizeKind(coinType) then
          return
        end
        Farm.CollectionSerial += 1
        local collected = tonumber(count)
        local capacity = tonumber(maximum)
        if not collected or not capacity or capacity <= 0 then
          return
        end
        if collected >= capacity then
          Farm.BagFull = true
          Farm:StopFarming()
          Farm:ResetCharacterForFullBag()
        end
      end))
    end
    for _, eventName in ipairs({ "RoundStart", "CoinsStarted", "RoundEndFade" }) do
      local event = gameplay:FindFirstChild(eventName)
      if event and event:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        local isRoundEnd = eventName == "RoundEndFade"
        Runtime:Track(event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
          Farm:ResetBagState()
          Farm.PassedCoins = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
          Farm.PassedContainer = nil
          if isRoundEnd then
            Farm:StopFarming()
          end
        end))
      end
    end
  end
  bindFarmRoundEvents()
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function() Farm:Stop(false) end)
  return Farm
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module
