--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2map
-- [[ mapservice ]]

local function create(API)
  local Config = API.Config
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Runtime = API.Runtime
  local CoinService = API.Services.Coin
  local Util = API.Util

  -- cache
  local MapService = {
    CachedContainer = nil,
    NextScan = 0,
    CachedCoinContainer = nil,
    CachedCoinPositions = {},
    CoinChildAddedConnection = nil,
    CoinChildRemovedConnection = nil,
  }

  local function disconnect(connection)
    if connection then
      pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
    end
  end
  local function cacheCoinPosition(coin)
    if not coin or not coin:IsA("BasePart") then
      return
    end
    local ok, position = pcall(function() return coin.Position end)
    if ok and Util.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
      MapService.CachedCoinPositions[coin] = position
    end
  end
  local function replaceCoinPositionCache(container)
    if MapService.CachedCoinContainer == container then
      return MapService.CachedCoinPositions
    end
    disconnect(MapService.CoinChildAddedConnection)
    disconnect(MapService.CoinChildRemovedConnection)
    MapService.CoinChildAddedConnection = nil
    MapService.CoinChildRemovedConnection = nil
    MapService.CachedCoinContainer = container
    table.clear(MapService.CachedCoinPositions)
    if not container then
      return MapService.CachedCoinPositions
    end
    for _, coin in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
      cacheCoinPosition(coin)
    end
    MapService.CoinChildAddedConnection = container.ChildAdded:Connect(cacheCoinPosition)
    MapService.CoinChildRemovedConnection = container.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(coin) MapService.CachedCoinPositions[coin] = nil end)
    return MapService.CachedCoinPositions
  end
  function MapService:GetCoinPositions(container) return replaceCoinPositionCache(container) end
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function()
    disconnect(MapService.CoinChildAddedConnection)
    disconnect(MapService.CoinChildRemovedConnection)
  end)

  -- containerdiscovery
  local function isCoinContainer(instance) return instance and instance.Name == "CoinContainer" and (instance:IsA("Folder") or instance:IsA("Model")) end
  local function isMapCoinContainer(instance)
    local map = instance and instance.Parent
    return isCoinContainer(instance)
      and map
      and map:IsA("Model")
      and map.Parent == Services.Workspace
      and (map:GetAttribute("MapID") ~= nil or map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") ~= nil)
  end
  Runtime:Track(Services.Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(instance)
    if isMapCoinContainer(instance) then
      MapService.CachedContainer = nil
      MapService.NextScan = 0
    end
  end))
  Runtime:Track(Services.Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
    local cached = MapService.CachedContainer
    if cached and (cached == instance or cached:IsDescendantOf(instance)) then
      MapService.CachedContainer = nil
      MapService.NextScan = 0
    end
  end))

  -- mapscan
  function MapService:GetCoinContainer()
    local active, _, roundContainer = API.Services.Match:GetRoundContext()
    if not active or not roundContainer then
      return nil
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < self.NextScan and isMapCoinContainer(self.CachedContainer) then
      return self.CachedContainer
    end
    self.CachedContainer = nil
    if now < self.NextScan then
      return nil
    end
    self.NextScan = now + Config.MapRefreshInterval
    for _, map in ipairs(Services.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
      if map:IsA("Model") and (map:GetAttribute("MapID") ~= nil or map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") ~= nil) then
        local container = map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
        if isCoinContainer(container) then
          self.CachedContainer = container
          return container
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end

  -- nearestcoin
  function MapService:GetNearestCoin(container, position, retryAfter, passedCoins, filter)
    if not container or not container.Parent then
      return nil, math.huge
    end
    if not Util.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
      return nil, math.huge
    end
    retryAfter = retryAfter or {}
    local nearest, nearestDistance, nearestPosition = nil, math.huge, nil
    local now = os.clock()
    for coin, coinPosition in pairs(self:GetCoinPositions(container)) do
      local retryAt = retryAfter[coin] or 0
      if not coin.Parent or not coin:IsDescendantOf(container) then
        self.CachedCoinPositions[coin] = nil
      elseif retryAt <= now and not (passedCoins and passedCoins[coin]) and CoinService:IsCollectable(coin, container) then
        local ok, currentPosition = pcall(function() return coin.Position end)
        if ok and Util.IsFiniteVector3(currentPosition) then
          if (currentPosition - coinPosition).Magnitude > 0.1 then
            coinPosition = currentPosition
            self.CachedCoinPositions[coin] = currentPosition
          end
          if filter and not filter(coin, coinPosition) then
            continue
          end
          local distance = (position - coinPosition).Magnitude
          if distance == distance and distance < math.huge and distance < nearestDistance then
            nearest, nearestDistance, nearestPosition = coin, distance, coinPosition
          end
        else
          self.CachedCoinPositions[coin] = nil
        end
      end
    end
    return nearest, nearestDistance, nearestPosition
  end
  return MapService
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2maptools
-- [[ maptools ]]

-- code

local function create(API)
  local Player = API.Player
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Runtime = API.Runtime
  local MatchService = API.Services.Match
  local MapTools = {
    FavoriteMaps = {},
    MoveGeneration = 0,
    MoveThread = nil,
    VoteThread = nil,
    ManualMoveUntil = 0,
    IsWalking = false,
    MovementOwner = nil,
    AutoGunTeleportEnabled = false,
    LastAutoGun = nil,
  }

  local function notify(content) API.Notify("Mapa", content) end
  local function allowAntiFlingTeleport()
    local antiFling = API.Features.AntiFling
    if antiFling and type(antiFling.AllowTeleport) == "function" then
      antiFling:AllowTeleport(0.35)
    end
  end
  local function getTeleportContext()
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Services.Workspace) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
      return nil
    end
    return character
  end
  local function getMovementContext()
    local inRound = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if inRound and Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
      return nil
    end
    return character, humanoid, root, inRound == true
  end
  local function getLiveTarget(target, requireAliveAttribute)
    if not target or target == Player or requireAliveAttribute and target:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      return nil
    end
    local character = target.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Services.Workspace) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
      return nil
    end
    return character, humanoid, root
  end
  local function isProfileLive(target, profile)
    return type(profile) == "table"
      and profile.Dead ~= true
      and profile.Killed ~= true
      and MatchService:IsAlive(target, profile)
      and getLiveTarget(target, true) ~= nil
  end
  function MapTools:GetPlayerOptions()
    local names = { "None" }
    for _, target in ipairs(Services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if target ~= Player then
        table.insert(names, target.Name)
      end
    end
    table.sort(names, function(left, right)
      if left == "None" then
        return true
      end
      if right == "None" then
        return false
      end
      return left:lower() < right:lower()
    end)
    return names
  end
  function MapTools:GetFavoriteMapOptions()
    local options = { "None" }
    local seen = { None = true }
    for _, favourite in ipairs(self.FavoriteMaps) do
      if not seen[favourite] then
        seen[favourite] = true
        table.insert(options, favourite)
      end
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(self:GetVoteBoard()) do
      if not seen[entry.Name] then
        seen[entry.Name] = true
        table.insert(options, entry.Name)
      end
    end
    table.sort(options, function(left, right)
      if left == "None" then
        return true
      end
      if right == "None" then
        return false
      end
      return left:lower() < right:lower()
    end)
    return options
  end
  function MapTools:TeleportToMap()
    local _, map = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local character = getTeleportContext()
    if not map or not map.Parent then
      notify("Não há um mapa carregado no momento.")
      return false
    end
    if not character then
      notify("Seu personagem não está disponível para teleportar.")
      return false
    end
    local spawns = map:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
    local spawn = spawns and spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if not spawn then
      notify("Não encontrei um ponto de spawn no mapa.")
      return false
    end
    local ok = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(spawn.CFrame) end)
    if not ok then
      notify("Não foi possível teleportar para o mapa.")
      return false
    end
    allowAntiFlingTeleport()
    notify("Teleportado para " .. tostring(map:GetAttribute("MapID")) .. ".")
    return true
  end
  function MapTools:TeleportToLobby()
    local character = getTeleportContext()
    if not character then
      notify("Personagem indisponível.")
      return false
    end
    local workspace = Services.Workspace
    local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
    if not lobby then
      notify("Lobby não encontrado.")
      return false
    end
    local spawn
    for _, name in ipairs({ "LobbySpawn", "SpawnLocation", "Spawn", "SpawnPoint" }) do
      local candidate = lobby:FindFirstChild(name, true)
      if candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart") then
        spawn = candidate
        break
      end
    end
    if not spawn then
      spawn = lobby:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
    end
    local destination
    if spawn then
      destination = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
    elseif lobby:IsA("Model") then
      local box, size = lobby:GetBoundingBox()
      destination = box * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 5, 0)
    elseif lobby:IsA("BasePart") then
      destination = lobby.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, lobby.Size.Y / 2 + 4, 0)
    end
    if not destination then
      notify("Não encontrei um local válido no lobby.")
      return false
    end
    allowAntiFlingTeleport()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      character:PivotTo(destination)
      local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if root then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
      end
    end)
    if not ok then
      warn("[Exodus MM2] Lobby TP: " .. tostring(err))
      notify("Falha no teleporte.")
      return false
    end
    notify("Teleportado para o lobby.")
    return true
  end
  function MapTools:FindRoleTarget(role, includeHero)
    local data = MatchService:GetPlayerData()
    if not data then
      return nil
    end
    for name, profile in pairs(data) do
      if type(name) == "string" and type(profile) == "table" and (profile.Role == role or includeHero and role == "Sheriff" and profile.Role == "Hero") then
        local target = Services.Players:FindFirstChild(name)
        if target and isProfileLive(target, profile) then
          return target
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function MapTools:FindGunHolder()
    local data = MatchService:GetPlayerData() or {}
    for _, target in ipairs(Services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local profile = data[target.Name]
      if target ~= Player and isProfileLive(target, profile) then
        local character = target.Character
        local backpack = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
          return target
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function MapTools:TeleportToGun()
    local _, map = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local character = getTeleportContext()
    if not character then
      notify("Seu personagem não está disponível para teleportar.")
      return false
    end
    if not map or not map.Parent then
      notify("Não há uma partida em andamento.")
      return false
    end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local nearest, distance
    for _, gun in ipairs(API.Services.Drops:GetAll()) do
      local part = API.Services.Drops:GetPart(gun)
      if part then
        local gap = (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
        if not distance or gap < distance then
          nearest, distance = part, gap
        end
      end
    end
    if not nearest then
      notify("Não encontrei uma arma caída no mapa.")
      return false
    end
    allowAntiFlingTeleport()
    local ok = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(nearest.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) end)
    if not ok then
      notify("Não foi possível teleportar até a arma.")
      return false
    end
    notify("Teleportado até a arma caída.")
    return true
  end
  function MapTools:SetAutoGunTeleport(enabled)
    self.AutoGunTeleportEnabled = enabled == true
    self.LastAutoGun = nil
  end
  Runtime:TrackTask(task.spawn(function()
    while not Runtime.ShuttingDown do
      if MapTools.AutoGunTeleportEnabled then
        local _, map = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
        local gun
        if map and map.Parent then
          for _, candidate in ipairs(API.Services.Drops:GetAll()) do
            local part = API.Services.Drops:GetPart(candidate)
            if part then
              gun = part
              break
            end
          end
        end
        if gun and gun ~= MapTools.LastAutoGun then
          local character = getTeleportContext()
          if character then
            allowAntiFlingTeleport()
            local ok = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(gun.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) end)
            if ok then
              MapTools.LastAutoGun = gun
            end
          end
        elseif not gun then
          MapTools.LastAutoGun = nil
        end
      end
      task.wait(0.15)
    end
  end))
  function MapTools:TeleportToPlayer(target)
    local character = getTeleportContext()
    if not character then
      notify("Seu personagem não está disponível para teleportar.")
      return false
    end
    local targetCharacter, _, targetRoot = getLiveTarget(target, true)
    if not targetCharacter then
      notify("Escolha outro jogador vivo.")
      return false
    end
    local ok = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)) end)
    if not ok then
      notify("Não foi possível teleportar até o jogador.")
      return false
    end
    allowAntiFlingTeleport()
    notify("Teleportado até " .. target.DisplayName .. ".")
    return true
  end
  function MapTools:TeleportToRole(role)
    local target
    if role == "GunHolder" then
      target = self:FindGunHolder()
    else
      target = self:FindRoleTarget(role, role == "Sheriff")
    end
    if not target then
      notify(role == "GunHolder" and "Não encontrei alguém vivo com a arma." or "Não encontrei esse papel vivo.")
      return false
    end
    return self:TeleportToPlayer(target)
  end
  function MapTools:StopMovement(owner)
    if owner and self.MovementOwner ~= owner then
      return
    end
    self.MoveGeneration += 1
    local thread = self.MoveThread
    self.MoveThread = nil
    if thread then
      pcall(task.cancel, thread)
    end
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
      local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if root then
        pcall(function() humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) end)
      end
    end
    self.IsWalking = false
    self.MovementOwner = nil
  end
  function MapTools:WalkToPosition(destination, label, manual, isTargetValid)
    local character, humanoid, root, startedInRound = getMovementContext()
    if not character then
      notify("Você precisa estar vivo para caminhar.")
      return false
    end
    self:StopMovement()
    self.MoveGeneration += 1
    local generation = self.MoveGeneration
    self.IsWalking = true
    self.MovementOwner = manual and "manual" or "vote"
    if manual then
      self.ManualMoveUntil = os.clock() + 25
    end
    local thread
    thread = task.defer(function()
      pcall(function()
        local path = Services.PathfindingService:CreatePath({
          AgentRadius = 2,
          AgentHeight = 5,
          AgentCanJump = true,
          WaypointSpacing = 4,
        })
        local computed = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, destination) end)
        if not computed or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
          notify("Não encontrei um caminho até " .. label .. ".")
          return
        end
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
          if
            self.MoveGeneration ~= generation
            or Player.Character ~= character
            or startedInRound ~= (MatchService:GetRoundContext() == true)
            or startedInRound and Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false
            or humanoid.Health <= 0
            or isTargetValid and not isTargetValid()
          then
            return
          end
          if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
            pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
          end
          humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
          local deadline = os.clock() + math.max((root.Position - waypoint.Position).Magnitude / math.max(humanoid.WalkSpeed, 1) + 2, 3)
          while
            self.MoveGeneration == generation
            and (root.Position - waypoint.Position).Magnitude > 3
            and os.clock() < deadline
            and startedInRound == (MatchService:GetRoundContext() == true)
            and (not startedInRound or Player:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false)
            and (not isTargetValid or isTargetValid())
          do
            Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
          end
          if self.MoveGeneration ~= generation then
            return
          end
          if isTargetValid and not isTargetValid() then
            notify("O jogador não está mais disponível.")
            return
          end
          if (root.Position - waypoint.Position).Magnitude > 3 then
            notify("O caminho até " .. label .. " foi interrompido.")
            return
          end
        end
        if self.MoveGeneration == generation then
          notify("Você chegou até " .. label .. ".")
        end
      end)
      if self.MoveGeneration == generation then
        self.MoveThread = nil
        self.IsWalking = false
        self.MovementOwner = nil
      end
    end)
    self.MoveThread = Runtime:TrackTask(thread)
    return true
  end
  function MapTools:WalkToPlayer(target)
    local inRound = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local targetCharacter, _, targetRoot = getLiveTarget(target, inRound)
    if not targetCharacter then
      notify("Escolha outro jogador vivo.")
      return false
    end
    return self:WalkToPosition(
      targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3),
      target.DisplayName,
      true,
      function() return getLiveTarget(target, inRound) ~= nil end
    )
  end
  local function normalizeMapName(value) return string.lower(tostring(value)):gsub("[%s%d_%-]", "") end
  function MapTools:GetVoteBoard()
    local lobby = Services.Workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
    local pads = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads")
    if not lobby or not pads then
      return {}
    end
    local board = {}
    for index = 1, 3 do
      local pad = lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePad" .. index)
      local detector = pads:FindFirstChild("Detector" .. index)
      local mapName
      if pad and detector and detector:IsA("BasePart") then
        for _, descendant in ipairs(pad:GetDescendants()) do
          if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") and descendant.Name == "MapName" then
            mapName = descendant.Text
            break
          end
        end
        if mapName and mapName ~= "" and mapName ~= "MAP NAME" then
          table.insert(board, { Name = mapName, Detector = detector })
        end
      end
    end
    return board
  end
  function MapTools:FindFavouriteVote(board)
    for _, favourite in ipairs(self.FavoriteMaps) do
      local wanted = normalizeMapName(favourite)
      for _, entry in ipairs(board) do
        local candidate = normalizeMapName(entry.Name)
        if candidate == wanted or wanted ~= "" and (candidate:find(wanted, 1, true) or wanted:find(candidate, 1, true)) then
          return entry
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function MapTools:VoteLoop()
    if self.VoteThread or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local thread
    thread = task.defer(function()
      while #self.FavoriteMaps > 0 and not Runtime.ShuttingDown do
        if not MatchService:GetRoundContext() and os.clock() >= self.ManualMoveUntil then
          local entry = self:FindFavouriteVote(self:GetVoteBoard())
          local character, humanoid, root = getMovementContext()
          if entry and character and humanoid and not self.IsWalking and (root.Position - entry.Detector.Position).Magnitude > 4.5 then
            self:WalkToPosition(entry.Detector.Position, "a votação de " .. entry.Name, false)
          end
        end
        task.wait(2)
      end
      if self.VoteThread == thread then
        self.VoteThread = nil
      end
    end)
    self.VoteThread = Runtime:TrackTask(thread)
  end
  function MapTools:SetFavoriteMaps(favorites)
    self.FavoriteMaps = {}
    if type(favorites) == "string" and favorites ~= "" and favorites ~= "None" and favorites ~= "Nenhum" then
      table.insert(self.FavoriteMaps, favorites)
    elseif type(favorites) == "table" then
      for _, name in ipairs(favorites) do
        if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then
          table.insert(self.FavoriteMaps, name)
        end
      end
    end
    if #self.FavoriteMaps > 0 then
      self:VoteLoop()
    else
      if self.VoteThread then
        pcall(task.cancel, self.VoteThread)
        self.VoteThread = nil
      end
      self:StopMovement("vote")
    end
  end
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function()
    MapTools:StopMovement()
    if MapTools.VoteThread then
      pcall(task.cancel, MapTools.VoteThread)
      MapTools.VoteThread = nil
    end
  end)
  return MapTools
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2match
-- [[ shared MM2 round state ]]
local function create(API)
  local services, player, runtime = API.Roblox, API.Player, API.Runtime
  local Match = { Data = nil, DataAt = 0, NextPoll = 0, Polling = false, Generation = 0, RoundEnded = false }
  local request, requestTimer
  local function gameplay()
    local remotes = services.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    return remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
  end
  function Match:GetRemote(names, class)
    local folder = gameplay()
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
      local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
      if remote and remote:IsA(class) then
        return remote
      end
      remote = services.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name, true)
      if remote and remote:IsA(class) then
        return remote
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function normalize(data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    data = type(data.PlayerData) == "table" and data.PlayerData or data
    local profiles = {}
    for key, profile in pairs(data) do
      if type(profile) == "table" then
        local target = services.Players:FindFirstChild(tostring(key))
        local id = tonumber(key)
        if not target and id then
          target = services.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
        end
        local name = target and target.Name or type(key) == "string" and key
        if name then
          profiles[name] = profile
        end
      end
    end
    return profiles
  end
  function Match:Invalidate(ended)
    self.Generation += 1
    self.Data, self.DataAt, self.NextPoll, self.Polling = nil, 0, 0, false
    if ended ~= nil then
      self.RoundEnded = ended
    end
    if request then
      pcall(task.cancel, request)
      request = nil
    end
    if requestTimer then
      pcall(task.cancel, requestTimer)
      requestTimer = nil
    end
  end
  function Match:GetRoundContext()
    if self.RoundEnded then
      return false
    end
    for _, map in ipairs(services.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
      if map:IsA("Model") and (map:GetAttribute("MapID") ~= nil or map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")) then
        local container = map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
        if container and not (container:IsA("Folder") or container:IsA("Model")) then
          container = nil
        end
        return true, map, container
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function Match:Poll()
    local now = os.clock()
    if self.Polling or now < self.NextPoll or runtime.ShuttingDown or self.RoundEnded then
      return
    end
    self.NextPoll = now + 0.5
    local remote = self:GetRemote({ "GetCurrentPlayerData", "GetPlayerData" }, "RemoteFunction")
    if not remote then
      return
    end
    self.Polling = true
    local generation = self.Generation
    request = runtime:TrackTask(task.spawn(function()
      local ok, data = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer() end)
      if self.Generation ~= generation or runtime.ShuttingDown then
        return
      end
      if ok and type(data) == "table" then
        self.Data, self.DataAt = normalize(data), os.clock()
      end
      self.Polling = false
      if requestTimer then
        pcall(task.cancel, requestTimer)
        requestTimer = nil
      end
    end))
    if self.Polling then
      requestTimer = runtime:TrackTask(task.delay(4, function()
        requestTimer = nil
        if self.Generation == generation and self.Polling then
          self:Invalidate()
        end
      end))
    end
  end
  function Match:GetPlayerData()
    self:Poll()
    if os.clock() - self.DataAt <= 3 then
      return self.Data
    end
    return nil
  end
  function Match:IsAlive(target, profile)
    if not target or target:GetAttribute("Alive") == false or type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true then
      return false
    end
    local character = target.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return character ~= nil and character:IsDescendantOf(services.Workspace) and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
  end
  function Match:GetLocalRole()
    local data = self:GetPlayerData()
    local mine = data and data[player.Name]
    return type(mine) == "table" and mine.Role or nil
  end
  function Match:GetContext()
    local active, _, container = self:GetRoundContext()
    local data = self:GetPlayerData()
    if not active or not self:IsAlive(player, data and data[player.Name]) then
      return false
    end
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
      return false
    end
    return true, character, character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), root, container
  end
  local events = {}
  local function bind(name, callback)
    local event = Match:GetRemote({ name }, "RemoteEvent")
    local previous = events[name]
    if previous and previous.remote == event then
      return
    end
    if previous then
      previous.connection:Disconnect()
      events[name] = nil
    end
    if event then
      events[name] = { remote = event, connection = runtime:Track(event.OnClientEvent:Connect(callback)) }
    end
  end
  runtime:TrackTask(task.spawn(function()
    while not runtime.ShuttingDown do
      Match:Poll()
      bind("RoundEndFade", function() Match:Invalidate(true) end)
      bind("RoundStart", function() Match:Invalidate(false) end)
      bind("PlayerDataChanged", function(patch)
        if Match.RoundEnded then
          return
        end
        local data = normalize(patch)
        if not data then
          return
        end
        -- CurrentRoundClient publishes a complete snapshot, not a delta.
        if not Match:GetRemote({ "GetCurrentPlayerData" }, "RemoteFunction") then
          local merged = table.clone(Match.Data or {})
          for name, profile in pairs(data) do
            merged[name] = profile
          end
          data = merged
        end
        Match.Data, Match.DataAt = data, os.clock()
      end)
      task.wait(0.5)
    end
  end))
  runtime:OnShutdown(function() Match:Invalidate(true) end)
  return Match
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2pickup
-- [[ autogunpickup ]]

local function create(API)
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Player = API.Player
  local Runtime = API.Runtime
  local Util = API.Util
  local MatchService = API.Services.Match
  local Workspace = Services.Workspace
  local ReplicatedStorage = Services.ReplicatedStorage
  local PathfindingService = Services.PathfindingService
  local SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.12
  local ROLE_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 0.75
  local RETRY_DELAY = 0.8
  local KNIFE_REACH = 12
  local MIN_SAFE_GAP = KNIFE_REACH * 1.6
  local RUN_SPEED_FLOOR = 16
  local DEFAULT_THROW_REACH = 70

  -- state
  local Pickup = {
    Enabled = false,
    Busy = false,
    SafetyEnabled = false,
    Thread = nil,
    Generation = 0,
    ActiveMap = nil,
    ActiveHumanoid = nil,
    ActiveRoot = nil,
    Touching = false,
    RoleData = nil,
    RoleDataAt = 0,
    NextRoleRefreshAt = 0,
    NextAttemptAt = 0,
    RetryAfter = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    Failures = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    ThreatPathCache = nil,
    HuntRoot = nil,
    HuntGap = nil,
    HuntGapAt = 0,
    HuntUntil = 0,
    ObservedThrowDistance = nil,
    ThrowObservedAt = 0,
    KnifeThrownConnection = nil,
    PlayerDataConnection = nil,
    LastErrorAt = 0,
  }

  -- executorinput
  local function getTouchFunction()
    local ok, touchFunction = pcall(function() return firetouchinterest end)
    if ok and type(touchFunction) == "function" then
      return touchFunction
    end
    return nil
  end

  -- diagnostics
  function Pickup:ReportError(context, errorMessage)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - self.LastErrorAt < 5 then
      return
    end
    self.LastErrorAt = now
    warn("[Exodus MM2] Auto Pick Up Gun recuperando após erro em " .. context .. ": " .. tostring(errorMessage))
  end

  -- mapbounds
  local boundsCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local function pointInModel(model, position, padding)
    if not model or not model:IsA("Model") or not Util.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
      return nil
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    local bounds = boundsCache[model]
    if not bounds or now - bounds.At > 3 then
      local ok, cframe, size = pcall(function() return model:GetBoundingBox() end)
      if not ok or not cframe or not size then
        boundsCache[model] = nil
        return nil
      end
      bounds = { CFrame = cframe, Size = size, At = now }
      boundsCache[model] = bounds
    end
    local point = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
    padding = math.max(tonumber(padding) or 0, 0)
    return math.abs(point.X) <= bounds.Size.X * 0.5 + padding
      and math.abs(point.Y) <= bounds.Size.Y * 0.5 + padding
      and math.abs(point.Z) <= bounds.Size.Z * 0.5 + padding
  end
  local function isInLobby(position)
    local lobby = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
    if not lobby then
      return false
    end
    return pointInModel(lobby, position, 20) ~= false
  end

  -- roledata
  function Pickup:GetRoleData()
    self.RoleData = MatchService:GetPlayerData()
    self.RoleDataAt = os.clock()
    return self.RoleData
  end
  local function isProfileDead(profile) return type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true end
  function Pickup:GetActiveContext()
    local active, map, container = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if
      not active
      or not map
      or not character
      or not humanoid
      or humanoid.Health <= 0
      or not root
      or not root:IsA("BasePart")
      or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
    then
      return false
    end
    if Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      return false
    end
    local roleData = self:GetRoleData()
    local profile = roleData and roleData[Player.Name]
    if type(profile) == "table" and (profile.Role == "Murderer" or profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true) then
      return false
    end
    if self.ActiveMap ~= map then
      self.ActiveMap = map
      self.NextAttemptAt = 0
      self.RetryAfter = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
      self.Failures = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    end
    return true, character, humanoid, root, container, map, roleData
  end

  -- inventory
  function Pickup:HasGun(character)
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
      return true
    end
    local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return backpack ~= nil and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
  end
  function Pickup:HasKnife(character)
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
      return true
    end
    local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return backpack ~= nil and backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife") ~= nil
  end

  -- gunlookup
  local function getGunPart(instance)
    if not instance or not instance.Parent or not instance:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
      return nil
    end
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
      return instance
    end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then
      return instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end
    return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
  end
  local function gunStillThere(gun) return gun ~= nil and gun.Parent ~= nil and gun:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) end
  function Pickup:GetNearestDroppedGun(root)
    local nearest, nearestPart, nearestDistance
    for _, gun in ipairs(API.Services.Drops:GetAll()) do
      local part = getGunPart(gun)
      if part then
        local distance = (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
        if not nearestDistance or distance < nearestDistance then
          nearest, nearestPart, nearestDistance = gun, part, distance
        end
      end
    end
    return nearest, nearestPart, nearestDistance
  end

  -- threatgeometry
  local function flatDistance(from, to) return Vector3.new(from.X - to.X, 0, from.Z - to.Z).Magnitude end
  local function makeThreatRayParams(threatRoot)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
      Player.Character,
      threatRoot and threatRoot.Parent,
    }
    params.RespectCanCollide = true
    return params
  end
  function Pickup:GetThreatGap(position, threatRoot)
    if not threatRoot or not threatRoot.Parent or not Util.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
      return math.huge
    end
    local delta = threatRoot.Position - position
    local flat = flatDistance(position, threatRoot.Position)
    local vertical = math.abs(delta.Y)
    if vertical < 6 then
      return flat
    end
    if threatRoot.Position.Y > position.Y - 2 and vertical < 40 then
      return flat + vertical * 0.5
    end
    local distance = flat + vertical * 3
    if flat < 80 then
      local rayOk, obstruction = pcall(function() return Workspace:Raycast(threatRoot.Position, -delta, makeThreatRayParams(threatRoot)) end)
      if rayOk and obstruction then
        distance += 40
      end
    end
    return distance
  end
  local function gapToRoute(from, to, threatRoot)
    local a = Vector3.new(from.X, 0, from.Z)
    local b = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z)
    local threat = Vector3.new(threatRoot.Position.X, 0, threatRoot.Position.Z)
    local segment = b - a
    local length = segment.Magnitude
    local gap
    if length < 0.01 then
      gap = (threat - a).Magnitude
    else
      local along = math.clamp((threat - a):Dot(segment) / (length * length), 0, 1)
      gap = (threat - (a + segment * along)).Magnitude
    end
    if math.abs(threatRoot.Position.Y - from.Y) >= 6 then
      gap += 30
    end
    return gap
  end
  function Pickup:GetThrowReach()
    if self.ObservedThrowDistance and os.clock() - self.ThrowObservedAt <= 30 then
      return math.clamp(self.ObservedThrowDistance * 1.15, KNIFE_REACH + 6, 250)
    end
    return DEFAULT_THROW_REACH
  end
  function Pickup:CanMurdererSee(position, threatRoot)
    if not threatRoot or not threatRoot.Parent then
      return false
    end
    local params = makeThreatRayParams(threatRoot)
    for _, lift in ipairs({ 1.5, 0, 3 }) do
      local start = threatRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
      local destination = position + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
      local ok, obstruction = pcall(function() return Workspace:Raycast(start, destination - start, params) end)
      if ok and not obstruction then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function Pickup:IsMurdererDangerous(position, threatRoot)
    local gap = self:GetThreatGap(position, threatRoot)
    if gap < KNIFE_REACH + 8 then
      return true
    end
    return gap < self:GetThrowReach() and self:CanMurdererSee(position, threatRoot)
  end

  -- murdererlookup
  function Pickup:GetMurdererRoot(character, root, map, roleData)
    if self:HasKnife(character) then
      return nil
    end
    roleData = roleData or self:GetRoleData()
    if not roleData then
      return nil
    end
    for playerName, profile in pairs(roleData) do
      if playerName ~= Player.Name and type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role == "Murderer" and not isProfileDead(profile) then
        local target = Services.Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)
        local targetCharacter = target and target.Character
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local threatRoot = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if
          target
          and target:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
          and targetHumanoid
          and targetHumanoid.Health > 0
          and threatRoot
          and threatRoot:IsA("BasePart")
          and threatRoot:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
          and pointInModel(map, threatRoot.Position, 20) == true
          and not isInLobby(threatRoot.Position)
        then
          if self:HasGun(character) and self:GetThreatGap(root.Position, threatRoot) >= KNIFE_REACH + 6 then
            return nil
          end
          return target, threatRoot
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function Pickup:GetMurdererPace(threatRoot)
    if not threatRoot or not threatRoot.Parent then
      return RUN_SPEED_FLOOR
    end
    local velocity = threatRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    return math.max(RUN_SPEED_FLOOR, Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude)
  end
  function Pickup:IsMurdererHunting(root, threatRoot)
    if not threatRoot or not threatRoot.Parent then
      self.HuntRoot = nil
      self.HuntGap = nil
      self.HuntUntil = 0
      return false
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    local gap = self:GetThreatGap(root.Position, threatRoot)
    if self.HuntRoot ~= threatRoot then
      self.HuntRoot = threatRoot
      self.HuntGap = gap
      self.HuntGapAt = now
    end
    local toward = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - threatRoot.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z - threatRoot.Position.Z)
    local velocity = threatRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local heading = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
    if heading.Magnitude <= 4 then
      local look = threatRoot.CFrame.LookVector
      heading = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
    end
    local facing = heading.Magnitude > 0.1 and toward.Magnitude > 0.01 and heading.Unit:Dot(toward.Unit) > 0.5
    local shrinking = now - self.HuntGapAt < 3 and self.HuntGap ~= nil and gap < self.HuntGap - 1
    self.HuntGap = gap
    self.HuntGapAt = now
    if (facing and shrinking) or self:IsMurdererDangerous(root.Position, threatRoot) then
      self.HuntUntil = now + 4
      return true
    end
    return now < self.HuntUntil
  end

  -- navigation
  local function createPath(from, to)
    local ok, path = pcall(
      function()
        return PathfindingService:CreatePath({
          AgentRadius = 2,
          AgentHeight = 5,
          AgentCanJump = true,
          AgentCanClimb = true,
          WaypointSpacing = 4,
        })
      end
    )
    if not ok or not path then
      return nil
    end
    local computeOk = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(from, to) end)
    if not computeOk or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
      return nil
    end
    local waypointsOk, waypoints = pcall(function() return path:GetWaypoints() end)
    if not waypointsOk or type(waypoints) ~= "table" or #waypoints == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    return waypoints
  end
  local function pathLength(from, waypoints)
    local length = 0
    local previous = from
    for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
      length += (waypoint.Position - previous).Magnitude
      previous = waypoint.Position
    end
    return length
  end
  function Pickup:GetThreatWalkDistance(threatRoot, gun, map)
    local now = os.clock()
    local cache = self.ThreatPathCache
    if cache and cache.ThreatRoot == threatRoot and cache.Gun == gun and cache.Map == map and now - cache.At < 0.6 then
      return cache.Distance
    end
    local part = getGunPart(gun)
    local distance = math.huge
    if part and threatRoot and threatRoot.Parent then
      local waypoints = createPath(threatRoot.Position, part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
      if waypoints then
        distance = pathLength(threatRoot.Position, waypoints)
      end
    end
    self.ThreatPathCache = {
      ThreatRoot = threatRoot,
      Gun = gun,
      Map = map,
      At = now,
      Distance = distance,
    }
    return distance
  end
  function Pickup:IsRouteSafe(waypoints, from, humanoid, threatRoot, firstWaypoint)
    if not self.SafetyEnabled or not threatRoot then
      return true
    end
    local chased = self.ActiveRoot ~= nil and self:IsMurdererHunting(self.ActiveRoot, threatRoot) or false
    local speed = math.max(RUN_SPEED_FLOOR, tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed) or RUN_SPEED_FLOOR)
    local previous = from
    local walked = 0
    for index = firstWaypoint or 1, #waypoints do
      local position = waypoints[index].Position
      walked += (position - previous).Magnitude
      previous = position
      local murdererDistance = self:GetThreatGap(position, threatRoot)
      if murdererDistance < MIN_SAFE_GAP then
        return false
      end
      local myTime = walked / speed
      local murdererTime = murdererDistance / self:GetMurdererPace(threatRoot)
      local margin = chased and 0.5 or 0.15
      if murdererTime <= myTime + margin then
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end

  -- safetychecks
  function Pickup:IsSafeToApproach(root, humanoid, gun, gunPart, map, roleData, waypoints)
    if not self.SafetyEnabled then
      return true, nil
    end
    local _, threatRoot = self:GetMurdererRoot(Player.Character, root, map, roleData)
    if not threatRoot then
      return true, nil
    end
    local gunDistance = waypoints and pathLength(root.Position, waypoints) or (root.Position - gunPart.Position).Magnitude
    local threatToPlayer = self:GetThreatGap(root.Position, threatRoot)
    local threatToGun = self:GetThreatGap(gunPart.Position, threatRoot)
    local directThreatToGun = (threatRoot.Position - gunPart.Position).Magnitude
    local lineGap = gapToRoute(root.Position, gunPart.Position, threatRoot)
    local murdererPathDistance = self:GetThreatWalkDistance(threatRoot, gun, map)
    if self:IsMurdererDangerous(root.Position, threatRoot) or self:IsMurdererDangerous(gunPart.Position, threatRoot) then
      return false, threatRoot
    end
    if threatToPlayer < math.max(40, gunDistance) then
      return false, threatRoot
    end
    if threatToGun < 45 or lineGap < 25 or directThreatToGun < 30 or murdererPathDistance < 60 then
      return false, threatRoot
    end
    if waypoints and not self:IsRouteSafe(waypoints, root.Position, humanoid, threatRoot) then
      return false, threatRoot
    end
    return true, threatRoot
  end
  function Pickup:ShouldReplan(root, gunPart, threatRoot)
    if not self.SafetyEnabled or not threatRoot then
      return false
    end
    return self:GetThreatGap(root.Position, threatRoot) < 40
      or gapToRoute(root.Position, gunPart.Position, threatRoot) < 25
      or self:IsMurdererDangerous(root.Position, threatRoot)
  end

  -- routemovement
  function Pickup:RouteStillValid(character, humanoid, root, container, map, gun, requireGun)
    if
      not self.Enabled
      or Runtime.ShuttingDown
      or Player.Character ~= character
      or not character.Parent
      or not humanoid.Parent
      or humanoid.Health <= 0
      or not root.Parent
      or Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false
      or self:HasGun(character)
      or container and container.Parent ~= map
      or map.Parent ~= Workspace
      or select(2, MatchService:GetRoundContext()) ~= map
      or pointInModel(map, root.Position, 20) ~= true
      or isInLobby(root.Position)
      or requireGun and not gunStillThere(gun)
    then
      return false
    end
    local roleData = self:GetRoleData()
    local profile = roleData and roleData[Player.Name]
    return type(roleData) == "table" and type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role == "Innocent" and not isProfileDead(profile)
  end
  function Pickup:FollowWaypoints(character, humanoid, root, container, map, gun, waypoints, mode, generation)
    if #waypoints <= 1 then
      return "arrived"
    end
    local nextSafetyCheck = 0
    local lastEscapeGap
    for index = 2, #waypoints do
      local waypoint = waypoints[index]
      if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
        pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
      end
      humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
      local segmentDistance = (root.Position - waypoint.Position).Magnitude
      local speed = math.max(RUN_SPEED_FLOOR, tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed) or RUN_SPEED_FLOOR)
      local deadline = os.clock() + math.max(segmentDistance / speed + 1.5, 2)
      while (root.Position - waypoint.Position).Magnitude > 3 do
        if mode == "pickup" and self:HasGun(character) then
          return "collected"
        end
        if self.Generation ~= generation or not self:RouteStillValid(character, humanoid, root, container, map, gun, mode == "pickup") then
          return "stopped"
        end
        if mode == "escape" and os.clock() - nextSafetyCheck > 0.15 and self.SafetyEnabled then
          nextSafetyCheck = os.clock()
          local _, threatRoot = self:GetMurdererRoot(character, root, map)
          if threatRoot then
            local gap = self:GetThreatGap(root.Position, threatRoot)
            if lastEscapeGap and gap < lastEscapeGap - 4 then
              return "replan"
            end
            lastEscapeGap = gap
          end
        end
        if mode == "pickup" and self.SafetyEnabled and os.clock() >= nextSafetyCheck then
          nextSafetyCheck = os.clock() + 0.15
          local _, threatRoot = self:GetMurdererRoot(character, root, map)
          if threatRoot then
            local currentGunPart = getGunPart(gun)
            if not currentGunPart then
              return "gone"
            end
            if self:ShouldReplan(root, currentGunPart, threatRoot) then
              return "replan"
            end
            if not self:IsRouteSafe(waypoints, root.Position, humanoid, threatRoot, index) then
              return "replan"
            end
          end
        end
        if os.clock() >= deadline then
          return "stuck"
        end
        Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
      end
    end
    return "arrived"
  end
  function Pickup:TryEscape(character, humanoid, root, container, map, threatRoot, generation)
    if not threatRoot or not threatRoot.Parent then
      return false
    end
    local here = root.Position
    local initialGap = self:GetThreatGap(here, threatRoot)
    if initialGap >= 60 then
      return false
    end
    local away = Vector3.new(here.X - threatRoot.Position.X, 0, here.Z - threatRoot.Position.Z)
    if away.Magnitude < 0.01 then
      local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
      away = Vector3.new(-look.X, 0, -look.Z)
    end
    if away.Magnitude < 0.01 then
      return false
    end
    away = away.Unit
    local bestWaypoints, bestScore
    for _, angle in ipairs({ 0, 45, -45, 90, -90, 135, -135, 180 }) do
      local direction = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(angle), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(away)
      local destination = here + direction * 32 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
      if pointInModel(map, destination, 20) == true then
        local waypoints = createPath(here, destination)
        if waypoints then
          local previous = here
          local previousGap = initialGap
          local routeSafe = true
          for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            local gap = self:GetThreatGap(waypoint.Position, threatRoot)
            if gap < previousGap - 4 then
              routeSafe = false
              break
            end
            previousGap = gap
          end
          local score = previousGap - pathLength(here, waypoints) * 0.2
          if routeSafe and previousGap > initialGap + 3 and (not bestScore or score > bestScore) then
            bestWaypoints = waypoints
            bestScore = score
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if bestWaypoints then
      self:FollowWaypoints(character, humanoid, root, container, map, nil, bestWaypoints, "escape", generation)
      return true
    end
    local deadline = os.clock() + 0.4
    while os.clock() < deadline and self.Generation == generation and self:RouteStillValid(character, humanoid, root, container, map, nil, false) do
      humanoid:Move(away, false)
      Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
    humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
    return true
  end

  -- referencepickup
  function Pickup:TryPickup()
    if self.Busy or not self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown or os.clock() < self.NextAttemptAt then
      return
    end
    local ready, character, humanoid, root, _, map, roleData = self:GetActiveContext()
    if not ready or self:HasGun(character) then
      return
    end
    local gun, part = self:GetNearestDroppedGun(root)
    if not gun or not part then
      return
    end
    local touch = getTouchFunction()
    if not touch then
      self:ReportError("touch", "firetouchinterest indisponível")
      self.NextAttemptAt = os.clock() + 2
      return
    end
    self.Busy = true
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      if self.SafetyEnabled and not self:IsSafeToApproach(root, humanoid, gun, part, map, roleData) then
        return
      end
      if not self.Enabled or not gunStillThere(gun) then
        return
      end
      self.Touching = { touch = touch, root = root, part = part }
      touch(root, part, 0)
      Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end)
    self:ReleaseTouch()
    self.Busy = false
    self.NextAttemptAt = os.clock() + (ok and 0.4 or 1)
    if not ok then
      self:ReportError("coleta", err)
    end
  end
  function Pickup:ReleaseTouch()
    local active = self.Touching
    self.Touching = nil
    if type(active) == "table" then
      pcall(active.touch, active.root, active.part, 1)
    end
  end

  -- knifethrowobservation
  local function observeKnifeThrow()
    if Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local _, character, _, root, _, map, roleData = Pickup:GetActiveContext()
    if not character or not root or not map then
      return
    end
    local _, threatRoot = Pickup:GetMurdererRoot(character, root, map, roleData)
    if not threatRoot then
      return
    end
    local distance = (root.Position - threatRoot.Position).Magnitude
    if distance < KNIFE_REACH or distance > 400 then
      return
    end
    local previous = Pickup.ObservedThrowDistance
    Pickup.ObservedThrowDistance = previous and math.max(previous * 0.7 + distance * 0.3, distance) or distance
    Pickup.ThrowObservedAt = os.clock()
  end
  local function connectKnifeThrown(generation)
    local ok, service = pcall(function()
      local clientServices = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 5)
      local module = clientServices and clientServices:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 5)
      if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        return nil
      end
      return require(module)
    end)
    if not ok or type(service) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    if not Pickup.Enabled or Pickup.Generation ~= generation or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local signal = rawget(service, "KnifeThrown")
    if not signal then
      return
    end
    local connectOk, connection = pcall(function()
      if typeof(signal) == "Instance" and signal:IsA("BindableEvent") then
        return signal.Event:Connect(observeKnifeThrow)
      end
      return signal:Connect(observeKnifeThrow)
    end)
    if connectOk and connection then
      Pickup.KnifeThrownConnection = Runtime:Track(connection)
    end
  end
  local function connectPlayerDataChanges()
    local remote = MatchService:GetRemote({ "PlayerDataChanged" }, "RemoteEvent")
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      return
    end
    local ok, connection = pcall(function()
      return remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(changes)
        if type(changes) ~= "table" then
          return
        end
        if not Pickup.RoleData then
          Pickup.NextRoleRefreshAt = 0
          return
        end
        for playerName, profile in pairs(changes) do
          if type(playerName) == "string" and type(profile) == "table" then
            Pickup.RoleData[playerName] = profile
          end
        end
        Pickup.RoleDataAt = os.clock()
        Pickup.NextRoleRefreshAt = Pickup.RoleDataAt + ROLE_REFRESH_INTERVAL
      end)
    end)
    if ok and connection then
      Pickup.PlayerDataConnection = Runtime:Track(connection)
    end
  end

  -- lifecycle
  function Pickup:SetSafetyEnabled(enabled)
    self.SafetyEnabled = enabled == true
    return self.SafetyEnabled
  end
  function Pickup:Start()
    if self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    self.Enabled = true
    self.Generation += 1
    self.NextAttemptAt = 0
    self.NextRoleRefreshAt = 0
    local generation = self.Generation
    local thread
    thread = task.spawn(function()
      while self.Enabled and self.Generation == generation and not Runtime.ShuttingDown do
        local ok, errorMessage = xpcall(function() self:TryPickup() end, Util.FormatError)
        if not ok then
          self:ReportError("ciclo", errorMessage)
        end
        task.wait(SCAN_INTERVAL)
      end
      if self.Thread == thread then
        self.Thread = nil
      end
    end)
    self.Thread = thread
    connectPlayerDataChanges()
    local throwThread = task.spawn(connectKnifeThrown, generation)
    Runtime:TrackTask(throwThread)
  end
  function Pickup:Stop()
    self.Enabled = false
    self.Generation += 1
    self.NextAttemptAt = 0
    self:ReleaseTouch()
    local thread = self.Thread
    self.Thread = nil
    if thread then
      pcall(task.cancel, thread)
    end
    self.Busy = false
    if self.KnifeThrownConnection then
      pcall(function() self.KnifeThrownConnection:Disconnect() end)
      self.KnifeThrownConnection = nil
    end
    if self.PlayerDataConnection then
      pcall(function() self.PlayerDataConnection:Disconnect() end)
      self.PlayerDataConnection = nil
    end
    self.ActiveHumanoid = nil
    self.ActiveRoot = nil
  end
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function() Pickup:Stop() end)
  return Pickup
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

--!optimize 2
-- @modules mm2shoot
-- [[ shootmurder ]]

-- code

local function create(API)
  local Players = API.Roblox.Players
  local Services = API.Roblox
  local Workspace = API.Roblox.Workspace
  local Player = API.Player
  local Runtime = API.Runtime
  local MatchService = API.Services.Match
  local Randomizer = Random.new()
  local ShootMurder = {
    ManualEnabled = false,
    AutoEnabled = false,
    ManualAccuracy = 100,
    AutoAccuracy = 100,
    WaitForKnife = false,
    RoleData = nil,
    RoleDataAt = 0,
    NextRoleRefreshAt = 0,
    NextRoleWarningAt = 0,
    Destroyed = false,
  }

  local function getAliveCharacter(target, profile)
    if type(profile) ~= "table" or profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true or not target or target:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      return nil
    end
    local character = target.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
      return nil
    end
    return character, humanoid, root
  end
  local function notify(content) API.Notify("Shoot Murder", content) end
  function ShootMurder:RefreshRoleData()
    self.RoleData = MatchService:GetPlayerData()
    self.RoleDataAt = os.clock()
    return self.RoleData
  end
  function ShootMurder:HasSheriffRole()
    local profile = self.RoleData and self.RoleData[Player.Name]
    return type(profile) == "table" and (profile.Role == "Sheriff" or profile.Role == "Hero") and profile.Dead ~= true and profile.Killed ~= true
  end
  function ShootMurder:IsLocalMurderer()
    local profile = self.RoleData and self.RoleData[Player.Name]
    return type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role == "Murderer"
  end
  function ShootMurder:WarnRoleRequired()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < self.NextRoleWarningAt then
      return
    end
    self.NextRoleWarningAt = now + 10
    notify("Você precisa ser Xerife ou Herói para atirar.")
  end
  function ShootMurder:GetLocalContext()
    local inRound = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    if not inRound or Player:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
      return nil
    end
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local profile = self.RoleData and self.RoleData[Player.Name]
    local roleCanShoot = type(profile) == "table" and (profile.Role == "Sheriff" or profile.Role == "Hero")
    local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local hasGun = character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
    if
      (not roleCanShoot and not hasGun)
      or type(profile) == "table" and (profile.Dead == true or profile.Killed == true)
      or not character
      or not humanoid
      or humanoid.Health <= 0
      or not root
      or not root:IsA("BasePart")
      or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
    then
      return nil
    end
    return character, humanoid, root
  end
  function ShootMurder:GetMurderer()
    if not self.RoleData then
      return nil
    end
    for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local profile = self.RoleData[target.Name]
      if target ~= Player and type(profile) == "table" and profile.Role == "Murderer" then
        local character, humanoid, root = getAliveCharacter(target, profile)
        if character then
          return target, character, humanoid, root
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function ShootMurder:FindGun(character, humanoid)
    local gun = character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
    if gun and gun:IsA("Tool") then
      return gun
    end
    local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    gun = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
    if gun then
      pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(gun) end)
      if gun.Parent == character then
        return gun
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function ShootMurder:GetShotOrigin(localCharacter, gun, root)
    local attachment = root:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
      or gun:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment", true)
      or localCharacter:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment", true)
    if attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
      return attachment.WorldCFrame
    end
    local handle = gun:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
      return handle.CFrame
    end
    return root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0)
  end
  function ShootMurder:GetClearAim(character, root, gun, localCharacter, shotOrigin)
    local _, _, coinContainer = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    local ignored = { localCharacter, gun }
    if coinContainer then
      table.insert(ignored, coinContainer)
    end
    for _, instance in ipairs(Services.CollectionService:GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
      table.insert(ignored, instance)
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local origin = shotOrigin.Position
    local points = {}
    for _, name in ipairs({ "UpperTorso", "Torso", "Head", "LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart" }) do
      local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
      if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        table.insert(points, part.Position)
      end
    end
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
      if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanQuery then
        table.insert(points, part.Position)
      end
    end
    for _, point in ipairs(points) do
      local direction = point - origin
      if direction.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        local rayIgnored = table.clone(ignored)
        for _ = 1, 32 do
          params.FilterDescendantsInstances = rayIgnored
          local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
          if not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then
            return point
          end
          if not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or hit.Instance.Transparency ~= 1 then
            break
          end
          table.insert(rayIgnored, hit.Instance)
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function ShootMurder:GetShotPoint(hitPosition, accuracy)
    accuracy = math.clamp(tonumber(accuracy) or 100, 0, 100)
    local inaccuracy = (100 - accuracy) / 100
    if inaccuracy <= 0 then
      return hitPosition
    end
    local likelyMiss = Randomizer:NextNumber() < inaccuracy * 0.45
    local radius = likelyMiss and (2 + inaccuracy * 6) or (inaccuracy * 0.65)
    local direction = Vector3.new(Randomizer:NextNumber(-1, 1), Randomizer:NextNumber(-1, 1), Randomizer:NextNumber(-1, 1))
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
      direction = Vector3.xAxis
    end
    return hitPosition + direction.Unit * radius
  end
  function ShootMurder:TryShoot(automatic)
    if self.Destroyed or Runtime.ShuttingDown or not API.IsActive() then
      return false
    end
    if os.clock() < (self.NextShotAt or 0) then
      return false
    end
    if not automatic then
      self:RefreshRoleData(true)
    end
    if not self:HasSheriffRole() then
      if not automatic then
        self:WarnRoleRequired()
      end
      return false
    end
    local localCharacter, humanoid, localRoot = self:GetLocalContext()
    if not localCharacter then
      return false
    end
    local target, targetCharacter, _, targetRoot = self:GetMurderer()
    if not target then
      return false
    end
    if self.WaitForKnife and not targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
      return false
    end
    local gun = self:FindGun(localCharacter, humanoid)
    if not gun or gun.Parent ~= localCharacter or gun:GetAttribute("Disabled") == true then
      return false
    end
    local shootRemote = gun:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
    if not shootRemote or not shootRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      return false
    end
    local shotOrigin = self:GetShotOrigin(localCharacter, gun, localRoot)
    local hitPosition = self:GetClearAim(targetCharacter, targetRoot, gun, localCharacter, shotOrigin)
    if not hitPosition then
      return false
    end
    local shotPoint = self:GetShotPoint(hitPosition, automatic and self.AutoAccuracy or self.ManualAccuracy)
    local ok = pcall(function() shootRemote:FireServer(shotOrigin, CFrame.new(shotPoint)) end)
    if not ok then
      return false
    end
    self.NextShotAt = os.clock() + math.clamp(tonumber(gun:GetAttribute("FireCooldown")) or 0.3, 0.1, 5)
    return true
  end
  function ShootMurder:Update()
    if self.Destroyed then
      return
    end
    if not self.ManualEnabled and not self.AutoEnabled then
      self.RoleData = nil
      self.RoleDataAt = 0
      self.NextRoleRefreshAt = 0
      return
    end
    local inRound = MatchService:GetRoundContext()
    if not inRound then
      self.RoleData = nil
      self.RoleDataAt = 0
      self.NextRoleRefreshAt = 0
      return
    end
    self:RefreshRoleData(false)
    local localCharacter = self:GetLocalContext()
    local canShoot = localCharacter ~= nil and self:HasSheriffRole()
    if self.AutoEnabled and canShoot then
      self:TryShoot(true)
    end
  end
  function ShootMurder:SetManualEnabled(enabled) self.ManualEnabled = enabled == true end
  function ShootMurder:SetAutoEnabled(enabled) self.AutoEnabled = enabled == true end
  function ShootMurder:SetWaitForKnife(enabled) self.WaitForKnife = enabled == true end
  function ShootMurder:SetManualAccuracy(value) self.ManualAccuracy = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 100, 0, 100) end
  function ShootMurder:SetAutoAccuracy(value) self.AutoAccuracy = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 100, 0, 100) end
  function ShootMurder:Destroy()
    self.Destroyed, self.ManualEnabled, self.AutoEnabled = true, false, false
  end
  Runtime:Track(Services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if ShootMurder.Destroyed or not API.IsActive() or os.clock() < (ShootMurder.NextUpdateAt or 0) then
      return
    end
    ShootMurder.NextUpdateAt = os.clock() + 0.05
    local ok, errorMessage = pcall(function() ShootMurder:Update() end)
    if not ok then
      warn("[Exodus MM2] Shoot Murder: " .. tostring(errorMessage))
    end
  end))
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function() ShootMurder:Destroy() end)
  return ShootMurder
end
local Module = { create = create }
function Module.setup() return true end
Module.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Module

-- [[ autodark ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local AutoDark = {}
local utils
local remote
local gameInfo
local world
local connection
local configObserver
local epoch = 0

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  ENABLED_KEY = "AutoDark",
}

-- connections
local function disconnect()
  epoch += 1
  if not connection then
    return
  end
  if utils then
    utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
  end
  connection:Disconnect()
  connection = nil
end

-- synchronization
function AutoDark.sync()
  if not utils or not remote or not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue(CONFIG.ENABLED_KEY) ~= true then
    disconnect()
    return true
  end
  if connection and connection.Connected ~= false then
    return true
  end
  disconnect()
  local runService = utils.getRunService()
  if not runService or not runService.Heartbeat then
    return false, "Heartbeat indisponível"
  end
  local owner = epoch
  local lastErrorAt = -math.huge
  connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if owner ~= epoch then
      return
    end
    if not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue(CONFIG.ENABLED_KEY) ~= true then
      disconnect()
      return
    end
    if not gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled() then
      return
    end
    local camera = world.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
      return
    end
    local ok, reason = pcall(remote.fireDark, gameInfo.getDarkSealEventId(), camera.CFrame)
    if owner ~= epoch then
      return
    end
    if not ok and os.clock() - lastErrorAt >= 1 then
      lastErrorAt = os.clock()
      warn("[AutoDark] " .. tostring(reason))
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(connection)
  return true
end

-- setup
function AutoDark.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" or type(deps.Remote) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependências ausentes: Utils, GameInfo ou Remote"
  end
  AutoDark.teardown()
  utils, remote, gameInfo = deps.Utils, deps.Remote, deps.GameInfo
  configObserver = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.AutoDark ~= nil then
      AutoDark.sync()
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(configObserver)
  world = utils.getWorkspace()
  return AutoDark.sync()
end
function AutoDark.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(configObserver)
    end
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  disconnect()
  utils, remote, gameInfo, world = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- contract
AutoDark.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Remote = "remote", GameInfo = "gameinfo" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "getWorkspace", "getRunService", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "isActive", "observeConfig" },
    Remote = { "fireDark" },
    GameInfo = { "getDarkSealEventId", "areAbilitiesEnabled" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "sync", "teardown" },
}

return AutoDark

-- [[ auto dash ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local AutoDash = {}
local deflectGeometry
local utils
local gameInfo
local dash
local movement
local localPlayer
local runService
local root
local heartbeat
local lastTickAt = -math.huge
local inFlight, handledSignals = nil, {}
local exchangePartner = nil
local exchangeTarget = nil
local exchangeChanges = 0
local exchangeAt = nil

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  MAX_EXCHANGE_AGE = 1,
  MAX_EVENT_AGE = 0.2,
  MIN_UP_SPEED = 68,
  MAX_HORIZONTAL_RATIO = 0.65,
  TICK_INTERVAL = 1 / 120,
}

-- helpers
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
local function validVector(value) return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z) end

-- event-filtering
local function clearExchange()
  exchangePartner, exchangeTarget, exchangeChanges, exchangeAt = nil, nil, 0, nil
end
local function clashPartner(packetTarget)
  local time = utils.now()
  local physics = deflectGeometry.getDefensePhysics()
  local context = gameInfo.getClashContext(true)
  local snapshot = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(time)
  if
    not physics
    or physics.inClash ~= true
    or not context
    or not gameInfo.isSnapshotValid(snapshot)
    or snapshot.targetUncertain
    or snapshot.teleported
    or snapshot.locked
    or (snapshot.syncAt ~= nil and (not finite(snapshot.syncAt) or time < snapshot.syncAt or time - snapshot.syncAt > 0.5))
  then
    clearExchange()
    return nil
  end
  local partner, target = context.partnerId, packetTarget or snapshot.targetId
  if not finite(partner) or partner <= 0 or partner == localPlayer.UserId or (target ~= localPlayer.UserId and target ~= partner) then
    clearExchange()
    return nil
  end
  if exchangePartner ~= partner or (exchangeAt and (time < exchangeAt or time - exchangeAt > CONFIG.MAX_EXCHANGE_AGE)) then
    clearExchange()
    exchangePartner = partner
  end
  if exchangeTarget ~= target then
    if exchangeTarget ~= nil then
      exchangeChanges = exchangeChanges + 1
    end
    exchangeTarget, exchangeAt = target, time
  end
  if exchangeChanges < 2 then
    return nil
  end
  return partner
end
local function relevantOpponent(event) return clashPartner() == event.userId end

-- event-handling
local function onDash(event)
  local localRoot = root
  if
    not localRoot
    or not localRoot.Parent
    or inFlight
    or not utils.isActive()
    or utils.getConfigValue("AutoClashUpDash") ~= true
    or not gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled()
  then
    return
  end
  if
    type(event) ~= "table"
    or event.confirmed ~= true
    or not finite(event.signalAt)
    or not finite(event.detectedAt)
    or not validVector(event.position)
    or not validVector(event.velocity)
  then
    return
  end
  local time = utils.now()
  if not finite(event.userId) or event.userId <= 0 then
    return
  end
  if
    time < event.detectedAt
    or time - event.detectedAt > CONFIG.MAX_EVENT_AGE
    or event.userId == localPlayer.UserId
    or handledSignals[event.userId] == event.signalAt
  then
    return
  end
  local player = event.player
  if not player or player.UserId ~= event.userId then
    return
  end
  if event.signalActive ~= true or not gameInfo.isPlayerDashing(player) then
    return
  end
  local character = player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local localHumanoid = localRoot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not localHumanoid or localHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
    return
  end
  local velocity = event.velocity
  local horizontalSpeed = math.sqrt(velocity.X * velocity.X + velocity.Z * velocity.Z)
  if velocity.Y < CONFIG.MIN_UP_SPEED or horizontalSpeed > velocity.Y * CONFIG.MAX_HORIZONTAL_RATIO then
    return
  end
  if not relevantOpponent(event, localRoot) then
    return
  end
  local token = {}
  inFlight = token
  local ok, result = pcall(movement.upDash)
  if inFlight == token then
    inFlight = nil
    if ok and result == true and root == localRoot then
      handledSignals[event.userId] = event.signalAt
    end
  end
  if not ok then
    warn("[AutoDash] " .. tostring(result))
  end
end

-- setup
function AutoDash.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.DeflectGeometry) ~= "table" then
    return false, "DeflectGeometry ausente"
  end
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or not deps.Utils or not deps.GameInfo or not deps.Dash or not deps.Movement then
    return false, "dependências ausentes"
  end
  AutoDash.teardown()
  deflectGeometry = deps.DeflectGeometry
  utils, gameInfo, dash, movement = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.Dash, deps.Movement
  localPlayer, runService = utils.getLocalPlayer(), utils.getRunService()
  if not localPlayer or not runService then
    return false, "serviços indisponíveis"
  end
  dash.setHandler(onDash)
  return true
end

-- character-binding
function AutoDash.bindCharacter(character)
  AutoDash.detachCharacter()
  local newRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not newRoot or not newRoot:IsA("BasePart") or not newRoot.Parent then
    return false, "HumanoidRootPart indisponível"
  end
  root, lastTickAt = newRoot, -math.huge
  heartbeat = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not root or not root.Parent then
      return
    end
    local time = utils.now()
    if time >= lastTickAt and time - lastTickAt < CONFIG.TICK_INTERVAL then
      return
    end
    lastTickAt = time
    if not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue("AutoClashUpDash") ~= true or not gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled() then
      clearExchange()
      return
    end
    local partner = clashPartner()
    if partner then
      dash.tick(time, true, partner)
    end
  end)
  utils.trackCharacter(heartbeat)
  return true
end
function AutoDash.onBallSync(data)
  if not root or not utils or not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue("AutoClashUpDash") ~= true then
    clearExchange()
    return
  end
  if type(data) ~= "table" then
    return
  end
  if data.Teleported then
    clearExchange()
    return
  end
  clashPartner(data.TargetPlayerID)
end
function AutoDash.detachCharacter()
  root, inFlight, lastTickAt = nil, nil, -math.huge
  table.clear(handledSignals)
  clearExchange()
  if heartbeat then
    utils.untrackCharacter(heartbeat)
    heartbeat:Disconnect()
    heartbeat = nil
  end
end
function AutoDash.teardown()
  AutoDash.detachCharacter()
  if dash then
    dash.setHandler(nil)
  end
  utils, gameInfo, dash, movement, localPlayer, runService = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- contract
AutoDash.__contract = {
  requires = {
    DeflectGeometry = "deflectgeometry",
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    Dash = "dash",
    Movement = "movement",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    DeflectGeometry = { "getDefensePhysics" },
    Utils = {
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "getRunService",
      "getConfigValue",
      "isActive",
      "now",
      "trackCharacter",
      "untrackCharacter",
    },
    GameInfo = {
      "areAbilitiesEnabled",
      "getClashContext",
      "getSnapshotAt",
      "isSnapshotValid",
      "isPlayerDashing",
    },
    Dash = { "setHandler", "tick" },
    Movement = { "upDash" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "bindCharacter", "detachCharacter", "teardown", "onBallSync" },
  bindCharacter = true,
}

return AutoDash
